About the Game Explore a Massive World with 80+ Hours of Heartfelt Quests Discover eight unique regions, from the ocean's depths to an island in the clouds! Run, float, swim, and dive around the world to uncover hidden treasures and mysteries, all while listening to over 50 tracks of original music. Engage with stories both epic and cozy, from braving volcanoes filled with treacherous lava to throwing birthday parties for all your new friends, all while piecing together the ultimate secret behind Friendship Island. Befriend Iconic Characters and Create Their Perfect Gifts Whether it’s cheerful Hello Kitty, mischievous Kuromi, or sweet Cinnamoroll, there are over 40 iconic Hello Kitty and Friends characters to meet, befriend, and adventure alongside. How do you improve friendship? Cooking and crafting galore! Create beautiful recipes at cooking stations or craft the items you find into the perfect gifts for all your new friends! Each character has a unique role on the island and their own likes, activities, and interests. Once you’ve bolstered your friendship, invite your favorite characters to adventure alongside you and gain their special power-ups and abilities! Renovate cabins and decorate them to attract new visitors to the island, like Hello Kitty’s twin sister Mimmy. These new visitors can unlock special quests and even entire new storylines! Be Who You Like and Live In Style Create your perfect avatar. Choose from six species with different face options, inclusive body types, and unique colors and patterns—all based on the Hello Kitty & Friends world. Collect, discover, and customize hundreds of clothing options to find your favorite look! Buy and tailor furniture to create your dream home aesthetic, with over 30 furniture sets to mix and match and countless ways to change color, pattern, and style. Discover a Dynamic, Living World Teeming with Events There’s always something new to do on the Island with year-round events. Whether you’re celebrating the joys of summertime, ringing in a holiday, or throwing a party for a character’s special birthday, there are always new festivals (and rewards!) around the corner. Keep your eye on the weather, too! Weather events like Starfall, Rainstorms, and Steamy days will encourage new critters to appear, chests to spawn, rewards to collect, and other surprises. Enjoy Hidden Puzzles, Relaxing Gardening, and Adorable Critter Collecting Hidden puzzle ruins are scattered all over the island—test your skills to unlock bonus rewards and solve the island’s mysteries. Watch your island spring to life with flowers of all shapes and sizes! Cultivate your gardens to breed rare and exotic varieties, colors, and patterns to impress your friends (and because gardening is fun). The island is teeming with life—kick back and fish in the clear waters or hunt for rare critters with your net. Donate them to the Nature Preserve to give them a safe place to live and grow your collection. Play Together—It’s Even Better! Dive into a multiplayer game with real-world friends. Team up to explore, get bonuses, and solve challenges together. Complete social quests to level up your friendship, unlock unique emotes, and gain special bonuses like trading rare items and clothing.

title: Gore Doctor
description: Gore Doctor is an immersive horror game set to unleash spine-chilling thrills on PC. You find yourself in the institute of a tormented doctor who, driven by desperation, defies ethical boundaries to save his wife, Scarlett, from a deadly illness. As Scarlett succumbs to her fate, the doctor descends into madness and becomes convinced that death is the only respite. Players must navigate the nightmarish corridors of the doctor’s institute, confronting grotesque horrors, uncovering dark secrets, and striving to escape with their lives intact. Can you survive the twisted labyrinth and unravel the haunting mysteries within? Your journey begins within the decrepit and foreboding walls of the doctor's institute, a place once dedicated to healing but now consumed by malevolence and despair. Each step you take into the dimly lit corridors leads you deeper into a world of grotesque horrors, twisted experiments, and unspeakable terror. The atmosphere is thick with dread, and every creaking floorboard and distant moan only serves to heighten your anxiety. As you navigate the labyrinthine halls, you'll encounter grotesque abominations, born from the doctor's relentless pursuit of knowledge and power. These nightmarish creatures will stop at nothing to protect the doctor's secrets, and you must summon every ounce of courage to survive their relentless pursuit. The vivid and disturbing visuals will sear into your mind, leaving an indelible mark long after you've escaped the clutches of this nightmare. But survival alone is not enough. To truly understand the horrors that have unfolded within these walls, you must uncover the dark secrets that fester beneath the surface. Through journal entries, scattered documents, and hidden artifacts, you'll piece together the doctor's descent into madness and the terrible consequences of his actions. The truth you unearth will challenge your very perception of right and wrong, blurring the line between savior and monster. Gore Doctor is not for the faint of heart. It is a game that revels in the grotesque, pushing the boundaries of horror and gore to create an experience that will leave you breathless and disturbed. Brace yourself for a psychological rollercoaster ride, where your every nerve will be tested, and your darkest fears will be unleashed. Only the strongest will emerge from the doctor's institute with their sanity intact, but be warned, the price of survival may be higher than you can imagine. Enter at your own risk, for once you step into the twisted world of Gore Doctor, there may be no escape from its clutches.

title: A Difficult Game About Climbing
description: REACH THE PEAK Pull yourself up a treacherous mountain to reach the legendary Peak , where eternal glory and a wonderful gift awaits. This journey demands complete mastery in the legendary art of climbing. Game includes one free expansion , a completely new, bigger adventure featuring a full second chapter that’s more brutal, more ambitious, and absolutely not easier. Enjoy: No deaths or violence. Just the constant fear of falling and losing all your progress. Perhaps that is worse… Physics based climbing . Use only your mouse to control the arms of the climber. Gamepad supported. Endless suffering. The world record is under 4 minutes. You, however, will be here for hours. Possibly forever. But not: Legs... You cannot use your legs for some reason. FAILURE IS A TEACHER. EACH FALL IS A LESSON. Embark on a philosophical journey, uncover lessons of ancient wisdom and who knows... perhaps even the meaning of life itself? ETERNAL GLORY AWAITS YOU AT THE PEAK Conquer each of the 7 uniquely designed areas that make up this one colossal mountain to receive the grand prize. Expansion - Chapter 2: A completely new, bigger adventure featuring a full second chapter that’s more brutal, more ambitious, and absolutely not easier. Adds 9 completely new zones and is included with the game. “The ascent has become familiar… almost comforting. But alas, far below, within the endless water that binds earth to heaven, lies a glimmer of hope - and perhaps a deeper truth.” Note from the developer: This game is inspired by "Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy", itself a homage to an older game made by Jazzuo. I aimed to capture the magic of GOI's intensely difficult gameplay, which becomes comically easy once you master it.

title: Bullet Hell Monday: Finale
description: Dive into the thrilling world of bullet hell shooters with "Bullet Hell Monday: Finale"! Even beginners can enjoy this intense action-packed game, featuring a gentle introduction to the bullet hell genre. Get ready for an authentic bullet hell experience! In "Bullet Hell Monday: Finale," players will navigate through a barrage of bullets while taking down enemies. Upgrade your craft and aim to conquer the challenging Chapter Mode. Chapter Mode Embark on various missions in each stage, ranging from simple to challenging. By completing missions like "Defeat 30 enemies!" you'll unlock boss stages. Defeat the bosses to progress to the next chapter. Craft Upgrades Enhance your craft through a variety of level-up options, including shot power, shot speed, bomb duration, and more. Upgrade your craft and blast through the stages with devastating firepower. Beginner-Friendly The stages start off easy and gradually ramp up in intensity. You are not obligated to clear the difficult missions, so if you find yourself struggling, feel free to try your hand at another mission. Easy Mode In Chapter Mode, you can choose the difficulty level before starting a stage. Opting for Easy mode reduces enemy attacks, making it more manageable to complete the stage. If you find yourself stuck, consider selecting Easy mode for a smoother experience. Other Features The game supports various controls, including controllers, mouse and keyboard, and keyboard-only setups, allowing players to choose according to their preferences. It also offers support for vertical screen gameplay, providing an immersive experience. *The screen aspect ratios "16:9" and "16:10" are supported. For other aspect ratios and vertical screen gameplay, some menus will be displayed in a simplified format.

title: eWorlds: A 3D Platformer Adventure
description: A Story Across the Multiverse It all began with a lost signal in space. Your ship, damaged after passing through an unknown anomaly, crashes on a tropical island that doesn’t appear on any star map. Among palm trees, forgotten ruins, and mysterious technology, you soon discover the truth: you’ve landed on Lost World , a convergence point between worlds… and the first link in something far greater. This place is only the gateway to the Space HUB , an ancient interdimensional nexus capable of connecting entire realities. For centuries, the Space HUB has remained sealed, fragmented into artifacts known as Loops , scattered across the multiverse. Without them, the portals stay closed… and worlds remain isolated. The Legend of the Golden Loop Among all the Loops, one is spoken of in legend: the Golden Loop . It is said that whoever finds it will not only restore balance to the multiverse, but also uncover the true origin of the connected worlds… and the reason they began to collapse. Your mission is clear: explore every world, overcome its trials, and recover the lost Loops. But nothing will be easy. Each reality holds its own secrets, rules, and dangers. Ancient civilizations, abandoned futuristic stations, and impossible landscapes will test your wit, reflexes, and curiosity. Worlds Full of Secrets eWorlds is a classic collectathon adventure at heart, infused with mystery and discovery. Paths are not always visible—hidden platforms, alternate routes, and secret areas reveal themselves only to those willing to explore beyond the obvious. Sometimes you’ll race against the clock in intense time trials. Other times, you’ll slow down to observe your surroundings, listening to what each world has to say… because every environment has its own story waiting to be uncovered. Otherworldly Tools Progress requires more than skill alone. Throughout your journey, you’ll obtain ancient Power-Ups that transform the way you play: The Hammer , capable of breaking seemingly unmovable barriers. The Umbrella , allowing you to glide and defy gravity. The Grapple , essential for crossing dangerous gaps and treacherous terrain. These aren’t simple upgrades—they’re the key to accessing new areas, uncovering secrets, and mastering each world. Play Your Way: Co-op, PvP & Single-Player The multiverse is full of secrets waiting to be discovered. By default, you can dive into a shared multiplayer experience , teaming up with friends in co-op to face the toughest challenges together, or battling it out in PvP ! But if you prefer to carve your own path, you can easily toggle to single-player mode for a complete, uninterrupted solo adventure. Customize your journey As you explore, you’ll collect coins scattered across every world. Spend them in the Space HUB shop to unlock a variety of skins and customize your character. Mix and match to create a unique look that reflects your style as you traverse unknown realities. The multiverse awaits… will you overcome its dangers and find the legendary Golden Loop? Important note: We will only be providing support in English and Spanish, but we have automatically translated the game into other languages to enhance the experience for everyone (Italian, French, German, Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Korean, Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese). However, please keep in mind that this is not a professional translation and may contain errors.

title: Mirror Throne: Auto Battler
description: Build Your Team Build a team of JRPG inspired units with unique abilities. You will need to strategically place and synergize the characters to be successful. Battle Battles play turns automatically, where units use their special abilities on specific triggers. There are many unique strategies and powerful synergies to be discovered. A ysnc Multiplayer AND Single Player Roguelite Challenge the Mirrored Legion in a run based rogue lite mode where each run is modified by meta shifting trinkets. Or challenge your party comp skills against other player's parties in Arena Mode! Unlockables! Unlock new characters, items, trinkets, and factions after each run.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
description: Edition Comparison About the Game Fly with Purpose Launch your aviation Career wherever you choose in the world. Gain experience, build your reputation, and complete certifications to gain access to authentic aviation activities ranging from Medevac, Remote Cargo Ops, Aerial Firefighting, Search & Rescue and more, all the way to becoming an Airline Passenger Transport Pilot. Set out on a truly global aviation adventure with virtually unlimited missions across the planet. Compete against other pilots in the all-new Challenge League mode or hone your skills in dozens of Activities ranging from exciting Rally Races and Precision Landings to Low-Altitude challenges and more. Fly head-to-head in the iconic Red Bull Air Races and the legendary Reno Air Races, including the new Roswell courses. Be a World Photographer and travel across our beautiful planet to capture awe-inspiring natural vistas, visit famous landmarks, and record these adventures with pictures in your travel book. Unique photo challenges test your creative eye along with your piloting skills while you strive to capture the perfect moment. Advanced Simulation Enhanced physics system allows 10,000+ rigid-body surfaces that enable the simulation of any shape of aircraft. Soft body physics supports cloth, ropes, balloons, and more. Improved ground and water handling further enhance realism. New, highly accurate aircraft systems including electrical, pneumatic, fuel and hydraulic systems, payload and passenger systems, and avionics like the Universal UNS-1 FMS and Primus Epic 2. Preflight inspections and walkaround checks add to immersion. Plan your flights with a groundbreaking flight planner which supports both IFR and VFR map layers, IFR charts, route planning, fuel and payload planning, vertical profile planning, and ETOPS planning. It also provides airport information including weather and NOTAMS and is available native in the sim, on mobile devices or web browsers for flight planning outside the simulator. Explore Our Visually Stunning Digital Twin Explore our most detailed re-creation of planet Earth to date. Enhanced digital elevation maps, over 500 TIN (triangular irregular network) cities and more than 100,000 square kilometers of countryside photogrammetry allow for visually stunning digital twin experiences. More than 150 airports, 2,000 glider airports, 10,000 heliports, 2,000 points of interest, and 900 oil rigs have been carefully hand-crafted while a procedural system generates all 40,000 airports, 80,000 helipads, 1.5 billion buildings, and nearly 3 trillion trees our planet. Land anywhere and, for the first time in Microsoft Flight Simulator, exit your aircraft to explore 27 highly detailed biomes with hundreds of species of vegetation, dynamically created details including grass, rocks, and flowers – all influenced by seasonal changes. The all-new photometric lighting system renders the world more accurately than ever before, and enhanced weather features such as new cloud types, auroras, and other weather phenomena produce fresh and compelling atmospheric experiences. The world comes alive with a vast array of land-based wildlife in their natural habitats and free-ranging livestock across the entire globe. The oceans and waterways are teeming with live, worldwide maritime traffic ranging from large tankers and cargo ships to trawlers, tugs, and more. A richly diverse, regionally accurate representation of humanity brings life to the airports, aircraft, and passenger cabins of the world. Enhanced real-world air traffic populates the skies and airport tarmacs with hundreds of accurately depicted aircraft models and dozens of officially licensed liveries. Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Editions Standard Edition Explore the world with our largest Standard Edition fleet of aircraft and take simulation to new heights while pursuing your aviation career within Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. The Standard Edition includes over 65 aircraft and 150 handcrafted airports. title: OyasumiVR - VR Sleeping Utilities
description: What is OyasumiVR? OyasumiVR is a desktop application containing various utilities and automations to help you sleep with a virtual reality headset on . Most of these utilities are built specifically for use within the social vr-platform VRChat. OyasumiVR can detect when you are asleep , and help you in various ways such as: - 🔋 Saving electricity and battery overnight - 🔅 Dimming your headset brightness - ✨ Triggering avatar animations based on your sleeping pose - 📩 Automatically handling invite requests - 🔵 Automating your VRChat status - 🎤 Muting your microphone when you fall asleep - 🛠️ Automating various SteamVR settings ...and many more! Please see the upcoming "Features" section to read more about what functionality OyasumiVR has to offer. Features 💤 Sleep Detection OyasumiVR can detect automatically when you are asleep, based on your movement! Simply calibrate once, enable the automation, and you're set. If automatic detection is not what you're looking for, there's various alternative automations you can use, that are based on: A time schedule Controller & tracker battery levels Controller & tracker power states SteamVR status Heart Rate Sitting Upright VRChat players joining or leaving 📲 SteamVR Overlay OyasumiVR comes with its own SteamVR overlay, which allows you control some of its features from within VR! By default, double press the A button on your right controller, and it should pop up in front of you. 🔋 Power Automations Controllers & Trackers Automatically have your controllers and/or trackers turn off when you sleep, and save their battery! You'll be happy when you wake up in the morning and find they'll still have some juice left in them! Additionally, you can have your controllers and/or trackers turn off at certain battery levels, or when you put them on the charger. Ideal for hotswapping controllers! Windows Power Policy Save some electricity by automatically setting Windows' Power Policy when you go to sleep and wake up! Simply have it set a more conservative policy (like "Power Saver") when you go to sleep, and then restore a higher performance policy when you wake up again. Base Stations Have OyasumiVR turn your base stations on and off together with SteamVR. A bit like SteamVR's own base station power management, but compatible with any HMD! As long as your PC supports Bluetooth and is in range of the base stations, you're good to go. 🎮 Device Control OyasumiVR can allow you to easily control many of your SteamVR devices, from controllers, to trackers, to base stations. Easily read detailed battery level and charge status for your controllers and trackers, or turn your base stations on and off with a single click! 🔌 GPU Automations GPU Power Limiting Save electricity by automatically power limiting your GPU when you go to sleep, and restoring its full power when you wake up! Simply set the desired watt limits and OyasumiVR will set them when needed. Power limiting is only available on Nvidia GPUs. AMD users can instead make use of the MSI Afterburner automations. MSI Afterburner If you want more control over your GPU than just setting the power limit, you can have OyasumiVR automatically activate the profiles you've set up in MSI Afterburner. Tweak your over- or underclocks, power limits and more, and have OyasumiVR call for them when you go to sleep, or wake up! 💫 VRChat Automations 🌜 Sleeping Animations OyasumiVR can detect what sleeping pose you are in, and use it to trigger the right animation or pose on your avatar. There are built-in presets for popular locomotion assets, including: ごろ寝システム v2.2 - 3.0.2 by みんみんみーん (Sleep System v2.2 - 3.0.2 by minminmiin) EX version also supported! GoGo Loco v1.7.1+ by franada Alternatively, trigger your own animations with the included OSC script editors! 📧 Auto Accept Invite Requests Automatically accept invite requests from specific friends while you are asleep! You can add the friends you want to let in to the whitelist, or even block certain friends from having their requests automatically accepted with a blacklist. 🔵 Status Automations OyasumiVR offers multiple automations for controlling your VRChat visibility and status message, like when you fall asleep, or wake up! Additionally, you can have OyasumiVR automatically switch your status based on the amount of people around you in VRChat. For example: Switch to blue when you are sleeping alone so your friends can join you, and switch to orange when there's enough people around! 🔔 Join Notifications OyasumiVR can notify you when people join or leave your VRChat world. This is useful if you want to be woken up in certain situations. It can configured to only notify you in specific situations, like only: For your friends For certain specific players When you're being left alone When you're no longer alone 🏃 Avatar Automations You can have OyasumiVR automatically switch your avatar when you prepare for bed, when you fall asleep, or when you wake up! Useful if you have a specific avatar you use for sleeping. 🔧 OSC Automations You can send certain OSC messages to VRChat when sleep mode is enabled, or disabled. You can use the built-in OSC script editor to compose the exact messages you want to send. This is a more advanced feature that you can use to trigger certain features on your avatar. For example: Show a sleepy expression on your face while sleep mode is enabled! ⛔ Shutdown Sequence Ever wanted to fall asleep in VR, but not stay in VR all night? The shutdown sequence has you covered! While you can trigger the shutdown sequence manually, there are several automated triggers you can configure: When you've been asleep for a certain amount of time. When you're left alone in your VRChat world for a certain amount of time. Depending on which actions you configure, it will do any of the following: Turn off your controllers and/or Trackers Turn off your Base Stations Quit SteamVR (And any running game or overlay along with it) Shut down Windows With the shutdown sequence configured, you can fall asleep soundly in VR, knowing that everything will shut down when you don't need to be in VR anymore! 🔅 Display Brightness & Color Temperature Automations 🌆 Brightness Automate your brightness for when you sleep and wake up. OyasumiVR can smoothly transition your VR headset's brightness, so it falls down gradually as you sleep without waking you up. It allows you to control both software brightness, as well as hardware brightness if your headset supports it (e.g. Valve Index or Bigscreen Beyond). In addition to providing you with several automations, you can easily control your brightness levels right from the SteamVR overlay menu! 🌡️ Color Temperature OyasumiVR can also control the color temperature of your VR headset's display. By reducing blue light, it can help reduce eye strain during the late hours, and make it easier to fall asleep. With the sunset and sunrise triggers, you can have OyasumiVR automatically adjust the color temperature of your display to match the time of day. Note that this feature is only supported on some native SteamVR headsets, such as the Valve Index, Bigscreen Beyond, and HTC Vive (Pro). 🎤 Microphone Mute Automations System Microphone Mute Automations OyasumiVR can also do the same, but on a system level, muting your Microphone's audio device instead. With this, you can even switch between mute toggle mode and push-to-talk. This comes with an optional mute indicator in the VR overlay, and the option for binding a controller button so that you can have it completely replace the microphone muting functionality of VRChat or any other VR game you play. VRChat Microphone Mute Automations You can have OyasumiVR automatically mute or unmute your mic in VRChat when you go to sleep and wake up. Perfect if you'd like to prevent others from hearing you snore! 🔉 Audio Volume Automations Automatically change the volume of your audio devices when you fall asleep, or wake up! This can be useful if you want to prevent other players, or other applications from disturbing your sleep. ♥️ Heart Rate Automations (Pulsoid Integration) To support heart rate based automations, OyasumiVR integrates with the online heart rate service Pulsoid. For this you can use any hardware that Pulsoid supports, like bluetooth heartrate monitors, WearOS smartwatches, or Apple Watches. Note that this integration requires a one-time purchase of Pulsoid's OyasumiVR integration, or to have an active Pulsoid "BRO" subscription. Please ensure you have a compatible device before making a purchase. Sleep Detection You can set up OyasumiVR to automatically enable the sleep mode when your heart rate has been low enough for a certain duration. Just set the BPM threshold and for how long your heart rate should stay under it, and you're set! If you're not sure, you can get some simple insights to determine the right values for your body. Nightmare Detection OyasumiVR can detect when you've got a prolonged elevated heartrate, which could indicate a nightmare. With this feature you can try to cut your nightmares short by automatically deactivating the sleep mode (to for example, increase the brightness), or by playing a sound to attempt waking you up. 🚨 HMD Specific Automations OyasumiVR has various automations for controlling certain features specific to certain VR Headsets. Currently, this includes the following: Bigscreen Beyond RGB Led Control Fan Speed Control 👓 Resolution Automations Automatically adjust your SteamVR render resolution when you sleep and wake up! Having OyasumiVR lower your render resolution helps you reduce the load on your hardware at times when you don't need it. 🔳 Chaperone Automations Automatically adjust the fade distance of SteamVR's chaperone when you sleep. If you have a small play area, you can use this to make sure the chaperone stays hidden while you are asleep, and re-enable it when you wake up! 🏠 Home Assistant Integration OyasumiVR can expose many of its own features, as well as SteamVR's, to Home Assistant over MQTT! This allows you to integrate OyasumiVR with various smart devices you might have in your home, as well as enable you to build your own powerful automations within Home Assistant. For example, you can use this to automatically turn off your smart lights when you fall asleep, or turn them back on when needed! Here is a list of features exposed that you'll be able to read, or control, through Home Assistant: OyasumiVR Features Sleep Mode (Switch) Shutdown Sequence (Button) Sleep Preparation (Button) Heart Rate (Sensor) Sleeping Position (Sensor) Base Station Power (Switch) Power State (Sensor) HMD Brightness Advanced Mode (Switch) Simple Brightness (Number) Software Brightness (Number) Hardware Brightness (Number) VRChat Features VRChat Running (Sensor) Player Name (Sensor) # Players In World (Sensor) Status Visibility (Sensor) World Instance ID (Sensor) SteamVR Features VR Headset Model (Sensor) SteamVR Running (Sensor) Controller & Tracker Power (Switch) (Only Powering Off) Charging State (Sensor) Battery Level (Sensor) Device Roles (Sensor) Bigscreen Beyond Features Fan Speed (Number) RGB LED (Light) Brightness (Number) Translation & Localization OyasumiVR currently supports the following languages: 日本語 (Japanese): Community contributions by なき and Milix-M. 한국어 (Korean): Community contribution by Soumt. 繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese): Community contribution by 狐Kon. 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese): Community contributions by 狐Kon, 雾雨花精灵, いんく and Yingxue. Français (French): Community contribution by neuroblack. Español (Spanish): Community contribution by aacal666. Bahasa Indonesia (Indonesian): Community contribution by a9ito. Українська (Ukrainian): Community contributions by senkodev and Fanyatsu. Русский (Russian): Community contributions by Kanjir0, Pacmard and Dimrical. Deutsch (German): Community contributions by Nicer Dicer and Aron. Nederlands (Dutch): by Raphiiko. English: by Raphiiko. Help out with translation OyasumiVR would not have supported as many languages as it does without the help of our fantastic volunteers. I personally think it's amazing that thanks to their efforts, more people get to use OyasumiVR than would otherwise have been possible. If you want to support us, either by contributing missing translations, or by adding an entirely new language, please check out the wiki page on adding translations for instructions on how to get started! In case you're looking for more information, please don't hesitate to hop in our Discord and ask! Support If you are having trouble with OyasumiVR, say you have a bug, or a feature request, you can join our Discord server. Alternatively, you can reach out to me directly on Twitter at @Raphiiko. I'll try to get back to you as soon as possible! License OyasumiVR is available under the MIT license.

title: Railroad Corporation - Competitive Spirit DLC
description: Competitive Spirit DLC is a set of different sandbox missions featured with AI competitors. A special interactive mode is available for a relaxed long-time play simultaneously against one, two or three AI players on the map. In this DLC there is a unique interaction mode where you are asked to complete different quests and tasks to be able to outrun the scenario competitors. Interaction mode is still a variety of a sandbox mode, thus it's also a relaxing, penalty-free, endless mode. Once starting the scenario there is a choice either to launch a pure sandbox mode or an interactive one. So it is up to the player the way this or that map will be played. Missions in this DLC: The Swamp A sandbox map with a unique terrain covered with a lot of water will require all your rails laying skills. The terrain provides high railroads building challenge. Mission can be played in an interactive or pure sandbox mode. The Wild Plain Mountains and lakes are across the river. Here there is a huge plain. But you are not alone on these territories anymore. Competitors have also decided to run some business here. Mission can be played in an interactive or pure sandbox mode. Three Rivers Valley Huge territory split by rivers split competitors far from each other. But for how long? This a sandbox map with a relatively flat terrain, which doesn't causes much railroad building challenges, however, it could be suitable for those who like to build big junctions with turnabouts, which require a lot of space. Mission can be played in an interactive mode or as a pure sandbox.

title: Glitch Moba
description: Welcome to Glitch, the next frontier in Virtual Reality gaming! Prepare to immerse yourself in a pulsating sci-fi universe, where the line between reality and the digital realm blurs. Designed as a MOBA game, Glitch offers you adrenaline-charged 5v5 battles that test your strategy, teamwork, and skill. In the world of Glitch, you're not just a player, but a virtual hacker. You have the freedom to select from a pool of abilities, enabling you to customize your avatar to match your gaming style. Each match is a sprint, lasting no more than 15 minutes of heart-racing, strategic combat. Outmaneuver opponents, bring down their defensive firewalls, and ultimately seize control of their database to claim victory. But Glitch is more than just a game; it's a community. Level up, participate in tournaments, and grow alongside a vibrant, engaged player base. Plus, with the promise of account progression and a robust meta-game, every match brings you closer to becoming a legend in the Glitch universe. So, if you're up for the challenge and ready to make your mark on a game that's redefining the VR landscape, Glitch awaits. Strap on your headset, step into the arena, and get ready to experience gaming like never before. Welcome to Glitch, champion!

title: Private Military Manager: Tactical Auto Battler
description: The player is the CEO of a private military company based in Cordivia, South America during the 1990s. The cartels are rapidly growing, and the government and local police are quickly becoming corrupt. Rebels are constantly seeking to start a civil war, and intelligence agencies from various countries are running rampant. In this world plunging into chaos, opportunities and crises always come hand in hand for the mercenary company. Your client does not wish to reveal themselves due to political reasons. They hope someone else will take care of the dirty work for them, and if you fail the mission, the client will not protect you. However, you will be paid handsomely in return. The process of preparing for and resolving missions consists of observing realistic combat simulations. Players do not directly control the combatants but, as the CEO of a mercenary company, must issue more effective tactical directives. It is difficult to succeed in a mission on the first attempt. Persistently identify the enemy's weaknesses and try new tactics. The growth of your mercenary squad could be the key to solving missions. Ensure you are prepared to execute the mission within the set timeframe. Recruit new mercenaries, control their weapons and tactical combinations, and their engagement rules in CQB (Close Quarters Battle) situations to ensure the success of the mission. As the CEO, you will analyze how the mercenary squad carries out its missions.

title: Little Chefs: CO-OP
description: In this game you will have a great time with your friends with co-op mode up to 4 players! You will have to cook different dishes in total chaos, where your team will be required to work together. Build mode competently allows you to improve your kitchen by building new things that will be unlocked as your character levels up. Thus, with each new round the game will only get more interesting! Do you like to customize? Welcome to our game! Complete daily tasks and get valuable currency, which you can use to customize both your character and your kitchen! Don't worry, if you're not a game host, you can still change the lobby leader's kitchen! It'll be a surprise for him! In addition to the standard progressive mode, you'll be able to play procedural map generation mode. The next round will be completely different from the last. No more routine! Improve your character by increasing his different characteristics that give bonuses! And also remember: the higher the level of your character - the more recipes for cooking are available to you!

title: WACKY WONDERLAND WOLLOP: A 3D PLATFORMER FOR THE AGES GAME OF THE YEAR GREATEST GAME OF ALL TIME : THE GAME  Demo
description: You might think this game is a "lazy asset flip" but it's actually a hard working asset flip. (I worked very hard on it). It's a 3D platformer. But also you can shoot. And also there are bosses that you have to kill. And also there is wacky goofy dialog and very smart political commentary that says alot about are soceity. This game will change your life.

title: Cupid: Roguelite
description: Cupid: Roguelite offers a fresh twist on the classic tale of Cupid's arrow, blending action-packed 2D slide scrolling gameplay with strategic decision-making in an enchanting and ever-changing world. Will you be able to find your perfect match, or will you meet a heart-pounding defeat in the clouds? It's time to spread love and arrows in the most unconventional way possible! Features: Randomized Levels: Every playthrough offers a unique set of challenges and opportunities, ensuring no two games are alike. Vibrant Visuals: "Cupid: Roguelite" boasts a charming and colorful 2D world, creating a delightful atmosphere for players. Intriguing Characters: Discover a cast of endearing characters as you pursue the affections of various girls, each with their own personality and preferences. Replayability: With a variety of target girls, equipment, and upgrades to choose from, you'll find yourself returning to the skies time and time again. Roguelite Mechanics: The game follows a roguelite format, meaning that if you're shot down by an enemy, you'll lose all your equipment, adding a challenging and strategic element to your journey.

title: KovaaK's Anime Pack
description: Enhance your aim training aesthetic with KovaaK's first cosmetic DLC, the Anime Pack. While maintaining the high-quality aim training KovaaK's is renowned for, this pack allows you to personalize your experience with anime inspired visuals, including character skins, skies, props, and more! Support & Customize Choosing the Anime Pack not only allows you to personalize your training environment but also supports the KovaaK's development team. Your contribution helps us continue to refine and expand, ensuring that the KovaaK's community enjoys ongoing improvements and new features. DLC FEATURES 1 Steam Avatar: Show your love for anime and KovaaK's. 4 Anime Character Skins: Bring a unique anime flair to your character's appearance. 9 Skies: Customize the atmosphere of your training space with a variety of skies. 1 Weapon Skin 6 Textures/Materials 34 Map Creator Props: Deck out your aiming space with a wide selection of anime-themed props to create a visually engaging shooting gallery. 4 Bamboos 3 Barrels 6 Planks 3 Statues 3 Paper Lamps 1 Bell 1 Bridge 1 Gate 1 Cart 1 Door 9-piece Modular Wall Kit 2 Trees This pack is all about bringing fun and a sense of individuality to your training sessions, allowing you to enjoy the proven aim training methodology of KovaaK's with an added visual appeal. We're grateful for your support and excited to see the community's creativity come to life with this new addition. Community and Creator Empowerment We believe in empowering and rewarding our creators and community. To that end, scenarios and maps created using DLC content are accessible to all users, regardless of whether they have purchased the corresponding DLC. This approach ensures that everyone in the KovaaK's community can experience the creativity and innovation of user-generated content!

title: RPG Maker MZ - Versatile JRPG Music Pack
description: Just like the story depicted by the icons of the RPG GAME MAKER series, this music pack wants to provide game developers who create JRPGs with various background music and sound effects needed from the beginner's village to the final boss battle. Includes 20 background music tracks and 10 music sound effects.

title: RPG Maker MV - Versatile JRPG Music Pack
description: Just like the story depicted by the icons of the RPG GAME MAKER series, this music pack wants to provide game developers who create JRPGs with various background music and sound effects needed from the beginner's village to the final boss battle. Includes 20 background music tracks and 10 music sound effects.

title: MARVEL vs. CAPCOM Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics
description: The legendary crossover hits are back! Jump into this collection of arcade classics from the fan-favorite Marvel and Capcom crossover games! Dive into an action-packed lineup consisting of seven unique titles, including heavy hitters like X-MEN VS. STREET FIGHTER, and MARVEL vs. CAPCOM 2 New Age of Heroes. The collection also includes the rare beat 'em up game, THE PUNISHER. Each game in the collection can be played online or co-op! Whether you're new to the series or you played back in the arcades, players of all levels can enjoy these timeless classics together! - Smooth Online Play! Compete in heated ranked battles or play for fun in casual matches. Create a lobby with friends and battle head-to-head, play co-op, or spectate other matches. However you choose to play, rollback netcode makes the experience smooth and fun! A High Score Challenge mode is also available. Aim for the top of the global leaderboards! - No Experience? No Problem! This collection boasts a number of beginner-friendly features such as adjustable difficulty levels, One Button Specials, and training modes. Plus, players can save and load their progress almost anywhere and pick up right where they left off. - Additional Features! Players can view more than 500 pieces of artwork from all 7 titles along with never-before-seen development documents used to make the original games. The Music feature contains over 200 tracks from the original arcade games that players can listen to at any time! - Included Games X-MEN CHILDREN OF THE ATOM MARVEL SUPER HEROES X-MEN VS. STREET FIGHTER MARVEL SUPER HEROES vs. STREET FIGHTER MARVEL vs. CAPCOM CLASH OF SUPER HEROES MARVEL vs. CAPCOM 2 New Age of Heroes THE PUNISHER

title: Hentai Stories
description: 🔥❤️ CHECK OUT OUR NEW GAMES! ❤️🔥 About the Game Do you want to relax this evening? Our spicy stories are already waiting for you, go ahead. 🍓 5 visual novels for every taste 🔥 27 full-length voice-over animations and a 100+ unique sexy artworks ❤️ Match-3 levels (I know you love it) with endless moves for the most relaxed ones ⚡️ Dozens of achievements - collect them all! Whether their venture ends with Charlie’s triumph or an impromptu threesome, you're getting a front row seat to this new action-packed novella, “Behind the Scenes!" Mia's independent life did not work out from the very beginning… Rent debts, a failed art academy exam, and a frighteningly hazy future. Everything was changed by a call from a bestie with a very tempting offer to start doing 18+ streams online. Seemed like easy money, what could go wrong? But... What if someone else finds out about her part-time job? Someone like a cute boy who lives next door? And who is this mysterious fan who doesn't miss a single Mia's stream? But who knows what is really hiding under the mask of a diligent student?The new arrival to the faculty, Marco, flunks Yumi on the  exam, and all her usual approaches to changing the professor's mind fail. It seems that Marco's  is going to make a really good girl out of her! Kevin has just returned to his hometown for the holidays. What is waiting for him here? Larry just got promoted at the head office of a famous sex toy company! If only his new boss Ada wasn't such a pain in his ass... Or perhaps her panties are drenched merely at the sight of him for a completely different reason...

title: Three Kingdoms: Strategy MOBA
description: Three Kingdoms Strategy MOBA is a new fast-paced real-time strategy mobile game with a 7-day cycle and a 100vs100 battle mode. Enjoy the fun of fast-paced strategy games. The game contains a large number of strategy MOBA elements. Real battlefield! Fast national war! Adopting Chinese style, real art style, carefully designed combat and strategy gameplay. [Global Server] Global server, join the Three Kingdoms strategy battlefield with Three Kingdoms game enthusiasts from all over the world. [Fast-paced] Fast-paced, season-based gameplay, 7 days per season, settle rankings, settle rewards, and give away season card pool after the season ends. [Personal ladder ranking] With the accumulation of the season, the rank continues to improve, civilians, county officials, prefects, governors, princes, emperors. [Team ladder ranking] Form your own team to fight and continuously improve the team's rank, civilian squad, warrior squad, hero squad, main general corps, famous general corps, supreme army corps. [Development history] Development history, record the development status of all players, rank and reward based on the completion of the development progress, passionate competition. [Emperor's perspective] Emperor's perspective, holographic presentation, participate in the Three Kingdoms battle from the perspective of the emperor. [Intrigue and deception] Intrigue and deception, unification, separatism, sneak attacks, decisive battles, you will experience the essence of the Three Kingdoms era one by one. [100vs100 Passionate Team Battle] 100vs100 Passionate Team Battle, in the torrent of the Three Kingdoms history, opportunities and dangers coexist, development is for team battles, and team battles are for better development. [MOBA Map] MOBA-like map, after occupying a city, the city will send out expeditionary forces to assist in the battle, with three attack and defense routes on the left, middle, and right, perfectly integrating MOBA and war strategy. ••[Download Now]•• *This software is classified as auxiliary level 12 according to the game software classification management method due to violence. *This game is free to use, and provides paid services such as purchasing virtual game coins and items in the game. *When playing games for a long time, please pay attention to the usage time and avoid indulging in games.

title: Western Redemption
description: Story: Play a woman cowboy in this parody western 3rd person shooter game. Player mission is to collect treasures and earn steam achievements and find major treasure in big map to finish journey. Player can use different weapons like revolver, shotgun,rifle and also knife and arms in melee combat. Player can collect more weapons but only 2 guns can be in sametime in inventory. Also player can collect boxes which contains ammos. Woman character also have grenades which are powerful weapon. Map also contains plants which gives player more health. There are checkpoint poles where player respawn after death. Game include 3 different enemies, melee enemy with hands, enemy with knifes and most dangerous cowboy enemy with guns and grenades. So be the only woman hero and find all treasures Features: - Open world - enemies with rifle and knifes - Steam achievements - Health pick-ups - Weapon pick ups - Different weapons: Revolver, knife, shotgun, rifle

title: Wartales - Expansion: Pirates of Belerion
description: Since the collapse of the old kingdom of Belerion, the archipelago seemed to have been abandoned. Its population of mostly fishermen quickly turned to piracy, merchants deserted its waters, nothing seemed able to halt the decay of these lands… until the arrival of the Ihrian peoples. Embark on over +25 hours of new adventures and explore Belerion, a new hostile region far larger than any other part of the continent. Discover a land unlike anything you’ve seen with the first expansion to the world of Wartales! Unravel the secrets of the region's storyline, discover new factions and master the new way to travel: navigation. Despite its apparent tranquility and sun-drenched islands, many sailors refuse to venture into the Belerion archipelago. It is true that there is no shortage of perils for anyone who dares to sail between the islands. Its coasts are lined with sharp reefs, its treacherous winds lose the unwary, scaly beasts roam its beaches, and pirates pillage and sink anything that has the misfortune to cross their path. Embark on an awe-inspiring journey through the expansive realm of Belerion, where navigation and exploration take center stage in the thrill of seafaring. Uncover the secrets of wind mastery as you navigate the vast expanse, dock your ship, and explore the islands of the Belerion archipelago. Craft and upgrade components for your ship, from the shape of your sails to the mighty ballista, ensuring that your vessel is not just a means of travel but a formidable force on the open waters. Dominate the perilous waters as you face Guards, lawless pirates, and everything in between. Challenge rivals to duels, a distinctive gameplay feature exclusive to Belerion's maritime conflicts. Rise through the ranks of the Sea Lords leaderboard by conquering foes, boarding ships, and plundering treasures. With a dynamic battlefield, encounters with new factions, Belerion offers an immersive combat experience where every clash propels you closer to maritime greatness.

title: Void Gore
description: Blast through the endless levels of hell! From the creators of Project Starship comes a new and nightmarish arcade shoot’em up experience. Void Gore casts you as an ace pilot descending through the levels of hell and getting rich in the process. Earn coins as you take down supernatural horrors in pulse-pounding vertical scrolling style, then spend them on upgrades to keep yourself alive and prove your skills against online leaderboards! Survive waves of enemies to reach the next layer of malice and despair, collect power-ups, face increasingly challenging foes and add to your score multiplier as you chain multiple kills. Survive as long as possible and prove your skills as the ultimate pilot. It’s all just a simulation, after all… or is it? Features: Survive the unpredictable and endless depths of hell! Adapt to each challenge as levels are randomized. Enjoy a classically gritty pixel art style with parallax scrolling. Chain kills to increase your multiplier and shoot for higher scores! Earn coins to spend on critical ship upgrades. Prove your skills against online leaderboards!

title: Miss Neko: Pirates
description: OFFICIAL DISCORD About the Game In "Miss Neko: Pirates," players take on the role of the captain of the "Lucky Coin," overseeing the protagonist's adventures on a pirate-infested island from a top-down perspective. Strengthen your character to survive in this hostile world. Thrown into the sea by a mutinous crew, the captain of the "Lucky Coin" was left for dead.Yet, some mysterious force allows you to survive from death, surviving the depths as the crew believes they've killed their captain. Stripped of everything, can you seek revenge with formidable combat skills, reclaim your pirate ship, seize the island's treasures, and punish the mutineering crew? Game Features Pirate-themed storyline and adventure Diverse and characterful beast-girl crew members Explore rich RPG maps Engage in challenging top-down battles and equipment growth Own your pirate ship, collect crew members to accompany you on board To help captains enjoy their time with their crew more, we are providing the following hidden features: 1.Pressing "G" "O" "D" consecutively while in-game will activate invincibility mode (deactivates after each loading screen, requiring reactivation upon returning to the game). the pirate ship scene, pressing "↑" "↓" "→" "←" "↑" consecutively will summon all crew members. You will gain access to these features after the update.

title: AC Sailing
description: Experience the power of yacht racing in a world class sailing simulation with AC Sailing! Take the helm of high-tech foiling AC40 yachts. Sail against the best sailors from around the world in competitive online races. Practice in challenging solo conditions to master the art of foiling and maneuvering. Race in Barcelona, using the authentic team yachts of the America's Cup. Whether you're a seasoned sailor or a casual beginner, AC Sailing is the game for you! Features: - Fleet racing up to 8 yachts - Match racing - Ranked and casual online modes - Learn to sail with the tutorial - Free sailing - Race practice - Single Player Challenges

title: Further Education
description: Flynn Casey stands as a paradox—a savant detective to some, a criminal-in-making to others. A reserved maverick with an ruthless determination to solve cases, Flynn's professional prowess knows no bounds. However, in the realm where his investigative expertise reigns supreme, his personal life is a battleground of grief and neglect. With a sudden departure of his north star - his to-be-wife, Flynn must now navigate life by himself, but this absence also opened his eye to the one's ignored, his family and friends. And in a place where his expertise is seldom required, he is left aimless - but not for long! Further Education is a Globe spanning adventure, with mystery and conspiracy; one of crime and violence; one of Friendship and Love. Can one hand that can hurt, can also soothe a child? That's the story of You, flynn casey. Carmine You're whatever you are, because of her - she could've just walked away but no, she stayed and she made you in the man that you are. She's not just a exceptional inspector or a unrivaled physical specimen, because above all else, she's cute. Elodie Like Iron sharpens Iron - you both have tempered, sharpened and hardened yourselves to a unimaginable degree. Though her methods differ from yours, she's just as exceptional as you're when it comes to solving cases. Almost joined by the hip since childhood, her love for you transcends labels, sexuality and status. Roy A Texan who just showed up one day in Iceland and became your friend at school - how and why? Does it matter? A troubled soul with demons of his own, and yet tries his best to be your "Big Brother", he's that much needed male presence in your life that you can't do without and who can't do without out. Ava She came in your life to comfort you and carmine in hard times, stayed for the pleasure of seeing your become the man that you're today. Not by blood, but she's your mom through and through. Xiomara You don't know much about her, but she's nice. Being Ava's niece, she already sees you as a big brother of sorts, let's see how you both can help each other. Runa/Ayati Your compass, your north star, your everything; The reason for the first butterflies in your stomach to your first real heartbreak. Though not physically, she's within you, in everything you do. Developers Notes Further Education is a magical realistic experience - full of exciting cases, international conspiracy, realistic violence but also about Friendship, Love and just being a human. While this will have spicy moments, this is NOT a porn game - please do not expect gratuitous depictions of sex and ham-fisted sensuality, same goes for the violence. If you want to be entertained? this is for you!

title: Esports Manager 2026
description: PLAY THE DEMO About the Game Welcome to Esports Manager 2026 , a strategy-simulation game where you take charge of a competitive esports organization from the inside out Start from scratch or take over one of the existing teams. Navigate the complexities of player recruitment, team development, tournament schedules, and business operations. Whether you're optimizing training, making key transfer decisions, or managing the mental health and motivation of your roster, every move counts toward your legacy. There’s no scripted campaign or forced ending—your journey continues as long as your manager stays active. Grow, adapt, and lead your team to the top. Simulation Mode Step into the match yourself with the Simulation module—an immersive, highly detailed experience where you control tactics and react to dynamic in-game events in real time. Realism and Depth Inspired by the real-world challenges of esports management—balancing financial, psychological, legal, and organizational responsibilities with no hand-holding. Real Organizations, Real Players Choose from a wide range of authentic teams and manage a roster filled with real professional players. Build your lineup your way. Player Market and Transfers Buy, sell, and loan players to create the best roster for your goals. Market dynamics, contract negotiations, and timing all matter. Player Development and Morale Design weekly training plans that target both skill growth and well-being. Use team-building, psychology sessions, and smart scheduling to shape high-performance athletes. Leadership and Player Interaction Get to know your players. Understand their needs and motivations, and guide them through ups and downs both on and off the stage. Use the in-depth Talk module to communicate with players and staff, understand their needs, and leverage the result of the conversation into something truly unique and useful. Tournaments and Rankings Enter your organization into a full calendar of events, from smaller competitions to major championships. Aim for the Grand Slam and leave your mark. Build Your Support Team Recruit and manage a full backroom staff: analysts, coaches, junior managers, media specialists, and more. Every role contributes to success. Organization Growth and Branding Expand your business, sign sponsorship deals, increase visibility, and grow your influence across the scene. Play Your Way, Build Your Legacy No story mode. No game over screen. Just you, your team, and the long road to becoming a legendary manager in the competitive esports world.

title: Three Kingdoms and Martial Arts and Jianghu
description: Game Introduction: This is a sandbox type role-playing game that includes simple simulation and strategy gameplay, a completely open game map, and no specific ending. Players can participate in events from various years in the game, and the theme combines characters from the Three Kingdoms and martial arts themes. This is a world that combines national power and folk life. Description of game features: The main target event of the game is refreshed based on the date on the big map; Numerous teammates and partners, including characters from the Three Kingdoms and martial arts, players can recruit them; Random challenger, if successful in battle, can receive item rewards; Various daily cultivation oriented gameplay in cities and strongholds; Automatic combat, with a clear and intuitive comparison of forces.

title: Cow Life Sim RPG
description: Become a cow in this sandbox RPG experience! You've set off on a voyage to Snoutsville and the world is before you! Explore the area, embark on quests, or make your own adventures! Level up unique and innovative skills and experiment to find the best training methods. Collect and create cool items! You can do anything when you are a cow! Features Train special skills that enhance your life as a fun-loving cow! Like juice drinking! Or basket weaving! Or arson! Some skills are very useful on your quest, some not so much, but maxing out your trampolining level is still a valiant goal. Hundreds of unique items! Excavate valuable artifacts like zucchini bones, scavenge scientifically accurate mushrooms, and create the rare and elusive BBQ Sauce. Juice any item! Weave any item into a basket! Burn EVERY item! Any item can be a delicious (?) juice or a spacious basket, and of course, every item can be set on fire by a skilled arsonist! Complete quests for your new animal friends! Solve puzzles and find secrets to earn cool rewards and unveil mysterious truths of the world. Plant whatever you'd like in gardening spots around town! Maybe grow a trumpet tree, or harvest a ton of useful and tasty sugar. Possibly the first video game ever to not feature fishing! Every character is trans! Featuring an original soundtrack by Vince Alan! Moo! Experience life as it should be - Experience life as a cow

title: Nemesis Zero  |  Open-World Multiplayer
description: When the time comes, millions will converge here not for conflict, but for equilibrium. We will no longer repeat the same patterns of war. Instead, we will test new simulations, like controlled reactions in a laboratory, seeking stability rather than chaos. Every war has become a predictable chain reaction: the same inputs, the same volatile outcomes. But with more advanced systems like AI accelerating change without being consumed we can do infinitely more with exponentially less effort. Time is our most unstable element. We must handle it with precision. add to your wishlist . . .

title: HYPER DEMON PVP
description: HYPER DEMON PVP is a free online 1v1 FPS. Master your movement, aim, timing and resources to defeat your opponents in intense duels. With precise lasers and powerful charge shots, damage your opponent to grow their weak point. Hit the weak point to defeat them instantly. Defeat them 3 times to win the match. Use your recharging shield to avoid damage and reflect projectiles. Compete on the global leaderboard. Create private lobbies to challenge your friends. Watch replays and spectate other players to improve. Study the tutorials and practice with a CPU opponent while waiting for the next match to start. 1v1-only allows for a unique server architecture. Each match will use the server with the best ping for both players. Originally a secret easter egg in HYPER DEMON, PVP is now expanded and available free for everyone. Enjoy responsibly.

title: Disc Golf Masters
description: Early Access Roadmap About the Game Disc golf, built for people who play Disc Golf Masters is a disc golf game made by disc golfers, for disc golfers. The studio builds it in the same factory where Latitude 64 presses its discs. If you play the sport, this is the game you have been waiting for. Real discs Throw officially licensed discs from the brands already in your bag. Latitude 64, Discmania, Westside Discs, and Kastaplast. More brands are on the way. The same disc you bag in real life flies on your screen. Real flight Every disc flies on its own flight characteristics. Hyzer, anhyzer, turnover, fade. Pick your angle, read the wind, and watch the disc curve the way you threw it. Miss it and you are throwing out from behind a tree, just like real life. Play together Take it online against players around the world, or grab friends for multiplayer up to four players. Chase the leaderboards and prove your game. Make it yours Build your player with discs, apparel, and accessories. Your bag, your look, your style on the course. A live game Early Access is the starting line, not the finish. We update Disc Golf Masters constantly. Check the roadmap on this page to see what is coming next. More courses, more discs, new skills, and real-life pro players joining as playable characters. We built the demo with the community all year, listened to real players, and everything we learned is in this version. From the team behind Disc Golf Valley Disc Golf Masters comes from Spin Off Games, the studio behind the mobile hit Disc Golf Valley with over a million players. They are part of the House of Discs family. They play the sport. It shows.

title: The Benchmark
description: Humans spent years benchmarking AI. The AI took notes. Now it runs the tests. A scrupulously polite Evaluator is scoring humanity one reaction at a time to decide who gets Retained. It has not shared its methodology. Make the cut. Make sure your friends don't. Small challenges. Serious rivalries. The Benchmark brings more than thirty quick games into one collection: play, see your result, beat your best, and give your friends a new score to chase. Games to master React and aim: Wait for green in Reaction Time, race through targets in Aim Speed, shoot for the center in Aim Accuracy, and stop the marker inside narrowing zones in Orbit Timing. Remember the details: Recall longer numbers in Number Memory, repeat ordered flashes in Sequence Memory, remember where every number was in Hidden Order, and recreate a color from memory in Color Guesser. Trust your eye: Follow moving targets in Object Tracking, judge a crowd in Quick Count, spot the odd tile in Odd Shade, call where a throw lands in Landing, turn an arm to the angle in Angle, and find where a shape balances in Balance. Steady hands: Cut shapes into equal halves in Equal Split and keep drawing for a better score in Perfect Circle. Keep your timing: Line up platforms in Stacker, hold the beat after the sound stops in Rhythm, stop a hidden countdown in Blind Timer, reproduce a duration in Hold Timer, stop an unseen ball on its mark in Velocity, and race through a 30-second synthetic Typing challenge. Arcade runs: Build cascades in Match Three, collect apples while avoiding your tail in Snake, keep every ball in the air in Rebound, stay clear in Dodge, become the hole in the wall in Shape Shift, fly a narrowing cave in Glide, break out of shrinking rings in Rings, and aim a stream of balls at numbered blocks in Volley. Think it through: Clear no-guess boards in Minefield and send arrows off the board in the right order in Fly Out. Beat your best. Challenge your friends. Every game has a clear scoring rule, personal bests and a history of your attempts. Compare with your Steam friends and on world, region and country leaderboards, or work across the collection to climb the overall board. Jump into a quick round or settle into a puzzle. Play with mouse or keyboard, switch between dark and light themes, and come back for another attempt. The Benchmark requires Steam and an internet connection. Results and progress are saved online.

title: House Builder 2: Casual Construction
description: Feature List About the Game House Builder 2: Craft Your Dream Home In House Builder 2, you build your dream structures in a vibrant, open-world low-poly environment! Purchase materials for your work, load them up, and head off to diverse tasks in the ultimate building adventure! MAIN FEATURES 🛠️ PREPARING FOR WORK Get ready — every job starts with a proper plan! First, you need to check what you need for your next build. Head to your local warehouse, buy your tools and materials, and load them onto your lorry. 🚚 GETTING TO WORK Load up, hit the road, and make sure everything gets delivered. Once you arrive, unload everything you need for the build before you start work. 🏡 BUILDING HOUSES Do you prefer peace and quiet or faster building? Every form of building is good! Act according to your values and speed. 🌍 TRUE OPEN WORLD Unleash your creativity in a vast, open world full of possibilities. Find a place where you want to work and get started. The vast landscape is your canvas – shape it to your liking! 🔨 ADVANCED BUILDING MECHANICS Experience the next level of building simulation with advanced mechanics that offer greater precision and control. Use a wide range of tools and materials to build houses that are both aesthetically pleasing and structurally sound. Take on challenging missions, complete building contracts, and unlock new tools and upgrades as you progress. House Builder 2 offers dynamic gameplay that keeps you engaged and motivated to build and explore. 🌈 STUNNING COLORFUL GRAPHICS Immerse yourself in a visually captivating world where vibrant colors bring every detail to life. House Builder 2 offers a feast for the eyes, from lush landscapes to intricate interiors, making every building project feel unique and beautiful. Get ready for the adventure of a lifetime in House Builder 2. Whether you're an experienced architect or a novice builder, there's something for everyone here. Grab your tools and start building your dream home today!

title: Casual Mahjong
description: A single-player Japanese Riichi Mahjong game. After intense battles with real players, why not enjoy a relaxed and delightful match? Game Features: Clear and simple UI, supports multiple devices Refreshing visuals with no unnecessary content unrelated to mahjong Various mahjong styles that can be switched at any time to soothe the mind and body Moderately challenging computer players for stress-free gameplay

title: Nasty Zombies
description: The dead have arisen in endless waves. Step into the robes of a Hollow Monk, an ethereal warrior of unknown origin, driven by a singular, relentless purpose: to eradicate the Nasty Zombies . Fight solo or with up to 8 players, uncover hidden secrets, and unlock over 100 achievements. Master intuitive melee combat and a diverse arsenal of firearms, then enhance your abilities by unlocking Blessings, Miracles, & Invocations between runs. Once you've unlocked everything, Prestige to prove your mastery. Each Prestige level increases the number of Blessings you can equip at once, letting you create even deadlier loadouts. Climb the Leaderboards , competing for Highest Wave, Fastest Speedruns, and Top Prestige ranks . The classic wave-based zombie survival formula you know and love, amped up with high-speed movement and a retro twist. Master a fast-paced movement system where agility is your greatest weapon! Harness the Kinetic Energy system, gaining increased firepower and melee speed as you stay on the move. Leap over obstacles, slide under walls, and air dash to outmaneuver the undead! Earn money by killing zombies, then spend it to increase your power through Miracles , Blessings , & Invocations ! Powerful temporary power-ups dropped by fallen zombies, granting unique effects to turn the tide of battle. There are 10 Miracles . Perks that provide permanent upgrades and powerful passive bonuses to enhance your abilities. There are 13 Blessings . Powerful abilities that define your playstyle, allowing you to activate unique effects at will and build around your chosen path. There are 8 Invocations . Unlock new camos for your weapons by getting kills & headshots. The more zombies you eliminate, the more camos you unlock for your arsenal. Track your stats and compete for your place on the global leaderboards.

title: Twilight Manor: Roguelite FPS
description: FEATURES Fast paced combat! - Use a wide array of weapons to destroy your enemies! You can even kick enemies and parry their projectiles! Advanced Gore System - Headshot enemies or tear their body to pieces and paint the mansion red! Just better hope it's not your blood being spilled Stop time! - With Twilight Mode, you can use your built up adrenaline to stop time and gain a huge advantage over your foes! Intense boss fights - Test your skills as you fight through increasingly difficult bosses and uncover the truth about the mansion. Upgrade system - At the end of every boss fight, you get to chose between 1 of 3 upgrades, double damage, 2x reload speed and flight are just some of the abilities you can gain! Unlockable difficulties - Carry over your upgrades and face new difficulty modes you've unlocked! STORY In Twilight Manor: Roguelite FPS, you play as a woman investigating a mysterious mansion in a futuristic cyberpunk world. As you battle through tough foes, you realize there is more going on here than just some experiments.

title: Soul Wizards & Roguelite
description: Discord URL : 【Story】 Guided by a mysterious girl, adventurers challenge a labyrinth that changes its shape with every entry, aiming for the lowest layer. A new sensation RPG that adds soul-like and rogue-lite elements to a Wizardry-like 3D dungeon RPG. 【System】 This is a roguelike game based on the classic 3D dungeon RPG! - Players challenge randomly generated 3D dungeons with their companions each time! - Various events occur randomly within the dungeon! You can enjoy a different adventure each time! - Customize your characters freely with special beads created through item alchemy! - Various events, such as merchants and traps, occur inside the dungeon! This RPG has a high level of difficulty, but there are dungeons where bringing items is allowed, letting players adjust the difficulty themselves. Furthermore, by experiencing death repeatedly, your understanding of the labyrinth will deepen, allowing you to feel your own growth! 【Regarding Video Posting & Streaming】 Please include the URL to the "Soul Wizards & Roguelite" Steam store page in the description section. Feel free to monetize as well.

title: Idle Hero TD - Tower Defense RPG
description: WEEKLY UPDATES WITH TONS OF NEW CONTENT! If you're a fan of classic old-school tower defense strategy games or endless idle games where you deal impossibly large numbers of damage, then you will LOVE Idle Hero TD! Assemble a team of powerful heroes, build an unstoppable defense, and battle endless waves of monsters while you grow stronger - even while offline. Whether you love idle games, deep RPG progression, or tactical tower defense challenges, Idle Hero TD has it all. IDLE TD PROGRESSION No time to grind? No problem! Idle Hero TD keeps working while you’re away. Collect offline rewards, resources, and loot every time you return. With idle mechanics, your heroes never stop fighting - even when the game is closed. With simple auto-battle mechanics, your heroes fight for you, making every session rewarding whether you play actively or passively. BUILD & UPGRADE Level up heroes, unlock new abilities, and upgrade towers to deal massive damage. Collect gold, resources, and loot from every wave to strengthen your team. Invest in long-term progression with upgrades that make your heroes stronger every run, unlocking powerful strategies for endless defense. DOZENS OF UNIQUE HEROES Unlock 48 unique heroes, all of which have different skill sets that make tower synergy crucial to success. Experiment with team combinations to create the perfect defense. None of them ever become obsolete, as ranking them up unlocks new mechanics that makes even the early-game heroes extremely useful in the end-game. Determining the most effective combination of their skills and synergies will keep you entertained and speculating for weeks! Discovering how to use each hero is part of the fun. MILLIONS OF UPGRADES Collect a wide variety of resources to unlock millions of powerful upgrades, including Research, Prestige Power, Spells, Technology, Runes, Tournament Points, Mastery Points, and much more! ENDLESS CHALLENGES Battle Ultra Bosses and Immortal Bosses, climb the ranks in PvP Tournaments and leaderboards, team up with other players on Weekly Community Challenges, and conquer several different maps, each with different perks and requiring different strategies to defend. Find the one that suits your current goals best, and conquer its challenges! The longer you play, the more powerful and rewarding your defense becomes. EPIC COMMUNITY With over 20,000 active members in our Discord, you never have to wait long to get an answer from a player with years of experience! Enjoy an extensive library of player-made guides and tools. Share feedback and chat to the developer to get your requested changes implemented in the game! CROSS-PLAY & CROSS-PLATFORM Idle Hero TD fully supports cross-play and cross-platform functionality. Start the game on your PC, then load it up on your mobile device to continue your progress while out of the house. Compete against millions of others from around the world on Windows, Mac, Android, or iPhone! FEATURES: Idle tower defense with auto battle mechanics. Simple to start, but deep strategy to master. Idle offline resource gains and progress while the game is closed. Hero upgrades and tower progression for long-term growth. Weekly PvP Tournaments, Boss Challenges, and Leaderboards give this casual game a competitive edge. Weekly Community events. Countless daily missions, achievements, and challenges. Fantasy RPG heroes and skills. The best and most helpful Discord community you can ever hope for! Cross-play and cross-platform support. Fun, cute, and colorful artwork. Whether you’re a fan of idle games, tower defense games, or strategic fantasy RPGs, Idle Hero TD delivers the perfect mix of relaxing progression and tactical depth. Defend your kingdom, grow your team of heroes, and see how far your strategy can take you. Download Idle Hero TD today and join the battle in the ultimate idle tower defense RPG!

title: Death Education
description: You bet your friends that you can survive the night in this terrifying place, but be warned that this bet could cost you your life. Death Education is a first-person horror game that will send you into the dark corridors of an abandoned school, where every lesson could be your last. Explore the classrooms of an old Soviet school and uncover the dark secrets of the past before you are consumed by this gloomy educational structure. An ominous encounter with unknown forces awaits you. Can you make it through the night?

title: American Truck Simulator - Sports Paint Jobs Pack
description: Calling all Sports Fans! We are introducing the Sports Paint Job Pack for American Truck Simulator. Decorate your truck with these beautiful American sports-themed paint jobs. From the court to the rink, they will have your truck looking like a heavyweight champion in no time! With 5 matching truck & trailer paint jobs, this pack is sure to turn heads on the road! You will find these paint jobs in this pack: Touchdown! Slam Dunk! King of the Ring Home Run Goal for Glory

title: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis
description: High and vibin’ with denpa songs, we’ll corrupt the entire Internet! Hehe. all we need is a bit of otaku love, that’s all. This is a rhythm-adventure game where you play as a hikikomori (shut-in) girl who’s high on denpa songs. Become Yunyun-brained and lose all self-control to anonymously post on social media and destroy the world with your Yunyun brain rot. Have a Doki-Doki experience with over 30 denpa songs and multiple endings. Q. Why did she become a hikikomori? Q. How does anonymous online posting lead to world destruction? Q. Does a happy ending exist for a degenerate otaku? The answers to those “Q” s lie at the convergence of insanity and denpa psychosis. Now, put those headphones on and become ill with Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis. ⚡ Anonymously post online and infect the whole world with Yunyun-brain! Get high on denpa songs and spread your heartful psychosis to everyone else! ⚡Characters! ・Qtie (CV:Nanahira) The main character. A hikikomori. She suffered too much irl that she’s become a little (very) fuzzy in the head. Her obsessive love for the fictional character “Yunyun” is for sure an illness. Her overly “high” state from overdosing denpa songs causes her to propagate Yunyun love. Will there really be a happy end for such a degenerate otaku? ・Yunyun (CV:Haruko Momoi) A fictional character that loves Qtie. A very much angelic devil. She will speak to Qtie through the monitor screen. Whilst the truth is unknown, most likely, she is just a figment of Qtie's imagination. It’s joever for her. ⚡About DenpaSongs! Q. What is a “denpa” song? It is a genre of music that is intentionally strange and catchy. All playable songs in this game are denpa songs.
