CHiNCHiYA) 35.Strawberry Cake 36.Quit being a maid? Quit being a human? ♥Listen up! Do you like cute anime girls? Do you like strange and catchy denpa songs? Do you wish for the death of this ♡♡♡♡ed up world? Great! Add “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” to your WishList and stay updated for release information and updates!

title: Neon Rhythm Plus
description: In a future where the dangers of robotics has led the world to outlaw technology, the cyborg Neon faces threats.. and colorful characters.. at every corner. Neon Rhythm Plus is an duel-screen rhythm game, with quick and responsive controls that tests your skills against the city's various obstacles. Deflect, dodge, and time your actions to the beat of the music to succeed. Every song is a new boss! A unique 3-lane gameplay style, where every attack is timed with the beat of the music. A soundtrack featuring songs of multiple genres, from retro chiptune, to synthwave and electronic. Sharp and stylish cartoon cyberpunk graphics, all hand-drawn. EASY and NORMAL difficulty levels, allowing you to enjoy the game no matter your skill level. Full mod/workshop support , with endless potential. Make your own levels with custom music, characters, and dialogue! All story levels were made with the same mod tools available to use.

title: Escape Room Collection C2 Psychological Horror
description: Game Name: Escape Room Collection C2 Psychological Horror Game Description: A collection of escape room games with a psychological horror theme. In these games, where strong horror visual stimuli and clever psychological cues keep players both timid and captivated, you'll be locked in a room surrounded by a terrifying atmosphere where you must find clues and solve puzzles to escape. Each game offers unique and challenging puzzles, with intricate clues and power-ups, unexpected ending routes. Can you survive the tense and terrifying atmosphere of the room, and only the smartest and most resourceful players will succeed in these thrilling escape room challenges. Target: 1. Keep an eye out for any hints and avoid all dangers. 2. Find clues and solve puzzles to escape the escape room. 3. Meet all the secret room challenges. 4. Unlock all the chapters How to play: Once the game starts, you'll explore the game's built secret rooms, which you can tap to complete, so keep an eye out for every detail. On the right side of the game screen is a list of backpacks, where you can view the collected clue items, some items can be used directly, and some items may need to be combined with other items to generate new items to use them normally. The use of props requires a clever combination of daily life experience, but some props may not be able to think about its use according to normal ideas. The specific puzzles in each level are different and need to be explored by the player himself. Again, the game has multiple endings. Skill: The terrifying atmosphere and the route of multiple endings must be carefully observed and calmly analyzed. All clues may be hinting at something Game Features: Series Collection: Multiple chapters with connections, rich levels, intricate puzzles, all kinds of impossible possibilities, mind-blowing! Thriller Horror: Thrill and excitement when in the oppressive horror atmosphere of the game! Multiple endings: The game logic has designed multiple endings, which is full of fun! Leisure decompression: Immerse yourself in the secret room of the game, find and explore, discover new possibilities, discover new clues and props, and guess the purpose of props after getting them, which is exciting and joyful. Reasoning exercises: face a variety of difficult puzzles, messy clues. Actively use your brain, connect them, and solve the problems one by one. It's hearty.
developers: Escape Room Collection C2 Psychological Horror
publishers: Escape Room Collection C2 Psychological Horror

title: Mr Death: The Violent Silence
description: Mr Death is a Terrifying Thriller where you take place as a detective named Sebastian Moonshade in a town named Woodcarve. Your mission is to investigate the murders of the killer Vincent Crowfield whilst playing against his quick-witted AI that learns from your prior actions that will do anything to prevent you from stopping him with his plans.

title: Cyberpunk Inquisitor
description: Dive into this neon-lit, dystopian world as a detective unravelling the mystery behind a series of murders. This game is the first of its kind: a thrilling fusion of rogue-lite randomization and a traditional murder mystery investigation! Every case is set in a sprawling high-density Megabuilding, where you will meet and question various Citizens in order to uncover the truth. Explore each floor of the Megabuilding, from grimy bars to futuristic Habitation Pods, in search of clues and suspects. With each playthrough, face new challenges and unpredictable twists, ensuring no two investigations are ever the same. Utilize your wits and gather evidence to crack the case before time runs out and corruption consumes the city. Can you navigate this unpredictable, treacherous world and bring some justice to its oppressed Citizens?

title: Orion71 Shooter Mayhem Arena
description: Overview: Cybernetic Apocalypse: Rogue Shooter is an action-packed roguelike shooter set in a dystopian cyberpunk future overrun by hordes of zombies, giants, and even dragons. As a lone survivor equipped with high-tech weaponry and cybernetic enhancements, you must navigate through levels filled with relentless enemies, deadly traps, and scarce resources. Each playthrough offers a unique experience, challenging you to adapt and survive in a hostile world where death lurks around every corner. Intense Roguelike Shooter Action: Experience adrenaline-pumping, fast-paced gameplay as you fight your way through generated levels filled with relentless enemies and challenging obstacles. Diverse Enemies: Encounter a variety of enemies, including hordes of undead zombies, towering giants, and fearsome dragons. Each enemy type presents unique challenges and requires different strategies to defeat. Sci-Fi Cyberpunk Setting: Immerse yourself in a gritty cyberpunk world filled with neon lights, futuristic technology as you uncover the secrets of the zombie outbreak. Upgradeable Weapons and Abilities: Customize your playstyle with a wide range of weapons, upgrade your arsenal and unlock devastating abilities to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

title: Grandpa High on Retro
description: A strange phone call has invaded the peace of Grandpa… Only you have the power to rescue the mistress so Grandpa can return to chill in his house. The neighborhood is now your fight arena for an epic fight to rescue the mistress, kill all the enemies! Can you rescue the mistress? Campaign Grandpa will have a visually stunning retro third person action adventure campaign that will keep you on the edge of your seat, with semi open linear level environments with very good world building and storytelling. Grandpa will have intensely gratifying gameplay experience blending Retro graphics with modern third person mechanics. Free DLC: The game includes the Free DLC inside the game and the 2nd Free DLC is currently in development.

title: WARNO - Early Access Pack
description: WARNO ’s Early Access Pack celebrates the community's invaluable and continued support of the game’s development in Early Access. MAIN FEATURES: The Early Access Pack features 7 extra Divisions , 3 of them representing forces in and around a Cold War-era divided Berlin and 4 additional Divisions . Battle for Berlin NATO’s Berlin Command contains the combined forces of three Western Allied garrisons stationed in West Berlin during the Cold War. The Soviet 6th Separate Guards Motorized Rifle Brigade is East Berlin’s powerful counterpart to the NATO garrisons stationed in West Berlin. The East German Berliner Gruppierung is built up around a Nationale Volksarmee’s motorized rifle division, its wartime task to eliminate West Berlin as part of Unternehmen Zentrum. Additional Divisions The American 24th Infantry Division (Mechanized) contains a substantial National Guard component. Based in the United States, it is earmarked to reinforce NATO in West Germany during WARNO’s war scenario. The US 35th Infantry Division is a true National Guard formation and, thanks to its plentiful armored battalions, acts as a missing link between a US Army’s mechanized and tank divisions. Many of its units feature the Reservist trait. The Soviet 27th Guards Motorized Rifle Division was used to trial the latest Cold War equipment available to the Soviet Army as part of the “Division 90” concept. The mixed East German and Polish Rügener Gruppierung contains various anti-landing detachments and formations under a single, unified command. Early Access Pack features: 7 new Divisions for both NATO and Warsaw Pact. New units and models including FV432 RARDEN , F-117A NIGHTHAWK stealth bomber, MIRAGE IV , KGB’s elite Spetsgruppa “A” , L-39ZO , 2S5 GIATSINT-S , National Guard units, and much more.

title: GameCreator - Action Roguelike - 幸存者 - Survivor（类幸存者 Survivor Like）
description: This template is the first party GameCreator game template - 《Survivor》. It can be used to visualize the game of making Action Roguelike. The template contains the functions of GameCreator engine and the core system unique to the template as well as the editor. Joystick and SteamDeck support Core Gameplay Survive on the designated map and use automatic skills to kill incoming enemies. Actor System Multiple actors and their initial attributes and skills can be set for players to choose from. ● Support unlocking actors using coins. ● Support custom attributes and damage calculation formulas for actors. ● The actor's avatar can set collision range ● Support setting the maximum level and upgrade experience curve for actors Enemy System Multiple styles of enemies can be set ● Set the attributes and styles of enemy types in the database ● Place enemies on the level map, set their appearance timing, location, lifecycle, and other parameters ● The enemy's avatar can set collision range Skill System Skills provide a wide range of parameters to set, such as active and passive skills, cooldown time, damage values, etc ● Support shooting bullet screen skills, calculate damage based on the collision range of the bullet screen animation and the enemy's collision range ● Support direct skills, settle damage based on the collision range of the released animation and the enemy's collision range ● Supports locking targets or specifying angles ● Support passive skills and increase character attributes. ● Support related events (such as events when using skills, events when hitting targets) ● Support skill upgrading (e.g. through Hex Technology) ● More parameters waiting for you to experience Hex Technology After actor upgrading, you can select one from multiple Hex Technology. It can create functions to acquire skills, upgrade skills, and customize events (such as clearing all enemies). Supporting multiple parameters for upgrading skills, each Hicks can only upgrade one attribute, such as reducing skill cooldown time and increasing skill damage. Global Talent Global talents will not be reset by restarting the game, and will be strengthened by the coins earned each time the game is played. ● Support enhancing talents to bring new skills into the game ● Support enhancing the initial attributes of the character ● Support factions (as in game examples provide three factions) ● Support setting the upper limit of talent levels and dependency on talent trees ● Support custom events Map Level Multiple levels can be set ● Configure levels by drawing scenes and placing enemies ● Support setting multiple attributes for levels ● Support setting the required number of coins to unlock levels ● Does not support any obstacles Advanced Extension Due to the engine's support for plugins and scripts, and the template providing complete code and corresponding exclusive editors, it can be extended arbitrarily on the basis of the template. More features waiting for you to experience! materials The built-in materials in the template are allowed for commercial use. If used for non GameCreator engines, it is necessary to purchase a professional version of GC software and indicate the source at . It is not allowed to resell slightly modified versions of the material, but free sharing is allowed and must comply with this rule.

title: Turn Based Boxing: Tactics - Legends Edition
description: Enjoy the game in 11 languages: The Most Savage Boxing Game: This is a hard game. Some boxers will die. Recruit fighters and watch them grow older. Train them, assign Perks, Fight. Unlock coaching strategies. Manage finances and upgrade your gym. Play Your Way: Hot swap texture packs at anytime without losing progress. Create Your Gym: Assemble a diverse team of boxers with unique skills and styles. Each boxer contributes to earning cash for the gym. Use cash to train your boxers and bribe the commission. Recruit and Customize Boxers: Scour the globe for the most talented fighters to join your gym. From seasoned veterans to up-and-coming prospects, every boxer has unique strengths, weaknesses, and personalities. Dozens of Perks / Endless Boxer Builds: Perks are special abilities that enhance a boxer's performance in different aspects of the game. These can range from increased stamina and power to improved defensive maneuvers or tactical advantages in the ring. As the manager,  choose which perks to enable. Synergize perks with each boxer's talents, weaknesses, fighting style, and the gyms overall goals. Increasing Stats by Training: Allocate cash to increase your boxers' base stats. Each stat contributes to a boxer's overall performance in the ring and can be improved. Some stats have stars, meaning the boxer is talented. Death: When a boxer sustains injuries during matches they risk death. Boxers age over time. At 60 years old one is vulnerable to death from injuries. At 100 they will die. Complete Quests and Unlock Strategies: Meet quest criteria to unlock strategies that any boxer in your gym can utilize. Strategies can be changed before each round of fighting. Climb the Ranking and win the Lineal Championship: With perseverance, strategy, and a little bit of luck, you'll lead your gym to greatness and cement your legacy as one of the greatest boxing managers of all time. Join the discord and share your fighters and compete in tournaments. About the Developer: This game was made for boxers and boxing fans by a boxer and a boxing fan. Learn about real boxing tactics, boxing history, culture and slang. Discover and challenge the easter egg boxers from the living, the dead and the fictional.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
description: Grab your friends, pick your favorite TMNT character and jump into an adventure to save Master Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious online and local co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales. Looking for a more immediate, high-intensity challenge? Dive into the brand-new Arcade Mode packed with unpredictable runs, the Hex and Flex system, new biomes, fearsome Wraith enemies, and even more chaotic fun with friends. Brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike TMNT action where no two runs are the same. With randomized power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies. Master the powers of water and fire, utrom and ooze, light and darkness, robotics and -most importantly- Ninja to create unique and bodacious builds for your TMNT characters. Every run brings new challenges and opportunities - explore and perfect your favorite builds, and combine them with allies to conquer your enemies. When Splinter is kidnapped by Shredder, mysterious portals appear across NYC and the Turtles will battle to recover their father from the clutches of the Foot Clan. However, an even greater threat lingers in the shadows… With additional settings, balance and tuning enhancements for PC, Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!

title: Cupig's Key Collectathon
description: Cupig's Key Collectathon is a simple game where you collect keys to open treasure chests. Your main objective it to solve harder and harder levels finding the shortest way possible the fastest. If you fall you die but the timer continues to go on so be precise! 100Levels! Solve 100 harder and harder levels, visiting several worlds from sky islands to the deep sea. Be fast! Beat your time, be the fastest Pig to collect all the keys and treasure!

title: Life Sim
description: Life Sim is a unique simulation game that gives you complete freedom to live however you choose. The game has no set goals—you define your own. Whether you want to build a successful career, manage properties, create a budget, stay fit, or anything else, Life Sim offers every essential feature you’d expect from a life simulation game. In Life Sim , you are the center of everything. The world revolves around you. Shape your country’s economy for the better and raise the standard of living, or plunge it into chaos, leading to mass emigration and death waves. The choices are entirely yours. You have the power to influence your country’s economy, agriculture, exports, and imports. Become the beloved king of your people, or play as the feared landowner who controls all the farmlands and is both hated and feared. Life Sim lets you create your dream character and your dream country, putting ultimate control in your hands.

title: Naval Action - Galeon
description: Naval Action - Galeon This is a premium consumable ship. It is not refundable. You must have an appropriate rank to sail it fully crewed. Galeon - was once a workhorse of international trade.  It is an armed trader so you will easily handle any light threat from pirates and privateers. Great looks, modest speed, and being fully refurbished this 17th century ship makes a statement about your great taste in classic retro boats. About premium consumable vessels. Premium ships cannot be captured by players or traded. You can request this vessel from the admiralty once a day as long as you don't have the same vessel already in your docks. You will be able to request the frame and planking wood type when ordering a ship. Admiralty requests for this ship will be completed instantly. Imported DLC ships allows you to ignore hauling of resources and crafting receiving the ship for free: Just  buy guns, repairs, and other consumables and you are good to go. If you don't plan to use the ship for combat - for example for hauling - you don't even need guns, repairs and consumables. DLC will appear in your redeemable list after you dock to any port. You must have an appropriate rank to sail it fully crewed.

title: Finn JRPG
description: Turn-based traditional RPG in a low fantasy setting. Grind mobs for gold and gear in a setting based on old Finnish mythology, then upgrade your party to advance to stronger areas. Defeat monsters, then invest gold in stores to upgrade your characters to be able to defeat stronger monsters. Zero instances of downtime between player inputs and gameplay for the entire duration of the game, optimal for casual play as well as speedrunning. Fully playable with Controllers and Steam Deck. Created by a single developer on a shoe-string budget. All source code available under AGPL license at: https://github.com/anttijuo/CrowningReverie

title: Awaken: Hentai Dice
description: The world of magic has been always close to our own, and there was no order in it. The Legenday Laughing Wizard has united the city many years ago, and before his disappearance hid innumerable treasures, the key to which was his dice. For a long time this wonderful artefact had no owner, but now everything has changed. ✨ By the Will of Fate, you become it's owner ✨ You couldn't even imagine how your life would change after you found some strange dice at your grandfather's house. Turns out the familiar City is inhabited by monsters and magical creatures, and magic is everywhere - you just have to be able to see it. After getting the dice of the Legendary Laughing Wizard, you will be drawn into intrigues and squabbles, battles and treasure hunts. And of course, a real wizard will never be left without the attention of charming women. Just don't forget that not everything in the City is what it seems, and can you really trust these beauties? Numerous sex scenes are seamlessly integrated into a fast-paced plot. Win the trust and favor of sorceresses, demonesses and catgirls. Defeat your opponents using the dice mechanics. Upgrade your dice and find new ones to become stronger. Look for spells and save up mana in battle to use them at the right moment. Don't forget about the side quests. What reward awaits you at the end of this amazing adventure depends only on your choice. Dare to dive into a fantasy world full of adventure, danger and desire! ⭐️ 12 girls with their own goals, history, and interests ⭐️ Determine your worldview - will you embrace magic or seek to return to the familiar world? ⭐️ A plot full of humor and drama ⭐️ Animated characters and sex scenes ⭐️ Interesting combat system based on dice and spells ⭐️ Upgrade and collect a unique set of dice ⭐️ Side quest in the City and from girls ⭐️ Beautiful visual style

title: Platformer Paradise
description: In the current state of the game there are: 2 Unique Playable Levels to explore and conquer. In this game called Platformer Paradise , a man on a mission, going through an obstacle course. Be careful this is not a walk in the park. Avoid Obstacles to complete levels, use anything to your advantage, hiding behind walls, glass, even staying out of the view of Cannons will suffice towards your survival.

title: Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle-
description: —A roguelite × puzzle game where quick thinking decides your survival— This game is a hybrid that fuses the strategic depth unique to roguelites, the thrill of match-3 puzzles, and the freedom of deckbuilding! Players aim to strengthen their deck to achieve the target score set for each stage. Lose, retry, and chase that next burst of satisfaction. 【Deck-Building】 Customize and enhance your puzzle deck to aim for high scores! Each card triggers a unique chain reaction on the board. The key lies in how you design the connections between your cards. 【Relics】 Your relic choices can make or break a run. It's all up to you! Here are just a few of the many unique relics you’ll encounter: Create special blocks with 4-match combos Boost score multipliers when clearing 3+ colors at once Having more coins allows you to earn more points Stack relics for massive synergy and score bonuses! 【Puzzle Techniques】 Slide the puzzle grid both vertically and horizontally— This unconventional control scheme demands forward thinking and flexible strategy. Stay sharp! Even tough situations can be turned around with the right moves. Solve the puzzle… or face the consequences. Customize your voxel character with various outfits and styles. Lose a match, and witness your cute avatar meet a shockingly intense voxel fatality—a mix of dark humor and visual flair that’s as satisfying as it is brutal. Unravel the mysteries of ancient ruins using powerful stone tablets! Disrupt your rivals and fight for the top spot! Up to 8 players can go head-to-head in competitive puzzle battles. Use huge combos to sabotage your opponents—and claim victory with style. Treasure hunters from around the world set off on a board game-style adventure Ancient relics said to grant any wish lie hidden in dangerous ruins. Face powerful guardians like the Desert Sphinx, the Dragon of the Scorched Ruins, or the Kraken of the Sunken Temple— Defeat them by solving ancient puzzles and uncover the truth behind their legends! Rogues, outlaws, and rival explorers—each has their own wish. What will yours be? Please refer to the official guidelines available on our website for content creation and streaming permissions.

title: ESports Simulator
description: ADD TO WISHLIST ESports Simulator is a simulation game where you can create and manage your own esports team. Control all aspects of a professional esports team - from selecting players, organizing training programs, building a gaming house, and purchasing equipment. FEATURES Create and manage your own esports team. Transfer players, develop training programs, and devise strategies to achieve the best performance. {img}{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/PlayerBuyingGif.gif[/img] Build and manage a dedicated gaming house for your team. Provide the best conditions to enhance your players' performance. Buy the best gaming equipment for your players. Observe and optimize the effects of different equipment on player performance. Test your team's performance in realistic simulated matches. Implement your strategies and compete against rival teams. Track player performance and team statistics in detail. Observe K/D/A ratios, earned rewards, and more.

title: Lost Girl Platformer
description: Lost Girl Platformer is a thrilling 2D platform game where you play as a courageous girl. Your task is to jump from platform to platform to survive and escape. But be careful: time is limited, and every jump must be precise! Features: - Pixel graphics - Obstacle courses - Timer Good luck!

title: Board Game Society
description: With Friends Pass, only one player needs to own the game. Invite your friends and play together without everyone having to buy a copy THE DEPTH UPDATE ADDS A NEW LAYER OF PLAYER AGENCY, WITH UNIQUE CHARACTER ABILITIES, A MUCH LARGER ABILITY CARD POOL, MORE EVENTS AND EVEN MORE WAYS TO INFLUENCE YOUR GAMES. CHARACTER ABILITIES Each character now has their own unique ability, making them have their own tactical advantage and playstyle. 20+ NEW ABILITY CARDS 20+ new ability cards, expanding and giving the player even more tactical agency with new ways to influence everything from encounters with monsters & players, movement, traps and the board itself. NEW EVENTS New events that creates more interaction between players, and shakes up the board in different ways. PASS & PLAY Play together locally on the same pc, with only 1 controller / Keyboard & mouse. Making couch and Pass & Play sessions much easier to set up and play. CONTROLLER SUPPORT Controller support is now added, making the game even more comfortable to kick back, relax and play. Battle your way through the board. The tougher the foe, the better the rewards. Trick, trap, or take them down... but beware, they’ll do the same to you. Hunt down hidden crystals across the board. No crystals, no final fight. Only one can claim victory. Will you have the most crystals? Game features: Multiplayer PVP Multiplayer PVE Boardgame aesthetics Horror satirical elements Turn-based gameplay Original music Custom cards and boardgame Skin customization Tabletop vibes Multiple levels P2P hosting solution Multiple Events

title: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox
description: The Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox game immerses players in a world of realistic physics and unpredictable interactions. In this virtual universe, ragdoll characters have a unique balance system that allows them to rebalance themselves after receiving impacts or pushes, resulting in extremely realistic animations. The main feature of this game is the freedom given to players to interact with characters in creative and dynamic ways. They can throw knives, shoot different firearms, and even cause spectacular explosions. Additionally, players can incite fights between characters, allowing punches, kicks, dodges and shots during intense confrontations. One of the most interesting features of the game is the player's ability to take control of any character present, enabling a unique and varied gaming experience in each session. Additionally, players have the freedom to create their own levels, adding an element of customization and creativity to the game.

title: 家屋探索 -Japanese House Exploration-
description: What Kind of Game is Japanese House Exploration? It is a first-person mystery horror adventure game set in a  Japanese house. A Japanese house that shouldn't exist, inhabited by an unidentified creature. You explore that nostalgic house, uncovering its mysteries. The Story ――My friend has gone missing. She disappeared on her way back from school. There are no witnesses. ――However, I have a clue. "I'm being called to that house" She said this yesterday when she seemed strange. There shouldn't have been a house in such a place. Half in doubt, I headed towards it and found a traditional Japanese house standing there. The boy, though scared, had made up his mind to find his precious friend. With determination in his heart, he stepped into the Japanese house. The number of endings. There are 4 endings.(Add one more ending) Play time The playtime for this game is estimated to be between 60 to 90 minutes. Digression This is my first game, but I hope you enjoy it! If you get stuck in the later part, please refer to this walkthrough video: ↓ Uploading and livestreaming Guidelines welcome. title: Violent Horror Stories: anthology
description: "Violent Horror Stories: anthology" is an anthology of horror games from different authors. Each game represents the authors' take on the theme of "pursuit" with its own visual design, gameplay, and story. The average completion time for each game is 15-30 minutes. title: Dead Soul TowerDefense:Shadow Labyrinth
description: This is a pixel-style classic tower defense game that incorporates roguelike elements. You need to summon souls to fend off enemy attacks, and each type of soul has its unique skill tree, with skills randomly selected upon upgrading. The game features an endless mode where you must achieve the highest score possible to unlock more skill trees. You can build your own unique maze. 8 unique defense towers, each with their own specialized skills: Steal, Slow, Stun, Critical Hit, Multi-Arrows, Bloodthirst, Poison Arrows, Armor Reduction... Killing monsters increases your experience level. When you level up, you can randomly choose unique skills to build your own playstyle. You can adjust the difficulty of the levels to achieve higher scores. Upgrade your skill tree for permanent boosts! Achievement system: Unlock more Soul Artifacts and challenge higher difficulties! If you're interested, add it to your wishlist! That way, I'll be more motivated to release more updates! If you have a better idea, please contact me by email! My

title: Valorwood (Early Access)
description: Washed Ashore on a Living World Awaken on the mystical Isle of Valor and set out on a journey shaped by time itself. In Valorwood , every realm, timeline, and dimension holds its own dangers, biomes, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Each choice you make forges a new path through a world bound to the fabric of time. Survival Across Realms Develop vital survival skills to endure changing climates, gather resources, and adapt to harsh environments. From lush forests to hollow swamps and scorching deserts, each biome demands a different strategy as you hunt, craft, and thrive. Explore Timelines and Dimensions Journey beyond ordinary worlds into ancient civilizations and forgotten ages. Traverse realms such as the Celestial Realm, Underworld Realm, Apocalypse Dimension, Ancient Egypt Timeline, Dynasty Era Timeline, and Viking Age Timeline as you uncover the true story connecting them all. Craft, Build, and Brew Collect materials to forge tools, armor, and structures that empower your survival. Construct functional bases, create potions, and personalize your surroundings with decorative and practical elements that evolve with your progress. Fight, Evolve, and Conquer Master dynamic combat styles, from close-quarters strikes to long-range attacks and magical techniques. Unlock abilities like Forager, Beastmaster, and Necromancer, customizing your playstyle to face evolving threats across timelines. Discover and Shape the World Embark on main quests, side adventures, and hidden dungeons that reveal the deeper mysteries of Valorwood . Dynamic weather and time systems influence your journey, from clear skies to raging storms, creating a living world that constantly shifts around you. Companions and Comforts Tame creatures to aid your travels and join you in battle. Engage in peaceful pursuits like fishing, cooking, farming, and trading, or take on mini-games and challenges to earn rewards and customize your experience. Key Features Stylized open-world survival RPG spanning realms, timelines, and dimensions Deep crafting, brewing, and base-building systems Dynamic third-person combat with multiple playstyles and abilities Procedural weather and biome diversity across regions Quests, dungeons, factions, and hidden lore to uncover Single-player, co-op, and multiplayer support Companion taming, trading, farming, and side activities

title: Difficult times
description: Monsters are attacking! Enemies are moving along the roads to the portals, and you must stop them! Summon knights and place towers that will attack the aggressor! For destroyed enemies, you will receive gold, which you can spend on defensive structures. Place barricades on the roads to slow down the enemy's movement. Use magic to turn the tide of battle. Use resources wisely and you will win! Game genre - tactics Game features: Dynamic gameplay Lots of enemies Interesting gameplay

title: Difficult times 2
description: Monsters have returned to our lands! Undead and goblins are trying to destroy us. Stop them before they reach the portal! Place towers that will attack them! Summon soldiers, place barricades to stop them! You can summon a slowing fog that will appear near the towers and slow down the movement of enemies along the roads. For destroyed enemies, rubies are given, which can be spent on building towers. Use magic, which is gradually restored. Enemies come in different types, some are fast, some have a large supply of health. Act carefully and you will win! Many enemies Interesting gameplay Dynamic gameplay

title: Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool
description: Confront Destiny About the Software This tool is separate from the "Black Myth: Wukong" game itself and is non-playable. The "Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool" is a PC benchmark application specifically developed for "Black Myth: Wukong". It evaluates your hardware performance and system compatibility through the real-time rendering of an in-game sequence. You can customize benchmark settings to preview game visuals and performance under different graphics options. ※ Due to the complexity and variability of gaming scenarios, the benchmark results may not fully represent the actual gaming experience and final performance.

title: Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking
description: Co-Op Kaiju Horror Cooking is exactly what the name suggests. You and your friends are medieval monks, chefs--and walking liabilities. In this absurdist online multiplayer horror game, 2-4 of your favorite people (or more, if you want to risk your computers/sanity) must use traps, proximity voice chat, and Gregorian chanting among other tools to feed giant monsters known as 'kaiju', gather treasure, and prevent the apocalypse. You have 10 minutes. Don't stay in the Larder. Don't get caught. Features Flexible tag-based cooking system. Chop ingredients, salt them, burn them--and then fire them into a kaiju's jaws! A story about grappling with your faith as your leaders begin to die off, leaving you to carry the torch, told across 13 levels. The first-ever multiplayer project from the developers behind Clickolding and I Am Your Beast. Dramatic medieval soundtrack by award-winning composer David Mason (Dredge, Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3). Run away from monstrous creatures--and when necessary, turn them into food. No tomatoes, since they were only introduced to Europe in the 16th century.
