title: Hell Shooter
description: Hell Shooter is a roguelike dungeon crawler game. It features unique attack methods, exhilarating action, an oriental hellish atmosphere, and each character's storytelling. Unique attack method When attacking enemies, you must only attack them by dashing!! Design the optimal attack path by bouncing between structures and enemies. Soul Eruption There are rewards for good play. Collect the combo gauge to erupt your soul. It will be a powerful attack. 100 items Countless items will help you on your adventure. Collect more items to cast powerful attacks. Ghosts of the Underworld Encounter ghosts with their own stories. Game design considering replayability Experience the underworld that changes every time you explore. Death is not the end. Explore and earn money to purchase reinforcements and items!!

title: VR Sailing
description: Did you go out to sea today. Everyone has a dream of sailing in their hearts, but due to geographical reasons, time constraints, economic reasons, and so on, it has been abandoned. Here are bays suitable for sailing competitions from all over the world, come and enjoy the fun of sailing to the fullest. The operation of sailboats in the game is not so complicated. Just control the rudder with your left hand and the sail with your right hand to flexibly control the sailboat and enjoy the pleasure of riding the wind and waves. Here, you can participate in sailing competitions along a fixed route, or embark on treasure hunting adventures at will. The wind direction is different every time, which can bring more fun and freshness. Highlights ■13 real bay maps from around the world to choose from ■You can choose between competition mode and treasure hunting mode ■There are simple mode and expert mode to choose from ■There are two operating habits to choose from: switching forward or reverse ■Each scene has 8 wind directions to choose from ■There are 10 randomly occurring weather conditions ■There are 50 patterns and 5 colors of sails that can be purchased with points ■Realistic ocean wave effects ■A fully physics based sailing experience ■Each competition route will go through stages of downwind, headwind, and crosswind ■According to the 9 levels that have been upgraded based on the voyage, there are 9 levels waiting for you to challenge ■Every game will match different opponents

title: VIOLENT RUSH
description: “Lonely street artist Gene takes the desperate step of joining a crew of fellow graffiti rebels led by the cunning and arrogant young Vanessa. With his help, will the gang be able to shake up the society of their hometown, which is suffocating under the cruelty of the authorities and the regime?” VIOLE[n]T RUSH is a short visual novel that will captivate you for a couple of hours with its intricate plot and cyberpunk atmosphere. Learn about the street art movement in the futuristic metropolis of New Astra, the past of its greatest crew – HE11AHOUND – and its legendary founders. Inside you’ll find: An engaging, fast-paced story, 2-3 hours long; Stylized, hand-drawn graphics; Strong, vivid characters; Cinematic sound effects, an atmospheric soundtrack, and vibrant visuals. The game uses licensed Creative Commons music made by the following artists: Beat Mekanik, bent wyre, BrokeMC, Kellee Maize, Lightning Traveler, Pierce Murphy , and Yshwa.

title: Claritas - Dungeon Crawler RPG
description: Claritas is a 2D, turn-based, party-building dungeon crawler RPG with a variety of unique systems and mechanics. Claritas offers multiple playable characters, each with four unique abilities, allowing for endless strategic combinations. Build your party from a diverse roster of characters, with the flexibility to swap members at any time throughout the game. Enhance your heroes' abilities using skill points earned with each level up. You can freely redistribute these points at any time, allowing for flexible customization. Take on bounty hunting contracts to eliminate specific monsters, earning valuable rewards like experience points, gold, and other bonuses. Unlock powerful perks that provide permanent enhancements to your entire party. Encounter unpredictable random events in dungeons, each offering unique choices that lead to different consequences.

title: Canvas - The Board Game
description: Create stunning paintings and earn ribbons in Canvas , the digital version of the acclaimed board game that challenges your strategy and artistic eye. In Canvas , you combine transparent Art Cards to create unique paintings, with each card adding elements and icons that shape your final score. Strategic choices about which cards to layer, and which icons to reveal or cover, are key to meeting scoring conditions and earning ribbons. Each painting contributes to your score while also becoming a one-of-a-kind masterpiece with its own title. The game features stunning artwork on each card, designed to inspire your creativity. Every decision shapes your painting, creating satisfying challenges for both new and experienced players. FEATURES: Cross-platform online multiplayer! Private online games with friends Local multiplayer (on the same device or via Steam Remote Play) Solo play against bots Synced progress across all your devices. Play online game on one device, continue on another! A gallery of your best paintings An interactive tutorial The full set of Art Cards for endless painting combinations © 2025 Mipmap, under license from Tycoon Games

title: Golf With Your Friends 2
description: Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. If you loved the first game, buckle up, you’re in for a hole lot more. New courses, new chaos, and enough ridiculous moments to make you question your friendship choices (in the best possible way). And if you’ve never played Golf With Your Friends before? Friend. Where have you been? Hiding in a bunker? It’s fine — you can jump straight in with everyone else soon. Very soon. Twelve. Players. Twelve. More late nights. More arguments. More moments where someone sinks a hole-in-one by pure accident and won’t stop talking about it for the rest of the round. Whether you’re playing locally or cross platform, everyone’s invited. Introducing Chaos Mode, where the courses fight back! Putt your way through remixed courses, where players who can adapt on the fly and embrace the chaos, come out on top. No two playthroughs are the same in this brand-new experience. Build the course of your (or someone else’s) nightmares The revamped level editor (course creator) is now available on all platforms! Giving you more tools, more options, and more power to create courses that your friends will either applaud or never forgive you for. Build it, share it and take zero responsibility for what happens next. Golf With Your Friends 2. More modes, more mayhem, more reasons to question your life choices. Wishlist now. Fall is closer than it looks.

title: Esports History: Prologue
description: Esports History: Prologue is an RPG simulator combining time management, character development, and deep mini-games. You will take the role of an ordinary student and develop him into a professional eSports player. Defeat bosses in tournaments, raise your reputation in the community, and become the best! TIME-MANAGEMENT The race with the strongest players never ends. Properly manage your time to train and earn money, but control stress and fatigue to come out of the battle as a winner. MINI-GAMES Enjoy alternative versions of hit games of the past. Develop in one of the eSports disciplines: strategies or shooters. Training skills, upgrading your skill tree and mental state affect your character's strength in mini-games. CREATE A UNIQUE CHARACTER Form your own play style. Upgrade your characteristics and talents as you wish. Will you train AIM to improve marksmanship or Strafe to become elusive? Develop an economy by dominating resources or micro-control to emerge victorious? It's up to you.

title: Erotic Rhythm
description: Purchase Notice Players who have bought Sexy Beats, please note that this game is the same work, only some characters are different. If you cannot accept it, please do not buy it. Thank you. About the Game "Erotic Rhythm" is an addictive and sexy rhythm game. Simple operation, beautiful songs and attractive girls to bring you a dreamy flow experience. Just hit the notes accurately and the girl will swing her body to the music. Game features ♪ 10 Erotic animated CGs Girls in the cgs will react to the game beats by swing their bodies and even take off clothes. ♪ 10 beautiful songs Including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian and English. Multiple styles, different experiences. ♪ Simple operation Only 2 buttons are needed to play the game. Anyone can get started quickly. ♪ Each song contains 3 difficulties Play the simple mode easily, practice in the normal mode, and finally challenge the hard mode! ♪ Score leaderboard Try to get a higher score and leave your name on the leaderboard! ♪ CG Gallery Enjoy girls' charming bodies and make them swing as you like.

title: iRacing Arcade
description: iRacing Arcade is a third-person racer where your skills on and off the track shape your journey from grassroots racing to motorsport glory. Compete in races to earn resources, then decide how to grow your team. Will you invest in buildings to unlock boosts that give you a crucial track advantage? Or will you focus on recruiting top-tier drivers to compete for you in licensed global series? Every choice matters. Build your legacy, one race at a time! Tactile Physics Model Race across multiple categories with a physics model that’s easy to learn yet endlessly rewarding, keeping you hooked as you chase the perfect lap. Build a Motorsport Legacy Compete in weekly events across licensed series to earn resources, then invest in buildings,  new cars, skilled drivers, or customizations that showcase your team’s brand. Race in Licensed Tracks & Series From the Porsche 911 GT3 Cup in Imola to the GTP at Mexico City’s legendary Hermanos Rodríguez Autodrome, iRacing Arcade lets you experience the vibrant world of motorsport with stylized recreations of licensed cars and tracks. Host or Join Online Races Compete in online multiplayer with up to 11 competitors worldwide. Leave your mark in Global Time Trials Hone your racing line as you chase top times on the Global Leaderboards—or set the pace and let others chase you. With weekly rotations, the competition always stays fresh.

title: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26
description: Step into the All-Madden legacy this season. Experience generational playmakers, unlock rewards, and celebrate football’s greatest coach. Energize your team in EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26 with the Goal Line Pack! Log in to Madden Ultimate Team in Madden NFL 26 and receive three 88 OVR BND to add to your lineup: LaDainian Tomlinson, TJ Watt, Jalen Ramsey EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26 leverages a new AI-powered machine learning system to convert thousands of plays from nearly a decade of real NFL data into more explosive gameplay—with new player-specific traits, authentic play-styles, and adaptive counters that match on-field tendencies and strategies of NFL quarterbacks and coaches. From the Skol chant in Minnesota to the light show in Baltimore, immerse yourself in new presentation across the NFL including game-impacting weather, team traditions, and dynamic halftime shows with Scott Hanson. Built from Sundays. Real NFL data powers the realest Madden to date. SIGNATURE QBS Star NFL quarterbacks move, look, and feel more like the superstars they are. EXPLOSIVE NFL GAMEPLAY Explosive NFL action at your fingertips with improved player movement. COACH DNA Adaptive counters informed by real NFL coaching trends. ROSTER MANAGEMENT Modernized depth charts, new positional roles, and the Wear & Tear system add strategy and experimentation to roster management and game-planning. FOOTBALL WEATHER Depending on how extreme the conditions are, Football Weather can completely disrupt your original game plan. Adapt to new challenges like limited visibility downfield in heavy snow and fog, or wet conditions that will directly impact player movement, stamina, ball security, and more. DEFENSIVE CONTROL & STRATEGY Control your pass-coverage depth with new custom zones, and perfect your pass rush strategy with new stunts and twist options at the line. This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

title: Hack and Slash Fury
description: *This game includes all downloadable or purchasable content for free inside the game. Action to the rhythm of Heavy Metal Fight and destroy the dark soldiers while you are advancing and hearing heavy metal songs and complete the stage for see the next epic cinematic! True Deep Action Unleash all your fury on the battlefield and slash your enemies into pieces! The true hack and slash it´s here! Giving a true combo system gameplay with the same controls and deep combo system of the bests! With lot of cinematics and legendary medieval charachters! feel in your hands! and in your PC! a true hack and slash game! not an easy and repetitive game like the rest! Here you will have to learn how to play! become stronger! learn to do attacks! combos! movements! use special attacks and much more! like if you are playing a true 3D hack and slash like the old times... You are bored of easy simple games withouth cinematics? erase them! now it´s time to download Hack And Slash Fury!!! Show your sword! Unleash your fury! Destroy all your enemies!!! And save the world of the hands of Tyranny And Destruction!!! And see with your own eyes tons of Scenarios! epic Cinematics! and epic Soundtracks!!!! Lot Of Cinematics Experiment a full canonic Story Mode wich wants to give a cinematic and manga shonen style with charachters of great lore and strong personality forged in war, after each stage a new cinematic it's waiting for you, advance on this epic history while you are fighting against lot of enemies and new scenarios. Deep Combo System Multiple combo routes which offers multiple advantages regardling to your current position and the one of the upcoming enemies, use each combo route with brain so you can unleash all your true potential and destroy all your enemies fiercely. Charge Your Attacks Hold down the attack button and you'll start charging up an attack that will destabilize the enemy if you manage to execute it at the perfect time. Fury Mode Prepare for enter a state wich will increase your speed but decrease your hit precission, use it for gain more Fury Attacks Bar and do damage fastly, when it's ending do the Special Super Movement and destroy all your enemies in front of you with an epic movement of slow motion time. Fury Attacks Use Fury Attacks Bar to do fastly charged attacks and stop your enemies with great hits and extend your combos even more. FPS/TPS Camera Change the camera view while you are fighting, change from the classical charachter camera to an inmersive first person like FPS games or play with a third person camera with less zoom to fully see your charachter, and only pressing a button! Epic Soundtrack Enjoy Heavy Metal Obsidian Shell Music for Stages and Orquestal ones of other musicians for Cinematics. 10-15 hours Story Mode A Great War between Light and Dark Empires with great rivalities between memorable charachters With lots of cinematics, enemies, stages, combos, type of attacks and great learning curve. Customizable Enemy Speed More slower on easy difficulties giving a more paused gameplay and more fast on harder difficulties to give a more fast gameplay experience. Your Mouse it´s your Sword(or use gamepad) Move with mouse, attack and do combos combining the left and right click, rotate the camera with the wheel and press it to use the main Fury attack!!! only you will have to use keyboard on specific cases like activate fury mode, enable movement, change view zoom or pause the game. Dinamic Scenario Ambientation No scenario will be the same the next time you play It, the textures, sky and music will change randomly for each scenario, tons of combinations giving the impression the scenario has completely changed, and there is lot of completely new scenarios with tons of posible combinations, replayability it's giant on this game. Finally a True Hack And Slash Stop of play easy and repetitive games, this haves a great learning curve to exploit all your potential, you will be able to dominate the fury state, fury mode, combos, position, dash and destroy all your enemies to see the upcoming cinematic? while you are hearing heavy metal songs and experiencing an epic history about war between Dark And Light Empire? K.O. triangle Fill the Fury bar and get a K.O triangle with which you can eliminate any enemy in one slash! but be careful! if you fail it you will have spent it in vain! Talk button Press the speak button to hear the protagonist say mythical phrases in whatever language you are playing the video game in! with multiple phrases in more than 10 languages! Turn auto-pointing on or off Tired of the typical hack and slash where your player attacks automatically without the need to aim at the enemy? Deactivate it and savor the authentic demands of an ultra-complex combat system! Immersive Lighting Fog or darkness? Each stage has its own style! And every time you complete the game all the night and fog stages will change to the opposite! Online PVP Mode (1-8 players) Fight against rivals from all over the world and any platform in online mode with Crospplay! Master the deep and complex combat system and its multiple combos, zoning, evasion and aiming techniques! to destroy them all! FPS at Maximum This game does not block the amount of FPS that your screen plays as it happens in many others, here it will work at the maximum FPS that your screen supports, you can reduce this value in the main menu options. The Golden Age Returns Hack And Slash Fury is a trip back in time to when video games were made with all the love and innovation possible and were also reinforced by placing special emphasis on the depth of gameplay, challenge, story, music and personality, bringing a totally unique, innovative and nostalgic experience. Support & Updates This game will receive updates regardless of the date the game was released if the game needs them and the developer can make them.

title: RPG Maker MZ - Sci-Fi Near-Future Action BGM Pack
description: This high-quality sound pack is perfect for action RPGs and shooting games! It includes themes for main gameplay, combat, tutorials, configuration screens, and various other events, all crafted to fit a cohesive world view. With looping tags, the ogg and m4a files are ready to be seamlessly integrated into your game right away. ******************************************* Contents: OGG files: 13 items M4A files: 13 items ******************************************* ・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice. ・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker ・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.

title: Software Dev Tycoon
description: Step into the world of software development and build your own tech empire in Software Dev Tycoon ! Start as a small, scrappy startup and grow into a software giant by managing projects, hiring skilled developers, and tackling industry challenges. Develop cutting-edge applications, take on lucrative contracts, and navigate the complex world of software engineering. You’ll need to balance creativity and efficiency as you manage deadlines, budgets, and client expectations. Will you create the next hit app, or will your competitors outshine you in the race to innovate? In Software Dev Tycoon , every decision matters—whether it’s choosing the right projects, managing your talent pool, or expanding your business. The road to success won’t be easy, but the rewards are limitless! Key Features: Start and grow your company : From small projects to full-scale software solutions, evolve your business and build your reputation. Manage your team : Hire and train employees based on their strengths and skills. Develop diverse software : Create apps, websites, and custom software to meet your clients' demands. Research and innovate : Unlock new technologies and tools to stay ahead of the competition. Contracts and deadlines : Balance tight schedules and budgets to deliver projects on time and keep your clients happy. Market your products : Promote and sell your software, gaining users and profits to reinvest in your business. Dynamic industry : Adapt to a constantly changing market as trends, technologies, and competitors evolve. Whether you're looking for a fun and casual experience or want to strategize your way to tech stardom, Software Dev Tycoon offers a dynamic simulation of the software industry. Can you take your company to the top?

title: Rhythm Hotel
description: Follow Me X：@Rhythm_Hotel Discord：ENet75YjE7 About the Game 🎵「Rhythm Hotel」is a rhythm game bursting with wildly unpredictable, absurdly hilarious storylines. The playable demo offers a taste of the bizarre, darkly humorous rhythm challenges waiting inside this fantastical inn bursting with whimsy and beats. The full version will deliver over 20 wildly unique rhythm mini-games, each with its own ridiculous story. Step into 🎵Rhythm Hotel🎵 — where every tap launches a rhythm-fueled adventure! One-Button Controls, Instantly Addictive The rules are simple: every level runs on a single button. That one design choice lets your hands keep time before your brain catches up, so the rhythm gets into your body right away. One button is all you need, you could almost play it with your eyes closed. Eccentric Cast, Hilarious Tales The hotel is packed with bizarre guests from every corner of history and the globe, each with a laugh-out-loud story and a signature rhythm skill to match. Check in for a delightfully absurd adventure where every tap sends the story somewhere you didn't expect. Ever-Evolving Rhythm Challenge No two levels play the same. Test your timing, your rhythmic memory, and your precision as new mechanics pile up and get trickier, easy to pick up, and genuinely hard to master. Musical Universe Explore music from all over the world: pounding EDM, retro disco, earworm pop, and gleefully oddball sound effects. Any genre can become a rhythm playground. A Message from the Devs: 🎵 We're a three-person indie studio that started with rhythm games, but we dream bigger. We want to push the boundaries of the genre, exploring how rhythm can fuse with different mechanics, styles, and emotions. Close your eyes. Catch the beat with your ears, let your fingers dance to the melody. Open them, and every tap has turned into an unexpected twist in the story. 🎵 Rhythm Hotel is currently in development, targeting a release by the end of the year. If it looks like your kind of chaos.  please 「Wishlist it now」 ! Your support means the world to us, it's the fuel for our late-night crunch sessions!

title: Toy Battlegrounds: Shoot 'Em Up Survival
description: New Shoot 'em up Survival! About the Game Toy Battlegrounds is a shoot 'em up survival game set in a kid’s bedroom. Battle endless waves of toys using a variety of weapons in atmospheric nighttime surroundings. Survive against different enemy types, collect power-ups, and prove your skills in this action-packed toy war! About Toy Battlegrounds Toy Battlegrounds is a shoot 'em up survival  game set in the vibrant and chaotic world of a kid’s bedroom. Transformed to toy size, you must survive relentless waves of animated toys that come to life in the dead of night. Use a variety of weapons, each with unique firepower, and unlock power-ups to enhance your arsenal. Key Features Face off against different enemy types, from swarming toy soldiers to hulking bosses, all while navigating around the room’s obstacles. With an atmospheric nighttime setting, intense gameplay, and non-stop action, Toy Battlegrounds challenges you to hold your ground and become the ultimate toy hero!

title: Snow Resort Simulator
description: Be part of our Community About the Game You don't manage this resort from a menu. You run it with your own two hands. Snow Resort Simulator drops you at the foot of a mountain with nothing but a run-down ticket booth. Every improvement starts with physical work: shovel snow off walkways, chop firewood and feed it to the fireplace, crack ice off rooftops with snowballs, and haul supplies through the cold. As your resort grows, so does what you can do. Build guest houses and rent rooms to overnight visitors. Clean up after checkout, restock supplies, and watch as hotel guests flood your bar, restaurant, and shop with extra business. Open a repair shop and fix broken ski gear by hand. Diagnose the problem, grab the right tools, and get it done. Upgrade your shop to take on bigger jobs and stock new equipment for sale. Run the bar during après-ski hours. Pour beers, shake cocktails, and keep the drinks flowing while guests unwind after a long day on the slopes. Open a retail shop and sell winter gear to your guests. Stock the shelves, price your inventory, and handle the checkout yourself. Bigger orders mean bigger profits. Hop on a snowbike and explore the mountain. The map is large, the snow is deep, and there's always a reason to head out, whether it's chopping wood, hauling supplies, or just enjoying the ride. Run the kitchen yourself. Take orders, cook meals, mix drinks, and clear tables before the next wave of hungry guests arrives. Upgrade your menu and equipment to serve more customers and earn more per order. Sell lift tickets to incoming skiers and get your first income flowing. It's simple work, but it's the foundation of everything you'll build. Clear snow and debris to unlock new areas. Chop wood and keep fireplaces burning. Repair ski nets after storms. Track down lost wallets and phones. Collect pinecones across the mountainside. Throw snowballs at guests, just because you can. Snowstorms will pile up work and break your equipment. Keep the resort open through a blizzard and earn your reputation. Stay up late enough and you might catch the northern lights. Hang Christmas decorations during the holiday season for a revenue boost. What's included in Early Access: 6 areas to unlock and manage: Ticket Office, Repair Shop, Bar, Restaurant, Store, Hotel Upgrade trees for each area with no forced order Hire workers to keep areas running while you expand Dynamic weather: snowstorms, northern lights, Christmas season 32 Steam achievements Full progression from a single ticket booth to a five-star mountain resort

title: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror
description: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror is a J-horror RPG where every choice carries the weight of human lives. Japan’s birthrate has collapsed. The elderly now outnumber the young three to one, and Tokyo is dying. A brutal geopolitical blockade has cut off food, medicine, and power. Society is unraveling and violent crime is on the rise. You play as a caregiver whose job is to keep the neglected elders alive for one night. The only problem: there aren't enough supplies for everyone. How many of them will still be alive when the sun rises? Welcome to Den-Den: Tokyo Horror. There is no happy ending to this story. Features Events unfold in real-time, with the game taking place over a single night. Each hour that passes, the city falls further into chaos. Time is always moving forward and every choice you make has a consequence. Manage your limited supplies while scavenging the city for whatever you can find in order to survive another hour. Turn your trash into treasure by using recycling machines scattered around the city. Enter into the nightmarish senior living facilities located around the city to care for the neglected elders you're responsible for. Collect and equip powerful  charms that grant supernatural blessings. Fight or flee using improvised weapons such as kitchen knives, tasers, black-market pistols, and much more. Your actions have permanent consequences. Every character in the game can die because of you. Scavenge Rummage through abandoned apartments, overflowing dumpsters, and dark alleys for anything that might buy one more hour of life. Food, painkillers, batteries, bullets… or nothing at all. Discover Talk, listen, lie, threaten, or comfort. Every conversation branches. Every relationship can save you or doom the people you’re supposed to protect. Fight or Flight Desperate people, violent criminals, and things far worse stalk the streets. Swing a rusty kitchen knife, fire a shaking pistol, shock with an electrifying taser, or simply run. Do whatever it takes to stay alive until sunrise. Fear Something evil has awakened in the darkest corners of the city. It feeds on neglect, regret, and bad decisions. Make too many wrong choices… and it will come for you, and everyone left in your care.

title: Welcome to a Sexy, Open World!
description: Story When he awakens from a terrible accident, Sejima Seiya finds himself in another world—Laurentide. A world with a legend, long held by its people: ──The seed that shall give birth to heroes and end the era of war shall come from another world.── Seiya has that seed within him. And despite being viewed as breeding stock, he still wishes to have sex. But now the father of the future heroes could become king of the world. So... Drawn by the legend, beautiful women gather from across the world, seeking his seed. ──Or perhaps some harbor the ambition of unifying the world under their motherland. ──Or perhaps some simply desire sex with Seiya. Regardless, Seiya's days of getting milked by beautiful women have begun... Features Traditional Visual Novel with multiple heroines Over 2,000 CGs and variations to explore! 20+ hours of average reading time By the creator of Princess Evangile and Imouto Paradise! Includes bonus content: Maternity Dress Patch!

title: Depths of Endor: Dungeon Crawler
description: Embark on an epic journey in this classic, turn-based dungeon crawler RPG! Dive into a retro-styled adventure that combines the best elements of old-school role-playing games with modern features of a roguelike. Explore dangerous dungeons, defeat fearsome monsters, and uncover hidden treasures as you guide your hero through a roguelite full of challenges. 🧙 Choose Your Hero - Play as one of 7 unique races: Elf, Human, Dwarf, Gnome, Troll, Undead, or Draconian each with distinct abilities and stats. - Customize your hero’s journey by joining 10 different guilds: Nomad, Warrior, Thief, Mage, Healer, Paladin, Ninja, Ranger, Warlock and Shaman. Each guild offers unique skills and playstyles. ⚔️ Classic Turn-Based Combat - Experience tactical and strategic combat as you face off against challenging foes. - Master your skills, equip powerful weapons, and use potions to survive the toughest battles. - Collect a variety of weapons, from simple swords to rare magical items! 🏰 Explore Dangerous Dungeons - Venture into 10 different dungeons filled with traps, hidden passages, and powerful enemies. - Find hidden secrets and treasures as you navigate through multiple levels. - Each dungeon offers a different challenge and environment, keeping the experience fresh and exciting. 🛡️ Guilds & Skills - Join a guild to unlock special abilities and improve your hero’s skills. - Train with fellow members to become stronger and more adept in your chosen path. - Become the ultimate warrior, thief, or mage as you rise through the ranks! 💰 Daily Rewards - Collect gold from daily chests to help you on your journey. - Visit the shop to purchase weapons, armor, and other items to boost your hero’s power. - Find normal and magical items to strengthen your character and prepare for tougher challenges ahead. 📜 Features - Retro pixel art style that brings back the charm of classic RPGs. - Turn-based gameplay that emphasizes strategy and planning. - An in-depth character progression system with countless ways to build your hero. - Newly released game with regular updates, new dungeons, items and features based on player feedback! 🌟 Why Play? - Nostalgic RPG experience with a modern twist. - Endless opportunities for character customization. - Engaging, turn-based combat with an emphasis on tactics and strategy. - A growing world with new content added regularly. 🛠️ Dungeon Maker [NEW EXCLUSIVE FEATURE!] Unleash your creativity with custom map and enemy creation! Exclusive to PC, the Dungeon Maker lets you design your own dungeons, shaping every twist and turn. But that's not all—craft unique enemies to populate your creations, complete with personalized names, stats, and even custom images. Bring your imagination to life and challenge players with your own handcrafted adventures! 🌀 Labyrinth Mode Discover the new Labyrinth mode! In New Game+, challenge yourself with procedurally generated dungeons, filled with unpredictable layouts, deadly traps, and fierce enemies. No two runs are the same. Adapt, strategize, and see how far you can go. Download now and start your adventure today!

title: CRTX - A Psychological Horror Puzzle
description: You wake up in a strange padded cell with children's music playing and a robotic voice speaking to you. You should definitely take the psychological tests it demands, because as little humanity as there is in its voice, there is just as little in its treatment of test subjects. Perhaps it would be better to look for a way out... But it's best to do so unnoticed... Solve psychologically rich puzzles in an oppressive atmosphere Think outside the box and prepare for confusing and frightening puzzles Uncover where you are and how to escape in a mind-bending story Silence the voice forever!

title: CRTX - A Psychological Horror Puzzle Demo
description: Imagine Squid Game and Portal having a child. That's basically CRTX (pronounced cortex). Be prepared for an oppressive atmosphere with dark humor, a few horror elements and a story that digs deep inside your mind...

title: Kaamos: Puzzle Roguelike
description: Kaamos is a bite-sized turn-based puzzle roguelike where battles are fought by matching tiles on a grid with looping rows and columns. Build your character and deck of tiles by looting equipment from your foes. Traverse a dark medieval world where the Sun went down and never rose again. Face hostile opponents in duels to the death where you see enemy actions in advance. Match tiles of the same color on a grid where dragging a row or column loops it back on the other side in order to counter the incoming onslaught of enemy attacks. Stab, crush and cleave your way to victory. Equip powerful weapons, armor, and rings to change your tactics and tile selection for battles. Want to be a dual-wielding berserker, an evasive duelist, or a knight clad in heavy armor? With over 180 items there are interesting build choices and playstyles for every player. Navigate a randomly generated dark medieval world filled with madness. Unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of the Sun or fade into the darkness. You are not alone. There’s always something lurking in the dark behind every fork in the path.

title: Curse of The Mask: Kaal Yoddha - An Action Adventure Game
description: Kaal Yoddha is a dark mythological action-adventure game where you play as Prince Avyaan, a skilled archer and warrior battling demons on a cursed island. Master bow, sword, and soulslike combat, uncover ancient masks, and face brutal boss battles in a story-driven dark fantasy world! A Cursed Island Awaits Step into Kaal Yoddha, a single-player dark fantasy action-adventure game rooted in ancient myth and forgotten legends. You are Prince Avyaan, a fearless warrior sent to a cursed island where demonic forces spread corruption with cursed ancient masks. Precision Combat – Bow, Sword, Double Axe Engage in dynamic soulslike-inspired combat that rewards timing, positioning, and mastery. Wield bow and arrow for ranged combat. Switch to sword combat for intense close encounters. Adapt your playstyle to survive relentless demonic enemies. Learn enemy patterns and strike with precision. Every battle is a test of skill, not chance. Parkour and Exploration Traverse the island using parkour and environmental navigation Scale cliffs and ancient structures. Navigate treacherous terrain. Solve environmental puzzles to unlock new paths. The Curse of the Mask The island is haunted by cursed masks born from an ancient Demon. Explore eerie forests, ruined temples, hidden caverns, and collapsing sanctuaries, a place where reality breaks, uncovering environmental storytelling through murals, relics, and cryptic notes. Epic Boss Battles Face towering monsters, cursed warriors, and demonic entities, each born from the island’s corruption. Victory is earned, not given. Will you break the curse and restore honour to your legacy, or be consumed by the darkness that rules the island? Take up your bow. Draw your blade.Become the Warrior.

title: Directory Dungeon - File Explorer Dungeon Crawler
description: Directory Dungeon is a tiny dungeon crawler played right in the windows file explorer. Explore a monster and loot filled dungeon by dragging and dropping your player folder into new rooms, equip powerful items by dropping them into your equipment folder, and defeat terrible monsters in auto-resolved combat. Features! Play the game in the windows file explorer and console window! Think of the file explorer as the playing pieces of the game and the console window as the dungeon master keeping track of everything. Explore the dungeon by dragging and dropping your player into a new room , or just cutting and pasting them there. Fight and defeat terrible monsters! And then loot their folders! Arm and armour yourself with the loot you find throughout the dungeon , by dropping it into your equipment folder. Enjoy a tasty cabbage, or other dungeon treats, to refresh yourself between fights! Figure out the secret to banishing evil from the dungeon forever! Is this doing anything weird to my PC? Nope! Directory Dungeon only ever touches files which it has created, never looks at files outside of its install directory, and doesn't use any weird file system hacks. Check out the FAQ in the Steam Discussions for more info! No generative AI was used at any point in the creation of this game.

title: Bullet Hell Game Anthology
description: Great news for Bullet Hell fans! We’ve prepared an anthology of games in your favourite genre from various indie developers! Try out free demo versions of projects that have just recently been released or will be out in the near future! Kickback is a top-down shooter with roguelike elements, where shooting is the only way to move. Repel waves of mutants, create combinations of weapons and upgrades to survive at all costs on your own or with a friend in a local co-op mode. Hotloop - Use the force of gravity in a fast-paced space shooter with realistic physics and orbital mechanics. Westild's Law - Journey to the heart of the Wild West in this thrilling pixelated 2D shooter and challenge the gang of Wild Joe to free your hometown from their iron grip! Castle Break - Breakout game + physics + shooting + building. Use your mouse like in air hockey to kick enemy bombs back into the evil Black Castle! Destroy enemy towers rockets and lasers. Build your base to protect your little dudes - you need them to win BOUNCE GUN is a challenging arcade roguelike shooter with a huge number of item combinations, unconventional controls and an unusual approach to difficulty progression.

title: Passant: A Chess Roguelike
description: Passant is a chess roguelike, where the rules can be twisted and unique pieces can be used to change the game. Build your board by earning powerful pieces with unique rules, items to change the tide of battle, and badges that can twist all the rules to deliver victory. Beat match after match of increasing difficulty until you can beat the final boss and become a grandmaster. Expands on the rules of chess: Unique pieces, such as the Archbishop, Dragon Knight, Dragon King and more! Twists on traditional chess, such as Atomic Chess, Reflecting Bishops and Zombie Pawns. Usable items that can give you an advantage, such as freezing a piece, demoting a piece to a pawn, or promoting one of yours to a queen! There are also challenge modes and increasing levels of AI difficulty, so beginners and grandmasters alike can enjoy the game.

title: Grass Life Sim
description: Grass Life Sim is a game in which you can become grass. This game will give you a meditative gameplay. You can stand and contemplate the beauty of the forest around you living your life as grass. You can also perform actions that grass usually performs (stand in the same place). Features You're grass You're in the forest There is grass around you And not only grass Other Features 2 game mods: arcade and realistic Simple control Beautiful stylized graphics

title: House Flipper 2 - Co-op DLC
description: Share the fun! It’s time to invite your friends to House Flipper 2 and dive in together! With cross-platform support, whether you’re on PC or console, up to four players can team up in both story and sandbox modes. Let the co-op creativity begin! Join forces to create dream homes like never before—whether it’s tackling grand mansions for an epic challenge or diving into story mode missions for a more relaxed vibe! Feeling stuck? Explore amazing designs from fellow Flippers on the mod.io platform. And don’t forget to share your own creations there—you might just inspire the next great Flipper! Bigger, better & uncut! More hands on deck means fresh challenges ahead! Take on four brand-new properties and four unique orders, all designed with co-op gameplay in mind. From sprawling spaces to high-maintenance clients, the pressure is on! The real test? Mastering teamwork and managing tasks together. And watch out—keeping your crew focused is key to turning collaboration into success!

title: Firehawk: FPV Drone Shooter
description: In Firehawk, you are a force of nature, pilot advanced FPV combat drones through intense missions where split-second decisions matter. Death sends you back to base - but your tech, skills, and power grow with every run. REAL FPV DRONE COMBAT A real FPV drone. With guns. Firehawk runs on true drone physics, so every dive, every corner, and every kill is flown by hand. 10-player PvP. 2 to 4 player co-op. Roguelite runs, endless survival, and time trials solo. Start as a rookie. Crash a lot. Become an ace. 10-PLAYER PVP Up to 10 pilots, no aim assist, no autopilot. Every kill is throttle, angle, and timing. Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Bounty Hunter, Domination, and Capture the Flag. CO-OP SURVIVAL Endless waves, scaled for 2 to 4 pilots. Turrets, hacker drones, elite squadrons, and bosses that solo players have been cursing since launch. Friendly fire is off, so shoot freely. SOLO ROGUELITE, SURVIVAL AND TIME TRIALS The roguelike campaign: fly missions, die, expand your base, come back stronger, and push toward a final boss that will make you rethink every approach angle you know. Time Trial: fixed maps, fixed enemies, your unlocked drones, and a leaderboard to climb. TRUE DRONE PHYSICS A custom physics engine models thrust at every rotor, so the drone carries momentum, drifts, and never brakes by magic. Two control modes: Arcade for mouse and keyboard or gamepad, and Realistic , full acro for FPV radios and gamepads, with Betaflight rates and your actual rates supported. Autofire triggers when your crosshair crosses a target, so a two-stick radio is all you need; switch to manual fire if you'd rather pull the trigger yourself. EARN YOUR ARSENAL 23 drones across light, medium, and heavy classes. None is stronger than the others; pick the one that flies the way you like. XP unlocks new drones and adds new weapons to the drop pool, and everything you earn is yours in every mode. 42 weapons, 25 gadgets, 44 enemy types, 6 maps from open islands and deserts to tight industrial interiors and night ops. FEATURES Online PvP for up to 10 players: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Bounty Hunter, Domination, Capture the Flag Online co-op endless survival for 2 to 4 players Single-player roguelike campaign with persistent base progression Time Trial with Steam Leaderboards Custom drone physics engine with Betaflight and Actual rate support Arcade and Realistic (acro) control modes Autofire and manual fire FPV radio, gamepad, and mouse and keyboard support 23 drones, 42 weapons, 25 gadgets, 44 enemy types including 7 bosses, 6 maps Windows and macOS, all modes ROADMAP Multiplayer is in Beta and shaped by what pilots actually play. Matchmaking and a competitive mode are next. Feedback goes straight into the build.

title: SillyAhhPVP
description: Every match deals you random attacks. No two fights are the same. Your moveset randomizes every single match. You get 1-5 attacks from the pool and have to figure out how to win with whatever you're given. Nobody knows what they're working with until the round starts. Fight on random maps. Slide under attacks. Dive from the air. Land a heavy hit and your opponent falls over, they can't do anything until they stand back up. 1v1 or team vs team. Adapt faster than everyone else or lose. KEY FEATURES • Random attacks every match (1-5 moves per player, is customizable) • Random map selection (customizable pool) • Knockdown system: hard hits ragdoll your opponent temporarily • Movement options: sliding and air diving • 1v1 and team game modes

title: Anime Shop Simulator ✨
description: Anime Shop Simulator is fun first-person simulation where you become the manager of your very own anime shop! Play solo or join forces with friends in online co-op to expand your shop, attract more customers, and create the ultimate otaku and trading card paradise! MANAGE YOUR SHOP Build your dream Anime Shop! Arrange manga, figures, and collectible cards on the shelves to create a seamless and enjoyable shopping experience for your customers. CO-OP GAMEPLAY Join forces with your friends online in 4-player co-op mode to manage your anime shop together, divide responsibilities, and plan strategies to maximize your profits. COLLECT THEM ALL AND FIGHT IN PVP! Unbox booster packs and discover unique treasures! Find rare collectible cards to sell for a profit or keep them to complete your ultimate anime card collection. Fight with other players in PvP TCG game and find out who's the best! CUSTOMIZATION Transform your anime store into a one-of-a-kind otaku haven! Choose your favorite wallpaper, give your shop a unique name, and decorate it with items to reflect your personal style. GROW Enlarge your shop, upgrade its decor, and stay in tune with the dynamic trends of the anime industry to remain competitive. In Anime Shop Simulator your decisions shape your journey. Can you transform your small boutique into a thriving otaku hub while balancing customer satisfaction and financial success?

title: Gassal Simulation
description: 1. Geniş Tanıtım Metni: Gassal Simulaton – Preparation for the Final Journey! Genre: Simulation | Realistic | Spiritual Experience Platform: PC (Steam) Mode: Single Player 🕊️ A Silent Duty, A Profound Experience Death is the most inevitable truth of life. Gassal Simulaton invites you to take part in this sacred duty. As a gassal, you will respectfully prepare the deceased for their final journey and experience this spiritual process in the most realistic way. From the morgue to the cemetery, manage every step with patience, care, and deep contemplation. In the silence, you will work alone, feeling the weight and significance of each action. 🎮 Gameplay Mechanics 🔹 Step by Step – The Final Farewell ✔ Preparation: Organize your inventory, gather the necessary materials, and create a respectful environment. ✔ Morgue Procedures: Verify the identity of the deceased and carefully follow the proper procedures. ✔ Washing Process: Adjust the water temperature, wash, rinse, and complete the cleansing with rose water. ✔ Shrouding: Wrap the deceased according to religious and cultural customs. ✔ Placing in the Coffin: Handle with care and ensure everything is properly arranged. ✔ Burial Process: Dig the grave, lower the coffin, and complete the burial with respect. This journey requires no haste, no negligence, and no disrespect—only patience, precision, and reverence. 🌍 A Deeply Immersive Atmosphere 🔹 Meticulously designed locations such as the morgue, washing area, and cemetery. 🔹 Fully interactive objects: Water, soap, shroud, coffin, shovel, and other burial tools. 🔹 Weather & Lighting Effects: Misty mornings, twilight shadows, and dynamic lighting enhance the solemn atmosphere. 🎵 Sound & Spiritual Immersion 🔊 An auditory experience designed for deep reflection and mindfulness. ✔ Realistic ambient sounds: Flowing water, soft winds, distant birds, and footsteps. ✔ Subtle, atmospheric background music to support the spiritual experience. ✔ Complete Silence Mode: Play with no sound at all and focus solely on the moment. 🕯️ In Silence, With Respect, The Final Duty This is not just a game—it’s a journey. A unique simulation that reminds us of life’s impermanence and invites deep contemplation. Are you ready to fulfill your final duty?

title: EA SPORTS FC™ 26
description: Experience The World’s Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26. The latest update introduces a brand-new international tournament mode featuring 48 national teams, alongside new authentic stadiums to play in. Take on international-themed Manager Live Challenges, and step into Player Career with new international ICONs and Heroes. About the Game This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

title: Tower Defense
description: In the game, you will have to protect the castle from dark forces. Your castle will be guarded by a battle mage. In addition, various bonuses will help you. Weapons and bonuses can be upgraded. After purchasing, you will be able to: - feel like a castle defender fighting dark forces. - enjoy exciting and dynamic gameplay. - develop your strategic and tactical skills. - feel progress as you improve your abilities. - enjoy victories over enemies.

title: Backrooms: Exploration
description: Backrooms: Exploration is a single-player horror game, that takes place in 2020. Two friends have lost their jobs due to COVID-19, but they still have to bring food to the table. After a failed heist, one of them ends up in the Backrooms. Now your only mission is to survive. In Backrooms: Exploration , you have to find your way out of the Backrooms. Everything is viewed through a Bodycam which is mounted on your head. Backrooms: Exploration is  an atmospheric experience, that entertains everyone who enjoys the Backrooms. Explore the many levels of Backrooms in the most realistic way. Experience this unique story about the Backrooms. Some parts of this game are heavily inspired by Kane Pixels ' work.

title: Adult Education
description: Adult Education is a provocative visual novel set within the intimate confines of an adult evening school, where traditional classroom rules are left at the door. The story follows a sultry and enigmatic teacher who begins to develop a secret, passionate interest in her female students. As the lessons progress, so do the teacher's desires, sparking forbidden relationships that blend education with seduction. The game delves deep into themes of power dynamics, illicit attraction, and sensual exploration, with each encounter pushing the boundaries of what is acceptable between teacher and student. In this story, the teacher's desires aren't the only ones at play. The students, too, have their own passions and pleasures, often seeking out forbidden trysts in the secluded corners of the school library and hidden nooks of the restroom. These moments of lust unfold in secret, turning the school into a backdrop for heated, illicit encounters. As the lines between education and desire blur, players are immersed in a passionate journey that offers a combination of erotic storytelling, captivating characters, and provocative scenes. Explicit Adult Scenes : Experience detailed and uncensored erotic moments, crafted for mature players. High-Quality Illustrations : Stunning, hand-drawn visuals that bring each encounter and character to life. Diverse Settings : Explore intimate scenarios in various school locations, including the library and restroom. Mature Themes : Delve into forbidden attraction, power dynamics, and sensual exploration, all within the context of adult education. Atmospheric Soundtrack : An immersive score that sets the tone for every passionate encounter.

title: Soulbound Roguelike
description: Soulbound Roguelike is a 2D pixel-art action-adventure game that blends Roguelite combat builds with creature collecting. To revive your Sect, you must dive into dangerous Mystic Realms, find various Divine Beast companions, and lead your Sect back to become No.1！ ▸ Build Playstyle: Choose from 4 martial arts: Blade, Gun, Fist, or Energy Sword. Combine them with 3 Skills and 9 Enchantment slots to easily define your unique combat style! ▸ Blessing Combos: Collect 140+ combat Blessing Buffs. Combine specific Blessings to activate powerful "Bond" effects. ▸ Permanent Growth: Practice techniques to upgrade stats—Max HP, Crit Rate, Beast Power... Every run makes you stronger than the last! ▸ Divine Beast Collection: What hatches from the eggs in hidden dungeons? Besides the mighty Azure Dragon and the chill Capybara, there’s even “Chicken Bro”, trained for two and a half years… Collectors, this is your paradise! ▸ Battle Companions: Ride Divine Beasts into battle or fight side-by-side. Use their unique skills to clear maps easily. ▸ Divine Beast Fusion: Will they evolve to look cooler or just weirder? No doubt, they will be stronger. ▸ Ascend the Ranking Ladder: Compete in the global Sect rankings and challenge players from all over the world in real-time! ▸ Idle Management: Unlock the "Exhibit Area" and let your beasts work to earn money for you. Enjoy the freedom of idle gains! Soulbound Roguelike is now available on Steam! Come pet the beasts, test your combos, and experience the unique fun of "Roguelite + Taming"!

title: Delta Vector - Turn Based Racing
description: Delta Vector is a unique turn-based racing indie game that combines tactical decision-making with vector-based physics. Master the art of precision racing as you calculate your every move across challenging tracks! Core Gameplay Vector-Based Movement: Each turn presents you with 9 possible moves, carefully simulating real racing physics. Your previous speed and direction affect your next move, creating a strategic "domino effect" throughout the race. Tactical Decision Making: Choose between accelerating, braking, or turning - or combine these moves for advanced maneuvers. Every decision matters as your momentum carries through each turn. Surface Physics: Race across different surfaces including asphalt and gravel, each affecting your car's handling and speed differently. Master the art of drifting on loose surfaces and maintaining control on tight corners. Visual Feedback: Watch your car leave tire tracks, kick up gravel, and create smoke effects based on your driving style. The dynamic camera system follows the action, creating an immersive racing experience. Game Modes Time Trial: Perfect your racing line in single-player mode. Challenge yourself to complete laps with the fewest possible moves and compete for the best times. PVP Racing: Challenge your friends in local  races. Take turns plotting your moves as you compete head-to-head for racing supremacy. Challenge Mode: Test your skills in a series of increasingly difficult scenarios. Unlock new cars and tracks as you progress through  challenges. Features Diverse Track Selection: Race across multiple meticulously designed tracks, each with unique layouts and challenges. From tight technical circuits to high-speed tracks, every course offers a different racing experience. Car Variety: Choose from a garage of unique vehicles, each with different handling characteristics, speeds, and acceleration profiles. Visual Effects: Experience dynamic racing effects including tire smoke, exhaust effects, drift marks, and surface-specific particle systems that react to your driving style. Accessible Controls: Easy to learn, hard to master - use simple mouse clicks or keyboard controls to select your moves, while the game handles the complex physics calculations. Whether you're a casual racing fan or a hardcore strategist, Delta Vector offers a fresh take on the racing genre, combining the thoughtful planning of turn-based games with the excitement of motorsport physics!

title: A Difficult Game About Letters
description: When your best friend falls into trouble, it’s up to you to embark on a daring journey through the Land of Letters . In A Difficult Game About Letters , you take control of a character who can transform into any letter of the alphabet. Each letter's shape provides unique abilities, which you’ll need to solve puzzles, navigate obstacles, and complete challenging platforming levels. Here’s what you can do in the game: Transform Into Letters : Instantly switch between 26 different letters to adapt to obstacles. Each letter's shape can help you in unique ways. Jump Across Platforms : Use letters like J or V to jump higher or leap across wide gaps. Hook and Grab : Turn into L or T to hook onto ledges, edges, or moving platforms. Roll and Squeeze : Transform into round letters like O or C to roll through tight spaces or under obstacles. Brace and Balance : Use sturdy letters like X or H to block moving walls, balance on narrow platforms Every level is a playground of letters and shapes, requiring you to think creatively, experiment with transformations, and master precise movements to progress. With endless possibilities for how to use the alphabet, each challenge feels fresh and rewarding.

title: Emergency Call - The Firefighting Simulation 3
description: Experience one of the most exciting and versatile professions up close. In Emergency Call – The Firefighting Simulation 3 , you are part of a German professional fire department and bear responsibility for the safety of your city. When an emergency call comes in at the dispatch center, every firefighter knows their role. Which position you take on is entirely up to you. During your 24-hour shifts, you make purposeful use of the time between calls to prepare for a wide variety of challenges. A daily rotating duty roster gives you the opportunity to take part in training courses, drills, and physical fitness sessions. In doing so, you earn the qualifications needed to be deployed in different roles – from attack squad member to engineer across a range of emergency vehicles. In the training courses, you are taught all the necessary knowledge in both theory and practice to take on new responsibilities on the job. Drills with equipment such as the Halligan tool help you optimize procedures and save valuable time during operations. Working with a thermal imaging camera is also a skill that needs to be practiced. Daily physical training increases your stamina under stress, which makes a real difference out in the field. Strength, endurance, and recovery capacity can all diminish over time if neglected. Your endurance, in particular can be a decisive factor in saving valuable time during an incident. Beyond that, there are many routine tasks at the station that form an important part of daily fire house life – and they all need to get done. Once the alarm sounds, a large operational area with diverse urban districts awaits you. From classic firefighting operations to traffic accidents, you'll face numerous incidents spanning rescue, firefighting, recovery, and hazard protection. A dynamic day-night cycle and changing weather conditions add further challenges and variety. Features Join the ranks of a professional fire department Incidents across four operational areas: Rescue, Firefighting, Recovery, and Protection 24-hour duty shifts with a rotating roster Developed in cooperation with the Berufsfeuerwehr Mülheim an der Ruhr Large open operational area with diverse and varied incidents Dynamic day-night cycle with changing weather conditions Complete training courses and qualify for additional roles in the field Daily drills help save valuable time during operations Train regularly to increase your resilience on the job Keep track of your progress and development at all times There's always something to do at the station between calls

title: Super Golden Odyssey: 3D Platformer World

About Super Golden Odyssey Super Golden Odyssey takes you on a thrilling 3D adventure through fantastical worlds filled with excitement. Key Features With colorful visuals and smooth gameplay, this adventure is perfect for players of all ages. Explore diverse environments, tackle exciting challenges, and uncover surprises that will keep you coming back for more in this unforgettable journey!

title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
description: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales Digital Deluxe Edition This set is a bundle of The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales game with various adventuring accessories. Contents of the Digital Deluxe Edition: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales Digital Deluxe Edition Pack: - Fairy Bangle accessory - Cherry Blossom Anklet accessory - Roselle Ring accessory *See the official website for bonus details. The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales Prologue Demo Carry your save data over to the full version of the game in this new prologue demo! Enjoy the opening chapter of the story with the same freedom of adventure as in the full game. Progress in the main quest, explore the unknown, or hunt down new weapons and magicite—the future is up to you. Your adventure in Philabieldia, a world filled with discovery, starts here! *This demo version features content taken from the retail version of the game with some differences, such as limits on accessible areas. About the Game A brand-new action RPG from the creators of OCTOPATH TRAVELER and BRAVELY DEFAULT – The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales combines stunning HD-2D visuals and exciting action-adventure gameplay for the first time! The adventurer Elliot and his fairy sidekick Faie set off on a journey across four ages to fulfill a thousand-year mission. Enjoy intuitive and rewarding action-based battles with strategic support abilities from a fairy as you reveal this world’s mysterious history. • Seven Weapon Types and Fairy Magic Arm yourself with up to two weapons at a time to do battle with the beast tribes that overrun the continent. Faie’s fairy magic will prove handy in clearing both the fiends and puzzles that stand in your way. • The Four Ages of a Millennium To lift the curse on Princess Heuria of Huther, Elliot and Faie will cross through the Doorway of Time to visit different periods in history. Elliot’s home time, the Age of Safekeeping… The Age of Reconstruction, in which humans eke out a meager existence… Humanity’s height of prosperity in the Age of Magic… And the Age of Budding, the birth of human civilization. Across every age, a terrible threat looms over Elliot and Faie’s adventure. • Personalized Adventuring with Magicite Customize Elliot’s weapons by equipping different combinations of magicite found during the journey. Try out all sorts of variations and confront obstacles using your own methods.

title: Curse of Pirates
description: Ahoy, ye port rats! It be time to leave the land for the lily-livered and set sail into the cursed waters of Curse of Pirates — a swashbuckling action roguelike where honor, luck, and good ol' rum decide yer fate! Become a captain whose fame echoes across all seven seas! Explore the far corners of the ocean, hunt for ancient treasure maps, and slice through hordes of enemies: sea monsters, ruthless corsair scoundrels, undead fiends, nightmarish beasts, and even cursed gods of the deep! And watch out for those damned parrots — they're a real nuisance! All hands on deck! Become the captain of yer destiny! You be an ambitious captain of a rickety ship with grand dreams. Want to rule the pirate world and become the fiercest and richest Pirate King? Then prepare to traverse fire, water, and a storm of cannon fire! Curse of Pirates be: ⚓ Endless waves of foes! Enemies will keep comin’ at ye, stronger and craftier with each attack. Use yer wits to navigate between islands and sea monsters! ⚓ Hundreds of unique builds! Mix and match skills to change your combat style, boost yer weaponry, and even turn the tide of battle! ⚓ Epic maritime campaigns! Fight, grow stronger, and sail through five dangerous maps filled with brutal enemies. Survive and face the final boss — the ultimate test of yer pirate skills! ⚓ The true pirate life! Enough languishing in port with a barrel of rum—hoist the sails and set forth for new adventures! Hire a crew or ye might regret it! Ye can’t survive alone on the sea! A gallery of unique characters awaits ye, each with their own stories, quirks, and deadly skills: ☠ Ghostly captains who summon the dead! ☠ Dark cultists dabbling with ancient powers! ☠ Zar’Kul, a spawn of the abyss, bringing chaos and destruction! Who will be yer loyal mate? A fiery-haired beauty with a big heart? A ghost captain with unfinished business? Or perhaps something much darker… Choose wisely and be ready for the consequences! Where be the map? We need a map! In the grand tradition of pirate tales, ye shall embark on dangerous adventures in search of ancient treasures, not all of which ye truly want to find. A map and the ability to alter the terrain will aid ye, allowing for the addition or removal of elements on the battlefield. True pirates don’t sail blindly! Seek out ancient treasure maps, but beware—not all that glitters is worth the haul. Change the land to shift the course of battle! 🎶 Sing pirate shanties with yer crew, keeping spirits high before the storm! Fifteen men on the dead man's chest— ...Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum! Drink and the devil had done for the rest— ...Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum! All hands on deck! Cast off the lines, hoist the sails! Full speed ahead to glory and riches! ☠🏴‍☠️

title: Bodybuilder Simulator CO-OP
description: Bodybuilder Simulator CO-OP Bodybuilder Simulator is a third-person open-world game set on a forgotten Italian island, where sport is not a choice — it’s a necessity. 🏝️ A Living Open World of Training and Competition The game takes place on an isolated island where every inhabitant lives by a rhythm of training, work, and competition. This is a world where physical condition defines your opportunities, status, and the respect you earn from others. Every building can be explored, and the island is full of life — from gyms and homes to competitive bodybuilding venues. 🧬 Create Your Own Character You begin with an advanced character creator that allows deep customization: body fat percentage and muscle mass genetic traits and physical predispositions detailed face and body customization skin tone and many other parameters Every choice you make affects your character’s development and potential. 💪 Realistic Training and Body Development The game features over 100 exercises recreated from real-world movements. Every workout visibly and physically transforms your body: muscles tighten and change shape veins become more visible under strain skin reacts to body fat levels and training intensity fatigue affects exercise execution and technique facial expressions reflect real effort and exhaustion Nutrition, supplementation, and recovery (sleep) are essential — neglecting any of them will impact your progress. 🍕 Lifestyle Matters Your choices shape your future. You can: eat junk food and live a passive lifestyle or train consistently, follow a strict diet, and push your body to its peak Every decision has consequences — from appearance to performance. 🏆 Career and Competitions Take part in bodybuilding competitions across multiple categories and build your legacy. You can also take photos of your character to track progress and compare your physical transformation over time. 🤝 Living NPC System The island is inhabited by NPCs who: follow their own daily routines train in gyms and develop their bodies react to your physique and behavior change their bodies over time (muscle gain / fat gain) You can train with them, help them improve, or compete against them. They also react emotionally — they may support you or criticize you. 🏋️ Gym and Home Progression Your gym and house are fully customizable: buy and upgrade equipment change colors, textures, and materials add decorations, posters, and electronics expand and evolve your training space Both locations are highly interactive and grow with your progress. 💼 Work and Survival To progress, you must earn money — balancing work with your bodybuilding career and investing in your development. 🥊 More Than Bodybuilding In addition to bodybuilding, the game includes: martial arts running swimming calisthenics strongman training 🔥 Game Modes deep story-driven career mode full open-world sandbox planned: co-op mode for up to 4 players This is not just a simulator. It’s a life where strength defines everything. Add to your wishlist and follow the development.

title: Turn-Based Touchdown
description: A Strategy RPG and DeckBuilder based around the game of American Football. Create your own custom Team with a custom Color Scheme, Name, and Region. Upgrade your Players stats Improve the Playbook with Deckbuilding mechanics and synergies Face Off Against Difficult Opponents on your way to a Championship!
