Get ready to dive into a world bursting with a sizzling cast of characters and ever-expanding, delightfully cheeky scenarios that evolve with every update. Gameplay features: 5 Stories and location to choose from , or customize it your own way. Engage in full lustful intercourse with either one or two partners. Use your mouse, VR controllers  to interact with the characters. Select different poses to keep things interesting for you and your partner. Playful spanking both in PC or VR. Reach climax by choosing the right moves! Fantasy Realization. Threesome mode is availible and completely remade to improve the experience, now the third character will interact with the other 2 in different ways than before.

title: Normal Golf Game
description: Hazy memories. A $100,000 fee. No sign of an exit. Welcome to a very Normal Golf Game. HOW HARD CAN IT BE? From the twisted well-adjusted  mind of Luke Muscat (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride), Normal Golf Game is a sadistically accurate recreation of the noble game of golf. Use physics to manipulate the path of your club, while simultaneously managing your stance, direction, and the angle and path of the face. OKAY, QUITE HARD IT TURNS OUT. Explore a giant golf course that is both a trap and a playground. Shoot from anywhere, aim at anything. So long as you don't try and leave, we will have a fun, normal time. OTHER FEATURES A nice day out Learn a fun new sport Meet  a game developer Have a great, very normal time WAIT, WHO? Normal Golf Game was built almost entirely by me, Luke Muscat. The real Luke Muscat that is, not the fictional Luke Muscat that traps you in the game. Confusing, I know.  I’m a solo dev, Youtuber, and have the worlds worst golf swing.

title: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
description: Just Updated Roadmap About the Game Set in a living ecosystem , 'Everything is Crab' is a cute, challenging, highly replayable action roguelite . Make animal inspired evolutionary choices to concoct your own unique creature every run, both mechanically and visually. It's Spore meets Modern Roguelites As everybody knows, eventually, every organism ends up evolving into a crab. Right? Well, except for you. Choose your own evolutionary path and strategy to thrive and defeat convergent evolution. Take that, science! Over 125 abilities combine to create a plethora of different builds and playstyles: Become a wily trickster, a ferocious predator, a gregarious leader, a nimble nomad, or take on any number of other survival strategies. Legs! Claws! Pincers! Wings! More Legs! Fur! Tail! Scales! Tentacles! I SAID MORE LEGS!!! Build your formidable, visually awkward chimera or get Darwin'd in the process. 125+ evolution based abilities Endless possibilities and visual combinations Strategy-defining evolutions Many viable survival strategies and playstyles A living, thriving ecosystem Many different critters with their own goals and strategies, each of them with several stages of evolution Four distinct biomes with different rules, climate events, points of interest, flora and fauna Night and day cycle A variety of bosses that may (or may not) appear with each run Huge meta-progression layer Difficulties system (if you dare!) Genetics (starting Characters), which can be combined to create endless starting character combinations Challenge Scenarios to push your adaptation skills to the limit More evolutions Endless runs Prove your survival skills to unlock Endless runs, ditch the timer, and outlast the apocalypse! Track your findings, meta-progression and achievements in the Codex Have a Crabby day!

title: Turn Turn Turn Based!
description: Experience a unique spin on the rogue-lite deck-building card-game genres. In Turn Turn Turn Based! , the battlefield changes and evolves. To survive, you must manage your hand and anticipate your enemies next move. Key Features At the end of each turn, the board rotates , completely changing how the battle may operate. Use specialised Spin Cards to manually manipulate the board and turn the tide of the battle in your favour. Most cards have a unique effect . Cards may only trigger in certain zones or modify other cards on the battlefield. Experience the psychological themes of nostalgia, and unhealthy attachments to the past. The further you play, the more distorted reality becomes. Follow the narrative in Story Mode , or see how long you can survive the torment in Endless Mode .

title: The Sims™ 4 Adventure Awaits Expansion Pack
description: WHAT'S INCLUDED IN THIS PACK About the Game Break free from the everyday with daring activities and Getaways in The Sims™ 4 Adventure Awaits Expansion Pack*. Nurture the spirit of play in childhood and carry it through a bold, adventurous life. Create Custom Venues for Sims to explore and send them on Getaways you design like a kids’ camp, fitness retreat, or even a romantic contest. Kids will also find their playtime more meaningful than ever. They can even connect with Imaginary Friends! KEY FEATURES: Time for a Getaway? — New experiences are out there for you to discover — or create! Explore the possibilities of Custom Venues and Getaways. Getaways can last a day or more and be anything from restful to challenging. Schedule activities that’ll help your Sims recharge, and maybe meet new friends. You can even apply rules to your Getaway. For example, Elimination Rules — like skill or relationship gains — will have Sims competing to outlast each other. This’ll be extra fun for Sims with the new Competitive Trait. Build and decorate your unique Custom Venue however you want, decide what kinds of activities are available there, and share it to the Gallery for others to enjoy. Adventure Starts at Childhood — From camp Getaways to imaginative play, the fun Sims have as kids will set the stage for the rest of their lives. Child Sims can develop new traits by going through Formative Moments, and forge evolving Childhood Sentiments towards Sims they grow up knowing. Customize Modular Playgrounds with slides and activities for a ton of Childhood fun. Kids can challenge each other with games like Hide and Seek or Rock, Paper, Scissors, and even have Imaginary Friends! Choose from 4 different Imaginary Friend dolls and 4 different personalities: Goofball, Competitive, Creative, and Evil. These personalities will affect the activities they suggest, so keep those smoke detectors handy! A Life of Play — The love of play begins during childhood and lasts a lifetime. Sims will have new skills to engage with: Papercraft, Entomology, Diving, and Archery. Make classic crafts like paper planes, catch and raise butterflies, make a splash with new diving boards, and hit the bullseye! These activities are for both kids and grown-ups, as are the Diving Board, Waterslide, and Kayak. Get out there and explore the water! Active Adult Sims will enjoy working out with Spin Bikes and Free Weights, and drinking a refreshing smoothie from the new Blender. Adventure Around Every Corner — Explore 3 neighborhoods — Wanderwood Wilds, Crystal Valley, and Jellyfish Junction — in the adventurous world of Gibbi Point. There are engaging Sims to meet, quests to uncover, and sights to see including an erupting geyser, a bioluminescent bay, and a lagoon glowing with jellyfish (the locals love jellyfish). Attend festivals on the boardwalk, and start a career as a Park Worker that can lead to working as a Park Ranger or a Camp Counselor. You might even spot the mysterious Plumbird! Each of Gibbi Point’s neighborhoods has its own Getaway — Camp Gibbi Gibbi, Revive & Thrive, and Love Highland — that Sims can jump right into.

title: Caribbean Legend: Age of Pirates
description: Based on Age of Pirates 2: City of Abandoned Ships version 1.3.2 AT by BlackMark Studio (C). A unique genre blending naval combat, land exploration, and open-world global map. Think Sid Meier's Pirates! meets Bannerlord. You are the captain and owner of your own ship—the finest fate one could hope for in the 17th century Caribbean. Pledge your service to colonial powers, engage in trade, plunder merchant convoys, explore uncharted islands, conquer settlements, hunt for buried treasure, meet historical figures, recruit a crew of loyal companions, and command a fleet of legendary vessels. Step into the role of Peter Blood, a skilled physician whose life takes an unexpected turn after being wrongfully accused of treason and sold into slavery. From these humble beginnings, you'll forge your path to freedom and perhaps become the most feared or respected figure in the Caribbean. Or create your own character and freely explore the world of the Golden Age of Pirates. Sixty of hours of content: Multiple characters and nations to choose from Female protagonist option Open-world sandbox without restrictions Modern controls and Caribbean Legend engine Letters of marque, sieges, and colony conquest Historical events and personalities Over 20 major side quests—from ancient curses to gubernatorial conspiracies Hundreds of procedural missions and assignments Dozens of ships, hundreds of items, and unique weaponry Romance storylines and companions Naval and land-based combat Enhanced world map Explore native ruins and urban dungeons Trade, treasure hunting, and piracy on your path to wealth and glory

title: Book Shooter
description: 《Book Shooter》is a magic shooting game similar to rogue, tower defense, and vampire survival. In the mysterious forbidden area, you are awakened as a book, with a Bible that can do magic, advanced mathematics that can fight, and a The Emperor's New （Clothes×）Book！ The gods in the forbidden area want to devour you all the time. Open the magic book to learn magic, defeat the gods, and get the forbidden power. You can freely match books, title pages, colleges, and concentration Progressive challenges, diverse enemies and rewards, powerful enemies are waiting for you to challenge Fight the final boss, it's time to test you, remember not to panic! Defeat the boss, get mysterious drops and ink, it's time to start the Elemental Academy!

title: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
description: Relive the golden ages of video rentals by opening your very own video store. Rent, sell, organize and build your business from the ground up. Hire staff, manage your team and become the best rental destination in town! From taking reservations and charging late fees to recommending movies and preparing delicious snacks, there’s never a dull moment when running your store! Customize your walls and floors, decorate with posters and memorabilia and expand your layout to build the video store of your dreams. Fill your shelves with thousands of unique VHS tapes, each with their own title, genre and hand-drawn cover art! Order movies on your old PC or buy exclusive bootleg films from the shady Tape Dealer.  Each week will have new releases inspired by real iconic movies of the 80s and early 90s. Additional Game Features: Build Your Dream Team: Hire staff to give you a hand on daily tasks to run your store. Manage Your Returns:  Add returned movies in the system, rewind tapes and set aside reserved movies for your customers. Charge Late & Broken Fees: Track late and damaged returns and deal with different customer reactions and complaints. Evolving Customer Interactions: Seasons, weather and holidays affect gameplay and what your customers rent! Be ready, rainy Friday nights are crazy busy in the store! Seasons & Festivals: Play through all four seasons as the environment transforms around you. Each season features special holidays and festivals, all brought to life with unique artwork! Share Movies With Your Friends: Every movie can be ordered on your PC with a unique code that you can share with your friends!

title: BOOBS - Unlock Nudity
description: This DLC unlocks the nudity option in the main game. Thank you for your support! <3

title: World's Toughest Quiz (Free to play)
description: World's Toughest Quiz is a free-to play trivia game where you have to give the correct answer for a difficult question. There will be one correct answer out of four option. Its like who wants to be a millionaire question format. You will only have 20 seconds for every question. Quiz are based on different subject and topic. There is more than 500 quiz in the game and more quiz will come in future update. People of all ages can play this game.

title: Mann Versus Zombies
description: Merasmus returns with more than a tide of blood. This time he possesses something far more malicious than his usual magic tricks. The Undead have arisen... with their rotting carcasses mangled, mutated, and hungry for the flesh of the living! Welcome to Mann Versus Zombies , a total-conversion Team Fortress 2 mod that transforms familiar battlefields into desperate last stands against endless waves of horrific creatures. Survive the Hordes Start with nothing but a weak sidearm and your own wits. As waves after waves close in, you’ll need to manage your cash, upgrade your arsenal, and adapt quickly. Each wave grows more intense and more difficult to survive as the hordes will only increase in numbers and aggression. Build Your Arsenal Acquire a wide range of new weapons inspired by real-world firepower, from tactical rifles to heavy-duty crowd controlling tools. Once you’ve earned enough, take things a step further by feeding your weapons into the Mannifester , to really show them who's in charge. Perks for All Gain the upper hand with powerful perks that benefit your combat effectiveness. Choose wisely as the perks don't come for cheap! And keep in mind... they aren't permanent. Stand your Ground Every second counts when you're surrounded. Work together with your teammates, manage your resources, and repair barricades to keep the defenses standing. A Twisted World Fight across an ample variety of locations, from the dusty battlements of Teufort to the frozen alpine wilderness. Each environment offers its own challenges... and its own creatures. Nowhere is truly safe from them . Endless Challenge There is no final wave. The onslaught of hordes never stop, and neither should you. Push your limits, set new records, and see how long you can truly survive. Play Your Way Solo survival or co-op with up to 8 players Full Workshop support for custom maps and skins Wear your cosmetics from Team Fortress 2

title: Victoria 3: Songs of the Homeland - Music Pack
description: Victoria 3: Songs of the Homeland Step into the transformative world of the Victorian Age designed to immerse you in an era of bold national identity, the rise of modernism, and the birth of the truly international era. This evocative Music Pack promises to: Evoke National Pride: Stir your emotions with powerful anthems that capture the fervor of emerging national identities and the pride of a people defining their place in an ever changing world. Celebrate Modern Innovation: Experience the living pulse of modernism through dynamic, forward-thinking compositions that mirror the transformative spirit of the Victorian era. Capture Global Ambition: Feel the energy of a burgeoning truly international world, with tracks that reflect the excitement and ambition of a world on the brink of globalization. This soundtrack was recorded live by FILMHarmonic Orchestra Prague under the baton of Adam Klemens.

title: Card Shop Simulator Multiplayer
description: Three diverse modes, each offering a different experience. Single Player Mode Play at your own pace. Hire staff to help manage your shop with ease, and your progress is fully saved. You can always join a friend’s multiplayer game using your solo save file. Co‑op Multiplayer Mode Invite up to 3 friends and run a great card shop together! Experience the joys of teamwork, unleash your creativity to decorate your shop, share the excitement of opening card packs, and challenge your friends to a friendly card duel on a lazy weekend. Competitive Multiplayer Mode Want to compete to see whose shop earns more, whose cards are stronger, or whose card‑battling skills are sharper? Each player runs their own shop on the same street, fighting to attract customers. Collect Rare Cards With over 400 cards spanning 7 generations and a wide variety of card frames to enrich your collection, there’s always more to discover. Some mysterious cards only appear under special conditions. Legend tells of a set worth a fortune—with a bit of luck, you might obtain it on your very first day, while others may never catch even a glimpse of the myth. Wager your cards and enter the duel! Classic Duel Featuring an auto-battle system based on elemental strengths and weaknesses, this mode delivers a fast-paced and accessible card battling experience—full of thrilling randomness and luck. Advanced Duel A turn-based battle mode where you command every move—decide which cards to play, choose attack targets, and master the timing of each spell. Total tactical control is in your hands. Uncover the Secrets of the Street Venture Beyond Your Shop Step into the streets and discover all kinds of surprises—maybe a hidden card, a game of basketball, a rooftop view, or a trader who buys spare cards. Challenge the local gym, too. Whenever you explore, something unexpected is always waiting. Showcase Your Creativity: Customize Your Shop Use a wide range of interactive decorations, plants, shelves, card display walls, flooring, ceilings, plush toys, and statues to design a shop that’s uniquely your own.

title: CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 Tsundere ~Prideful and Competitive~ GP-01
description: The content added to CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP01 by the Tsundere -Prideful and Competitive- DLC can be accessed in the following mode: [Empire Life Mode] ・In this mode, you can see a conversation between your maids! Please be advised that this DLC may contain BDSM or BDSM-adjacent content. -CAUTION- If you're playing COM3D2 It's a Night Magic without the R-18 patch, you will need update ver. 1.26 to play the "Tsundere ~Prideful and Competitive~" DLC. Otherwise, Tsundere WILL NOT show up in COM3D2 It's a Night Magic. Please visit our website and install the update manually. -Install Instructions- 1. Download update from our website (It may take awhile to download) 2. Extract the zip folder, and double click the "update.exe" file.

title: CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 Tsundere ~Prideful and Competitive~ GP-02
description: The content added to CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP02 by the Tsundere -Prideful and Competitive- DLC can be accessed in the following way: 1. Become even more intimate with your maid with the marriage system! After fulfilling the requirements such as likability at the "Cathedral" facility, you will be able to proceed from the "lover" relationship to "bride" with your maid. 2. Private Maid Mode See one of your favorite maids in a variety of everyday scenes and enjoy the conversations and life around the Empire Club! 3. Empire Life Mode Adds new events to Empire Life Mode. Please be advised that this DLC may contain BDSM or BDSM-adjacent content. -CAUTION- If you're playing COM3D2 It's a Night Magic without the R-18 patch, you will need update ver. 1.26 to play the "Tsundere ~Prideful and Competitive~" DLC. Otherwise, Tsundere WILL NOT show up in COM3D2 It's a Night Magic. Please visit our website and install the update manually. -Install Instructions- 1. Download update from our website (It may take awhile to download) 2. Extract the zip folder, and double click the "update.exe" file.

title: Forged Desires: A Bara JRPG
description: Forged Desires is a JRPG with dating sim elements and two datable guys: Leonard, the royal soldier, and Galin, the wizard. It's also based on wearing clothes to learn different skills and using different Field Skills like becoming invisible, swinging, and pushing heavy objects. The story is about a blacksmith, Alaric, who has his village destroyed by Prince Draven, and now he wants to stop his evilness. 2 Datable Guys with different routes from the middle of the game until its end; Clothing System with four outfits and unique skills to learn for each one; Field Skills (each cloth allows you to do different actions in the field, like becoming invisible, swinging, and pushing heavy objects) 9 H-Scenes including kissing ones; A Classic JRPG combat with turned-based battle;

title: Forged Desires: A Bara JRPG Demo
description: Forged Desires is a JRPG with dating sim elements and two datable guys: Leonard, the royal soldier, and Galin, the wizard. It's also based on wearing clothes to learn different skills and using different Field Skills like becoming invisible, swinging, and pushing heavy objects. The story is about a blacksmith, Alaric, who has his village destroyed by Prince Draven, and now he wants to stop his evilness. A Classic JRPG combat with turned-based battle; Clothing System; Field Skills (each cloth allows you to do different actions in the field, like becoming invisible, and swinging); 2 H-scenes;

title: YOKAI GODDESS An Urban Legend Bullet hell Adventure
description: Story: Miko Kuromori and Akiko Natsuda are members of the Modern Folklore Research Club . One day, they find themselves trapped in a ghostly version of their school. Their only way out is to lay to rest the Seven School Mysteries —powerful spirits straight out of urban legends. Features: Two gameplay styles: Explore the eerie school corridors in search of clues to pacify vengeful spirits, and battle through intense bullet hell stages filled with diverse enemies and bosses. Occult Bullet Hell: Use talismans, purified salt, and even roasted soybeans ! And if that's not enough, Miko can parry enemy attacks with her gohei wand . Unique levels: From a cursed room where hands reach out from the walls to a drainage system where a cloaked ghost drags away his victims—even a haunted retro game cartridge awaits. Nekonomicon: ??? The Prologue Demo is currently available—a short introduction in which you can try out the core mechanics and experience the beginning of the story. Inspirations: Touhou Project, Pocky & Rocky, Deltarune, Corpse Party.

title: Clear the Snow
description: Clear the Snow with Friends From casual players to perfectionists — everyone will find something for themselves. Enjoy the calm rhythm, cozy atmosphere, and meditative satisfaction of clearing snow one patch at a time. Have Fun with up to 4 Friends A shovel isn’t just a tool — it’s also a ride! Slide down snowy hills with your friends and prove who’s the fastest to reach the bottom. Have snowball fights, build snowmen, and take on fun challenges — there’s always something to do together! Choose the Right Tool and Enjoy the Process Watch as every movement reveals a perfectly clean surface beneath. Layer by layer, the heavy snow disappears, leaving behind a sense of order and peace. It’s more than just cleaning — it’s a mesmerizing, soothing experience. Use Powerful Equipment You’ll have access to shovels, snow blowers, melting trucks, anti-ice chemicals, and even heavy machinery! Each tool you use earns experience points you can spend on upgrades and skill improvements. Clear the Snow and Earn Money Start with simple tools and take on snow-clearing jobs around town. Complete tasks, earn money, and gradually improve your equipment. As you progress, unlock new machines, access larger contracts, and expand your snow-removal capabilities step by step. Wishlist and Follow for Updates!

title: Runix: Pinball Roguelike
description: Build your playstyle by combining different balls, stats, and magical artifacts. Battle powerful enemies with unique mechanics with your pinball magic balls. Complete missions to earn gold, grow stronger, and unlock new powers. Choose your path to restore balance to the world and become the ultimate Pinball Wizard. You are the last mage of the ancient Pinball Order. The only one able to bring balance to this universe. There will be challenging bosses awaiting you at the end of each scenario. Those bosses have their specific techniques that you will need to overcome to complete your journey. Use the archer towers to kill the enemies with arrows that you will activate in different ways. Using them in combination with some balls and artifacts will create powerful combo shots that will obliterate your enemies. You will move the ball using the ultimate magic when you have enough mana. This will allow you to change the ball's course and move it to where you want it. There are a lot of features in this game. Among all the functionalities that this game has, we can highlight the following ones. 50+ Different balls with different effects for powerful combos 3 Different scenarios (pinball tables) with completely different mechanics to explore and master Leaderboards to compete against your friends or the world 60+ Artifacts that will change the way you play pinball and the interactions Classic pinball with improved elements that will make the game more interesting and appealing Increase your powers with permanent upgrades that will allow you to be even more powerful Replayability: This game will give you ascension levels that will allow you to replay the game and test your skills in the harder scenarios Infinity mode: After you defeat the final boss with your deck, test the limit of the deck, going as long as you can!

title: Funny Volleyball
description: "Funny Volleyball" is a modern remake of the classic arcade volleyball game from the 90s, giving new emotions and nostalgia. Immerse yourself in bright and picturesque landscapes, enjoying the game, but do not forget about the main goal - victory! Take part in an exciting arcade tournament or play quick matches. Fight with a smart opponent controlled by the computer, or challenge your friend. Get ready for fun battles and unforgettable moments on the court! Game Features Character Selection Each character in the game has unique characteristics that affect the gameplay style. You can choose a character with high stamina, powerful strikes, impressive jump height, or increased movement speed, allowing you to adapt the gameplay to your preferences. Variety of Court Locations Each tennis court is set in a unique location, adding diversity to the gameplay. You can play on slippery ice, where characters will face difficulties in control, or on a sandy court that slows down running and requires greater agility and strategy from you. Difficulty Levels The game offers various difficulty levels, allowing every player to find the right challenge. You can face an easy opponent for a casual experience or test your skills against an artificial intelligence that will become a true master of the game, requiring maximum concentration and skill from you to win.

title: Third-Person Shooter and Platform Jumping and Level-based Adventure
description: Game Introduction: This is a level crossing game that combines third person shooter and platform jumping, and the game progresses linearly according to the order of the levels. Description of game features: The storyline of the game follows a linear progression through levels in order; Some levels require clever jumping sequences to pass;Some levels require the correct weapon selection to pass; During the process of passing levels, players can unlock more weapons;During the process of passing levels, players can encounter more map elements. Game version roadmap: Third person shooting mode: All equipment (7 pieces: jetpack, sword, rifle, rocket launcher, grenade, flamethrower, sofa); Level challenge Mode: All levels (40 levels); Town simulation mode: Town features (protagonist skin, equipment enhancement, item warehouse, coin dungeon, farm picking, daily tasks); Open world mode: Character avatar customization system, Open world gameplay (added updated test scene).

title: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD Free to Play
description: 🔥 Free to Play 🔥 Ancient Wars: Sparta HD Free to Play lets you relive the legendary RTS, fully remastered—and completely free. Command 2 rotating civilizations, play one mission from each of the three campaigns, battle across selected maps, and challenge others in multiplayer, including the Ranked mode ( Sparta League ). Plus, unleash your creativity with the full map editor. Content updates every month, bringing fresh civilizations and battlegrounds so no two wars ever feel the same. Experience the thrill of real-time strategy and begin your conquest of the ancient world today. Ancient Wars: Sparta HD – Relive the Golden Age of Real-Time Strategy Get ready to experience one of the most epic chapters in RTS history. Ancient Wars: Sparta HD is a fully remastered edition that brings the legendary battles of the ancient world to a whole new level. Lead the Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians through monumental wars that will decide the fate of civilization. With enhanced HD graphics and refined gameplay, this remaster immerses you in tactical warfare where every decision can change history. Customize your armies, master advanced strategies, and unleash devastating abilities to crush your enemies. 🔥 Customize Don’t inherit an army— forge your own. Design and equip your troops with unique weapons and armor. Capture enemy weapons and vehicles to turn them into your advantage. Adapt your army in real time to counter enemy strategies. ⚔️ Conquer It’s not just about winning… it’s about domination. Scale walls, break gates, and overrun fortresses in monumental sieges. Rule the seas with realistic naval battles: ram, board, and destroy. Unleash advanced physics: deadly traps, chariots charging, and buildings collapsing under your might. 👑 Dominate Every faction, a unique way of war . Every campaign, a legend to relive . Command asymmetric civilizations: Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians with unique tactics, units, and playstyles. Relive three historic campaigns: Sparta under Leonidas, Persia under Xerxes, and Egypt in rebellion. Grow your heroes with an RPG-style leveling and skill system. 🏹 Compete Do you have what it takes to be remembered as a true legend ? Enter the Sparta League and face players from around the world. Challenge smarter and more adaptive AI than ever before. Only the most skilled will rise to eternal glory. 🛠️ Create Don’t just play history— write your own. Design epic scenarios and battles with a powerful map editor. Publish and download mods on Steam Workshop : a community of strategists building unforgettable experiences. Expand your game beyond the original with limitless content. ⚔️ Forge your legend in the ancient world Are you ready to lead your army to victory? Command the battlefield, defend your empire, and relive the most glorious moments of history with Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. The fate of civilizations lies in your hands!

title: Violent Horror Stories 2
description: Violent Horror Stories 2 delivers a fresh lineup of horror games from different developers. Each title puts its own spin on the theme of confinement, complete with distinctive visuals, gameplay, and story. Expect roughly 30 minutes of playtime per game. Last year the pursuit‑themed anthology featured No, I'm not a Human , I ate old man's liver now this b***ch is mine , Sensation , All along the toon tower . This time we are packing in even more games from an even wider range of authors, all centered on the new theme. GAMES FROM THE ANTHOLOGY: You have [x] missed calls After getting ahold of a classified documents folder, you isolate yourself in an old friend's apartment. As missed calls begin to pile up, decide which caller to meet at the day's end — but be wary! Some are not who they seem. Hi, What's Your Emergency Based on real events. Story about how hard it is for a child trapped in an abusive home to get help. Barricade the door and fight through the hotline phone tree, where a wrong choice costs precious seconds. Coin Locker Baby As a small forgotten child explore the life that was denied to you. HeartWood The Great Evil has been defeated, but its final curse has looped the forest and driven your friends insane. In the guise of the Dream Girl, you must gather the scattered fragments of your former team. Strike from the Skies After only a few hours, an unknown enemy has captured almost everything. Our last hope lies with artillery.  Use the telegraph to transmit coordinates and prevent the enemy from reaching the civilians. Padishah's lady In the harem, all the girls are fighting for the attention of the Padishah. And you are one of these concubines. Charm everyone to survive and protect your future child. The Village and the Dead A mysterious death took place in a remote village. Everyone has their own motives and their own dark past. To solve the case, you'll have to dig deeper... Even if the truth breaks you. Coupon for a Million Welcome to the TV show: navigate the maze, complete tasks with the brand new phone, find the coveted coupon – but the organizers won't give you an easy win. Down the Stairs Daily life of a person with dementia. The Exit is Inside To escape from captivity in the morgue, a surgeon will have to learn to speak with the dead in the language of scalpel and tweezers. Deadman’s Hand: Hold'em A dark, immersive visual novel blending horror elements with a Texas Hold'em poker simulation. Every player at the table is hiding something and it's not just their cards. Your life is on the line. Take all the chips or face the gunfire. This isn’t a casino. It’s a deathtrap.

title: Plants vs. Zombies™: Replanted
description: What’s new vs. the 2009 GOTY edition? About the Game The classic Plants vs. Zombies returns in glorious HD! DANG! After years in Crazy Dave’s attic, the original battle between Plants and Zombies is back — bigger, brighter, and crazier than ever before! Experience the game that started it all, now remastered with upscaled HD graphics and packed with new secrets to uncover. Revisit the epic backyard standoffs you remember, this time with new levels, fresh twists, and 15 years of never-before-seen franchise history at your fingertips. Relive the glory days of peashooters, sunflowers, and brain-hungry chaos! Rejoin the ultimate garden defense and experience the backyard brawl that started a phenomenon — now back for a new era!

title: BARDA: Backpack Roguelike
description: Help Thȫmi reach the mountain’s summit and honor the final promise he made to his grandpa: to scatter his ashes to the wind from the highest peak of the highest mountain. To reach the top, Thȫmi must gather tools and resources at every stop along his journey. But space is limited, and inventory management is key to overcoming the challenges ahead. With over 140 unique items of different sizes and effects, carefully organize your backpack and decide what is worth carrying to survive the climb. As Thȫmi gathers new tools and makes his way toward the summit, he'll journey through breathtaking landscapes—from lush jungles and raging volcanoes to frozen mountain passes. Though the path is a lonely one, friendly mountain dwellers can offer valuable services and assistance along the way. Throughout the ascent, hunger, fatigue, and madness will constantly affect both Thȫmi and the items in his backpack. Massive dragons, terrifying trolls, and sneaky goblins will stand in his way. Fortunately, combat isn't the only solution. Use your items wisely as they may be the key to your survival. Each expedition unlocks new items, tools, and companions to aid future climbs. The journey doesn't end once your grandpa's wish has been fulfilled. No two ascents are the same, and neither is Thȫmi. Follow BARDA on Social Media!

title: Beak Force (Early Access)
description: 🐧 Beakforce – Waddle Into War Beakforce is a fast-paced, first-person shooter where you're not just any soldier—you're a battle-ready penguin armed to the beak. Engage in high-energy, low-temperature warfare across dozens of unique maps, wield a variety of wacky and powerful weapons, and customize your penguin to strike fear (and maybe laughter) into your enemies. Whether you’re flanking through frozen outposts or soaring across snowy stadiums in style, Beakforce is all about wild, chaotic fun—with the precision of a shooter and the personality of a penguin. ❄️ Features: 🧊 Penguin-Powered FPS Combat – Play as a heavily armed penguin in an action-packed shooter with fluid controls and tight gunplay. 🎮 Multiple Game Modes – Classic Team Fight, 2v2, Zombies, and more to come! 🌎 Diverse Maps – Wage war across frosty peaks, icy arenas, sunken ships, and secret arctic bases—each with unique layouts and strategies. 🔫 Weapon Variety – Equip everything from snowball launchers to freeze-ray rifles and more traditional ballistic beak-blasters. 🧢 Full Customization – Dress your penguin in hats, outfits, skins, and accessories. Build your style—and your loadout. 🐧 Waddle With Friends – Squad up with your flock or take on others online in multiplayer madness. Whether you're looking to freeze your enemies in style or just have a good laugh sliding into battle, Beakforce brings the chill... and the thrill.

title: Unshine Arcade
description: Welcome to the (S)Unshine Arcade! ... is what the mysterious virtual pet says, stuck in the 'Grand Prize' cabinet that really wants you to free it. Several arcade cabinets are scattered throughout the arcade, but someone really wants you to play this one game... Why did they make it? What's going on with this arcade? ... Why is there blood? Unshine Arcade combines fast-paced action roguelite stealth-shooter arcade madness with psychological horror. Earn tickets, find gacha balls, and discover meta-progression secrets that make each run deadlier. Find your way out of the (S)Unshine Arcade as you discover the truth about its horrifying past. Try not to get betrayed along the way...

title: SRPG Studio JRPG Background Vol2
description: This is the battle background formatted for the SRPG Studio with a size of 840 x 480. The following files are contained. (This DLC also includes 1680 × 960 files.) 1. audience _chamber_bright 2. audience _chamber_dark 3. castle_gate 4. castle_hall 5. causeway 6. hideout 7. ocean 8. stream 9. temple_ruins 10.wharf The terms of use of materials are as below: 1. Materials can be used, not only for the game created with the SRPG Studio. They can also be used in paid games. 2. Materials can be used and processed. 3. The author's copyright of the materials belongs to SapphireSoft. However, when you use the materials, you are not required to mention it. 4. The sales of the materials are prohibited. The sales of the processed materials are also prohibited. 5. The distribution of the materials is prohibited. The distribution of the processed materials is also prohibited. 6. Materials can be used in age-restricted games.

title: Software CEO
description: Software CEO is a relaxing yet deep business simulation game where you create and manage your own software company from scratch. Start your journey in a humble garage with a single desk and an old CRT monitor. As an ambitious founder, you’ll take charge of every aspect of your growing startup: producing software, hiring employees, furnishing your office, and managing deadlines, bugs, budgets, and burnout. At the heart of the game lies a unique component-based development system. Every software product, feature, or module is built from multiple layers of components, across five tiers of complexity. To create higher-tier components, you'll need to produce — or delegate — all the underlying elements. Good planning, skilled staff, and smart investments are key to success. You can focus your business on three different types of production: SaaS platforms – Launch and operate live online services (e.g., marketplaces, social networks, MMORPGs) and generate revenue through subscriptions or advertising. Traditional software – Design and release standalone products for sale, from image editors to video games. Contract work – Deliver specific components for other companies under tight deadlines to earn reliable income. As your company grows, so do the challenges. You’ll have to: Recruit and train employees with different specialties. Maintain product quality while dealing with bugs and technical debt. Manage team morale, burnout, and workplace needs. Respond to market trends and cybersecurity threats. The better your setup, the more efficient your team. Buy and upgrade computers, chairs, and desks. Customize your workspace with stylish decor to boost productivity or simply impress your investors. You can rent or buy bigger offices, moving from tiny startup spaces to multi-floor buildings as your empire grows. Whether you're a micromanager who loves optimizing production pipelines, or a chill player who enjoys growing a cozy business at your own pace, Software CEO offers a strategic yet relaxing sandbox to build your digital empire.

title: Pro Strategy Football 2026
description: PLEASE NOTE!!  PSF 2026 IS NOT THE NEWEST VERSION OF PRO STRATEGY FOOTBALL! HEAD TO PRO STRATEGY FOOTBALL 2027 FOR THE LATEST AND GREATEST! Pro Strategy Football 2026 version: Animation now has real jersey numbers!  Shoulder numbers are optional, to reflect real jerseys throughout history, and the shoulder numbers and jersey numbers can be colored differently! Accurate and realistic formations by era!  HUGE jump in realism and immersiveness! Can now manually trade players and draft picks for even more player movement! Player Season Logs! View every season log for your favorite (or hated) players. Drill down to see how he did in a season, and then click any game to view the stats and watch any play or drive (watch the whole game if you want!). Career Record Books! Year-by-year or All-time best seasons! Tons of categories! Click on any leader and jump immediately to his season logs for that season! HUGE overhaul to Highlights! You can now view ANY drive and ANY play of any game! Relive game-winning drives and key plays, even entire games! Perfect for reliving key drives from every season! Configure highlights to watch the ones YOU want! Highlights mode is better than ever!  You can still step through key highlights, but now you can configure the highlights!  Even better, you can step through drives and plays!  You can even start at the beginning (or start in any drive) and watch as much of the game as you want! Can now filter Weekly and Studio games by conference! Choose alternate uniforms and helmets!  Play at a neutral site!  Use team-specific and championship-specific screen backgrounds! Create and import smaller draft pools! This will allow users to create historic draft pools and import them - change history! Can create team-specific (and championship-specific) background screens for Game Setup and Game Summary screens! The combination of career records, player season logs, and the new ability to watch any play of any game bring hundreds of hours of fun!

title: Artemis - Book Two (Early Access)
description: Bugs will likely be present that slipped through the cracks during BETA. Please report them so they can be addressed. Book Two will feature chapters 5 & 6 off the bat, followed by 7 when it's ready and finally 8 thereafter. The remaining books (Books 3 & 4) will be released as separate DLCs. The next installment of Artemis picks up immediately after Book One's conclusion. In Book Two, you will help Artemis understand what it means to be human, as you guide her through various scenarios and prepare her to be a member of society. Some choices will influence a new core mechanic, Artemis' Discernment Protocol . This will affect how she handles situations in future chapters. You will also navigate the corporate world, as you revive Kapuletti Industries back to its former glory and prepare for the McCreed Expo. And of course, advance your progression with love interests.

title: Retro Racing 2
description: Rev your engines and get ready for a thrilling ride with Retro Racing 2, the ultimate old-school retro racing game that brings back the excitement of classic 2D top-down racing. Choose from a variety of cars, each with unique performance characteristics, and race across diverse tracks and challenging environments. Collect power-ups, to increase Top Speed, Acceleration and Tires, or for an instant Nitro boost, and speed your way to the top of the leaderboard! This nostalgic yet fresh racing game offers an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep you hooked for hours. Slick graphics and exhilarating gameplay make Retro Racing 2 a must-play for racing enthusiasts of all ages. Features • Classic 2D Top-Down Racing: Enjoy the simplicity and thrill of retro-style racing with modern enhancements. • Cars: Choose from a variety of cars, each with distinct speed, handling, and acceleration attributes to suit your racing style and track. • Power-Ups: Collect power-ups scattered across the tracks to boost your car’s performance and gain an edge over your rivals. • Level Packs: Race through various challenging environments including: • Practice: Hone your skills and master the tracks before taking on tougher challenges. • Circuits: Traditional racing tracks for a pure, competitive experience. • Snow: Slippery and unpredictable tracks to test your control. • Sand: Tight sandy tracks that require careful handling and quick reflexes to avoid sliding off course. • Split-Screen Multiplayer: Compete with up to 4 players in split-screen mode and quadruple the fun! • Leaderboards: Climb to the top of the leaderboard, showcasing your racing prowess and achieving the ultimate bragging rights. Why You'll Love It • Fun for All Ages: Simple yet engaging gameplay makes it perfect for players of all ages. • Replay Value: Multiple cars, power-ups, and level packs, every race offers a new and exciting challenge, will keep you coming back to improve on your best time. • Competitive Spirit: The leaderboard adds a competitive edge, encouraging players to continuously improve their skills and outperform their friends. Get Ready to Race! Join the Retro Racing 2 community and relive the glory days of arcade racing with a modern twist. Whether you’re a seasoned racer or a newcomer, there’s always a thrill waiting for you on the track. Download Retro Racing 2 today and experience the ultimate in retro racing fun!

title: Press A: Extremely Realistic Life Simulator
description: Press A , is, much like the protagonist’s vocalization, an artistic expression of the state not only of the game industry, but of most aspects of life in the 2020s. Press A , is an experimental project riding on the back of meme culture, that brings an obscure, yet very relevant nowadays, meme to life in an unprecedented manner. Features : Revolutionary approach to game input - you can press [A] to Aaaaaaaaaaaaaa. Robust statistics system accumulating info on how long you Aaaaaaaaa or how many times you Aaaaaaaaaaa. Function to even pause and quit the game. Hand drawn graphics (i'm really proud of this one). More planned if the demand arises...

title: Void Miner – Incremental Asteroids Roguelite
description: Void Miner is a incremental roguelite bullet hell that is about mining asteroids, collecting resources and upgrading your ship to blast through waves of asteroid belts. WISHLIST AND PLAY NOW Start with a simple ship, picking off as many asteroids as you can. Explore the upgrade tree. Lay waste to the entire asteroid belt.

title: SnowRunner - Season 18: Patch & Power
description: Help the Mexican state of Chiapas complete the construction of a brand new geothermal power plant after a recent bout of tropical storms left the region in chaos. Trek across 2 exciting new jungle maps aboard two new powerful and versatile trucks! - Two new 4km² maps set in Chiapas. Tame a brand new jungle biome for the very first time in SnowRunner! Drive across sandy beaches, lush forests and mangroves that’ll put your skills to the test - Two new vehicles: the Mercer R230, an Offroad-class cargo hauler with great maneuverability and crawler suspension giving it a unique role in the SnowRunner garage, and the HIB Billert M816, a Highway-class truck with a unique combination of speed and low fuel consumption, making it a formidable long-range specialist. - New activities:  Assist local authorities in setting up a brand new geothermal power plant in the heart of Mexico! The National Energy Commission needs your help to finalize the construction of a new sustainable power plant. Start with strengthening the coastline to prevent flooding, restore what can be and dismantle what cannot. Once the groundwork is laid, connect the various stations into an active network! Season 18: Patch & Power is included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

title: SnowRunner - Season 19: Research & Restore
description: Welcome to Switzerland! Help Science on the way to its next major breakthrough through 3 expansive winter maps, exploring and sourcing materials to assist in the construction of a cutting-edge space observatory and much more. Three new 4km² winter maps set in Switzerland. From public infrastructure to advanced scientific research and even tourist festivals, this picturesque canton is buzzing with new projects! Two new vehicles: the Wortek 250T, an incredibly versatile Heavy-class truck with one of the largest fuel tanks in the game and deep add-on modularity, and the Derry Savior, a maneuverable 8x8 Heavy truck with three steering axles and the muscle to take the biggest cargo up the steepest climbs. New activities:  Participate in the reopening of an old viaduct, help the locals get a colorful hot-air balloon festival off the ground, and secure roads against the threat of avalanches! Once the path is safe, complete the observatory’s renovation by delivering its delicate optical instruments. Season 19: Research & Restore is included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

title: SnowRunner - Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 2
description: The Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 2 is now available! Expand your SnowRunner garage with two new behemoths: the Heavy-class Mercedes-Benz NG3850 and the Off-Road Mercedes-Benz LG1519 6x6 “Mamute”. This DLC is not sold as part of a SnowRunner Year Pass.

title: RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike
description: RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers with the element of roguelike deckbuilding. Combine special coins with powerful items to trigger satisfying synergies. It’s a nonstop dopamine rush packed into one unpredictable, coin dropping ride. Discover all kinds of special coins during your runs! Combine Seed Coins with Water Coins to grow a money tree right inside your machine. Drop a Cat Coin to hunt down every last Rat Coin and rack up extra tickets. Need more points? Use a MultiCoin to boost your score across the board. Too slow? Blast a TNT Coin to trigger a massive explosion and blast every coin forward at once! Uncover 150 unique items that can dramatically shift the course of your run. Stack multipliers, spawn coins with extra points, or simply shake the machine when you're running dry. Apply special plating to your favorite coins to enhance their effects and unlock even wilder combos. Play as one of several unique characters, each with their own set of themed coins and playstyle. Take on the role of a greedy raccoon manager who excels at math-based combos, or a quirky biologist who specializes in animal-based coins. Every character offers a fresh and wildly different way to play. 6 playable characters, each with their own unique coins 150 distinct coins with special effects 150 power-up items with unique abilities Endless run mode for infinite replayability 8 difficulty levels to master

title: The Alters Benchmark Tool
description: The Alters Benchmark Tool is a PC benchmark application specifically developed for The Alters. It evaluates your hardware performance and system compatibility. This tool is separate from the game and is non-playable.

title: Non-violent Hero 非暴力系勇者！
description: A hero rescues a princess but refuses to use violence. His weapon is a microphone. Features No violence at all. Defeat enemies with reason. A beautiful map hand-drawn by the king, just in case the hero gets lost. A castle that can only be entered once . There is absolutely nothing inside. You can freely enter the villagers’ houses, as if they were your own. You can rescue the princess… or not . You can obtain a handsome photo of the hero. A total of eleven endings. Non-Violent Hero is a pixel RPG. You play as a charming yet stubborn hero who refuses to use violence, helping the king rescue his daughter kidnapped by the Demon King. Through different choices, you can reach different endings and shape the story in your own way.

title: SuperWEIRD: Automation Roguelite
description: Roadmap About the Game Your production line is your battle plan. SuperWEIRD is an automation roguelite where worker bots supply disposable fighters, and the world grows one planet fragment at a time. Build your network, push back the Goofy Goo, and experiment across runs. Play solo or in a team of up to four. Put your bots to work Build an army of rusty, clumsy robots, with workers to craft and deliver supplies and fighters to take on the Goofy Goo. Guide your bots with paths and task points marked by flags. Connect production chains that keep your fighters equipped with increasingly powerful weapons. Improve your network as new threats appear and turn production into firepower. Defend your work from the corruption The Goofy Goo shattered your planet. Now its creatures and giant robot bosses threaten everything you rebuild. It consumes resources and structures, so your production network and defenses have to work together. Piece the planet back together Join fragments of a shattered planet to expand your world. Experiment with how hundreds of pieces fit together, create your own layout, and adapt your production network to the land you build. Rescue the locals Rescue inhabitants from corruption and bring them back to your base. Befriend them to earn useful perks such as extra health, larger inventory stacks and increased speed. Bring friends—or build solo Play solo or coordinate your factory and defenses in a team of up to four. Join friends online or over a local network and keep the supplies moving together. Built by Luden.io We make games about programming and automation. SuperWEIRD brings that experience to a world you can rebuild with friends. Add SuperWEIRD to your wishlist and follow its development.

title: Touhou Iyuushou ~ What the Bullet Hell?!
description: Touhou Iyuushou ~ What the Bullet Hell?! is a Touhou Project fan-made bullet hell game that pays homage to Impossible Spell Card . It features a collection of short, self-contained danmaku stages—each one a standalone, visually striking bullet pattern designed to challenge your reflexes and puzzle-solving skills. "Iyuushou" means "Testimony of Strange Encounters". You play as Marisa Kirisame , reimagined as a danmaku researcher , investigating mysterious spell cards appearing across Gensokyo. Armed with a variety of tools, you'll analyze, survive, and outwit increasingly bizarre bullet patterns! 🧪 Core Features 🔸 Danmaku Challenge Collection A large set of short, carefully crafted stages. Each stage is an individual bullet hell "exhibit", offering unique gameplay, aesthetics, and logic to decipher. 🔸 Strategic Item System Bring helpful items into battle to turn the tide—but be warned, using them affects your final reward! Go in raw for greater glory. 🔸 Multiple Difficulty Levels & Challenge Styles Tackle each stage at Easy / Normal / Hard / Lunatic difficulty. Want to prove your skill? Try clearing stages without items for maximum bragging rights! 🔸 Stamp Collection System Clearing a stage earns you collectible stamps . Higher difficulties award more stamps, and clearing a stage without items earns you a rare, shining Gold Stamp ! 🔸 Scene EX: Long-form challenges included! Each game day features a "Scene EX", where all bosses of that day appear in succession, taking turns unleashing their bullet patterns. This provides players who enjoy longer gameplay sessions with a more complete and intense danmaku rhythm experience. 🔸 DIY Mode: Create Your Own Challenge Runs Use levels as "cards" to freely combine and arrange them, building your own long-form bullet hell challenges. Save and share presets, and compete with friends for high points! 🔸 Daily Challenge: Fresh Danmaku Combos Every Day! The game randomly selects different bosses to appear together each day, creating unprecedented mixed battles. Every day brings a brand-new experience! 🎯 Game Identity & Style A Touhou Project fan game made with love for danmaku and its creative potential Inspired by Impossible Spell Card , but expands with more solutions and player freedom Light on story, heavy on gameplay—perfect for pick-up-and-play or long challenge runs Catering to both quick-stage runs and marathon STG experiences Functions both as a "danmaku art gallery" and a technical proving ground for STG fans ⚠️ Warning: This game contains flashing lights and rapid patterns that may trigger seizures in players with photosensitive epilepsy.

title: NextVisuals Benchmark Forest
description: NextVisuals Forest is a next-generation GPU performance benchmark designed to push modern graphics hardware to its limits. Built on state-of-the-art rendering technologies, it delivers an uncompromising visual experience that sets a new standard for fidelity and realism in real-time graphics. Key Features: Explore Mode – Freely roam the benchmark environment and dynamically adjust the time of day to experience lighting and mood transitions in real-time Detailed benchmark stats , all saved to Steam Cloud for comparison across devices . Ultra-High Polygon Density for intricate, richly detailed environments Real-Time Global Illumination and Lighting to simulate realistic light behavior Hardware Ray Tracing for physically accurate shadows, reflections, and lighting effects Volumetric Fog and Clouds for immersive atmospheric depth NextVisuals Forest runs exclusively at high and ultra settings for consistency, and like gaming scenarios, it can use native and upscaled resolutions, with TSR, FSR and DLSS, ensuring comparable visual fidelity. This ensures a comparable, raw evaluation of hardware capabilities, ideal for users, developers, and reviewers who need forward-looking metrics. Note : The frame rate achieved in this Benchmark is directly comparable to typical video game performance, due to its settings, focus on cutting-edge rendering, and upscaling solutions. Achieving 60FPS can guarantee the same performance with optimized settings. A score of 10,000 is translated to 60 FPS.

title: Kitchen Gore
description: Kitchen Gore is a physics-based horror cooking simulator. Features: Physics-based cooking : Juggle ingredients, flip food to cook all sides, and manage chaotic kitchen dynamics. Tense and unnerving atmosphere : Creepy tone with occasional goofyness. Two Perspectives: A story mode and the hardcore mode that brings a new perspective to the story Endless survival mode : Test your endurance and mastery under constantly building pressure. Gameplay In Kitchen Gore you voluntarily feed a monster in your basement. The ingredients are various and require different approaches to be cooked. While doing this you also have to periodically scroll the phone to keep her(?) distracted. If things go wrong and you get her angry, play the music box to calm her down. Story Who are you and why are you voluntarily keeping and feeding a monster in your basement? Each level in story and hardcore mode unravels more about your character and the situation. Hardcore mode introduces new story content that re-contextualizes the original narrative from story mode as well as a different ending scene. We recommend playing the game with headphones Hope you enjoy :)

title: Staffer Retro : A Supernatural Mystery Quest
description: An island town where supernatural powers exist... Dive into the truth of the past, all obscured by the monotony of daily life. [Staffer Retro] is a detective adventure that explores past events related to supernatural powers. Synopsis A world where supernatural abilities exist. Plus, tools with mysterious powers, 'STAFF.' For Verita, an ordinary girl who resides in a second-hand store, Shop Retro, these things sound like stories from a far-off world. That is, until she's suddenly buried under a considerable debt. You’ll be joining Verita on her journey, by Help her resolve the story’s contradictions and mysteries, and decide how she should act. Hidden stories behind the scenes and various tricks you might have missed if you weren’t paying close attention are waiting for you. Delve into how these supernatural powers have shaped the past! Choose your actions! Use conversation or exploration to gather information and new documents, then reach your own conclusion as you reason through what you've found. The results of your own choices and logic can lead you toward a different ending. Use logic to combine documents Make use of the document-centric system that has defined the Staffer series! Combine information about these supernatural happenings recorded on all sorts of documents in order to discover a brand-new truth. Over 40 unique kinds of documents holding over 100 different clues and The rules behind these supernatural powers, and all these suspicious records... are waiting you! Recall the truth of the incident ─ Re:Story system Sort through six types of documents in order to find the clues to the story playing out. Once you fill them all out, the truth hidden within might just make itself known. Reveal the truth behind the story ─ Retro system Behind the seemingly peaceful daily routine, a vicious truth lies in wait... At the end of each mystery, the 'dark side' exists to be uncovered. Turn the conclusion on its head in order to discover a new ending. Voice acting for the main story features over 20 characters The story, consisting of 6 episodes (Acts) and 11 endings, features over 20 characters voiced by a talented cast of 17 or more Japanese voice actors. Solve the mystery with voice recordings equivalent to two full seasons of a Japanese anime series! Animations that breathe life into Characters & Cutscene Enjoy high-quality illustrations brought to life with Spine animation! All characters, including extra characters, have been animated. And also applied a variety of facial expressions to the characters to create a more realistic presentation. *All content in this game may be freely streamed. *No generative AI was used at any stage of this game's development.

title: Rhythm Animal Café
description: ☕ Welcome to Rhythm Animal Cafe! Rhythm Animal Cafe is a charming collection of hand-drawn rhythm mini-games where everyday life becomes a musical adventure! In this lively little town, going to work, cooking, playing games, and all sorts of ordinary activities turn into hilarious rhythm challenges. No complicated controls or overwhelming note charts here. Just listen to the music and press a button at the right moment to enjoy the simple, pure fun of rhythm gaming! ✨ Game Features Doug Busy. Dog. Age 26. Office Worker. His name is Busy, and he certainly lives up to it. He works nonstop, sleeps only four hours a night, and doesn't earn a penny in overtime pay. Here comes his boss with another empty promise! His coworkers know better, but Doug opens wide and swallows it whole, right on the beat. Pan Youxian. Panda. Age 42. Jack-of-All-Trades. Despite his laid-back name, he's never got a moment to spare. Cooking, fixing pipes, playing in a band... there's nothing he can't handle! Watch him work his magic in the kitchen as onions, potatoes, and eggs fly his way. One perfectly timed flip after another, and a delicious plate of fried rice is ready! Burmilla Cait. Cat. Age 24. Cafe Employee. Her name sounds cheerful and lovely, but she's not always as happy as it suggests. Today, she's appearing on a TV show! The cameras make her terribly nervous, but as she finds her rhythm, she slowly relaxes and finally shows off a sweet smile. Tucked away on a street corner in this bustling animal town is a cozy little cafe. And you're the Manager! You'll get to know the locals, share their joys and troubles, and lend a helping hand whenever you can. Work, cooking, deliveries, part-time jobs, sneaking in a little break... Even the messiest days can become wonderful memories when you follow the beat. Turns out, everyday life has a rhythm of its own. Welcome to Rhythm Animal Cafe , a heartwarming and hilarious collection of rhythm mini-games! 🎵 Feel the Beat, Even Without Watching the Screen! Ever find yourself tapping along to your favorite song without thinking? That's the idea behind Rhythm Animal Cafe . Listen to the beat. Press the button. That's it! No complicated button combinations or endless streams of notes. Just follow the rhythm, and you'll quickly get the hang of it, even if you've never played a rhythm game before. Every beat, melody, and character animation is carefully designed to let you rely on your ears as much as your eyes. But hitting every beat perfectly? That's another story! 🐾 Everyday Life, Extraordinary Rhythm Challenges! Every animal in town has a job, a story, and a rhythm of their own. An office worker struggling with his boss's empty promises, a panda cooking up a storm, and residents juggling one part-time job after another... These ordinary moments become a colorful collection of rhythm mini-games, each with its own music and surprises. Nail the beat for a satisfying performance, or miss a few notes and enjoy the animals' hilarious reactions! After all, a Perfect isn't always the funniest outcome! 🎶 35 Tracks That Bring Everyday Sounds to Life Clattering dishes, bustling street stalls, neighbors chatting... Here, even the sounds of everyday life become part of the music! Featuring 35 tracks across a variety of styles, including Jazz, Pop, and House, the soundtrack brings every scene to life. Music, gameplay, and animation work together to make you feel like you're part of the animals' everyday adventures. Some tunes are sweet and relaxing. Others are so catchy they'll stick in your head all day! Don't be surprised if you find yourself tapping along long after you've stopped playing. 🎨 A Cozy, Hand-Drawn World Full of Life Warm sunlight, leafy rooftops, a vintage record player, and a whole town of busy, fluffy residents. With its lively 2D hand-drawn animation, Rhythm Animal Cafe feels like a storybook brought to life. There's no world to save and no evil overlord to defeat. Just work, meals, friends, everyday worries, and that wonderful moment when you can finally relax after a long day. It's these little moments that make up the rhythm of life. 🛠️ Create Your Own Rhythm! The story of this little town is far from over! A Level Editor is planned for a future update, giving Managers the chance to create rhythm mini-games of their own. Design your own challenges, combine music, sound effects, animations, and performances, and even tell your own stories! We can't wait to see the creativity our community brings to this world. The Level Editor is currently in development. Its release date will be announced later. ☕ Managers, Welcome to the Cafe! Life can get busy, and things don't always go as planned. But with a little music, there's always a bit of happiness to be found. If you're feeling tired, why not stop by our little cafe and stay a while? The coffee's ready. All we're missing is you, Manager! ☕🎵

title: Funny Bones
description: Funny Bones: Test Your Typing Speed and Spelling Skills in this Summoning Madness! 🎃👻 Get ready for the spooky challenge of Funny Bones ! In this fast-paced Halloween themed game, your mission is to spell out the body parts of each skeleton before it fades into the underworld. Complete one skeleton, and another appears—but beware! The pace picks up with each new skeleton, challenging even the quickest fingers! 🖤💀 Modes: 📖 Story Mode: where you find the mysteries of the necromancer's school. ♾️ Infinite Mode: here you can put yourself to the challenge and compete against others to become a Summon Master. Key Features : ⚡ Fast Reflexes Needed : Each round speeds up—do you have what it takes to keep up with the skeleton swarm? 📚 Educational & Addictive : Test your anatomical knowledge and spelling skills in this brainy, fast-paced game. 🧛 Perfect for Halloween : With eerie visuals and thrilling music, Funny Bones plunges you into the spirit of the season. Prove who’s the ultimate speller among the undead! 🕸️👀 How to Play: - Type the words that fall using the keyboard to summon the missing parts of the skeleton 🦴✨ Credits: Trailer Music : Hall of the Mountain King Kevin MacLeod Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0 License - Remix: Red Monkey Studio. Keyboard UI :

title: The Last Flight
description: 🌍 The world once soared through the skies on wings of steel… until everything changed. When disaster struck, the lucky ones bought property on remote islands, now the last remaining safe havens. Humanity clings to survival, scattered and struggling, with fragile network infrastructure barely held together by a few. But life... goes on. Even in ruin. ✈️ You’ve found an abandoned plane It's old. It's broken. But it’s yours. Scavenge the world for parts. Rebuild it . Fly between islands... or maybe beyond . 💻 In a world where real interaction is rare, the internet is your lifeline Slow? Yes. Fragile? Definitely. But essential. Your connection to the world is digital and vital: Order plane parts online Chat with clients and maybe friends Browse post-apocalyptic websites Manage your email Pay your internet bills… if you want to stay connected 🧠 Monitor your needs and mental state Stay sharp. Stay sober. Flying under the influence isn't just reckless, it's deadly. 👥 And the past? It wasn’t as peaceful as you remember. Dark memories linger, haunting your every step. You’ll have to decide: run from them or face them.

title: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball Volume 9
description: This classic Williams™ Pinball collection brings three iconic tables together - PIN·BOT™, TAXI™, and WHO dunnit™ - each delivering a unique design, theme, and gameplay. Celebrate the golden age of pinball with vibrant style, addictive multiballs, and countless surprises for players of every skill level. This pack features: TAXI™: Jump into the driver’s seat of this high‑score cabbie extravaganza! Pick up famous passengers like Santa Claus, Dracula, Gorbie, or PIN·BOT himself. WHO dunnit™: Investigate crime scenes, gather clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the case - all within an amazing noir environment from the 1930s. PIN·BOT™: Embark on a journey through the Solar System! Fill the lamp matrix to unlock PIN·BOT’s visor and shoot jackpots on this iconic 1980s sci-fi classic.

title: Golf 5 MAX
description: Grip it and rip it! Master your swing, build your golfer, and take on classic rounds, arcade challenges, and rivals worldwide. Every shot counts! Pick your golfer. Build your legend. Each character has unique strengths and weaknesses. Level up five key skills to develop your playing style: Power – Hit it further. Technique – Master your spin. C onsistency – Stay in control. Accuracy – Sharpen your aim. Recovery – Escape tricky situations. Tee off across seven original courses, each with its own character, from tropical dunes to autumn greens. New landscapes, new challenges, endless ways to play. Enjoy classic 9‑ or 18‑hole rounds, tackle Birdie or Bust for all‑or‑nothing pressure, or push your speed to the limit in Time Attack mode. Challenge up to four players online, enter global tournaments, and climb the rankings. Real, responsive golf physics. Retro-inspired arcade gameplay. RPG-style golfer progression. Distinct characters with unique abilities. Classic and arcade game modes. Online multiplayer for up to 4 players. Global tournaments and rankings. Try the free demo and add Golf 5 MAX to your wishlist!

title: How Many Dudes? The Roguelike Autobattler
description: How Many Dudes? is a roguelike dudebuilder that's all about game-breaking synergies and simulated chaos. Welcome to the Dude Ranch, where you recruit and manage your ever-expanding army of Dudes Choose from  a wild cast of 49 Unique Dudes across 7 Dude Families: Undead Dudes, Employed Dudes, Warrior Dudes, Fantasy Dudes, Sci-Fi Dudes, and Action Dudes, plus new Sports Dudes from the free major update. Setup your Team to mix and match Dude Types and form ridiculous synergies - like Zombie Dudes who explode when struck by enemies, Ninja Dudes who throw a barrage of Shurikens, or Cowboy dudes who lasso other Dudes out of danger. More than 850,000 Team compositions means there's tons of strategies and overpowered combos to discover. Create game-breaking synergies with your choice of Dudes, Trinkets, and Relics Collect hundreds of Dude Relics that warp the rules of battle. Make your Wizard Dudes fling a volley of fireballs when they move, your Ninja Dudes enter stealth when in danger, or your Finance Dudes generate cash with a life insurance policy on your other Dudes. Defeat Act Bosses to earn Trinkets - powerful items assigned to a Dude Type that enable game breaking strategies. Should you give your Wizard Dudes ADHD, or give your Samurai Dudes a Taser?  It's up to you! Choose your Dudes wisely. Each Dude has their place in battle, from dishing out damage to tanking it to commanding other Dudes. Find the right balance between offense and defense, and see if your team can make it all the way to the final act. Face escalating enemy waves—from toddlers to wolves to gorillas to gods Conquer boss fights that test your team’s synergy (and your sanity). Defeat bosses to earn Silver and Gold stars for each Dude, and see if you can master them all! Strategic roguelike autobattler full of game-breaking synergies 42 Unique Dude Types to recruit and build out your team Hundreds of Relics, Trinkets, and Wandering Dude events that completely reshape each run Three Tiers of Challenge, each with additional unique enemies and epic boss battles Game modes like The Daily Dude and Ensemble Mode, which allows for pre-selecting your dream team Infinite replayability and absurdity

title: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27
description: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27 Comparison About the Game Run the league one decision at a time. EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine, transforms Franchise into a reactive, always-evolving league where every NFL athlete has a distinct, realistic personality that informs their motivations, demands and reactions. Gameplay gets physical with more precise control from authentic WR/DB battles, new short-yardage mechanics, defensive coverage improvements and new strategic pre-play settings and controls. Build your NFL legacy on a deeper progression path in the new Superstar G.O.A.T. Career Journey and control your roster with more customization with Ultimate Team Captains. FRANCHISE The all-new Persona Engine gives every NFL athlete a distinct personality that informs their motivations, how they think and how they respond, transforming your Franchise into a reactive ever-evolving league shaped by every move you make. GAMEPLAY Authentic NFL Physicality Every snap is a battle for control. All-new WR/DB interactions bring true NFL physicality to every route, with realistic hand-fighting, jostling, and leverage that define separation and coverage. Win tight 50-50 moments with timing-based catching and refined contested interactions, or take command in critical situations with improved short-yardage mechanics and plays like the “Tush Push” that decide games when inches matter most. Gameplanning & Customization Own every decision before and after the snap. New gameplan adjustments let you preconfigure how your team aligns and reacts, while streamlined pre-play controls put every adjustment at your fingertips. Smarter receiver logic keeps plays alive, while advanced coverage systems and plaster logic help defenses adapt in real time giving you total control to execute your strategy on every snap. SUPERSTAR Become the greatest NFL Superstar of all time through an expanded G.O.A.T. Career Journey. Field degradation makes turf progressively tougher to play on, impacting player movement, stamina, ball security and strategy.

title: RabbitHole Island : Turn-based Vtuber Battles
description: A FREE game where you explore an island and battle vtubers in epic turn-based combat. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Story Those who follow the mouse eventually find themselves on Rabbithole Island, an island dominated by supernatural creatures. But the real danger is the pull of curiosity. Take a peek into a parallel world, a fascinating ecosystem, through the eyes of an overly curious observer. Follow along a journey of self-development, misadventure, and foolhardy ambition. Traverse through symbolic day & perpetual night, endure the soak, shock, and scorch of the elements, and slowly approach the asymptote of natural curiosity. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Gameplay -Take on a variety of boss fights against powerful vtubers -Traverse the island with a papercraft skillset and adaptability -Acquire companions to aid on your journey -Explore beyond the initial path to go deeper than anyone recommends -Follow along a silly narrative that is about as deep or nonsensical as you interpret it to be. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Navigation Navigate an island full of obstacles, hazards, and puzzles -Acquire vtuber companions, each with their own unique skillset fit for clearing obstacles, solving puzzles, and aiding in battle. -Explore multiple environments -Master your skillset -Uncover secrets -Find random bowls of rice --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Combat Face  enemy mascots, vtubers, and other creatures through turn-based combat. With each major fight tougher than the last, it'll take observation , skill , and strategy to overcome the challenges each vtuber brings to the table. -Execute attacks with action commands -Defend against enemy attacks with context-specific actions -Read attack patterns -Conditional support from companions -Strap on extra perks with wristbands (If you're feeling confident, strap on the submission wristband .) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Features 12 Vtubers to battle 30 Total enemies Original Soundtrack Wristbands Achievements Arcade mode Hard mode A sprinkle of downsilliness A miniscule amount of tomfoolery -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- More Info Rabbithole Island is a solo-project created by Missile .
