title: Plinbo: Roguelike Plinko
description: Plinbo offers a unique gaming experience that blends strategy and luck, where each run lets you choose different card and challenge combinations in a roguelike style. Each turn: Build your deck through strategic decisions. Take risks by joining challenges. Shape your experience with your choices. Fight to reach the target money. Endless Strategy and Innovation With various card and challenge combinations, every run offers a new journey and a different strategic challenge. Tarot cards that uniquely shape your experience. High-risk, turn-based challenges. Luck cards that instantly change your game. Some cards keep you standing in the early game… others shine in the late stages. Some will always be by your side. title: Cyberpunk Store Simulator
description: Cyberpunk Store Simulator puts you in the neon heart of a dystopian city, running a high-tech shop where your 3D printer and business instincts are your greatest weapons. Manufacture unique items, serve a diverse clientele, and upgrade your space to shape a massive retail empire. Manufacture Your Inventory Skip the corporate suppliers. Fire up your in-store 3D printer and produce unique, high-demand items directly from digital blueprints. Print the goods, grab them, and stock them directly onto your shelves. In this city, you build what you sell. Stock Cyberpunk Goods Fill your shop with world-specific goods: neural chips, holo-lenses, exo-gear, energy capsules, and more. Arrange your layout, set your prices, and keep up with the city's ever-changing demand. Hire Robotic Assistants Deploy robotic helpers to handle restocking, sorting, and in-store logistics. Automate the daily grind so you can focus on upgrading and growing the business. Launch Drone Deliveries Reach customers across the sprawling city. Pack the orders and send out your delivery drones to fulfill online requests fast and efficiently. Process Futuristic Payments Customers pay their way. Accept traditional cash from street-level citizens or process quick, frictionless payments using embedded cybernetic chips and holographic scanners. Explore a Living City Step outside and explore a metropolis that never powers down. Hovercars drift between towers, LED billboards flood the corners with light, and AI-driven crowds fill the streets at every hour. Expand and Upgrade Start small and reinvest your profits. Upgrade your equipment, expand your floor space, and turn a modest single-room shop into a landmark of the neon city. Build Your Cyber-Store Empire In Cyberpunk Store Simulator, the daily chaos of retail meets the high-tech reality of a dystopian world. You are fully in control of your economy. Acquire new 3D blueprints to print highly sought-after items that draw wealthier citizens. Balance your budget between purchasing raw materials for printing, upgrading your store's capacity, and maintaining your equipment. Watch out for local thieves, handle eccentric customers, and manage your reputation. Whether you are dealing with cyborgs at the register or watching your delivery drones navigate the neon-lit skyline, every shift brings a new opportunity to grow. Key Features 3D Printing Production: Manufacture unique products directly from blueprints, bypassing traditional corporate suppliers. Cyberpunk-Exclusive Goods: Sell neural chips, exo-gear, holo-lenses, energy capsules, and more. Robotic Assistants: Deploy robots to handle restocking, sorting, and in-store operations. Drone Delivery System: Send orders across the city via automated delivery drones. Dynamic Payments: Accept both physical cash and futuristic embedded chip payments. title: Forbidden Terror: Board Game
description: Forbidden Terror is an episodic psychological horror game where each episode unravels a different horror tale. Forbidden Terror: Board Game In the first episode of Forbidden Terror, you take the role of Jonah, an 18 year old living with his parents. Jonah and his parents moved into a new house that they acquired for a very low price after a family was brutally murdered there and no one else was willing to live in it. Jonah and his best friend Emily, who is a huge fan of horror films, discover an Ouija Board at their local convenience store and bring it home for fun. They had no idea it was more than a simple board game. Gameplay The game is designed to fully immerse you in the story of the narrator. It is primarily an atmospheric, psychological horror, first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration and conversation mechanics. It features photo-realistic graphics, immersive environmental design and a cinematic aesthetic.

title: Esports Manager 2026 Demo
description: PLAY THE DEMO About the Demo Welcome to Esports Manager 2026 , a strategy-simulation game where you take charge of a competitive esports organization from the inside out Start from scratch or take over one of the existing teams. Navigate the complexities of player recruitment, team development, tournament schedules, and business operations. Whether you're optimizing training, making key transfer decisions, or managing the mental health and motivation of your roster, every move counts toward your legacy. There’s no scripted campaign or forced ending—your journey continues as long as your manager stays active. Grow, adapt, and lead your team to the top. Simulation Mode Step into the match yourself with the Simulation module—an immersive, highly detailed experience where you control tactics and react to dynamic in-game events in real time. Realism and Depth Inspired by the real-world challenges of esports management—balancing financial, psychological, legal, and organizational responsibilities with no hand-holding. Real Organizations, Real Players Choose from a wide range of authentic teams and manage a roster filled with real professional players. Build your lineup your way. Player Market and Transfers Buy, sell, and loan players to create the best roster for your goals. Market dynamics, contract negotiations, and timing all matter. Player Development and Morale Design weekly training plans that target both skill growth and well-being. description: Build and manage your ultimate retro arcade! Buy classic Arcade Machines, Galaxy Pinball, and Gift Claw games, or invest in Cinema 8D, Go-Karts, and Racing Simulators. Manage the economy, hire staff, and keep every machine running! Build Your Arcade Empire Step into the neon-lit world of the past and build the ultimate entertainment center in Retro Arcade Shop Simulator. Start with a humble, dusty venue and gradually transform it into a booming, large-scale arcade business. Buy nostalgic arcade cabinets, organize your floor plan to maximize customer flow, and watch the tokens roll in. Whether you want to recreate a cozy 80s hangout spot or build a massive, multi-room gaming paradise, you have the tools to bring your retro tycoon dreams to life. Manage a Growing Business Growing your business takes more than plugging in a few machines. You’ll need to manage a token economy across four different currencies, watch your hourly income, and take out bank loans to fund your expansions. Unlock up to 10 unique rooms and fill them with a variety of attractions. Offer your customers classic Air Hockey, Pinball, and Whack-A-Mole, or invest in high-end Plane Simulators, Bowling Alleys, Go-Kart tracks, and immersive 8D Cinemas. When crowds get overwhelming, hire cashiers, cafeteria workers, and token collectors so no customer ever waits in line. Customize Your Neon Haven Make the arcade truly yours with deep interior customization. Choose from dozens of wall and floor textures, add vibrant graffiti murals, and set the perfect mood with neon lighting, signs, and decorative plants. Keep Every Machine Running Heavy use takes its toll. Cabinets break down, screens go dark, and a dead machine is a machine that isn't making you money. Service and repair your hardware, mop the floors, empty the token boxes, and keep the whole venue in working order. Blend relaxing business progression with an unforgettable nostalgic atmosphere and become the ultimate arcade tycoon! Key Features Build Your Arcade Empire Expand from a small shop into a massive entertainment center by unlocking 10 distinct rooms. Over 25 Unique Machines & Attractions Build your dream venue with 28 distinct types of entertainment, ranging from classic Arcade Cabinets, Pinball, and Whack-A-Mole to high-end Plane Simulators, Go-Karts, and 8D Cinemas Service & Repair Machines wear down with use. Keep them serviced and repaired, mop the floors, and collect the tokens to keep your arcade profitable. Deep Economy Management Navigate a complex financial system with 4 token types, hourly income tracking, and multi-tier bank loans. Automate with Staff Hire and manage cashiers, cafeteria workers, repairmen, cleaners, and token collectors to keep your business running smoothly. title: Element TD 3 - Tower Defense
description: Element TD was originally released in 2005 on WarCraft 3. Across the subsequent versions on StarCraft 2, Dota 2, Android/iOS, and Element TD 2 we've always aimed to add new things but stay true to the feel of the original. With the addition of heroes, Element TD 3 represents the capstone of the series. Elements Assemble You have six elements to combine that create 47 towers each with a unique ability. Because your towers are tied to your elements and their level, the choice you face is unlocking more types of towers versus higher levels for your existing ones. If you choose the latter and max out a tower, you unlock specializations for it. These allow you to change the nature and role of the tower. Each element has its own strengths and weaknesses, so your choosing the right upgrade paths is crucial to winning. It's not just which towers you unlock and how far you upgrade them, what order you do it in matters too. The rock-paper-scissors nature of elemental damage means that you need a variety of towers to adapt and survive. This is a game with an abundance of options for winning. Heroes Arrive Your Builder returns in Element TD 3 with a brand-new role: Hero. A longtime staple of the series, your Builder now enters the fray as a fully playable Hero for you. Stepping out from behind the construction hammer, your builder now wields new attacks, spell casts, and accumulated passives. Choose between 12 Heroes with each wielding unique attacks and abilities. You also have a randomized additional pool of 60 spells tied to the elements to select from. As you gain and upgrade elements, you gain and upgrade spells for your hero from this pool. The end result is many different ways to play each hero. Don't want to micromanage your spells? Stick them on smart autocast! Let your Hero cast spells on its own with optimal timing based on the situation. Dynamic Battlefield Every few waves the global weather randomly changes. It brings elemental boosts that you can synergize with. It also brings a unique elemental boss. The creep wave order is also random. Together they allow for a true endless end game with variety. No two games play the same! Cooperate to Survive Play with up to 8 players to synergize your elemental choices, tower placements, and hero usage. Each of the 8 co-op maps has a recurring unique scenario that encourages your team to come together to overcome the challenge. Leaderboards allow you to see how your team stacks up to others. Battle or Go Solo There is also a ruthless game of survival for you to play. Try to outlast your opponents in the long run by turtling for income or go in hard and fast to rush them to their death. There are 10 free-for-all maps to compete on. Solo leaderboard play allows you to compete in singleplayer. Features 47 Towers with unique abilities created through multiple elemental upgrade paths. 12 Heroes with distinct active and passive abilities. 60 elemental spells to select from. 6 Elements to empower your towers to create powerful diverse defenses. 10 Free-For-All and 8 Co-op maps to test your tactics on diverse layouts. Co-op mode lets up to 8 players team up at once. Leaderboards to compete against other players for top score. Replay support to showcase your victories and learn strategies from others.

title: SpaceSim - Astrophysical Simulation Software
description: SpaceSim is a particle-based simulation and rendering software, primarily focused on astrophysical applications. Important! This is a non-realtime simulator. Although low-resolution simulations are fast enough to be real-time, simulations with millions of particles can take several hours to finish. This is not a game . It does not contain any game mechanics, progression, sandbox elements, etc. Please do not expect any gaming experience. The goal of the project is to "de-mystify" scientific simulations and make them accessible to the general public. SpaceSim uses the same approach (albeit simplified and at lower resolution) as the research simulations typically run on supercomputers, but it can run on your desktop PC or laptop, comes with an intuitive user interface, and requires no extensive knowledge of mathematics, physics, or programming. You can recreate some of the well-known simulations from the scientific literature, such as the Moon-forming impact, the formation of the ring system of Saturn, or the DART kinetic impactor. Or you can simply explore various initial conditions, both grounded and realistic, but also hypothetical "what-if" scenarios, such as the collision of two planets made of matter and anti-matter. Fluid dynamics and gravitation Each deformable object in the simulation is discretized into particles that interact with each other through collisions (by solving the Navier-Stokes equations) and gravitational attraction. Objects can also be rigid (non-deformable) - they retain their shape, which simplifies collisions between objects and optimizes simulation speed. The particle-based solver is useful for simulating a number of astrophysical events, such as the formation of planets from protoplanetary disks or the mutual interaction of galaxies. Object customization The application has a number of object types - planets, stars, asteroids, disks, clouds, galaxies, and more. Each object has adjustable parameters that allow you to change its geometry, materials, appearance, and simulation behavior. The surface textures of planets and asteroids can be further tailored using procedural generation or by uploading custom images. Or, if you need even more control, create your own objects using the Lua scripting language. Black holes (and white holes) The renderer includes the effect of gravitational lensing, bending the light rays that pass close to a black hole and creating realistic renderings of warped accretion disks, duplicated images of objects behind black holes (including other black holes) or Einstein rings of galaxies. Particle colors and gravity visualization SpaceSim provides additional insights into the simulation in a number of ways. It can color particles based on values of a specific quantity (velocity, pressure, material, ...), show the Roche limit indicating where satellites can have stable orbits, or draw the potential field to see the gravity wells around celestial bodies. Key features: CPU and GPU simulation solver Optimized gravity simulation using the Barnes-Hut algorithm Simulation history - store the entire simulation and replay it later Two render engines - Real-time or Raymarcher Customizable camera paths with object tracking Lua scripting for custom objects and simulation systems Built-in video recording (H.264 codec) and various export options (Alembic, OpenVDB)

Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole. Battle Your Friends Hit your friends with your ball. Ram them down with a golf cart. description: Combolands is a tiny roguelike citybuilder offering deep strategy in a bite-sized package! title: GAARL! - Gabe's Action Arcade RogueLike
description: GABE'S ACTION ARCADE ROGUELIKE! GAARL! is a difficult roguelike action platformer for 1–4 players. Wield your chain gun to fight monsters, or fire it into walls to climb through dank dungeons, sterile suburbs, and beyond. Buy upgrades, get good health insurance, and unlock the mysteries of GABE'S ACTION ARCADE ROGUELIKE! Simple Mechanics Your only tool is a chain gun: shoot it at enemies to deal damage, aim it at anything else to deploy a climbable chain. Retrieve your chains, and manage your ammo carefully. High Skill Ceiling Learn the enemies and environments, and manage your positioning carefully. Engage with a powerful perk system that offers qualitative changes to the way that you play. Hire private security, wield magical swords, release predatory lady bugs, cover your body in spikes, drink the blood of your foes! Features Tough as nails arcade action with permadeath 100+ handcrafted levels 5+ distinct zones featuring unique enemies, challenges, and environmental hazards 50+ game warping perks Local co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players 5 unlockable weapons of dubious usefulness 10 unlockable characters with unique traits Super secret, fully procedural, "chaos" mode Your time is your own! All meta progression content can be unlocked at any time Supports Low% play - no grinding or incremental stat increases!

title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27
description: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Editions EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Edition EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Edition includes: 6,000 FC Points over 3 months†† Additional FUT™ Player Evo slot Career content: 3 ICONs/Heroes 5-Star Senior Scout in Manager Career 5-Star Coach available for hire in Manager Career 5-Star Youth Scout available for hire in Manager Career 5 Manager Live Challenge Creation Slots The Grounds content: The Grounds Signature Sweatsuit Tier 3 Amp inspired by Mbappe 2 Double AXP for 10 Matches Consumables †† You must complete the steps to obtain the initial FC Points distribution by August 1, 2027 to receive all 6,000 FC Points. If you redeem after September 26, 2027, you will not receive any FC Points. About the Game This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

title: GOAT FPS
description: GOAT FPS is a fast paced, old school first-person shooter inspired by the classics from the 90s. You know the ones! That means big, open, hand crafted levels where there is no straight path to the exit. You'll have to explore every corner to find resources that will help you survive. If you've got a keen eye you might even find a secret or two. Being a game made entirely by a young overly ambitious Swede, this game is a short, but replayable experience. There's 4 different difficulty levels to choose between, lots of secrets to find and an in-game speedrun timer. FEATURES 5 levels 5 large, complex and unique levels to explore. All with secrets, items and different paths to take. 4 difficulties Harder difficulty levels will not only make enemies more dangerous, but will also make ammo pickups give you less ammo. This will force you to play more carefully and thoughtfully. You will have to make the most out of every resource, choose what battles to pick and make sure you find as many pickups as possible. The hardest difficulty "Brutal" is for the real ones ONLY! 5 usable power-ups Health herb A healing item that becomes more potent depending on how many you use at once. Armor Grants temporary invulnerability when used. Jetpack Grants the ability to fly for a very limited time. Can be used to access places previously inaccessible. Sentry A small portable turret gun that fires at enemies. Will explode when shot. Anti-toxic shoes Allows you to walk on hazardous materials. Physics objects Objects that can be picked up and kicked. Use them as shields or jump on them.

title: Universe Exploration
description: Universe Exploration is a text-based space idle game that blends incremental progression with strategic depth. Starting from the Solar System, players gather resources, build machines, research technologies, and gradually expand their territory—advancing from humble extraction to large-scale interstellar warfare. The early content draws inspiration from Sparticle999 ’s classic Space Company , but has been fully rebuilt and redesigned. The mobile interface is optimised for smaller screens and touch input, delivering a smooth and intuitive experience. Beyond its familiar beginnings, the game expands massively in the mid- and late-game—introducing advanced machines, interstellar fleets, artifact systems, and long-term progression mechanics that carry your journey from the Solar System to the far stars. Key Features: A complete tech tree spanning from primitive gathering to advanced production. Customisable fleet system with flexible tactical compositions. Powerful artifacts and cosmic wonders blending strategy and exploration. Carefully designed mobile UI with touch-optimised controls. Deep automation and long-term growth systems supporting endless expansion into the cosmos.

title: Sports Card Shop Simulator
description: Roadmap About the Game Welcome to Sports Card Shop Simulator ! Open packs, search for rare cards, and build the best sports card shop. Hunt for holos, autos, and numbered variants to satisfy your collection obsession. Design custom cards and enjoy the thrill of pulling those creations from a fresh pack! 📦Welcome to the Cardboard Empire Welcome to Sports Card Shop Simulator, where the smell of fresh packs and cardboard dreams fills the air. Run a growing card shop that mixes the love of collecting with modern business gameplay. Buy, sell, grade, trade, customize, and auction sports cards in a lively, changing market. Turn a small shop into the perfect place for collectors. ⚽Kick Off the Collection Begin the season with the world’s most popular sport: football! Collect players from over 50 national teams as they compete to win the CUP! Enjoy the excitement of the game as you open cards revealing unforgettable tournament moments. 🏆The Ultimate Chase Fill binders with a huge variety of cards. With over 4,000 different cards to find, finishing your collection will be a challenge! Enjoy a detailed rarity system with real chances of pulling special cards. Every pack could contain a common card, a shiny chrome one, a rare signed edition, or a numbered card where small print runs mean big value. Join bidding and auctions to compete for the most valuable cards. See the card market change based on shop actions, gameplay, and tournaments. ✨Design and Pull Custom Cards Try the game’s most special feature: create custom sports cards. These cards don’t just stay in a design tool; they become part of the game’s card collection, so players can find their own designs in packs as they play. Create your personal "dream pulls," share your cards, and make every pack-opening truly special. 🔍Grade Like a Professional Got a big find? Use a magnifying glass to check it carefully. Look for scratches or rough edges before sending it for grading. If it looks perfect, get it graded and aim for the top Gem Mint 10 to earn the most money. But miss a small flaw, and that value can vanish. 💼Build the Dream Local Card Shop Starting from a tiny shop, run your growing business with full control over upgrades, expansions, and shop decorations. When you need a break from the counter, go outside and play street sports mini-games to earn more experience! Enjoy a fun, easygoing gameplay loop made for both casual and serious players. 🎯Key Game Features 4000+ card variants from more than 50 national teams to collect, trade, and grade. Deep rarity system with authentic pull-rate odds. A bidding and auction system for competing over high-value cards. The dynamic card market reacts to your playthroughs, tournaments, and shop activity. Card grading and inspection mini-games that challenge your attention to detail. Create your own custom cards , which can even appear in future card packs. Full shop management , including upgrades, expansions, and cosmetic customization. Street sports mini-games that let players earn additional cards. Relaxing, collector-friendly gameplay loop designed for casual and dedicated players alike.

title: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
description: Roadmap About the Game Serve drinks while your bar falls apart. Barfender is a chaotic co-op bar sim where fights break out, drinks spill, and you’re still trying to keep orders moving. Customers get drunk, impatient, and start fights Orders pile up faster than you can handle Glasses shatter and the mess keeps spreading Unwanted guests wander in, thieves grab what they can Serve drinks, clean disasters, stop fights, and hold the bar together before it completely collapses. Serve Under Pressure Pour beers, shake cocktails, fake a smile, and mop up puke while the night spirals out of control. Online Co-op Chaos Serve customers together with friends. Maybe don’t smash a beer mug into your teammate’s face… or do! Problematic Customers Polite regulars, rowdy drunks, hopeless romantics, bar brawlers. Everyone here has a personality. Design The Bar Which You'll Probably Ruin Later Style your bar to perfection. Then pray the crowd doesn’t tear it apart. Unlock Drinks, Tools, and Upgrades Craft better drinks. Expand the bar. Lead your crew from a scrappy old bar to a thriving nightlife empire. Bar Games and Activities Blow off steam with darts, pool, retro arcade machines, and a wild rodeo bull. Booze and Bad Decisions Keep tempers down before it turns into a full-blown bar fight... or your wallet pays the price.

title: PowerWash Simulator 2 - Adventure Time Pack
description: ADVENTURE TIME! All of the sudsy satisfaction of PowerWash Simulator with the wit and whimsy of Adventure Time, rolled into one. Finn and Jake’s stomping ground is totally jacked up, and it’s down to you to save the day, like a real hero. Who wants to play video games?! Wash and explore five new levels from the Land of Ooo: the Tree House Living Room, Pizza Sassy’s, Ice King’s Castle, Candy Vehicles and the Tree House exterior! Don’t worry, everything stays right where you left it, but just a little bit cleaner. Homies help homies, always. So, brave the filth solo, grab your BFF to clean through the campaign together, or grab your 4-man band to shred schmutz in free-play. You’re a cleaning glob! Wishlist Now!

title: Heyoo 3D Platformer
description: Heyoo! The sky has lost its music On the morning of the Festival of Bells, a grumpy storm carried off all 46 Heyoo Bells and the village Tintins faded one by one. Only Heyoo, who carries a note inside that never goes out, can bring them back. A classic 3D platformer made to be enjoyed Moves that feel great: spinning double jump, air dash, roll and long jump, ground pound and super jump, wall jump and stomps. Six worlds with their own ideas: drum shells on Coral Coast, updrafts and an echo puzzle in Windy Canyon, platforms that move to the beat of the music in Tick-Tock Factory, ice and ski jumps on Snowy Peak... The village is home: every bell wakes up a neighbor, opens new gates and fills the village with music. A final boss with a heart: King Grumble doesn't hate music... he just wanted someone to listen. New: “Chained to the Sky” multiplayer 1 to 4 friends tied together with a musical rope climb a spiral tower to the Sky Bell. If one falls, they hang from the others… or drag them down too. A different tower every game: ten sections with the look and music of one of the six worlds, getting harder as you climb: gaps you can only cross by jumping together, gusts of wind, spikes, vanishing blocks, conveyor belts and lifts. Easy to play with friends: invite them through Steam, no port forwarding, and talk with proximity voice chat (or push to talk). Explore at your own pace 46 bells: in every world, the goal bell, the 5 golden notes bell, a hidden bell, the 3 lost Tintins bell, the purple note race bell, the rift challenge bell and the chorus bell (collect most of the notes in one go); plus 4 more in the village. 18 lost Tintins to rescue: they head home and fill the village square with life. A wardrobe with 91 items: skins with animated patterns (galaxy, aurora, marble, runes...), hats, accessories and trails in four rarities. Many can be bought with the notes you collect; the legendary skins can only be earned through great feats. A progress screen with statistics, time, note and race records for every island, and 19 achievements with their rewards. Assist mode with double hearts for a more relaxed adventure. Photo mode with a free camera and filters to capture your best moments. Made with care An original soundtrack for every world, and a village song that grows as you recover bells. Opening and ending cutscenes. Text in English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, French, German and Italian. Controller support (Xbox and similar) or keyboard and mouse, with fully rebindable controls. Accessibility: color-blind filter, interface size, reduced flashes and optional screen shake. Autosave in 3 save slots, with a backup copy.

title: Funny Park Reawakening
description: Funny Park is a first-person narrative psychological horror game, focused on exploration, atmosphere, and the gradual discovery of a disturbing story. STORY It is set in an early 2000s children’s amusement park, seemingly abandoned. A place that was extremely popular at the dawn of the new millennium—until something happened, and everything changed forever… something the park never truly recovered from. Taking the role of a teenage child, you somehow find yourself in the lowest levels of Funny Park in search of Something. Trapped beneath the park, your only path forward is to keep moving, uncover the secrets that led you there, and find a way back to the surface. But do you really think it will be that easy? Things lurking in the shadows will never stop stalking you. The path ahead is filled with torment, meant to toy with your mind and blur your perception. Who are you? What do you want? What are you searching for? Emotions will, somehow, take on a greater role the further you progress. Shadows of the past that never sleep… and are always looking for a way to reach you. FEATURES Atmospheric exploration, where every area hides important details about what happened in Funny Park. Environmental puzzles that require observation, memory, and attention to your surroundings to progress. Tense chases against the Strange Inhabitants, forcing you to run, hide, or make quick decisions. Environmental storytelling, delivered through scenery, sound, objects, and subtle events—without direct explanations. Psychological horror experience, focused on constant tension, discomfort, and emotional impact. The higher you climb, the closer you get to the truth… but there are shadows that do not want you to see the Light. Will you be able to escape the terror lurking in the depths—and discover why you are there?

title: Violent Nature
description: Violent Nature is an open world survival horror game set in a small town after an interdimensional invasion. Manage your overall health and resources, explore, and improve your gear as you push back the spread of an infectous growth. Status management Maintain your overall health by keeping yourself fed and hydrated. Strength can be replenished by sleeping. Keep infection down by dodging attacks from infected enemies, avoiding vines, and finding medicine. Inventory Management What you can carry depends on the quality of your backpack and clothing. Carry weight adds up quick and will slow you down. Keep up strength to better manage large carry weights. Noise Use stealth to avoid confrontation. Crouch to reduce noise. Gun shots and other loud noises will attract large groups of enemies. Crafting Build structures to aid survival such as a campfire or rain catcher. Combine items to create useful tools such as bandages and Molotovs. Vision Enemies and the environment are obscured when not in the players cone of vision. When exploring enclosed spaces line of sight is limited. Enemies can sneak up at any moment. Character Customization Customize your character by adjusting the body shape and selecting from sets of hair and colors. Equipped clothing and items appear on your character.

title: Wall World Strategy
description: The Wall is a colossal structure stretching far beyond the visible horizon, hiding traces of ancient eras and unexplained phenomena within its depths. Here, among stone, metal, and darkness, humanity has been forced to build a new life – clinging to the Wall and trying to survive in a world full of threats and mysteries. Wall World Strategy is a colony sim on a sheer vertical surface, where every decision affects the stability of the system. Build and expand your base, gather resources, take care of your people, strengthen your defenses, and send expeditions into distant regions and unexplored depths. Each new step forward brings not only opportunities for growth but also new dangers. Survival depends on your foresight, your ability to manage limited resources, and your willingness to make difficult decisions. BUILD AND EXPAND THE COLONY Establish a base on the surface of the Endless Wall and gradually turn a small outpost into a large, stable, and well-defended colony. Plan the placement of key structures, develop production chains, expand living areas, and build infrastructure capable of supporting both population growth and stable operations. As your colony grows, you will need to decide how to expand, which structures to prioritize, and where to allocate resources – whether into production, housing, or defense. WITHSTAND THE THREATS The Wall is far from lifeless. In its shadows lurk zyrexes – dangerous creatures that will attack your colony again and again, testing its defenses, organization, and your ability to respond. Strengthen your defenses, secure vulnerable areas, and decide how much you can afford to invest in protection. Additional pressure comes from emergency events such as accidents, disasters, and environmental hazards. They won't destroy your colony instantly, but they will disrupt its operations and trigger cascading problems. MANAGE YOUR SOCIETY Your colony is, above all, made up of people – living, working, hoping for the future, and depending on your decisions. Monitor their condition and take into account how they react to your choices. Overpopulation, food shortages, or supply disruptions can quickly lead to declining efficiency, crisis, and riots. Caring for your people is a core part of the strategy. The state of your population determines the performance of the entire colony – its productivity and its ability to endure prolonged periods of danger. A strong and well-supported society recovers faster from attacks and moves forward with greater confidence. GATHER RESOURCES AND ADVANCE Start with basic resource extraction and gradually build a more complex economy. Explore the depths of the Wall, search for stable resource deposits, and develop the infrastructure needed to use them efficiently. Technological progress allows you to improve core systems and unlock new possibilities. Enhance resource gathering and processing, reduce costs, increase efficiency, and strengthen your colony against external threats. Some technologies accelerate infrastructure development, others improve defense, automate key processes, or expand your ability to explore new areas of the Wall. SEND OUT EXPEDITIONS To explore beyond your colony, deploy robo-spiders – specialized machines designed for scouting, resource extraction, and operations in remote areas. Send them into uncharted sectors of the Wall to expand your reach, gather resources, uncover rare discoveries, and explore areas that are too dangerous or inaccessible for humans. However, distant regions bring not only opportunities but also risks. Expeditions may encounter hostile environments, unstable terrain, unknown lifeforms, or remnants of ancient machinery whose purpose has long been forgotten. Prepare your equipment, assess the risks, and decide how far you're willing to go. EXPLORE THE DEPTHS OF THE WALL The Wall is more than just the surface your colony clings to. Beneath it lies an entire world filled with resources, forgotten technologies, and rare artifacts. Extract valuable materials, recover technological samples that can accelerate your development, and uncover unique objects that help you understand this world. As you explore, you will begin to find answers – but each discovery raises new questions about the nature of the Wall and why it became humanity's last refuge. PLAY BY YOUR OWN RULES Develop your colony in Sandbox Mode without story constraints or time pressure. Choose from different maps and difficulty levels, tailor the conditions to your liking, and keep playing for as long as you want. Zyrexes will still attack, but you can play at your own pace and experiment with different development and defense strategies.

title: Brawl Arena Shooter
description: Brawl Arena Shooter is a fast-paced online arena shooter where cute animals unleash ridiculous firepower across tight, colorful battlegrounds. Dash through bushes, dodge incoming bullets, and outplay waves of opponents in chaotic Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch battles. Jump into a lobby on your own, fill it with bots, or fight against real players — each match can host a large crowd of competitors at once. Rounds are short, explosive, and easy to pick up, but surviving the constant crossfire of bullets and power-ups takes real skill. Earn XP from every takedown and climb through the progression system, then use the coins and gems you collect to unlock stronger heroes. Each character comes with its own balance of health, armor, attack power, and movement speed, making your choice of animal just as impactful as your aim. Use the in-game chat to coordinate with teammates or taunt rivals, dominate the global leaderboard with your lifetime kill count, and prove who truly rules the arena. Key Features Large-Scale Online Battles: Dive into hectic Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch rounds packed with both real players and bots. A Roster of Unique Animal Heroes: Begin with a starter hero and unlock many more using in-game earnings. Every character features distinct health, armor, attack, and speed attributes. Hero-Focused Combat: Pick from a variety of weapon designs — purely cosmetic — while the real strength comes from your hero’s stats and your tactical movement on the battlefield. Power-Ups Scattered Across the Map: Collect health boosts, damage enhancers, and speed pickups to shift the momentum of any fight. Multiple Distinct Arenas: Master every pathway, choke point, and hiding spot across the available maps, from open firefights to bushy ambush zones. Continuous Progression: Level up through consistent XP gains and unlock new heroes using coins and gems earned in matches. Global Kill Leaderboard: Your cumulative eliminations contribute to a worldwide ranking — climb the board and cement your legacy. Casual, Colorful, Always Online: Cartoon visuals, quick rounds, and simple controls make the game accessible for everyone, while constant action keeps every match engaging.

title: Just a Simple Turn-Based RPG
description: This is a turn-based RPG made for players who no longer have time (or patience) for endless grinding or for trying to understand overcomplicated plots about a group of students trying to save their rural city from a evil multiversal being. You’re just an adventurer looking for treasure. No twists. No world-ending stakes. That’s it. Features: Pixel art graphics , just like the good old days. A short adventure , because your treasure isn’t always waiting in the next castle. Every turn matters: you control only one character, so every action counts. Cast spells through enchantments: miss the input and… well, something will happen. Combos: create your combo sequences but pay attention to dont miss! Parry: You can parry special attacks but you got only one chance. At the end of the day… This is Just a Simple Turn-Based RPG .

title: Gore In Crayon
description: Don't stay up too late. Mamma likes to drink… a lot . Piece together a harrowing narrative told without words in this short 2D pixel survival horror. FEATURES Compelling and terrifying story A cute little horrible game of cat and mouse Gruesome game overs Multiple endings (Yeah, okay, you got me, there’s only two) Approximately thirty minutes of gameplay Short grind core song “Gore In Crayon OST” written and performed by Bad Plan

title: Competitive TicTacToe
description: Roadmap About the Game You think you know Tic-Tac-Toe, right? Everyone does. It’s a simple game... or so we thought. We took the classic 3x3 grid and added one game-changing rule: When the board is full, your oldest piece disappears. This single twist turns that "solved" game into a mind-bending strategy puzzle where every move counts. No more draws. No more boring stalemates. Every match has a winner. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT? Picture this: You’ve lined up three marks. Victory seems certain. But wait—your very first piece vanishes, and suddenly your opponent has the winning line. That is Upgraded TicTacToe . You can’t just think about the next move; you have to think 3 or 4 moves ahead. You need to remember which piece is fading out next. It’s Chess-level thinking on a Tic-Tac-Toe scale. COMPETITIVE PLAY Ranked Matches: Play for glory and climb the ELO ladder. Start at 1000 points and work your way up. Every win counts, every loss teaches you a lesson. Casual Mode: Want to relax? Play casual matches to practice without the stress of losing rank. Global Leaderboards: See where you stand against thousands of players battling for the top spot. FEATURES 🚀 Lightning-Fast Matchmaking: Usually finds a game in under 10 seconds. 💬 Express Yourself: In-game chat with quick emojis. 📊 Deep Stats: Track your Wins, Losses, ELO, and Match History. 🤝 Play with Friends: Invite your Steam friends directly to a lobby. ⏱️ Quick Sessions: Matches take just 2-5 minutes. Perfect for a quick break. 🎵 Vibe: Clean, modern interface with non-intrusive background music. WHY DID WE MAKE THIS? Honestly? We were sick of Tic-Tac-Toe always ending in a draw. If you play against someone who knows what they're doing, the game is broken. We asked: "What if the pieces didn't stay forever?" It turns out, that simple change fixes the entire game. No draws. Ever. Just pure strategy. WHO IS THIS FOR? If you love quick strategy games. If you love the grind of climbing a ranked ladder. If you want something that is "easy to learn, hard to master." THE BOTTOM LINE It’s Tic-Tac-Toe, but actually good. No draws, no RNG (luck), no pay-to-win nonsense. Just you and another player on a 3x3 grid. Simple concept. Deep strategy. Can you make it to the top of the leaderboard?

title: Inferno Loot: Bullet Hell Bound
description: Inferno Loot: Bullet Hell Bound is a high-octane, top-down action roguelike where every run is a desperate struggle for survival against the legions of hell. Dive into a dark, pixel-art world where your skill, your weapons, and your luck are the only things standing between you and eternal oblivion. Master the Bullet Hell Face overwhelming waves of enemies in intense, fast-paced combat. Navigate through a chaotic storm of projectiles while unleashing your own devastating arsenal. Every second counts, and one wrong move could be your last. Loot, Equip, and Evolve As you fight through the inferno, discover a vast array of weapons and gear. From rapid-fire submachine guns to mystical scythes, customize your loadout to suit your playstyle. Level up during your run to increase your health, armor, and power, turning your character into an unstoppable force of destruction. No Two Runs Are Alike Embrace the challenge of perma-death . Every time you fall, you rise again stronger, learning from your mistakes. With procedural elements and a wide variety of loot combinations, every attempt offers a fresh experience and new tactical possibilities. Key Features: Intense Roguelike Action: Fight, die, and repeat in a satisfying loop of progression. Deep Loot System: Find and equip powerful weapons like the AK47, M16, and mystical artifacts. Character Progression: Level up your stats mid-run to survive the escalating difficulty. Retro Pixel Aesthetics: Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted dark fantasy world with vibrant visual effects. Score Attack: Push your skills to the limit and aim for the highest score in the leaderboards.

title: Gods & Gore
description: GODS & GORE A roguelite tower defense game set in Greek mythology. Pick your god, collect mythological creatures, and defend you city. Expand each round to grow your defenses, powers, and combos to stop increasingly strong enemies. COMMAND Collect mythological creatures that persist between runs. Zeus' golden eagle and minotaur. Level them up so they grow stronger with every attempt. FREE BUILD Place your defenses and strategically build a deadly path for your enemies. Position matters: create chokepoints, stack upgrades, and turn your city into a fortress. Each wave, draft powerful building cards. Towers, barracks, walls, boosters - all have different strengths. VARIETY Artifacts, different map layouts, and randomized cards means no two runs are identical and you must adapt to the challenge with the hand you are dealt. Features: Card-based building system with infinite stacking upgrades Creature collection and power progression across runs Multiple gods with unique abilities Waves that scale until you die

title: Last Pirates: Die Together
description: Roadmap About the Game Last Pirates: Die Together is an online co-op horror experience filled with chaos, monsters, and LOTS OF BOOTY! You and your crew will use your unusually stretchy arms to gather as much loot as you can for your captain. Be mindful of your surroundings though. There are others who mean to keep the treasure for themselves. You land lubbers aren’t that tough! You and up to three of your closest mates will work together, communicate, and survive as you try to make your ol’ captain rich and happy! You are quite an unusual sailor! I bet you can grab just about anything with those pairs of hands. Dismantle doors, grab furniture, or destroy the island for all I care! Just bring that money back aboard or the captain will have our head! Remember, scallywags, you are here for gold! Collect all the booties (and protect your own!), shake things down, and don’t come out empty-handed or no-legged. Feel the adventurous drive push you deeper into the mysterious island, but make sure that at least one of you lives to carry out the gold. Make it back to the ship in one piece, would ya? Avoid all the dangers that the island has in store for you. Play the hero or hide somewhere if you find yourself in a pickle. Or maybe one of your crewmembers can provide a distraction… I’m sure they’ll be fine, trust us! Don’t be afraid to look at Davey Jones’ Locker. We all die anyway, so why not create an adventure worth remembering? Grab your crew, grab some booty, and make a story worth telling those bilge rats outside!

title: Substance 3D Painter 2026
description: Adobe Substance 3D Painter is the reference texturing app for 3D professionals and enthusiasts. From AAA Game Developers to Indies, from Feature Animation to Visual Effects studios, the industry uses Painter to bring their creations to life thanks to its unparalleled speed, flexibility and visual quality. Substance 3D Painter adapts to you, no matter your skill level Use Smart materials and have textures wrap onto your objects automatically, throw particles to easily add weathering effects with the help of the integrated physics engine or paint precise micro-details across complex asset spanning over dozens of textures sets or UDIMs. Texture assets for any game engine or renderer Substance 3D Painter is compatible with Unity, Unreal, Godot, VRay, Redshift, Renderman... No matter what your final platform is, Painter can convert your textures into the right format and give you results as close as can be from what you see in the viewport. Welcome to the community The Substance 3D community is made of some of the most helpful and talented artists in the world! Have a question or need some guidance? Join us on Discord or on our official forums, there is always someone ready to help. If you access Substance 3D Painter through the Substance 3D Indie subscription , you will always get access to the very latest version as long as your subscription is active. If you purchase the Standalone perpetual version , you will  get free feature updates until March 2027. After that date, you will get to keep this version like any other game or software you buy on Steam. Unmetered access to the Substance 3D Assets platform and generative AI features are only available through Adobe and are not included in the Steam version.

title: Complete Horror
description: Story Overview You wake up alone in an abandoned subway station. No memories. No signal. No way out. Something is very wrong here. The staff... they're still moving. Wandering endlessly in the dark. Something worse waits deeper down — twisted things that were never human. Every step reveals more questions. Every answer brings you closer to the truth. This disaster was no accident. And your awakening... was no coincidence. Third-Person Female Protagonist Play as a third-person female protagonist equipped with firearms and customizable outfits. As exploration progresses, players can obtain new weapons and clothing to survive increasingly dangerous areas. The combat system features rich animations, including execution moves, melee combat, and ranged gunplay. Core Gameplay Escape before your sanity completely collapses. Exploration and survival are equally important. The subway station is composed of multiple interconnected areas. Players must explore under limited time and resources, searching for key items and routes to progress. Environmental Storytelling The game does not directly explain the full story. Instead, players piece together the truth through environmental details, documents, and changes within the world. Puzzle Design Interconnected Environmental Puzzles Each area features puzzles tightly integrated with the environment, guiding players deeper into different sections of the subway. Danger During Problem-Solving Enemies and environmental threats may appear at any time while solving puzzles, keeping tension constant. Combat and Survival System Resource-Driven Combat Ammunition and healing items are scarce, forcing players to carefully choose between fighting and evasion. Enemy Variety The game features both zombies and special mutated creatures. Each enemy type has unique behaviors and weaknesses, requiring different strategies to overcome. The three developers are: Hesazin, Vocalmxj, and Vocalcxs.

title: Difficult Drivers
description: Drive with a friend in Difficult Drivers Share accelerating and steering controls with everything demanding teamwork. Time throttling, tapping brakes, calling turns, and threading narrow paths without getting knocked off. Dodge obstacles, recover from mistakes, and keep pushing toward the summit. Communication is key To succeed , you will have to work together... but that can be difficult when things get heated Keep your cool and try not to get too upset with your driving partner when they forget to brake — or turn left instead of right. Split Controls (and Role Swaps) The game is built around coordination , whether you’re communicating constantly or swapping roles to handle different challenges. Trade responsibility and adapt to a multitude of timings and precision. Car Physics The car isn't just a prop; It has its own physics simulations that can make for some dramatic (and wacky) fails and saves. Solo or Co-op If you work better alone, play solo, where you manage both inputs.

title: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim
description: In a towering space station split by wealth and corruption, your business runs on merchandise with flexible origins. You’re a former scavenger who secured a storefront thanks to a generous loan and questionable timing. Now rent is rising, factions are watching, and most of your best margins live in legal gray zones. You never really know who’s on the other side of the counter. Today’s customer could be a security fisher for evidence, a revolutionary seeking leverage, or a fallen elite testing your usefulness. Every sale is a gamble. Approve it, refuse it, report it, or look away; someone is always taking notes. Reputation buys access and protection, but it also paints a target on your back. On this station, every client is a potential profit and a potential trouble. Start as a gunsmith, chemist, water merchant, fence, farmer, or from absolute rock bottom. Every product line has its own profit curve and its own way of ruining you, weapons bring inspections, chemicals bring addiction, water brings liability, contraband brings raids. Some trades need heavy machinery and permits, others just a good hiding spot and a straight face. The better the margins, the worse the consequences when something goes wrong. You’re not choosing a theme for your shop, you’re choosing which kind of trouble you’re willing to monetize. Every item you stock carries its own risks. Cigarette packs need visual inspection before resale. Water must be tested and filtered. Weapons require permits and modifications. Profitable chemicals rely on closely guarded recipes. Rare items need proper appraisal to avoid overpaying. You can cut the product’s quality, relabel counterfeit products as genuine, or fence discounted, stolen goods if you believe Security won’t reach you. But beware, there’s always the mob justice. Suppliers overstate value, customers push their luck, and contraband often comes with issues you only notice after the deal is done. Your margins depend on how well you assess what’s in front of you.  Misjudge the item or the person selling it, and you absorb the cost. Keep the rent paid and you can start thinking bigger. Expand your operation, run multiple businesses, and unlock new merchandise and production opportunities. But rent keeps rising, and confiscated stock or a bad deal can leave you struggling to make the next payment. Every purchase needs to earn its keep A sentient AI chip went rogue and took its hosts with it. Augs look like everyone else ... until they don't. Stay alert, pick up on the signs. Every faction agrees on the policy, and you have the gun to enforce it. But missing the signs, or misreading them, carries its own price GAME FEATURES Run your store in a dystopian station Balance supply and demand by attracting the right customers Authenticate rare goods and sell them for a profit Haggle for the best deals, but remember that every bargain comes with a trade-off Master additional jobs: water merchant, hydroponic farmer, organ dealer, and more Manage machines and production chains to craft valuable artifacts Unlock advanced licenses to access the underground market Navigate cutthroat politics and build connections with the right factions to get the exclusive deals Profit from the arrogant elite by selling them counterfeit goods Exploit (or help) the less fortunate Manage and expand your inventory Hide stolen goods and contraband from the authorities (or bribe your way out if you get caught)

title: First Fantasy Hentai Studio
description: Wishlist now About the Game "First Fantasy Hentai Studio" — Immerse yourself in a non-classical fantasy tale about a party of adventurers with an unusual source of income. You were a legendary adventurer, but the road to adventure is thorny and winding... and your pockets are empty. It would seem like a hopeless situation, if not for one thing. Your group consists of four beautiful women, and the locals are used to masturbating to naked goblin women depicted on birch bark. It's time to fix that and earn some decent money! ..Sword. Yes! Immerse yourself in adventure, develop the first Hentai studio in the fantasy world to get out of the financial hole and pay all taxes to the local king. Read an exciting visual novel and make your own choices among a variety of plot developments. Play exciting mini-games: Try to capture your companions on camera and take the hottest photos. It's not as easy as you think, time is limited. Keep an eye on the moving markers and press the button at the right time. Go fishing and manage to pull the fish out in time before the line breaks. Also, fight enemies. Manage to press on them in time so you don't take damage! And don't forget about your relationships with your companions. Each of them is not only hot on camera, but also has her own personal story to figure out. In the game you will find: 🔥 About 20 different animations, including sex scenes and the characters themselves. 🔥 Original style, animated characters with voice acting. 🔥 Mini-games integrated into the main gameplay. 🔥 4 beauties in a group of adventurers.

title: Bullet Time Agent
description: BULLET TIME AGENT is a singleplayer, sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell playable in VR and non-VR (desktop) modes. Harness the mysterious Time Essence to slow time as you escape the sinister corporate facility, full of endless swarms of security bots. TIME IS ON YOUR SIDE Survive storms of bullets as you battle your way through robot-filled arenas. Use your Time Essence wisely to dodge enemy fire and deliver punch after satisfying punch to the endless security forces. OVERCOME IMPOSSIBLE ODDS Clear arenas full of bullets, lasers, and hazards with super-powered jumps, quick thinking, and smart time management . Level up your abilities to tackle the next area, with even more treacherous environments, cryptic puzzle locks, and more complex enemies. DEFEAT ULTIMATE BOSSES As you explore and collect more secrets and upgrades , you face increasingly difficult encounters that take strategy, persistence, and skill. Battle against elite bosses that will have you sweating as your limited Time Essence counts down. DEATH CANNOT STOP YOU Time bends for you, but not your enemies! Rewind time and return to battle, but every robot you destroy stays down until the battlefield is nothing but scrap. BULLET TIME AGENT is fast-paced action, with detailed cyberpunk sci-fi environments, an energizing soundtrack, and exhilirating challenges. Wishlist now!

title: IGTAP: an Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer
description: IGTAP is an incremental game that's also a platformer - it's in the name! Complete short platforming challenges to earn currency, then spend that currency on upgrades that let you generate even more currency. Unlock new movement abilities that open up both new, higher-income courses and faster routes within old courses. explore the world to find hidden bonuses Platform Upgrade Then watch the power roll in... ...Explore... ...Or optimise your path

title: SELF MADE: Investment Life Sim
description: START WITH NOTHING. END WITH EVERYTHING—OR NOTHING AGAIN. Begin at 18 with one defining choice: pursue an education or enter the workforce. From there, every month brings a new decision. Trade stocks and options. Build companies and acquire real estate. Find love, raise a family, and prepare your children to become the next generation of your empire. Take reckless risks, attract the attention of the SEC, or lose everything in a market crash. SELF MADE is a financial life simulator where your money, relationships, reputation, and health shape the story. The American Dream has never been this volatile. TRADE THE MARKET Trade more than 50 stocks across technology, healthcare, finance, energy, retail, and other sectors. Study the market, follow the news, and decide when to make your move based on financial fundamentals—including P/E ratios, dividend yields, and earnings per share. This isn't a clicker game. Follow Sector Trends: React to dynamic breaking news and macroeconomic shifts. Track Earnings Calendars: Capitalize on quarterly reports and trade after-hours price gaps. Survive the Cycles: Ride multi-year bull markets and protect your capital during crashes. Leverage Inside Information: Unlock tips from questionable contacts—just don’t get caught. Build your fortune Choose your stocks, make your move, and weather the market’s ups and downs. ENTER YOLO MODE Looking for something riskier than buying and holding? Enter YOLO Mode for a week of high-stakes options trading with pricing based on the Black-Scholes model. Trade Calls & Puts: Construct multi-leg strategies and watch your portfolio swing in real time. Chase Glory or Ruin: Earn achievements like Diamond Hands, fight for a place in the Hall of Fame, and pray your next earnings bet prints. BUILD YOUR EMPIRE Trading is only the beginning. Turn your profits into businesses, property, influence, and power. Start a Company: Design products, hire employees, invest in R&D, and pursue an IPO. Build a Real-Estate Empire: Scale from starter rentals and laundromat portfolios to strip malls, golf courses, and an eight-property hotel empire. Own a Sports Franchise: Sign star players, upgrade your stadium, and fill the seats. Launch a Rocket Company: Complete orbital missions and compete for lucrative government contracts. Run a Media Empire: Generate headlines, build an audience, and control the narrative. Found a Charity: Tackle global challenges in education, healthcare, climate, and poverty. Just be careful when mixing your business interests—manipulating stock prices with bogus headlines tends to attract regulatory attention. Grow your empire Buy investment properties, manage your portfolio, and collect rental income. LIVE AN ENTIRE LIFE Your balance sheet is only part of your story. Find Love: Meet 11 potential partners with distinct personalities—go on dates, get married, or face a costly divorce. Raise a Family: Have children, shape their education, and prepare them to inherit your empire. Build a Career: Start in fast food, earn an MBA, climb the corporate ladder, and reach the executive suite. Enjoy Your Wealth: Upgrade from a basement apartment to a penthouse, then collect sports cars, private jets, and yachts. Visit Atlantic City: Take a trip to the casino and put your money on the line. Protect Your Health: Your lifestyle choices can shorten—or extend—your limited lifespan. Leave a legacy Choose an eligible heir to inherit your wealth and continue the family dynasty. FACE THE CONSEQUENCES Every decision carries risk. Become too reckless and the SEC may come knocking. Survive Legal Scrutiny: Face insider-trading investigations, evidence gathering, courtroom trials, and fines. Choose Your Defense: Hire anything from an overworked public defender to an elite legal team. Serve Your Time: Spend years in Club Fed—or somewhere considerably worse. Survive the Brink: Watch a crash erase years of progress and claw your way back from forced liquidations—bankruptcy is always one bad bet away. One bad decision can change the course of an entire life. KEY FEATURES 50+ Tradable Stocks with detailed company fundamentals, earnings events, and market-driven price movements High-Stakes Options Trading with calls, puts, multi-leg strategies, and pricing based on the Black-Scholes model Empire Building across real-estate portfolios, tech startups, sports franchises, media, and aerospace Life Simulation covering careers, education, marriage, children, divorce, health, and aging 11 Romanceable Characters with unique personalities and relationship arcs Dynamic News & Events including quarterly earnings, market crashes, and SEC investigations Prestige Progression with multiple victory paths: wealth, philanthropy, and legendary status Retro Terminal Aesthetic featuring diegetic office environments and sharp satirical humor A COMPLETE GAME THAT KEEPS GROWING SELF MADE is fully released, but development continues with fixes, balance improvements, and substantial new gameplay systems. A full hedge-fund management system is currently in development. Its scope and release timing may change as development progresses. HOW WILL YOUR STORY END? Retire at 65 with billions in the bank and a family that loves you—or flame out at 40 with an SEC record, an ex-spouse, and a portfolio full of worthless calls.

title: Tower.defense(): Program The Fight
description: Program the fight. In tower.defense(): Program the Fight , towers do not decide for you. Place one on the board, open its controller and build the rule it will follow when the machines arrive. There is no syntax to type. The visual language introduces conditions, comparisons and logical choices in plain words, one idea at a time. You can start with “fire at the nearest enemy” and grow toward compact IF/ELSE behaviours that react to armour, position and pressure. Three towers. Three ways to think. Sentry — a direct weapon whose target and ammunition choices matter. Lance — a deliberate line shot that rewards timing and alignment. Warden — a support controller that scans, marks and slows threats for the rest of the plan. Each placed tower keeps its own controller. Save a useful program as a blueprint, reuse it elsewhere and adapt the local copy without destroying the original. The board is part of the code. Maintenance zones offer real placement choices rather than fixed universal sockets. Elevation can extend useful reach. Barriers and rooftop structures can break line of sight. A perfect rule in the wrong position is still the wrong solution. Test it. Understand it. Deploy it. Run a lab rehearsal to watch a tower's exact decisions. Pause, step and rewind the result, then inspect why a target was chosen. When the plan says what you mean, deploy it into the live fight. Clearing the route is only the first result. Protect the relay, respect hardware and block budgets, and solve without unnecessary live changes to earn the strongest evaluation. Logic puzzles inside a real tower defence. The campaign is built for people who have never programmed as well as players who enjoy optimizing a clean solution. SOFIA guides the maintenance channel, but the final behaviour is yours. Single-player tower defence driven by visual programs Readable IF/ELSE, comparisons and logical operators without typed syntax Sentry, Lance and Warden controllers with different tactical roles Placement, elevation and line-of-sight puzzles Deterministic rehearsals with causal inspection Reusable blueprints and per-tower local edits Optional hardware and code-block optimization goals

title: ANANKE: Roguelike AutoBattler
description: Ananke blends the tactical depth of an auto-battler with the dynamic choices of a roguelike. Build a powerful squad and defeat the enemies that stand in your way. The Draft: Choose units that fit your strategy each round. Combining distinct roles—tanks, DPS, and healers—is the first step to victory. Synergies: Combine units of the same origin to unlock powerful faction bonuses. Pair a Mage and Barbarian under the 'Human' synergy for devastating attack power, or field a Crab and Turtle under the 'Water' synergy to turn the tide with relentless health regeneration. Win battles and complete quests! Acquire powerful relics and items to forge an even stronger squad. Relics: The core of your progression, granting powerful buffs to your entire team. Your relic choices dictate your build's direction and the flow of combat, so choose wisely! Equipment: Gear up your core units with powerful items. Equip a magic sword to sweep enemies away with lightning strikes, or equip a shield to absorb incoming damage and hold the frontline. Quests: Take on unique missions during your run. From simple tasks like 'Defeat 2 Enemies' to demanding challenges like 'Collect 500 Gold,' earn powerful rewards—such as relics, items, and permanent upgrades—to strengthen your build. Every decision shapes your run. Learn from past defeats and chart your path forward. The Map: Navigate your course through randomly generated nodes. Risk dangerous Elite battles for greater rewards, or roll the dice on unknown events that introduce entirely new scenarios. Events: Unique encounters along your journey act as a double-edged sword. They can grant valuable blessings—or exact a heavy toll. Strategy: From unit positioning to route planning, every decision is in your hands. Adapt, optimize, and reclaim the fallen kingdom! Wishlist ANANKE now to stay updated!

title: Violent Sky
description: Violent Sky is an open-world storm chasing and severe weather simulation game where forecasting, preparation, and survival are just as important as getting the perfect view of the storm. Explore a large, varied environment filled with urban neighborhoods, suburban communities, open plains, and remote rural roads. Study changing weather conditions, track developing storm systems, and decide where to position yourself before dangerous weather arrives. Chase storms as they form and move across the map, document severe weather, and gather information while staying alert to rapidly changing conditions. A promising setup can quickly become life-threatening as heavy rain, strong winds, hail, flooding, and tornadoes impact the world around you. Your goal is not simply to find the storm—it is to understand it, safely get close enough to observe it, and make it back before the weather overwhelms you. Dynamic Severe Weather – Watch storms develop, strengthen, move, and affect different parts of the map. Storm Forecasting – Study weather conditions and determine where severe storms are most likely to form. Open-World Storm Chasing – Travel through cities, suburbs, farmland, rural communities, and wide-open plains. Document Dangerous Weather – Capture storms and severe weather events while searching for the best and safest position. Survival and Preparation – Manage the risks of poor visibility, damaging winds, flooding, debris, and rapidly changing storm paths. Atmospheric Exploration – Experience calm weather, distant storm development, darkening skies, and the tension of an approaching tornado. Every storm tells a different story. Read the sky, choose your route, and face the Violent Sky .

title: Simulation 9
description: You wake up trapped inside a simulation. A voice calls out to you, asking you to report the anomalies you encounter. You have a choice to make. Follow its instructions or defy them. One path leads to a simple anomaly detection game. The other plunges you into an exploration horror experience. Who created Simulation 9? For what purpose? Why are you trapped inside it? The choice is yours.

title: This Is Golf
description: This Is Golf is is first-person golf game where you use the mouse to shape the perfect shot. Scout the terrain Although the shot happens in first person, you can walk around in third person to see what the hole looks like or to spectate your friend's "crazy new stinger". Clubs You can pick from a wide variety of clubs, from the 5 iron to the 9 iron, pitching wedge, driver or putter, and they all have the own purpose. You will learn to choose right the more you hit with them. Procedural holes Every hole is procedurally generated. Multiplayer You can play in lobbies of up to 8 players.

title: It's About Pirates
description: It’s About Pirates is a survivors-like where you blast through relentless waves of enemies, collect loot, and upgrade your ship for epic naval battles. Navigate through storms of cannonballs, face mythical sea monsters, and time your attacks for devastating impact. Transform your ship into an unstoppable fortress with flamethrowers, harpoons, mortars, and a vast arsenal of deadly upgrades. Strategically combine weapons and items to craft powerful builds. Be prepared, as increasingly challenging enemies will stand in your way. Customize your vessel with over 150 unique parts discovered throughout your adventures. Complete quests across different pirate realms to expand your collection of ship components. Features: ⚔️ Automatic or manual aiming 🧭 Sail through 30 adventures ⚓ 10 distinct captains 🏴‍☠️ 6 Factions with unique abilities 🗡️ Over 140 items to shape your build 💰 Collect loot and unlock new ship skins ☠️ Test your skill in Endless mode 🏆 Compete on the leaderboard and claim your place among the top pirates The sea awaits!

title: DeathMaze - Dungeon Crawler
description: DeathMaze Dungeon Crawler is a brutal top-down action roguelike shooter in which you explore dark, procedurally generated dungeons linked together into dangerous sequences. In the HUB, you prepare for each expedition by choosing your weapons, ammunition, tools, and supplies. You then activate a runestone that generates a chain of dungeons with different threats, conditions, and rewards. During a run, you fight monsters using firearms and melee weapons, manage a limited inventory, recover lost gear after death, use transport drones, and activate anchor portals to push deeper and deeper into an alien dimension. The farther you go, the fewer resources you will find, the deadlier your enemies will become, and the greater the Demon’s wrath you will bring upon yourself. FIGHT FAST AND CHOOSE THE RIGHT WEAPON FOR EACH THREAT DeathMaze focuses on fast, responsive combat and instant weapon switching. Different enemy types require different tools of destruction, and quickly adapting your loadout is key to survival. RISK MORE AS YOU DESCEND DEEPER The dungeons are connected into sequences that become increasingly dangerous. Resources grow scarce, enemies become stronger, and death may cost you your entire loadout. If the runestone still has energy left, you can return to recover your gear, but every step forward increases the risk. PREPARE YOUR EXPEDITION IN THE HUB Every run begins with planning. In the HUB, you choose your weapons, ammunition, tools, and supplies, then activate a runestone that creates a sequence of dungeons with different conditions, threat levels, and rewards. USE DRONES AND ANCHOR PORTALS Drones allow you to deliver gear from the HUB to selected dungeons or send valuable loot back to storage, but using them comes with risk and drains more of the runestone’s energy. Activated anchor portals let you return deeper into the sequence instead of starting over from the beginning. AWAKEN THE DEMON’S WRATH Your presence and the use of powerful devices increase the wrath of this dimension’s ruler. As that wrath rises, the dungeon begins to tremble, a terrifying roar echoes through the halls, and a deadly horde descends upon you. In those moments, positioning, barricades, traps, and preparation are all that matter. CHANGE THE RULES OF A RUN WITH DEMONIC CARDS Demonic Cards let you modify the conditions of individual dungeons or entire sequences. They can increase loot, alter the weather, affect danger levels and rewards, but they usually come at a price. Every decision changes the nature of the expedition and the level of risk. Key features: Fast, responsive combat with firearms and melee weapons Procedurally generated dungeons and expedition sequences Run planning from the HUB and inventory management Demonic Cards that modify the conditions of an entire sequence Enemy hordes triggered by the Demon’s growing wrath Loot, crafting, and light survival elements

title: Banana Life Sim
description: Banana Life Sim is a game in which you can become a banana. This game offers meditative gameplay. You can stand and contemplate the beauty of the forest around you, living your life as a banana. You can also perform the actions that bananas usually do (mostly standing in the same place). Features You're a banana You're in the forest There are other bananas around you And not only bananas

title: Shroomanoid: breakout action roguelike
description: YOU ARE A GIANT FLYING MUSHROOM. BOUNCE OFF WALLS, CRUSH ENEMIES. CONTROL YOUR TRAJECTORY. STRIKE WITH PRECISION. YOUR GEAR DEFINES YOUR ABILITIES. COMBINE ITEMS TO CRAFT NEW ABILITIES. EVERY LEVEL UP IS A SLOT REROLL. SHAPE YOUR BUILD. ADD TO WISHLIST NOW!

title: Plague Inc: Aliens & Anti-Vaxxers
description: In this Special Disease type, crash your meteor into Earth and begin transforming it into a crystalline paradise of your own making. Change the World Crystalise the world from the streets to the core of the planet. Pass the crystallisation onto humanity, shatter their bodies into tiny pieces. Watch the Skies! Bring meteors from space to spread your infection, destroy research or even an entire country! Race to Research Humanity will deploy specialist dynamic responses to your actions. Fight back before they destroy you! Zombies vs. Earth A melting glacier unleashes a forgotten nightmare. Greenland falls to the zombie hordes overnight! There is no virus, no cure, only the relentless march of the undead. Can they consume the world? Anti-Vax Faith in vaccines is collapsing. Global vaccination campaigns fight to hold the line, but weaponised conspiracies and viral misinformation are infecting the truth! What's the worst that could happen? Hell on Earth It's time to subjugate the world! Unleash a heat-loving, hell-spawned plague to corrupt people, animals and even the world itself. Satan is waiting in the depths... Herd Immunity What doesn't kill humanity makes it stronger. In this upgraded simulation, infected people may now recover from diseases and develop a natural immunity to prevent reinfection. Can Herd Immunity save the world? Measles Measles is one of the most preventable diseases in the world thanks to modern vaccines, but misinformation and dangerous new mutations could lead to a deadly resurgence. Can you bring Measles back from the brink? Cure Mania The world’s gone cure crazy! Scientists are obsessively coordinated, sharing breakthroughs in real time across every border. Cure planes will launch earlier, and *much* more frequently . Can your disease survive when the skies are painted blue? Leprosy Leprosy still infects around 200,000 new people every year due to social stigma and long incubation periods but thanks to modern medicine, it's fully treatable. Can you save humanity's oldest disease from long-term decline?

title: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball Volume 10
description: Relive the golden age of pinball with Williams™ Pinball Volume 10! This amazing collection brings together the iconic Diner™ pinball table with the first ever official recreation of Fire!™ and Comet™. This pack features: Comet™: Ride the rails of a carnival classic! Race around the Comet Ramp, and chase high scores under the glow of flashing midway lights. Fire!™: Sound the alarm! Race against time to put out fires and rescue victims across a unique mirrored playfield, glowing with the heat of action. Diner™: Step into the charm of a classic American diner. Collect the D-I-N-E-R lights by serving cranky customers to unlock Dine-Time for massive scores.

title: One More Flight
description: The engines hum. The service cart rolls down the aisle. Inevitably, the plane goes down. Then the cycle begins anew. One more flight is a side-scrolling psychological horror game driven by observation, timing, and cumulative knowledge. Trapped aboard a flight destined for catastrophe, you cannot rely on carried-over items or character stats. The only weapon at your disposal is what you remember from every failed attempt. Study the cabin, experiment with fatal chains of events, and unravel the dark secrets lurking behind every compartment to break the loop and stop the crash for good. There’s much more to the plane than you might think. Carefully observe the passengers, your surroundings, and even the smallest details.
