Some threats aren’t immediately obvious; others are so bizarre your mind will refuse to accept them. Every step can lead you to a different ending; you never know what you’ll encounter. Death is not an end—it’s a trail left behind by your mistakes. With every turn, learn a little more, get a little closer, and break free from this endless cycle. At times, even a split-second of hesitation can change everything. Sometimes you’ll be racing against the clock; other times, you’ll have to rely on your dexterity and composure. Think fast, move carefully, and remember—you can’t afford to make a mistake. If you feel like you’re being watched, you’re probably right. No corner, no aisle, and no moment on the plane is as safe as you think. Keep your eyes peeled until you get off the plane; danger could be anywhere. If you think people will believe you, you’re wrong. They won’t listen to what you say, and they won’t understand what they see; besides, even you don’t know why you’re alone on this plane. Still, you have to find a way to save them.

title: Junk Record: A Video Game Adventure
description: Story Deep inside the forest, a mysterious animal-eared girl named Arika awakens. She wanders aimlessly, having lost all memory of who she is. Stung by an insect, her breasts explode in size! Mushrooms squirt onto her, covering her in pure white! A slime clings onto her like underwear! Even with all these debuffs, Arika won't give up! Her passionate adventure starts here! Game Features ■A classic RPG designed for an easy, accessible game experience Special care has been taken for the game's balance as well as your objectives and hints for events. We have done our best to create a game that naturally guides the player. ■Unique characters that breathe life into the story The rest of the cast engages in silly banter as well as serious exchanges with Arika. Care has been put into writing characters that are far from one-dimensional. ■Awake the Force Change As you progress the story, Arika gains the ability to wield the true power of the other heroines. Unleash powerful skills and ultimates to wipe out your foes! ■Status effects that affect the sprites and event CGs Apart from enlarged breasts, further debuffs can even cause her to lactate! Many other bad status effects await Arika as well. ■H events trigger based on the player's choices As a scene progresses, sudden quick time events will pop up. If you don't avoid it, then something bad will be in store for Arika...! Characters ●Arika A mysterious girl who wakes up without any memories -- or clothing. She stands out from the crowd with her fluffy ears and tail, assymetrical purple hair, tanned skin, and peculiar mole. After being taken in by Saki, she resolves to earn her keep, but... ●Saki A warrior hailing from the land of the East, she teaches swordsmanship as the master of her dojo. Though she speaks in an old-fashioned, patriarchal tongue, she possesses an especially voluptuous chest. While her strength overshadows her endowments, they say she possesses yet another secret... ●Bosses with distinct personalities These powerful foes stand in Arika's way. Of course, losing means a defeat H scene. But if you beat them on the highest difficulty, there might be a reward?

title: diffiCULT
description: diffiCULT is a multiplayer social deduction FPS where trust breaks quickly and suspicion spreads even faster. At the start of each match, every player receives a hidden role. You might be part of the Town trying to uncover the cult, a Cultist secretly working against everyone, or a Solo role with its own unpredictable objective. Nobody knows who to trust. Lie, investigate, accuse, and survive long enough to reach your victory. When the sun rises, players gather to talk about what happened during the night. Who acted suspiciously? Who might be lying? Players can accuse each other and start a vote. If the town agrees, the suspected player is executed. But be careful. One wrong vote can eliminate an innocent player and bring the cult closer to victory. When night falls, every role secretly performs its ability. Some players investigate houses to gather information. Others protect their allies. Cultists quietly hunt their targets while solo roles move toward their own hidden goals. The events of the night often change everything the next day. 🎭 Unique Roles Each player receives a different role with its own abilities and strategies. Some roles collect information. Some protect others. Some manipulate players or create chaos. Because of this, every match unfolds differently. ⚔️ Three Competing Factions Town Work together to uncover and eliminate the cult. Cultists Hide among the town and eliminate or convert players until you take control. Solo Roles Play your own game. Outsmart everyone and complete your unique win condition. Multiplayer social deduction FPS Three competing factions with different victory conditions Dozens of unique roles Daytime discussions and voting Night abilities that change the game Fully 3D first-person gameplay Proximity voice chat and social interaction A dark medieval cult atmosphere

title: Mushroom Simulator Co-op
description: Roadmap About the Game It's a world where you're a mushroom and so are your friends SPEAK AND GROW Voice waves magically feed your mycelium, speeding up your growth. Got a hedgehog eyeing your cap? Yell at it, and it'll realize it messed with the wrong mushroom - but be careful: noise can draw unwelcome guests, so sometimes it's best to shut up... STAY QUIET AND SURVIVE When a forager with a basket walks into your clearing, your only chance is to pretend you're not there. One sneeze and all that's left of you is spores. PROTECT YOURSELF AND YOUR KIDS Raise little mushrooms, protect them from the dangers of the forest, and shoot worms at Grandpa Geo. Nobody gets to kick your family around! PLAY WITH FRIENDS Get random mushroom skins, find your spot in a cozy clearing, and survive together with friends. Along the way you'll meet strange creatures and learn to accept yourself for who you are. No quests, no bosses. Just you, the forest, and everyone who lives in it.

title: Potato Simulato: Together Co-op
description: Welcome to Potato Simulato: Together , a chaotic physics-based platformer where you play as a helpless potato trying to survive a world full of traps, madness, and pure frustration. Roll, jump, and struggle your way through bizarre obstacle courses filled with spinning hammers, deadly spikes, collapsing platforms, and completely unfair surprises. One mistake… and it’s back to the start. This game is not about skill alone , it’s about patience, timing, and how much rage you can handle. 🥔 Features: Physics-based movement that makes every action unpredictable Brutal obstacle courses designed to test your sanity Instant fail mechanics — no mercy Funny, absurd environments (kitchens, deserts, floating islands, and more) ⚠️ Warning: This game may cause: Screaming Desk hitting Questioning life choices If you enjoyed games like that, you’re in the right place.

title: Glowstick Pirates: Harem Conquest
description: The answer lies beyond the horizon! Rackham has been struck with the ridiculous "Glowstick Curse" by a mysterious pirate—whenever he gets excited, his cock begins to glow with a dazzling light. Desperate to reclaim his normal life, Rackham sets out with his trusted companion, Anne, to track down the pirate who cursed him and find a way to break the curse. But their voyage soon carries them into far more dangerous waters. The legendary Sea God Sword has resurfaced, prompting Mary—the Bloodlust Warrior, Hector—the Queen of Curses, Ching Shih—the Strongest of the East, and Jonathan—the Hand of Justice—to make their moves. Pirates, conspiracies, and desire await at every turn. Can Rackham rally a crew of his own and break the curse before his glowing cock lights up the entire ocean!? 【The Curse, the Sea God Sword, and the Three Lords】 Sail across distant seas, challenge the pirate crews that hold sway over each region, and search for clues to break the curse. As rumours of the Sea God Sword spread, Rackham finds himself drawn into the conflict between the Three Lords. 【Strategic Turn-Based Combat】 Analyse each enemy's abilities and status, then combine skills, buffs, gear, and terrain effects to devise the right strategy for every encounter. 【Custom Gear and Builds】 Collect weapons, armour, and accessories, then adjust each character's stats and buffs to create offensive, defensive, or status-focused builds. 【Defeat and Recruit Crew Members】 Defeat the enemies in your path and recruit those who catch your eye into your crew. Each character has unique skills and a distinct combat role, allowing you to build your pirate crew however you like. 【Story and Events】 Sail to new regions, challenge pirate crews, and expand your ranks. As you progress through the story, unlock new character interactions, exclusive events, and adult content. Rackham and the Powers of the Seas Fan-favourite characters from across the series return. Build the pirate crew of your dreams!

title: Casualties: Unknown
description: Survive a Harsh World Each layer brings its own challenges, adapt and descend. Simulated Limb and Cardiovascular Systems Injuries are unavoidable. You will have to bandage yourself, fight infected wounds, and stabilize blood loss before losing consciousness. Additionally, your mood can greatly affect your chances of survival, too much doom and gloom will make your life harder. Craft to Survive As a creature capable of reason, using tools will allow you to travel the cavernous layers more efficiently. In case you start bleeding out, the flora will provide great resources to patch yourself up. Explore at Your Own Risk Previous expeditions have left some good loot behind. But even helpful things can prove to be your death. Uncover the Truth What actually lies at the end of this journey? And what becomes of you if you are to succeed? Features An entirely simulated cardiovascular and limb damage system Character traits to increase on your run: Intelligence, Strength, and Resilience Robust crafting mechanics to increase your odds of survival 3 characters with their own distinct playstyles 11 layers of an alien planet with their own challenges and dangers 300 items to find on your runs Adjustable loot and danger values accessible on the main menu

title: Soul Strip: Waifu Card Battler
description: Build a deck and fight monsters. Every card is a girl with her own personality. CHOOSE WHO LEADS Before each run you pick one girl. She gives you your first cards and helps you in every fight. BUILD YOUR DECK After every fight you take a new card. Cards can be upgraded. THREE ACTS You travel across the map and choose your own path: fight, visit a shop or rest. A boss waits at the end of each act. GET CLOSER TO THE HEROINES Take the girls on dates and give them gifts. The closer you get, the more new art you unlock. BUILD YOUR COLLECTION New cards come from packs you earn by defeating bosses. FEATURES 60 cards across five elements: Fire, Ice, Shadow, Holy and Void. 30 Common, 15 Rare, 10 Epic and 5 Legendary 6 heroine personalities: tsundere, kuudere, dandere, genki, yandere and himedere. Your leader's personality grants a bonus every turn Two upgrade paths for every card Elemental synergies: play two cards of the same element in one turn for an extra effect 3 acts of 15 floors: fights, elite enemies, shops, events and Hot Springs 34 enemies: 20 regular, 8 elite and 6 bosses. You always see what an enemy will do next turn 50 relics and 29 events 20 Ascension levels, unlocked after your first win Bond with the heroines: 5 levels, dates, gifts and new art 4 pack tiers with a guaranteed Legendary card. Packs drop only from bosses 10 card finishes 59 achievements and Steam Cloud saves

title: Mei Music
description: Mei Music is a local-first music player built around your own collection. Bring in songs from your computer, organize them into playlists, and listen in a clean desktop app designed for managing a personal library instead of browsing a streaming catalog. Features Included All Songs and Liked Songs views Create and manage playlists Import songs from your computer Adjust per-song volume Sort your library by name or imported date Customize playlist and song icons Optional: connect FFmpeg for local audio conversion workflows

title: Visual novel: Dashing 90s
description: Visual novel: Dashing 90s — a text-based interactive drama about a young man who came to the big city for an education, but faces a very different kind of challenge. Andrey is an ordinary prospective student from the provinces. His goal is simple: to enroll in a polytechnic institute and start a new life. But temporary housing in a communal apartment becomes the main test. Here, each neighbor has their own truth, their own interests, and their own ways of surviving. Speculator Ninka returns from Turkey with contraband and offers quick money for one favor. Alcoholic Kolya asks to go get vodka, hinting that refusal will be costly. Actress Larisa invites him to a midnight cemetery for a "ritual." An old friend, Kostyan, offers to drive his car, supposedly legally. A stranger asks to be escorted through a dark archway. And Kostya, nicknamed Turnip, the neighbor's son, returns from prison. He believes he is the only one in charge in this apartment. Every day, Andrei makes a choice: agree and receive money, connections, and support—but risk his freedom and life. Or refuse and be left alone to face hostility, suspicion, and threats. One agreement can lead to prison, the hospital, or the grave. One refusal can make him an outcast, but leave a chance to pass his exams. The story branches into dozens of endings: from successful admission to a maximum-security prison colony. The atmosphere of 1990s communal life, the criminal underworld, moral dilemmas, and the cost of every decision—all of this determines the protagonist's fate. Will Andrei be able to overcome these trials and preserve himself? Atmospheric soundtracks—a variety of musical tracks that immerse him in the atmosphere of the 1990s and heighten the tension of each scene. A branching plot—multiple twists and endings: from triumph to tragedy, every decision changes the protagonist's fate. A system of moral choices—there are no right answers, only consequences. The authentic atmosphere of the era – everyday life, language, and the realities of communal life in the 1990s.

title: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike
description: Updata Roadmap About the Game There’s an old saying in the kingdom: “When you’re lost, go to the nearest Dice Tavern.” It all started with Elena, a girl from the North who made a name for herself among the ruins of a tavern. She turned the humble game of Farkle into a challenge that swept across the kingdom. Six taverns, from the village to the throne. Thirty opponents, from humble challengers to legendary rivals. With just six dice, that girl rewrote her own destiny. And now, I can almost hear her calling: “Fancy a round?” Farkle is a classic dice game that has been played for centuries. Roll the dice and lock in your points, or keep pushing your luck. But Farkle, and you lose all your points for the round. Dice Tavern expands on these classic rules with roguelike deckbuilding mechanics. When dice gain unique abilities and probabilities can be reshaped, a simple game of luck becomes an adventure driven by risk, strategy, and clever combinations. 35 Unique Dice Every beautifully crafted die has its own ability and playstyle. They are more than tools. They can change the rules of the game. 43 Synergies Combine specific dice to activate powerful Synergies. Underdog lets cheap dice rewrite the rules for straights, while Holy Empire and Demon Dynasty let the three dice at the heart of your build decide whether you walk in the light or descend into the abyss. Every Synergy has its own story and logic. Deep Modding System Use lead weights to shift the odds. Apply copper, silver, or gold stickers to revive weak faces or stack powerful multipliers. Pair them with cheating tools to turn every die into a finely tuned machine. Gambler, Alchemist, Joker, and more. Each character puts their own spin on the rules. Some let you take bigger risks with fewer turns. Others make coatings cheaper while driving up the price of dice. One turns every scoring roll into a high-stakes gamble: a 65% chance to double your score, or a 35% chance to reduce it to 1 point. Different characters do more than change your starting conditions. They can make the same set of dice evolve into completely different strategies. Every choice is the beginning of a new fate. 6 taverns. 30 opponents. Target scores rising from 3,500 to 500,000. Every opponent brings a unique challenge modifier. They might seal away your strongest scoring numbers, restrict your favorite core combinations, punish Farkles with extra penalties, or drain your total score every turn. The shops are random. Gold is limited. Routes change every run. Every coin is a choice. Every roll is a risk. Every step takes you closer to the throne. After clearing all six taverns for the first time, Elena will open the door to a whole new challenge. Decrees: Stacking Challenges 15 Decree levels, each adding a new restriction to your journey. And it only gets tougher: the effects stack with each level. Previous restrictions remain in place as new ones are added. How far can your build and your luck take you? Endgame: Take Someone Else's Dice Every Endgame run is a puzzle left behind by the player who came before you. The dice, resources, and objectives are all set. Find the best solution within the given limitations. Every Endgame challenge is different. Take them on and find your way to victory. Fate never reveals its answer until the dice come to rest. Push open the tavern door and begin your journey.🎲

title: No Rest for the Wicked Early Access Soundtrack
description: Curated by composer Gareth Coker, this Early Access Anniversary soundtrack collection brings together some of his favorite pieces from the game's score to date. Experience a selection of tracks that best capture the plague-ridden world, its inhabitants and the weight of the Cerim's journey, presented for fans who want to relive (or discover) the soundtrack outside the game. NOTE: These are the Early Access versions of the tracks. As development continues, some pieces may evolve or be replaced in the final release.

title: Naval Supremacy
description: Write your own naval legend amid torrents of steel. In this strategy and progression game, you will manage the economy, develop the military industry, maneuver across the diplomatic stage, and personally design every warship—competing with the great powers across vast oceans in a contest of wisdom and courage. Say no to rigid, cookie-cutter blueprints. Your fleet is defined by you. The game features a rigorous attribute calculation system: weapon weight directly affects speed, while armor thickness determines survivability. A rich variety of ship platforms: Choose from 8 basic hull types, ranging from highly mobile destroyers to awe-inspiring super battleships. Highly flexible outfitting: Freely configure main guns, secondary guns, torpedoes, and anti-aircraft weapons. Balance mobility and protection to create custom warships perfectly suited to your tactical style. Heavy-gun light cruisers, torpedo carriers, hollow-shell destroyers, and other abstract designs are all supported. Every battle is full of variables—but they have nothing to do with you. Dynamic environments and engagement distance: Fighting in storms will greatly affect accuracy, while night battles severely test fire-control technology. You do not need to decide whether to conduct long-range bombardment or close the distance to unleash deadly torpedoes based on enemy and friendly configurations. That is the job of your admirals and ships. Battle damage and pursuit mechanics: Damaged warships will suffer real-time combat effectiveness degradation. When facing a routed enemy, use your speed advantage to pursue and expand your gains; or, when at a disadvantage, retreat decisively to preserve your strength. This part is your responsibility—your telegrams can reach the frontline command center. Master multi-dimensional warfare and build an unbreakable layered defense. Carrier battles: A complete carrier aircraft ecosystem. Dispatch fighters, dive bombers, and torpedo bombers to break through enemy anti-air fire and deliver devastating beyond-visual-range strikes against enemy capital ships. Deep-sea hunting: Submarine stealth values and anti-submarine sonar engage in a constant contest. Use submarine wolfpacks to pose a deadly threat to surface fleets, or deploy escort fleets equipped with depth charges to keep your shipping lanes secure. Your gaze must not be limited to the battlefield. You must also focus on the evolution of the world order. Control of strategic straits: Gradually seize control of 8 major global strategic straits, including Gibraltar, Suez, and Malacca. Choke the lifelines of global trade and gain abundant funding and strategic resources. Dynamic diplomatic rivalry: Interact with 6 AI nations, each with its own development preferences. Seek allies and form defensive alliances, pressure weaker nations to seize territory, and explore special mechanics involving absolutely neutral countries. Military-industrial trade: Accept warship construction commissions from AI nations, earn massive profits, and reinvest them into your own military industry. Selling large numbers of high-quality ship designs to AI nations can even help them grow. Every warship and every admiral bears witness to the rise of your empire. Dynamic admiral development: Recruit and train naval commanders with more than a dozen unique skills, such as “Precise Shooting” and “Damage Control Master.” Their attributes will grow intelligently based on their real combat performance. War history and memorial hall: Every warship has its own independent combat record. When a distinguished ship retires or is tragically sunk, it will be permanently recorded in the national memorial hall for future generations to honor. Research breakthroughs: Concentrate your resources to overcome key technology trees. Of course, research always comes with surprises. Whether you are a veteran strategist who commands from behind the scenes or a new commander just entering the world of naval warfare, the built-in tutorial will help you quickly master the core gameplay. Enjoy the pure appeal of strategy and progression in a turn-based experience with no real-time pressure. After all, giant ships and big guns are a man’s romance!

title: Not Quite Dead: Open World Survival
description: Open World Zombie Survival • Base Building • Looting • Crafting • Vehicles • Exploration  • Co-op * Inspired by classic survival games like: Surroundead, Dayz and Miscreated * You’re not dead… but you’re getting close. Survive in a brutal open world zombie survival game where every decision matters. Explore abandoned towns, scavenge for resources, build your base, repair vehicles, and fight to stay alive in a world overrun by the infected. 🌍 Open World Exploration Explore a large open world filled with: Abandoned cities and villages Forests and hidden locations Industrial zones and bunkers High-risk areas with rare loot Every location is handcrafted to reward exploration and risk-taking. 🔎 Looting & Survival Mechanics Search and scavenge for: Weapons and ammunition Food and medical supplies Crafting materials Rare survival gear This is a true survival game where resources are limited and every item matters. 🏠 Base Building System Build and upgrade your own survival base : Store your loot Craft equipment Prepare for dangerous expeditions Your base is your only safe place in a hostile world. 🚗 Vehicles & Travel Find, repair, and use vehicles to: Travel faster across the open world Carry more loot Reach dangerous zones Fuel is scarce, and every trip is a risk. 🧟 Zombie Survival Combat Face different types of zombies : Basic infected in safer zones Stronger enemies deeper in the map Dangerous variants in high-risk areas Combat is tense, fast, and unforgiving. ⚠️ Risk vs Reward Gameplay Push deeper into dangerous zones to find: Better weapons Rare resources Unique loot Or play it safe and survive longer. 🔮 Planned Features Dynamic events (airdrops, bosses, convoys) Expanded crafting system More weapons and gear New biomes and map expansions 🧠 Why You’ll Love It Open world zombie survival gameplay Strong focus on exploration and immersion No level restrictions only skill and preparation Inspired by classic survival games like Surroundead, Dayz and Miscreated - ROAD MAP -

title: Soul Strip: Waifu Card Battler Demo
Music Manager
description: Music Manager is a detailed simulation game about building careers in the music industry from 1952 to 2026, covering the history of modern popular music. Start in any year during that period and work across a global music scene, with playable locations across every inhabited continent. Scout talent, negotiate contracts, book gigs, send acts on tour, play festivals, record songs, release music, handle publicity and guide your artists through changing trends, shifting tastes and fierce competition. Some acts will need patience. Others may be ready to move quickly. The challenge is deciding where to spend your time, money and attention in an industry that never stands still. As your career progresses, achievements can unlock support staff who take over parts of the business, letting you focus more on the areas you enjoy most. If you enjoy management games built around systems, long-term planning and shaping your own story over time, Music Manager puts you in control of the decisions behind the music. Key Features Start in any year from 1952 to 2026 Manage acts across the changing history of modern music Work across playable global locations Scout, sign and develop artists Book gigs, tours and festival appearances Record songs and release singles and albums Handle publicity, public attention, reputation and long-term legacy Unlock support staff through achievements

title: CD Market - Music Label Sim
description: CD Market is a music label management game about taking a small record label through decades of music history. You sign artists, shape their careers, release records, send them on tour, chase charts, and try to keep the whole thing from collapsing when the industry changes around you. Some weeks are simple: a single sells well, a tour date goes smoothly, a new artist looks promising. Other weeks, a band is falling apart, a legal case lands on your desk, piracy eats into sales, a rival label makes an offer to your biggest act, and your next album still is not ready. That is the job. Build the label anyway. Start Anywhere From 1950 To 2020 Starting in the 1950s means dealing with a world built around physical formats, regional distribution, and record stores. Start later and the business has already changed. CDs rise, piracy appears, digital platforms arrive, and the comfortable old ways of selling music become harder to rely on. You can keep playing beyond 2020 and see how long your label can survive. Sign Artists And Manage Their Careers Scout new artists through your A&R department, negotiate contracts, pay advances, set royalties, renew deals, and decide who deserves a long-term place on your roster. Artists are not just sales machines. They have creative energy, stress, boredom, happiness, chemistry, traits, and problems of their own. A talented band can still burn out, fall apart, lose a key member, or become difficult to manage at the worst possible time. Make The Music Before You Sell It A release starts before the release screen. Set the creative direction for a project, choose the style and theme, book demo sessions, hire writers and producers, record songs, and decide what should become a single, album, EP, promo single, compilation, greatest hits release, or special edition. You can release music in different regions and formats, including Vinyl, Cassette, CD, and Digital. Each era changes what makes sense, what sells, and what risks you are taking. Promote The Release A great song can still disappear if nobody hears it. Run marketing campaigns, schedule PR events, send music to radio, create videos for TV, build hype before an album, and grow artist recognition across different regions. You may also get offers for commercial placements, collaborations, award-show performances, or other opportunities that can help a release take off. Tour, Sell Merch, Or Build A Festival Legacy After an album, send the artist out into the world. Choose venues, set ticket prices, plan dates, build setlists, add supporting artists, manage travel and amenities, rehearse, and watch each show affect reputation, stress, ticket sales, and future demand. You can also create merch sets, work with suppliers, order stock, set prices, and turn fan excitement into another part of your label’s income. As your label grows, festivals become part of its identity. Get your artists onto festival lineups, or create your own festival, book the venue, set the schedule, invite label and global artists, manage budgets, and try to turn a risky event into a name fans remember. Survive The Industry The music business does not stay still. Global charts move every week. New styles appear. Rival labels grow. Artists retire, get poached, or become famous enough to demand better terms. Awards can raise your profile. Legal cases can drain your cash. Piracy can destroy sales if you ignore it for too long. Build departments, hire better employees, bring in executives, run anti-piracy campaigns, settle or fight lawsuits, and make the kind of decisions that decide whether your label becomes a legend or a warning story. Grow Into Something Bigger... And Delegate The Chaos If your label becomes successful enough, the business expands beyond signing artists and releasing albums. You can build your own studio, move into better offices, hire executives, open distribution centers, run your own record stores, buy radio stations, make distribution deals with rival labels, and even acquire other labels. As the company grows, you can start delegating some of the chaos. Marketing executives can run ongoing PR work for your artists. HR executives can recruit and manage department staffing. Tour executives give you better forecasts before you risk money on the road. Distribution executives help with retail infrastructure, store costs, and rival-label deals. You can also hire release executives to help manage an artist’s album cycle. They can plan demos, schedule recordings, prepare singles, build release drafts, and wait for your final approval before anything goes out. By then, your label is not just surviving the industry anymore. It is part of what shapes it. Explore The Game In Sandbox Mode If you want less pressure, or just want to experiment, Sandbox mode lets you bend the game around your own ideas. Edit your label’s cash, recognition, genre popularity, release settings, ticket price limits, manufacturing costs, employee setup, and more. You can also create and edit artists, adjust members, change traits, boost happiness, fix chemistry, or set up the exact roster you want to play with. Use it to test strategies, build a dream label, skip the early struggle, recreate a specific music scene, or just make the numbers do something ridiculous and see what happens. Features Start in any year from 1950 to 2020 and continue endlessly Manage a record label through vinyl, cassette, CD, piracy, and digital eras Scout artists, solo members, and future stars through A&R Negotiate contracts, advances, royalties, renewals, and EP deals Manage artist happiness, chemistry, stress, boredom, burnout, addiction, and band drama Create demos, record songs, choose writers and producers, and build full album projects Release singles, albums, EPs, compilations, greatest hits, promo singles, and special editions Choose formats, regions, prices, publishers, marketing budgets, and distribution options Track sales, profit, certifications, piracy impact, chart positions, and regional recognition Run PR events, marketing campaigns, radio promotion, TV exposure, and commercial deals Plan tours with venues, ticket prices, setlists, support acts, travel, amenities, and show ratings Create merch sets, manage suppliers, order stock, and sell to fans Compete for awards and perform at major ceremonies Create your own festivals and invite label or global artists Handle legal cases, settlements, court outcomes, and anti-piracy campaigns Compete with rival labels, counter their offers, sign global artists, or acquire subsidiaries Build distribution centers, open record stores, and make deals with other labels Buy radio stations and strengthen your control over promotion Use Sandbox mode to edit your label, artists, money, recognition, and more Create or import custom music templates with different genres, styles, regions, stores, publishers, and radio stations Unlock achievements across sales, tours, awards, formats, legal cases, stores, and digital music It is about watching a label history grow one choice at a time. The first scouted artist. The risky single that worked. The expensive tour that did not. The band that almost broke up. The album that kept the company alive. The rival that took your star. The comeback you had to build from whatever was left.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Mystery Skulls Music Pack
description: Get into the rhythm with the new Mystery Skulls Music Pack. Celebrate the thrilling finale of the Mystery Skulls Animated series! Featuring FIVE new Rhythm Rifts by Mystery Skulls: "Ghost" "Freaking Out" "Hellbent feat. Snowblood" "The Future" "When I'm With You" Each Mystery Skulls Rhythm Rift features: Paranormal enthusiast, Vivi Yukino Background visualizer with custom particle FX Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design Buying any song from this Music Pack also unlocks custom Mystery Skulls items to equip in your Rift Profile! Songs are available in both original and explicit versions to play

title: Visual novel: The One from the Dark
description: One village. One night. Not a single witness. Jane Evans is a real estate appraiser. Her job involves abandoned houses in the wilderness. Her latest assignment takes her to Roadville, a village lost in the fog. There's no communication. The bus runs once a day. And the locals are hiding something. Jane will have to spend the night in a village where everyone smiles, but no one tells the truth. And where there's an ancient prophecy: "The most important is the one who comes from the darkness. The blood of others is needed..." GAMEPLAY This is a psychological visual novel where your main goal is to survive and escape. Gameplay is entirely focused on reading dialogue, Jane's internal monologues, and making decisions. Every choice you make can bring you closer to salvation—or send you into the arms of the Tree. The game offers several story paths and many hidden dead ends, where one wrong move can be fatal. GAME FEATURES Atmospheric horror. Terror is born from silence, fog, strange glances, and the gradual realization: you are no one here, you are alone, and no one will come. Gaslighting as a mechanic. You will be told scary stories, and a minute later you will think it was all fantasy. Will you believe yourself? Or will you think you are going crazy? Prophecy and the Tree. Something ancient grows in the center of the village. It is hungry. It remembers. And it has already chosen its victim. Multiple endings. Will you escape before dawn? Or will you become part of the community? Or will you never be found? "Truly, the most important is the one who comes from the darkness. But the one who comes from the darkness will never return."

title: Visual novel: Shadows of Ravenhall Castle
description: Writer Elizabeth Gray never imagined she would one day become the heir to an ancient castle. Everything changed after a letter arrived: grim Ravenhall, lost among mist-covered hills, had been left to her in the will of a man she barely knew. It seemed simple enough: arrive, inspect the estate, sign the necessary documents, and return to her old life. But on the very first night, Elizabeth realizes that Ravenhall came to her for a reason. Whispers echo through empty corridors. Old portraits seem to watch her every move. Candles go out without a breath of wind, and the past of the Blackwood family grows closer — and more dangerous. The deeper Elizabeth delves into the history of the castle, the harder it becomes to understand where the investigation ends and the trap begins. The player must decide how this story will end. Game Features • A visual novel in the genre of mystical detective fiction and psychological horror. • Choices that influence the heroine’s path and the ending of the story. • An atmosphere of slow-burning terror: mist, candles, whispers, portraits, and the feeling that the castle is watching every step.

title: Action Hero
description: EXCLUSIVELY ON STEAM FRAME! Punch dinosaurs, battle shotgun-wielding ninjas and dodge devious traps in Action Hero, a blockbuster VR FPS with explosive set pieces and cinematic design. Be The Hero In Your Favorite Movie Genres Fight your way through six bombastic movies, stepping into the hero’s shoes. Gameplay proceeds in slow motion, only speeding up as the player moves. Lean around bullets with stylish satisfaction, catch weapons in mid-air and take down enormous bosses. Features: Become the action hero in six genre-spanning movies. Pull off an explosive heist, master kung-fu in an epic saga, hunt for treasure in trap-filled ruins and more. Each movie mixes up gameplay with challenges, weapons, and setpieces. Dive under boulders, weave through laser grids and topple enormous bosses. Lose yourself in an immersive action experience in cinematic slow motion that lets you nail last-chance shots, deliver bruising punches, and dodge ninja stars just inches from your eyeballs. Play the Arcade Mode to transform the cinema experience into an arcadey score fest! No forced locomotion, no sudden drops, no artificial camera movement - Action Hero is a perfectly comfortable experience for VR veterans and newcomers alike.

title: FPS Chess: Ignition
description: Support the development of FPS Chess 2 and continued updates for FPS Chess with FPS Chess: Ignition, which includes a new reimagined version of the original map and the new "wooden" set of pieces with new weapons and abilities. The wooden piece set explores all sorts of new mechanics and dynamics between the pieces. Playing them is an all new experience completely different than the original set. You can also mix and match them with the other two existing piece sets to experience even more new matchups. Play Together Players who do not own FPS Chess: Ignition can always play with the new map and pieces by joining an online lobby of anyone who does own it. Developer Note FPS Chess always has been a student project that deserves much more stability and professionalism than it could be given, and the chance to explore all the amazing ideas of its community. That is why I am in the process of developing FPS Chess 2, a free and more stable rewrite of the original game with all sorts of continued content planned. FPS Chess: Ignition is my way of raising funds to develop the sequel while still giving something back to the community in the meantime. It is also my way of gauging interest on how many people are still hungry for more FPS Chess content. With these goals in mind, I'd like to note my intention in the future to roll the content of FPS Chess: Ignition into FPS Chess for free. If that happens, I also intend to recognize the amazing early supporters who helped fund the sequel through their purchase of FPS Chess: Ignition with exclusive in-game content within the sequel. Thank you! -Hadi, developer of FPS Chess

title: Pinball FX VR
description: This game supports the Steam Frame hardware only. Pinball FX VR brings the iconic franchise library to life with the ultimate ‘80s arcade atmosphere - now fully immersive in virtual reality! Huge Pinball Library - The game comes with three amazing tables. Delve into the shadows of the big city, explore ancient, secret tombs, and hunt for treasure on Pinball Noir, Curse of the Mummy, and Sky Pirates: Treasures of the Clouds. Additionally, you can purchase tables from the franchise’s extensive library from tables inspired by the biggest brands in entertainment to timeless Williams Pinball classics. Global Campaign Mode - Take on the pinball world in Campaign Mode! Conquer the districts beating unique missions for special rewards. Pinball In Every Form - Enjoy classic gameplay or fun challenges while you climb the global leaderboards. Interactive Objects and Mini-Games - The VR arcade also includes mini-games and other arcade activities, like dartboards, vending machines, and interactive gadgets.

title: Arcade & Motel Simulator Together
description: DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST! Wishlist Arcade Motel Simulator to get notified the moment it launches! About the Game A MOTEL, AN ARCADE AND A LONG NIGHT AHEAD Take over a roadside motel with a neon arcade next door and turn it into the stop everyone remembers. Rent out rooms, keep the cabinets busy, feed the players and grow your business night after night, alone or with friends. RUN THE MOTEL Greet guests at the front desk, haggle over the price of a night and hand over the key. Clean up after they check out, watch your reviews and star rating, and upgrade your rooms from bare Economy to Standard and Deluxe. EIGHT ARCADE GAMES YOU CAN ACTUALLY PLAY Every cabinet in your hall is a real game: the retro 3D racer Turbo Rush , the snake battle Snake , the endless runner Neon Dash , the delivery chaos of Pizza Rush , the light-gun shooter Motel Guardian , Hoop Shot basketball, Air Hockey and the dance machine Step Fever . Customers drop in to play too. Collect the earnings, complete each game's challenges to boost your income, buy new machines and expand the hall. COOK AND SERVE Gamers get hungry. Grill the patties, melt the cheese, drop the fries, plate everything up and serve it at the tables, then pick up the cash they leave behind. YOUR RETRO TABLET Run the business from a handheld with a nostalgic early-2000s desktop look: check your rooms, open and close the arcade, track challenges and earnings, order new machines and keep an eye on the bills. THE DAY ENDS, THE BOOKS CLOSE When the sun goes down, the neon lights come on and the parking lot starts to fill up. At midnight you close the day and see where you stand: the cash that came in, the rooms you rented, the arcade's earnings and your star rating. Open rooms and machines cost money every night; good reviews grow your reputation, and your reputation brings more customers to your door the next day. And on rainy days, everyone heads straight for the arcade. PLAY TOGETHER Invite up to three friends through Steam. One works the front desk, another runs the kitchen, and when the night gets quiet you can settle the score over a round of air hockey.

title: Maximilien — A Psychological Horror Interactive Novel
description: The story An atmosphere of psychological horror. Boston, September 1926. You are Maximilien Cornwell, a psychology student. A darkened past, an unnameable presence, and a mounting unease take shape as the authorities close in on the man they are already calling the "Ogre of South Boston". Something that does not belong to daylight presses at the edges of your dreams. 110,000 words · 480 passages 12 possible endings · 16 achievements A branch-and-bottleneck structure, and 1,750 conditions weighing your choices and their consequences. A dense world A city in ferment, and tainted with it. The gridded boulevards of South Boston, where Prohibition holds on. The university corridors steeped in old paper and in a knowledge that goes beyond reason. Between the frailty of dreams, an inner truth coming to light, and a raw reality asserting itself, the border thins as you go. Every step opens branchings you did not suspect, and encounters that your conduct alone decides. The writing is dense, precise, demanding, fed by Lovecraft, Poe, and the French roman noir. What unsettles you is never what you are shown. The story is demanding. How you meet it is up to you. Built for immersion A many-branched story that remembers everything you do. A real investigation system: clues, an inventory, hunches, and an interactive map of Boston. Every item you collect can change what you understand, and what you decide. Your psychological state wears away at the interface: visual artifacts build up little by little and unsettle the page, without ever touching the words of the story. A timeline built on a day and night cycle: a limited number of actions, and what you do at night is taken out of the following day. Each day is a decision about what you pursue, and what you let go. A police suspicion system. An investigation runs in parallel to your own, and it forgets nothing. Some sixty illustrations, over two hours of original score and sound design, some twenty animated and interactive sequences. Difficulty settings, optional tutorials, control over visual effects, audio, and display. More than it shows Maximilien is a solo project, more than seven years in development, made by Yohan Dupuy and enriched by the contributions of professionals: Original score by Gaëtan Larant and Nicolas "Solynk" Thonney. Graphics and interface by Nicolas "Solynk" Thonney. English translation by Lucia Desogus. Technical Available in English and French. Playable on Windows and Linux. Keyboard and mouse. Approximate playtime: 2 to 5 hours per playthrough. Age rating: 16+ All text written by the author, English translation by a human translator. Content warning: psychological horror, themes of dissociation, occultism, criminal violence, mental illness. The investigation begins October 26, 2026… Add it to your wishlist now, and settle in for a rare literary experience.

title: Project Angels 2 - Visual Novel
description: Project Angels 2 is a Military Themed Visual Novel and the sequel  to the original Project Angels VN. Steel Waters and Apollyon—two warring factions of the ANGELS super soldiers have tormented the waters of the Indicus Ocean for years. Their maker, a Puppetmaster turned Savior, now aims to balance the two beliefs of liberty and stability, all while reuniting what was once whole under a new home. Main Character: Savior — The Commander-in-Chief of Steel Waters Savior is the narrator, the sole Commander-in-Chief of Steel Waters, and the creator of the A.N.G.E.L.S. super soldier program. Not much is known about Savior's past, except that Savior, who is not a member of the Waters family, somehow managed to take control of Steel Waters' private security company and its sister companies. All Savior has always cared about are the Angels. After waking up from a coma, the Steel Waters commander is committed to reuniting what has been fractured. Faction: Steel Waters The Angels of Steel Waters are the upholders of stability and the believers of Terra Nova Stability. Given the moniker of Azure Angels, they are the peacekeepers of the Indicus Ocean. The Azures hunt pirates in the name of peace and stability. Some say the Azure Angels are heroes—the guardians of peace and the modern-day standard of living. However, others see the Azures as nothing but the defenders of the exploitative side of the modern economy. The Steel Waters Characters: Codename: Anna K. Anna Konstantinovna Waters. A second-to-none Angel warrior. Anna appears to be a straightforward fighter who does her job very well. However, her firm belief in stability makes her a double-edged weapon, defying friends or foes who threaten the stability of the home of the Angels. For an unknown reason, Anna's 3rd callsign "Waters" has always been and will always be a closely guarded secret. Codename: Vuur Vuur is the leader of the Hellfighters armored Angels. She is one of the oldest Angels and a special forces veteran of many successes and failures. Vuur seems to be wise beyond her age. However, just like Savior, she too has too many worries and doubts about too many things. Still, the humility of Vuur and Savior doesn't stop their subordinates from idolizing them. Codename: Vendetta Vendetta is Anna's most silly bestie. Some think of her as a comic relief character, and she takes it as a compliment. She never lets her gloomy friends, who can only think about ideals and duty, ruin her vibe. That's all known about this mischievous bundle of mischief, or is it? Codename: Omega Omega is the General of Steel Waters Marines. She was once seen as the strongest Angel until Anna took the title. Despite Omega's large, muscular, and imposing stature, these days she prefers to solve her problems with dialogue. Her days of throwing punches and going berserk are mostly over. Still, do not get on her nerves; her old habits of solving problems with punches may die hard and Omega has good muscle memory. Codename: Xaviera Xaviera is the General of the Steel Waters Homeguard. She is perhaps more of a money expert than a military general. However, without this military economist, Omega and Savior would be fighting their wars with a great budget deficit. And wars tend to be harder to win when one has very little money. Faction: Apollyon Apollyon is a pirate congregation of rebelling Angel supersoldiers. They call themselves the Sanguine Angels, the executors of freedom and liberty, and the seekers of a new home that would truly last for an eternity. Some say the Sanguines are just cruel pirates and smugglers—criminals who take what's not theirs and move goods illegally for profit. However, others see Sanguines as freedom fighters who stand against the exploitative world powers while bringing food and resources to the embargoed populace in need. The Apollyon Characters: Zero Zero , the always scheming leader of Sanguine Angels. She is a self-proclaimed nihilist. Nil. Nothing. She sees that true freedom requires life to be free of any assigned meanings. Free of expectations. Free of controls. Free of chains. And under her guidance, the Sanguine Angels of Apollyon fight to achieve their promised freedom and liberty Zero is obsessed with Savior despite her claims that nothing matters; to her, Savior clearly does matter. Also, she is obsessed with nuclear weapons, so evidently, nukes also matter to her. Cipher Cipher is Zero's temperamental twin. Unlike her twin sister, Cipher is more brawn than brain. Revenge, justice, finding purpose through struggle, and surpassing her twin sister are some of Cipher's obsessions. Sometimes, Cipher's desire to escape the shadow of the revered Zero makes this "inferior" twin act before thinking. If Cipher is given an important mission—a chance to outshine Zero—she would rarely refuse it, even if she doesn't fully believe in the mission. Cipher is by no means content with being Zero's second-in-command. Faction: Rosemeria The Rosemeria Character: Princess Rossa Rosemeria Rossa is the leader of Rosemeria—a special autonomous region of the country of UIA. Long ago, the kingdom of Rosemeria was integrated into UIA following the ancient UIA-Rosemerian war. Despite decades of relatively peaceful coexistence between Rosemeria and UIA, grievances over the new hyper-patriotic UIA administration may reopen old wounds. Today, as UIA continues to decline and Rosemeria remains in the uptrend, some begin to suspect that the princess might be plotting to destroy UIA so her realm could regain independence.

title: FPV PVP
description: FPV PVP takes the tense, round-based tactical shooting you know from games like Counter-Strike and rebuilds it around fast, agile FPV racing drones. Instead of running and gunning on foot, you fly. Master your quadcopter, hold the angles, plant or defuse, and out-fly the enemy team in pure skill-based combat. This is a competitive FPV drone shooter for Windows PC. Pilot with a real RC transmitter (with full calibration), a gamepad (Xbox or PlayStation), or keyboard and mouse. TWO FLIGHT MODELS Arcade: self-leveling and beginner-friendly, so you can jump straight into the fight. Acro: rate-based flight that delivers the true FPV feel for pilots who want full control. GAME MODES 5v5 Bomb Defusal: round-based, CS-style objective play with plant and defuse, a buy economy between rounds, and bomb carry. Team Deathmatch: fast, respawning team combat. 1v1 Ranked Duel: first to 5 rounds, with sudden death when it's close. TWO ARENAS Substation: a tight industrial A/B-site arena of crates, containers and cover. Sandstorm: an open desert outpost built for fast, aggressive flying. Both are designed for true three-dimensional combat, where threats come from above and below, not just ahead. COMPETITIVE RANKED PLAY Two separate ranked ladders (5v5 and 1v1) with global leaderboards. Climb through 17 rank grades from Bronze I up through Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master and Elite, powered by an Elo system with hidden MMR. Complete 5 placement matches to earn your rank, then compete across seasons (with inactivity decay) to prove where you stand. BUY MENU AND ECONOMY Spend your earnings on a Rifle, SMG, Sniper or Shotgun, deploy a kamikaze Bomb-Drone, and pick up armor to survive the next engagement. TALK TO YOUR TEAM Built-in voice chat with team comms and 3D proximity voice, so you can hear enemy drones buzz past. Per-player mute lives right in the scoreboard. ONLINE AND OFFLINE Browse an internet lobby list, invite friends with codes, form parties, and play over LAN with automatic discovery. Prefer to warm up solo? Practice against AI bots in single-player. BUILT FOR COMPETITION Server-authoritative hit registration with lag compensation, host migration, reconnect support, killcam, kill feed, scoreboard, minimap and spectator mode keep matches fair and readable. Your career is cloud-saved and follows your account across devices. RUNS ON ALMOST ANYTHING Graphics scale from high-end rigs all the way down to old, low-end PCs: an auto-detect picks a sane preset on first launch, with manual tiers down to a bare-minimum mode. WHY EARLY ACCESS? FPV PVP is launching in Early Access because the core competitive experience is ready to play, but we want to build the rest of the game alongside our community. The full mode lineup, ranked ladders, flight models, economy and netcode are already in. During Early Access we'll be expanding the map pool, refining balance, and adding content based on player feedback. Jumping in now means you help shape where the game goes.

title: iRacing® Studios NASCAR 26
description: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26. Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase! And, with all the laser scanned assets of iRacing, the level of authenticity has never been higher with dynamic track, an all new peak performance training mode, and enhanced driving physics across every chassis. And, with our new cross-play multiplayer feature, you can take on all your friends and show them who's best! NASCAR 26 brings all the thrills and excitement of race day, right to your living room. Are you ready to start your engine?

title: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
description: BUILD, GROW STRONGER, SURVIVE There is no truly safe place in the middle of a broken world. That’s why you must create your own. Use what you can find in abandoned structures, deep within the forest, and throughout the world around you to build a shelter that can keep you alive. Start with a simple cabin and gradually turn it into a stronger, larger, and more livable base. Organize your shelter, craft the items you need, create a place to rest, and prepare for the dangers that come with the night. But remember: this world does not belong to you. If you want to stay alive, hiding will not be enough. Every piece you collect, every fire you light, and every wall you build will determine your chances of survival. FIGHT TOGETHER WHEN THE FOG ROLLS IN Time passes, the weather changes, and every new day turns into a new struggle for survival. In a 24-hour day and night cycle, gather resources, reinforce your shelter, and prepare for the threats ahead. The direction of the wind can change, rain can suddenly begin to fall, and dense fog can completely destroy your visibility. But the fog is not only a part of nature; it is also a warning sign of one of the greatest dangers. When visibility drops, zombies can become more aggressive and attack from within the darkness and fog. Try to survive alone or fight against this dangerous world with up to 4-player co-op support. Explore together, defend together, build together, and fight to stay alive. SURVIVE WITH WHAT YOU HUNT, GROW, AND FIND Hunger is just as ruthless as the dangers waiting outside. To survive, you will need more than weapons and shelter; you will need food. Search abandoned places for supplies, make use of the resources nature provides, and find a way to feed yourself. In the forest, you can hunt animals such as deer, process their meat, cook it over a fire, and eat it. But ready-to-eat food will not always be available. Work the soil, plant vegetables such as tomatoes, grow your crops, and use the ingredients you gather to prepare more nutritious meals. From a simple bite to a warm bowl of soup, every meal you make will directly affect your struggle to survive.

title: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal
description: Legendary Warriors In this game we will all know and follow the story of the legendary mercenary warrior Lancelot, the ancestor of the legendary warrior Vasaltis, all chapters will be offered for free as long as they are developed by their developer and included through updates (only the first ones available for now due to the initial release) An Untold Story Every time you complete a stage you will see a new epic cinematic that will follow and tell an epic war between the dark army and the human forces, but like never before... unexpected things will happen... Ultra Deep Gameplay Probably the deepest learning curve ever created for a hack and slash game, you will have to fight against learning combos and use them with a great strategy depending on the position of your enemies, but to adapt this complex system to all types of players, you can choose the difficulty level to enjoy the game perfectly even if you do not want to master this complex system or choose the most difficult one to evolve your skills and prepare for the online mode while playing the Story mode. Heavy Metal Music for stages sung and composed by the developer with his electric guitar and Orchestral Music made by other artists for cinematics. Enjoy epic music while playing to enjoy every cut you make on your enemies and enjoy all the cinematics at the highest level while you are completely immersed in the game with an impressive soundtrack that gives you a lot of fun and immersion. Action, Satire And Love This story and its cinematics are not like the rest of the games, here you will see everything that you could not expect, normally the games focus only on action or suspense stories, but this unifies all types of film genres, telling you an untold story about legendary warriors but like never before... A New Online Mode For The Gaming Industry Here the best will always win, but meanwhile the other players control the others, what will you choose? Your name will always be the protagonist! And your comments too! Any movement counts! Combined war or psychological battle? you will choose how to be the protagonist of the room... Fully Connected Online Mode With this online mode you will find rooms as fast as possible if someone is playing this game or the previous one, all the players will play in the same online mode and can fight each other on any platform, and while you play in the Story mode of either of the two, the game will find rooms to play if another player is playing in the online mode or if you are looking for an online game in any hack and slash fury game, all the players will be connected on the same servers and rooms. Random Atmosphere For The Stages. Choose between darkness or fog, or retro, then the stage textures will change every time you restart the stage or enter a new one, giving you a lot of replayability. Memorable Characters You will remember each one, each one has their own personality and preferences, their original design, objectives and philosophies, no one is the same as the others, each one was forged by their past, and looking for their future. Third Person Camera View or First Person Camera View You can change the camera zoom by pressing a button! Choose whoever you want, there are many! Compatible with mouse+keyboard or any gamepad. This game works perfectly with any gamepad if you have Steam input enabled, this will make it work perfectly with the game, or with mouse+keyboard if you don't want to use a gamepad. More Information This game is the prequel to Hack And Slash Fury, made only with love by its developer juan_poder_azure with no improvements compared to the previous game, because no one is better than the rest, and everything is loved and cared for by him.  Season 1 (Chapter 1, 2 and 3)(Available)(This is the beginning of the Story mode, in these chapters we will know what happens just when the great war begins) (The following seasons with the chapters included will be developed if the developer has the motivation and enough time to be able to create them since they take a huge amount of work, these will include new chapters of the story mode with new cinematics, scenarios and songs made by its developer for scenarios and other artists for cinematics, with this the player will advance in the story mode, while any player can play the online mode that connects Hack And Slash Fury 1 with Hack And Slash Fury 2 so as not to separate the player base, and fight between both in the same room, for players who want to have the complete game immediately it is recommended to buy Hack and Slash Fury 1 while waiting for more seasons of Hack And Slash Fury 2 (the following seasons may have a price between €2.99 and €4.99 unless they are all included at the same time at a higher price)

title: Frisky Phone: College Casual
