title: Lootbox Inc.: The TCG Card Battler
description: Make the Numbers Go Up! Welcome to Lootbox Inc. , a TCG roguelike where simple mechanics lead to ridiculous combinations! Choose your LootTheme, build your deck, and take on tournaments against challenging opponents or decks created by other players. With simple mechanics and countless ways to combine them, how far can you push your strategy? So Much Loot. So Many Possibilities! Discover a growing collection of cards, items, and unique effects that can completely change how you play. Each LootTheme brings its own cards, mechanics, and playstyles. Build around a single strategy, mix different collections, or experiment with combinations no one has tried before! Stack Combos. Break the Numbers!!! Play your cards, trigger unique effects, and watch your carefully crafted synergies turn into ridiculous damage! Every tournament is a new challenge. Beat the target score, overcome special rules, or test your deck against another player's creation in asynchronous battles. No timers, no pressure. Just you, your strategy, and increasingly absurd numbers. Open. Upgrade. Repeat. Open lootboxes and boosters, discover new loot, and turn your build into something even stronger. Fuse cards or itens into more powerful versions, enhance them with upgrades, and discover special LootStyles that change the game. Every new piece of loot is another opportunity to make your build stronger! Unlock New Ways to Play! Choose a Champion and equip Perks to shape your strategy before each run. Unlock new possibilities as you progress, experiment with different combinations, and discover new ways to approach every challenge. There is no single perfect strategy. Find your own way to break the game!

title: Choban: Open World Shepherd Survival
description: About This Game Choban: Open World Shepherd is a relaxing yet challenging open-world shepherd simulation where every journey across the mountains becomes a story of survival. Start each morning by gathering your flock in the village and lead them safely to the highlands. Explore vast valleys, forests, rivers, and mountain trails while protecting your animals from wolves, harsh weather, and unexpected dangers. As the sun sets, bring every sheep safely back home before night falls. Built with a living world, dynamic weather, and seamless region-based environments, every playthrough offers a unique adventure. Your choices, routes, and management of the flock determine your success. Features 🐑 Lead and manage your own flock 🌄 Explore a beautiful open world inspired by real landscapes 🐺 Protect your animals from predators and environmental hazards 🌧️ Experience dynamic weather and seasonal changes 🏕️ Discover villages, forests, rivers, and mountain plateaus 🐕 Work together with your loyal shepherd dog 🌙 Complete daily herding routines from sunrise to sunset 📦 Gather resources and improve your equipment 🎯 Dynamic quests and world events 🌍 Region-based world generation powered by the Artevren platform Mature Content Description This game contains mild depictions of animal attacks, survival elements, and combat against wild animals. No graphic violence or gore is present. Why You'll Love Choban Whether you enjoy peaceful exploration, strategic resource management, or immersive survival gameplay, Choban offers a unique blend of shepherd life and open-world adventure. Every sunrise begins a new journey—and every sunset is a race to bring your flock home safely.

title: FRAGLINE: Esports Manager
description: Every round is decided before it starts. By the players you signed, the roles you gave them, the utility you drew on the map, and the call your IGL makes at 1:55. FRAGLINE is a deep esports management sim. Take over an org nobody rates, build a roster, write your own playbook, and drag the team out of open qualifiers and onto the Major stage. Every round is played out by a full tactical AI engine that reads your setups, your utility and your roles, and punishes you when they are wrong. Most management games roll the dice and hand you a number. FRAGLINE plays the round out. Ten agents move through a real map, hold the angles you told them to hold, throw the utility you drew, and lose the site when your setup was thin on the wrong side. What you watch on screen is what decided the scoreline, so every loss has a reason you can go back and find. Every agent thinks for itself. What it has seen, what it heard, what it believes the enemy is doing. Your in-game leader makes macro calls off that belief model, never off perfect information. Duels resolve from real attributes. Aim, reflexes, positioning and discipline, plus dedicated mechanics for Flick, Tracking, Spray Control and Movement. A flicker and a tracker win different fights. Utility is physical. Smokes are volumes, flashes and molotovs respect walls and floors, and a mistimed nade blinds your own entry fragger. Watch it your way. Follow every round live on a clean 2D radar view, or skip straight to the result with a fast resolver that still reads your tactics. This is not a slider. You open the map, pick a role slot, and draw where that player walks, where he holds, and where his smoke lands. Save it as a set, and at freeze time your team runs it. When it falls apart you can see exactly which player was standing where, and go back and fix the line yourself. A whole season can turn on one A execute you finally got right. Draw executes on the map itself. Per role slot, per phase: walk paths, hold angles, crossing lanes, stances and waits. Place utility by hand. Line the smoke up from the throwing spot to the target. The team buys it, walks to the spot, and throws it in the match. Tag by side and intent. Execute, control, retake, anti-rush, post-plant. Your IGL pulls from the book at freeze time, and you can override the call yourself. Twelve tactical dials on top. Tempo, entry discipline, freedom, mid control, retake policy, save behaviour, utility usage and more. Every one is wired to real engine behaviour, not a hidden percentage. The book keeps score. Every set tracks its own win rate from matches and scrims, so you find out which A execute on Mirage actually works. Share it. Export a single set, a map book or your entire playbook to a one-line code or a file. Import a friend's. Trade playbooks with the community. The nineteen year old you pulled out of an open qualifier is not a stat block waiting to be maxed out. He has a ceiling you cannot see, a personality that decides how he takes a benching, a first language that may not match the rest of the room, and maybe five good years in him. Your job is to find him early, point his training at the right thing, and know when to sell. Attributes on a 1 to 100 scale with a hidden potential ceiling that development pushes against and never breaks. Nobody becomes a five star just by grinding. Three growth channels. The yearly age curve, daily training, and skill points earned from matches and sessions that you spend attribute by attribute. Or hand the budget to your coach. Roles are side specific. Five T roles, seven CT roles, per-map deviations, and a five star aptitude rating for each one built from stats and match experience. Hidden personality axes drive ambition, loyalty, professionalism, temper and adaptability. They shape negotiations, unrest, dressing room reactions and how a player takes bad news. Language matters. 53 nationalities with real language tables. Team chemistry is built on a shared tongue and personality fit, and an international roster that cannot talk to each other plays measurably worse. Rare traits. Aggressors who snowball off entry frags, anchors who refuse to leave their site, egoists who take the fight alone. And the very rare wonderkid. Age is undefeated. Veterans decline and retire. The good ones come back to your building as a coach, analyst or mentor. Over 7,000 players are out there and you cannot see most of them properly. Scouts bring back bands, not numbers, and the report is only as sharp as the analyst who wrote it. When you finally move, you sit at a negotiation table against an agent who knows exactly how much your rivals are offering. And every deal is paid for out of one pot: whatever you hand to wages is money you no longer have to buy anyone. Selling is half the game. Rival clubs watch your roster and put real offers on the table for the players who are outgrowing you, and a title winning season is the fastest way to get your star poached. Take the fee and rebuild, or hold him for one more Major run and watch his contract wind down to nothing. Scouting with real fog of war. You only know what your scouts have seen. Attributes show as bands until a player is properly known, and an unscouted signing is a gamble you take with your own money. A live transfer market. Search the whole world by role, age, potential, region, attribute floors, fee and wage ceilings. Save your searches and get told when new names match them. Negotiate for real. Fees, wages, contract length and a 24 clause contract book: release clauses, buyouts, loyalty bonuses, appearance and title bonuses. Every clause is read by the engine later. Offers come in as well as out. AI clubs bid for your best players, list a player for sale to bring the buyers in, and decide whether the fee is worth the hole it leaves in your lineup. Free agents, expiring deals and pre-contracts. Sign a star on a free transfer if you spot the expiry before anyone else does, or lose one of yours the same way. One budget, split by you. The board gives you a pot and you decide how much goes to wages and how much stays available for fees. Both are hard caps. Nobody bails you out. Income you have to build. Sponsor deals with conditional bonus objectives, merchandise revenue driven by how famous your players actually are, and prize money from the events you win. A full ledger. Weekly wage runs, transfer fees, staff salaries, bonus payouts and a cash runway that tells you how many months you have left at this burn rate. Your results do not disappear into a table. FRAGLINE ships with a working esports news site inside the game, and it writes about your world. You lose a Major qualifier and read the headline the next morning. You sign a nineteen year old nobody has heard of and the scene notices. It covers the teams you are chasing too, so the league always has a story running, whether you are in it or not. A full in-game esports media portal. Front page, breaking news, match reports, event pages, world rankings, team and player profiles. Written from what actually happened. Your signings, your upsets, your collapses, your retirements. Rivals get covered too, and you read about a title race you are not in. Every name is a link into your save. Click a club, read the roster, click a player, open his file. One world model. Rankings, prize money, tournament archives and hall of fame records all read from the same simulation you are playing. Five good players are not a team yet. Somebody has to run the practice week, read the opponent, keep the room together and get everyone to the venue with something left in the tank. Every seat you fill and every day you book between match days is a decision that shows up on the server later. A staff department that is actually read by the engine. Head coach, assistants, analysts, scouts, performance coaches, psychologists and mentors, each with attributes, traits and coaching licences that change what your team gets. A better analyst is a better opponent report. A living calendar. Leagues, open and closed qualifiers, tiered tournaments and Majors, with a map veto phase you can automate or play out yourself. The week between matches. Training plans, bootcamps, individual drills, team talks, media duties, dressing room events, and a relationship system that remembers the player you sold. Club legacy. Records, historic rosters, a hall of fame, and a wall of names that outlives the players who earned them. Every save generates its own scene from a seed. Different players, different clubs, different careers about to happen in places you will never look. You start at the bottom of it. A scene of 1,200 clubs and 53 nationalities, every player generated fresh for each save. A full career from tier five obscurity to the Major stage, one match day at a time. 13 languages: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean. No aim. No reflexes. Just the roster, the playbook, and 24 rounds to prove you were right. Build the org, write the playbook, live with the call. FRAGLINE is a deep esports management sim with a tactical match engine that plays your hand-drawn sets, players who grow and fade on their own terms, and a living media scene that reports every result.

title: No Socks RPG
description: A Charming J-RPG inspired NSFW game! On an island where you play as Socks ,  A Dog-Girl swimming teacher who got her favorite outfits snatched by some weird dudes! Teacher clothes, Casual Weekend fits, Swimsuits and more sexy outfits ! Socks has a wide variety of unlockable outfits! Each one highlights a different side of our dog girl's personality. Use her outfits to unlock spicy scenes during her adventure! Five cute guys; five different outcomes! Depending on your outfit, Socks can warm them up to something a bit more exciting than just swimming. Fetch all your outfits back from those troublemakers to see them through! There's some kooky, sexy girls to meet! They'll help Socks on her quest - fighting with her to help save the isles of which they call home! Learn to time their attacks in battle. Use both your heads; and help the girls beat up their enemies! If you're into sexy J-RPG's or Monster Girls then wishlist our game! Play as our werewolf Socks , and take a vacation off to the Magical Isles . No socks required.

title: Botter - Idle Dungeon Crawler
description: Botter is an Idle / Incremental Dungeon Crawler. Create your character and define a build, send it into a dungeon (it will likely get slaughtered), equip the loot you find, add some spells to your arsenal and go again. Over 20 biomes across 5 tiers, you need to find a working build and maybe you can progress into the hell that is the endgame endless mode.

title: GAARL! - Gabe's Action Arcade RogueLike DEMO
description: GABE'S ACTION ARCADE ROGUELIKE! GAARL! is a difficult roguelike action platformer for 1–4 players. Wield your chain gun to fight monsters, or fire it into walls to climb through dank dungeons, sterile suburbs, and beyond. Buy upgrades, get good health insurance, and unlock the mysteries of GABE'S ACTION ARCADE ROGUELIKE! Simple Mechanics Your only tool is a chain gun: shoot it at enemies to deal damage, aim it at anything else to deploy a climbable chain. Retrieve your chains, and manage your ammo carefully. High Skill Ceiling Learn the enemies and environments, and manage your positioning carefully. Engage with a powerful perk system that offers qualitative changes to the way that you play. Hire private security, wield magical swords, release predatory lady bugs, cover your body in spikes, drink the blood of your foes! DEMO Features Tough as nails arcade action with permadeath 20 handcrafted levels 2 distinct zones featuring unique enemies, challenges, and environmental hazards 20+ game warping perks Local co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players 3 unlockable characters with unique traits Your time is your own! All meta progression content can be unlocked at any time Supports Low% play - no grinding or incremental stat increases!

title: Hackagon: Cyber Card Battler
description: OUTTHINK THE OTHER SIDE. PLAY ONLINE FOR FREE. HACKAGON is a free-to-play 1v1 cyber card battler built around simultaneous turns. Commit your cards before either side can react, read the plan hidden across the network, and seize control when every play reveals together. Jump into online play for free. Queue for Ranked or Casual matchmaking, browse public lobbies, or create a private room for a direct challenge. Prefer to learn the system first? Fight adaptive AI before taking your deck online. Against the AI, Topology mode turns adjacency into a changing network graph. Energy rises each turn, giving you more ways to spread pressure, reinforce a lead, or bait the other side. Most battles revolve around three contested areas, but the shape of the network can change. Stage your cards, revise the plan while the turn is open, then commit. Rules such as Honeypot, Air-Gapped, Quarantine, and Fortified keep every board tactically distinct. Every card combines cost, power, and a tactical effect. DDoS floods an area and cuts enemy power, Worm spreads into adjacent areas, and Threat Mirror copies the strongest opposing card at its location. Effects resolve in a clear sequence, so a clever setup can overturn raw numbers and a single well-read turn can reshape the entire match. Choose Red offense or Blue defense, then build a 12-card deck from a growing pool of 60 Red, Blue, and neutral cards. Unlock agents with always-on abilities that shape how a deck plays before the first card is committed. Specialize in tempo, shields, disruption, scaling, or combine them into a plan of your own. Enter FARADAY operations, receive CIPHER transmissions, and trace a threat moving through networks that should be dead. Mission paths introduce bespoke objectives, rewards, opponents, and rule combinations, turning the same competitive systems into authored tactical encounters. EVERYTHING IN THE NETWORK 60 cards across Red, Blue, and neutral pools, with more on the way A growing roster of unlockable agents with always-on abilities Free-to-play online 1v1 with Ranked, Casual, public, and private play Focused classic boards and changing network topologies Adaptive solo AI and story operations with CIPHER transmissions Play with mouse and keyboard or a controller, with Xbox and PlayStation button prompts

title: Couch PVP
description: 2 to 8 players, one screen COUCH PVP is a local split-screen arena shooter. Pick a mode, grab a controller each (keyboard welcome), and the match begins. Games are short, timed, and always end the same way: a podium, a stats board, and a rematch one button away. Easy to pick up — even for people who never play Every mode is explained in one sentence, shown before kickoff. Per-player aim assist : magnetic aiming and more forgiving shots. Beginners turn it on, veterans leave it off — and the match stays close. The controls fit on a single screen shown at launch: move, jump, shoot. Someone running late? A free controller is all it takes to join mid-game. 11 modes, from simple to devious Team vs Team , King of the Hill , Football : rules that fit in one sentence. Sticky Bomb : an explosive hot potato passed on contact. Juggernaut : one overpowered boss against everyone — take them down, take their place. Paintball : painted territory is the score. Zone Capture , Heist! , TYCOON WAR : control, plunder and sabotage for the strategists. Infection : every victim joins the pack. Zombie Co-op : the cooperative mode — everyone together against the zombie waves. Tournament chains rounds together with mode and map votes, wagers and point multipliers. 10 maps with signature events A train barrels through the station, the tide redraws the island, a rocket lifts off mid-match, a bull charges across the farm. Every map has its signature event, ready to shuffle the deck at the worst possible moment — taking the lead is not enough, you have to last. The end of the match is part of the game A 3D podium, a stats wall, and a badge for everyone — from ON FIRE to PUNCHING BAG. The match history keeps your last 20 podiums , viewable from the menu: the scores stay, the arguments do not. For every living room 30 languages. Accessibility options: colorblind modes, reduced flashes and screen shake, adjustable rumble and interface, remappable keys, per-player sensitivity. Designed with the Steam Deck in mind. Remote Play Together : one copy of the game is enough to play online with friends. Ready when you are Add COUCH PVP to your wishlist — and when game night comes, count controllers, not explanations.

title: Colonerra Age of Exploration
description: Are you ready to set sail into the unknown and lead your people to glory? Accept your appointment as His Majesty’s Viceroy of the New World. Take command of your country's finest men during the Age of Exploration . Discover the mysteries of this distant, uncharted land to the west. Build, trade, rule . Outwit your rivals. Outlast the storms. Quell the discontent. Govern with authority. Establish yourself as the father of a new nation and guide it to its full potential. Fortune may favor the bold, but the New World buries the unprepared. Will you forge an independent nation that can withstand the judgment of history… or will it crumble to ruin and disappear? Your trailblazing expeditions will uncover and chart hidden lands. Equip them for success, train them for the unknown. Let them bring you tales of majestic natural wonders, legendary riches, and fertile lands ready for settlement. Let them follow the trail of ancient legends and conquer cities of gold. Every single expedition is a venture into the unknown. Will you unveil the secrets of the New World… or watch others claim them first? Your colonies may have humble beginnings, but they gleam with potential. If only you could gather exotic resources before the autumn rains, if only you could construct a warehouse big enough to store them all in time. See that the rum is packed and ready before the merchant ship arrives. Every colony tells a unique story, just as every journey shapes a nation. Will you transform a handful of frontier outposts into a thriving nation… or succumb to the ravages of time? The King may claim the New World as his own, but it is far from empty. Diverse indigenous nations are watching your every move with curiosity and suspicion. Send missionaries, build trust, complete their quests, or challenge their claim to their ancestral lands. Friendship and conquest leave very different marks on history. Will you earn their trust… or seize their lands? Trading is undoubtedly the lifeblood of every colonial economy, but it is a perilous craft. Sail your ships across the Atlantic, negotiate with every passing merchant fleet, or barter with indigenous nations. Send your smugglers to move goods beyond the Crown's reach to avoid His Majesty's ever-growing taxes. As your trading empire expands, prices fall, smuggling becomes more difficult, and pirates grow ever bolder, leaving you constantly struggling to stay profitable. Will you build an empire on trade… or watch your economy collapse? You may not seek war, but you must endure it if the King declares it. Protect your colonies as you brace for the conflict. Your King's European ambitions might plunge the whole New World into a war any day now.  Muster your militia. Have your master sergeant train your troops. Fortify frontier settlements with a sturdy palisade before the spring arrives. Prepare your men for sudden raids. Be cautious in preparation and prompt and sudden in execution. Will your colonies endure the coming firestorm… or fall prey to the ambitions of rival empires? With each coin that builds your wealth, the pirates' lust for plunder grows ever faster. They may raid coastal settlements, prey on shipping lanes, harass your settlers, and spread dread all across the New World. Cast fear aside. Hunt them down. Send them to Davy Jones's locker. The sea rewards only those strong enough to command it. Will you break the power of the pirate captains… or watch your future be plundered by the scourge of the seas? Feel the call of freedom rise with every decision you make, every colony you settle, every building you erect. Shape the future of the New World with every social policy, champion your just cause in the town halls, appoint Founding Fathers, assemble the Colonial Congress, and carve your place in history by founding a nation unlike any other. Every nation begins with a single dot on a map. Will yours become a nation worthy of independence… or crumble before it has the chance to leave its mark? Your King has given you a mission. History will judge what you make of it. A New World awaits. KEY FEATURES ✓ Historical Turn-Based 4X Strategy ✓ Explore a vast New World ✓ Build and expand thriving colonies ✓ Master a dynamic colonial economy ✓ Trade across the Atlantic ✓ Negotiate with indigenous nations ✓ Respond to the King's demands and taxation ✓ Wage war against rival colonial powers ✓ Defend against pirate raids ✓ Appoint Founding Fathers and assemble the Colonial Congress ✓ Declare independence and forge a new nation

title: RV Life Sim
description: You are no longer a child. It's time to leave home, and all you have is your grandfather's old RV. Answer the call of the open road. RV Life Sim is an open-world nomad survival adventure that brings together long-distance drives, wilderness exploration, and a mobile crafting economy. Work, earn money, craft, sell, trade, and survive! Chase the horizon, discover new cities, camp under the stars, head down to the city to buy new clothes or camping gear from the shopping mall, and build a self-sufficient life over time. KEY FEATURES 🛣️ Your Home on Wheels and the Open Road Start your adventure by transforming an inherited old RV into your home on the road. Plan long routes across changing climates, keep your engine and mechanical parts in working order, and manage your fuel, food, rest, and trade throughout your journey. 🛠️ Craft, Trade, Survive Every kilometer has a cost, so turn your RV into your own business. Gather raw materials from nature, buy cheap resources like waste oil from towns, refine them into fuel, craft products inside your RV, and manage your cash, fuel, and supplies by trading with towns. Work to earn, or craft and trade to win! 🔧 Upgrade, Expand, Renew Reinvest the money you earn back into your RV. Add interior decorations, expand your storage space, and boost your engine for rough terrains. Once you save up enough, replace your grandfather's old RV with a newer model. 🛍️ Shop, Find Your Style Head to the city to buy new shoes and clothes from the shopping mall, and decorate your RV exactly to your taste. 🌲 Camp Under the Stars When the sun sets, set up camp anywhere you want in the vast wilderness. Pitch your tent, cook meals with what you've gathered, rest under the stars, and wake up to a brand-new horizon every single morning, featuring stunning, uninterrupted vistas that stretch as far as the eye can see. --- 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 A FAMILY-FRIENDLY JOURNEY RV Life Sim offers a peaceful, relaxing, and wholesome simulation designed for players of all ages. With no intense violence or stress, it is a perfect experience to enjoy at your own pace, making it suitable for the entire family. 🚗 FUTURE CO-OP ROAD TRIPS While the initial release focuses entirely on a polished single-player experience, a multiplayer Co-op mode is actively planned for future updates. You will be able to invite your friends, manage your RV together, and share the ultimate road trip adventure!

title: Horror Mahjong
description: May the Mahjong God watch over us tonight. A mahjong table waits for you in the middle of the room. Cold drafts creep in from all four sides. You start to play, then hear something behind you. Are you sure you want to look...? Play your hand. Stay alive. Draw, discard, pong, kong, win—take the win when you can. Shoot, slash, chop, thrust, blast—kill every ghost you can. You watch the tiles. I'll watch your back. Play around the table with friends and cover each other. When the monsters come, grab a gun, swing a peachwood sword, or throw a mahjong tile if you have to. Stock up, revive fallen teammates, and make it through the night. You can also play with computer tablemates. Dress up for the next round Create your own character: pick a hairstyle, put together an outfit, and choose your colors. At least you'll look good in the screenshots when you go down. Kongoto presents.

title: Lineup, Dark Lord! : Auto Battler
description: Lead your Demon Army! "Line Up, Dark Lord!" is a casual deck-building game where you build your own Demon army lineup to push back the enemy. Create the ultimate monster combination and stand at the top of the Underworld once again! Assemble your Demon Army! 👾 Build Your Ultimate Demon Army Deck! Combine unique monsters to create a one-of-a-kind, ultimate deck. ⚔️ The 'One-Line' Placement Strategy That Decides Victory! Battles take place on a single line! Carefully decide the order of your monsters to trigger perfect synergies. 🧪 Ultra-Fast Monster Fusion System! Fuse monsters to acquire higher-tier monsters faster and instantly boost your combat power! 🏆 Brawl in the Arena to Find the Ultimate Champion! Break free from constraints, mix and match traits, and engage in real duels with users worldwide! Unique Skills Based on Elements and Traits! Combine the unique traits and skills of each monster to break through the enemy lines.

title: MECCHA HORROR
description: WELCOME TO MECCHA HORROR! TWO DIFFERENT GAMES. PAINT TO WIN OR PAINT TO SURVIVE. RELAX AND PAINT TO WIN Paint your way through a RELAXING PAINTING ROGUELITE in Singleplayer or Multiplayer where every level gets harder, new enemies and bosses emerge, every timer gets shorter, and every run makes you stronger! SCREAM AND PAINT TO SURVIVE Descend into a CO-OP HORROR SURVIVAL with 2-4 players where painting is no longer about winning, IT IS ABOUT SURVIVING! OUTPAINT YOUR “FRIENDS” TO WIN Battle your “friend” in painting PvP through increasingly difficult challenges in the same environment under the same clock, earning upgrades and curses that punish them on their next rounds! PAINT WITH FRIENDS TO SURVIVE Run, paint, and hide your way through terrifying environments. Complete each map’s unique task, uncover the story, and grow stronger with every death! A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER Please ignore any voices you hear while playing MECCHA HORROR. They are lying. They are not real. There is no deeper story. There is no website. You are here to paint. You are here to have fun. ENJOY!

title: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
description: The Cup is a free 1v1 creature card battler, broadcast live. You coach a survivor and a line of three creatures. Every turn you play one card and make one attack, then the die TV decides how hard it lands while BroadcASH and BOBcast call it from the booth. Knock out all three of theirs and the match is yours. THE DIE DECIDES. YOU CHOSE THE DIE. Every creature is printed Safe, Swingy or Jackpot. Safe hits for the number on the card. Swingy rolls. Jackpot can miss outright, and a natural can wipe a creature off the board. You pick the risk when you draft, and everybody watches it land. There is no skip button, because the animations are the interface. EVERY CARD DOES EXACTLY WHAT IT SAYS Any of your creatures can hit any of theirs. No lanes and no hidden rules: the card is the rule, and the feed spells out every hit, reflect and knockout as it happens. A dome that hands damage straight back. A bee that stings once and goes to the Pit for it. Three a side, and three to six minutes a match once you know the rules. TONIGHT'S FIGHT CARD 59 contestants and 9 survivors from the United States, Canada and Mexico, every one a real animal or a cryptid, each with a checkable file THE ROAD: ten cases against invasive species in one run, with HALFTIME in the middle. Draft creatures and kits as you go, and a knockout is gone for the road Matches against the House, dealt or drafted, as many as you want Live 1v1 on Steam from the full release on December 3 Every match written to tape, with highlights and replays A shelf of mugs to earn, and a score composed in-house THE STATE OF THE BROADCAST Every painting on a card is commissioned from a human artist and credited on the card, one creature at a time, and the creatures still waiting wear placeholder art. The invaders are real photographs. Each survivor's kit is drawn from public-domain history, with its source on the card. The demo is out now: THE ROAD, the tutorial and matches against the House, offline. Card art by @chioart08, @prayogaardip, Ondřej Tichý, @tmcglynnart and Awesam. The game's text and voices are in English. A broadcast of the Galactic Athletics Commission.

title: Just Up: 2D Platformer
description: Just Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top... GAMEPLAY Jump across platforms and use your dash to reach the next one as you make your way upward. Plan your movement, time your jumps, and use your dash whenever you need that extra bit of distance to keep climbing. CHANGING ENVIRONMENTS The higher you climb, the more the world begins to change around you. Watch the sky shift from bright blue days to dark, star-filled nights as familiar objects slowly give way to increasingly unusual sights. Continue upward and leave the atmosphere behind on your journey to the top. FEATURES Automatic Checkpoints with 3 Save Slots Built-in Speedrun Timer Around 30 Minutes of Gameplay Support for 32 Languages 13 Music Tracks 26 Achievements Steam Leaderboards Steam Cloud Saves

title: Battle Bots Auto Battler
description: Battle Bots Auto Battler is a single-player robot autobattler where the decisions happen before the fighting starts. Assemble a squad of combat bots, customize them with upgrades, and send your build into battle. Once combat begins, your bots fight automatically  leaving you to see whether your decisions were enough to survive the next round. BUILD YOUR BOT SQUAD Build a team of up to three combat bots , each contributing different strengths to your lineup. Experiment with team compositions and adapt your squad as enemy encounters become increasingly dangerous. UPGRADE YOUR BUILD Earn Scrap during your run and spend it between rounds to improve your machines. Install upgrades such as Power Cores, Reinforced Plating, EMP Modules, and Multithreaded Chips to increase your bots' capabilities and create increasingly powerful combinations. Every purchase presents a choice: strengthen your current strategy, cover a weakness, or save your Scrap for something better. WATCH YOUR BUILD FIGHT Once the battle begins, your job is done. Your bots select targets, attack, expend energy, take damage, and use their installed upgrades automatically. Battles are the test of the team and build you've assembled. Watch a simple 1v1 grow into larger battles as additional bots join the fight. THREE WAYS TO PLAY 10 Round Gauntlet Build your squad across a structured 10-round run and survive increasingly difficult enemy teams. Endless There is no final round. Continue upgrading your squad as enemies become progressively stronger and see how long your build can survive. Sandbox Skip the pressure of a run and freely experiment with bots, upgrades, and loadouts. Test combinations and discover strategies to use in other modes. BUILD. BATTLE. ADAPT. Battle Bots Auto Battler is built around a straightforward loop: Fight → Earn Scrap → Upgrade → Build Your Team → Fight Again Experiment with different upgrades, refine your squad, and find out how far your machines can make it.

title: Anywhere RPG
description: Play any character, in any world* Anywhere RPG is a real-time, top-down 2D sandbox RPG where an AI director acts as your personal game master. You don't pick from a menu of actions. You type whatever you want to do, like "pickpocket the merchant," "convince the guard I'm the king's cousin," or "attack the bandit." The AI decides whether it's plausible, rolls the dice, narrates what happens and changes the world to match. Nothing is scripted. Everything is generated and resolved live as you play. Describe any setting, such as a medieval village, a haunted space station or a noir detective city, and the game builds an explorable world around it. You get regions, buildings, items, quests, and NPCs with their own personalities and daily routines. Emergent gameplay : AI-run events, quests that adapt to what you do, and survival stats that fit your setting. Progression : skills generated for your world, perk trees, active abilities and hotkeyed free-text macros. Play your way : endless sandbox, pause anytime, god-mode editor, and every AI prompt is moddable. About the optional subscription The game plays fully out of the box on its free AI service, with no setup and no extra cost. The free service will always be supported, and the subscription will never get in its way. If you want more, an optional monthly plan adds a larger AI memory, better text and image models, and more map generations per day. *Censorship Notice (read before you buy) In order to comply with Steam's policies, the following types of content are blocked by content moderation and unavailable in the game. Restrictions may be lifted in the future if Steam changes their AI policies: Sexual content Copyrighted material Real-world politics Please report false positives by filing a bug report from within the game.

title: HENTAI CHAMELEON
description: Hentai girls play a game with their work friends, a sexy round of hide and seek! Paint your body and blend away into the environment! Play with friends or randoms and chat over proximity chat! Rules The men need to find the ladies, in order to win and get a "special reward" 💕💦 If one of the girls doesn't get found within the time limit, they win! When you're found as a girl, you'll switch to the male team and become a seeker. How to play Paint yourself into the environment as a girl with the brush tool, choose a pose and squeeze into a good hiding spot. As a seeker, you have to locate the girls and shoot them with your spotter gun. Characters Choose 1 of 12 different hentai girls to play as before the match starts, or 1 of 10 different males if you are a seeker! Rewards Catching a hiding lady will give you a fully animated sex scene as a special reward to enjoy! After, the girl player change teams to find the rest. Features Multiplayer matchmaking with up to 8 player lobbies Private lobbies of up to 8 players Proximity voice chat 12 hot fully animated sex scene varieties when catching a girl 8 Maps to play on! 12 Female characters and 10 male characters to pick! Unique soundtrack for each level Leaderboards Achievements

title: Gas Station Horror
description: Perform routine work tasks Fuel up cars, submit checklists, take out the trash, and other mundane work tasks Talk with NPC customers A variety of different outcomes that will give you additional tasks or affect the game's ending. Interact with objects Several different items around the gas station that play a role in the game's story.

title: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
description: You were bitten on the first day of the outbreak. Time is running out to stop yourself from turning. You are alone in the lab, and you have to make the antiviral that saves you, and humanity with you. Collect samples Streak samples from your own blood and from whatever you bring back from the field. Flame the loop, then draw the streaks across the plate with your own hand. A clean streak means a colony you can actually read. Identify the virus Read the colony under the microscope and work out its traits one by one. A wrong diagnosis does not stop you. It just makes you build the wrong cure. Develop the cure Mix reagents at the bench and synthesize your own core molecule, modules and syringes. Every correct diagnosis unlocks a new recipe. Trial, Error, Victory! Load your antiviral into the machine and watch the fight play out under the microscope. Every defeat teaches you something, and every victory teaches the virus something. Do not stop until you have the final vaccine. Stay alive Do not work hungry or sleepless. Tired hands shake, and a shaking hand means a ruined streak and a missed injection.

title: The Cup: Creature Card Battler Demo
description: The demo is the whole game against the House. Coach a survivor and a line of three creatures. Every turn you play one card and make one attack, then the die TV decides how hard it lands while BroadcASH and BOBcast call it from the booth. Knock out all three of theirs and the match is yours. WHAT IS IN THE DEMO THE ROAD: ten cases against invasive species in one run: five, HALFTIME, then five more. Draft creatures and kits as you go, and a knockout is gone for the road The tutorial: one match, called by the booth, from your first card to your first natural twelve The Arena: matches against the House, dealt or drafted, as many as you want Your contestant file: your record, your tapes, and a shelf of mugs to earn No connection needed, start to finish THE DIE DECIDES. YOU CHOSE THE DIE. Every creature is printed Safe, Swingy or Jackpot. Safe hits for the number on the card. Swingy rolls. Jackpot can miss outright, and a natural can wipe a creature off the board. You pick the risk when you draft, and everybody watches it land. EVERY CARD DOES EXACTLY WHAT IT SAYS Any of your creatures can hit any of theirs. No lanes and no hidden rules: the card is the rule, and the feed spells out every hit, reflect and knockout. A bee that stings once and goes to the Pit for it. Three a side, and three to six minutes a match once you know the rules. THE FULL RELEASE, DECEMBER 3 The whole game stays free. The full release adds live 1v1 on Steam, more cases and more cards. Wishlist The Cup and Steam will tell you the day it lands. PAINTED, PHOTOGRAPHED, ON FILE Every painting on a card is commissioned from a human artist and credited on the card, one creature at a time, and the creatures still waiting wear placeholder art. The invaders are real photographs. Each survivor's kit is drawn from public-domain history, with its source on the card. Card art by @chioart08, @prayogaardip, Ondřej Tichý, @tmcglynnart and Awesam. The game's text and voices are in English. A broadcast of the Galactic Athletics Commission.

title: Get The Artifact: Violent Incursion
description: The contract is simple: enter the station, steal the Artifact, and get out. Drop from the Client’s spaceship into a hostile space station and make your way toward the target before the countdown reaches zero. Every missed jump, wrong turn and hesitation costs time. Surviving the heist is only the beginning. Return to the station and take on a series of precision time attacks built around instant retries, route discovery, and cleaner execution. Learn faster lines and unlock new movement skills. Cut seconds from your runs first, then optimize the runs to shave off every millisecond possible. The individual time-attack sections track you overall time instead of the countdown. Your best run times go to the global leaderboards for each of the sections, allowing you to compare your execution against other players. Three minutes gets the heist done. Mastering the routes can take considerably longer.

title: Life++ : Idle Life Sim
description: Life++ is an idle incremental life simulator about making the most out of your numbered years. Start poor and unskilled, but with plenty of time. Decide how to spend it. Study, work, train, earn, unlock better opportunities, and slowly turn an inefficient life into one that actually works. Life++ takes direct inspiration from key games of the genre such as Groundhog Life, Progress Knight, A Usual Idle Life, Cyberpunk Life and more. You learn by doing, and the more you do, the faster you progress. Live. Die. Repeat. Your life will eventually end. But you won't. Everything achieved in one life carries over to the next as new affinities. What took you 20 years will take 5, then 2, then fewer still. Progress faster, reach new new milestones, reveal new options, and what took you a lifetime become routine. Each run gives you room to change the plan, strategize, explore further, cut wasted time, and reach things that were previously out of range. Automate Life If you keep going through the same motions every life, you can automate it. The game keeps getting larger, so you automate the parts that become routine and spend your attention on whatever still needs solving. Eventually, you won't be managing individual actions, but entire lifetimes. Keep Going...? A second life seems like a blessing. The next few lives are easy to accept. After a while, you can't help but wonder: Why do you keep coming back? And what if you want it to stop?

title: Anime Shop Simulator: Supporter Pack
description: Anime Shop Simulator — Supporter Pack If you enjoy Anime Shop Simulator and would like to support our small team and help us keep creating new games, the Supporter Pack is for you! This pack is our way of saying thank you for supporting Anime Shop Simulator and our future projects. Along with our eternal gratitude, you’ll receive a small collection of exclusive bonus content to add a little something extra to your game. The Supporter Pack includes: 💕 1 exclusive dakimakura to add to your shop (Licence 7) 📚 3 new manga to collect, stock, and sell. You will get then in Licence 2, 5 and 9. 📷 A new main menu camera angle featuring the heroine Add some exclusive items to your collection, enjoy a fresh new view in the main menu, and most importantly, show your support for our small indie team. Thank you for supporting us and helping us make more games! ❤️

title: Another 2D Platformer
description: YES. IT'S ANOTHER 2D PLATFORMER. Run. Jump. Collect things. Reach the exit. You've done this before. See? Completely normal. OKAY. MAYBE NOT COMPLETELY NORMAL. Things start changing pretty quickly. Platforms launch you. Gravity gets questionable. The level starts expecting slightly more from you than just holding right. Still a platformer though. Probably. JUMPING IS USUALLY QUITE HELPFUL. Usually. In Another 2D Platformer, even the basic things you take for granted can become part of the level itself. So maybe think before you start bouncing around everywhere. EVERY LEVEL HAS A DIFFERENT BAD IDEA. Rather than giving you the same obstacle course ten times, each level plays with a different rule, mechanic or expectation. Sometimes the level helps you. Sometimes it absolutely does not. And sometimes... EVERYTHING IS A CRATE. We don't know why either. Crates. Platforms made of crates. Obstacles made of crates. Probably some crates pretending not to be crates. AND THAT'S ONLY THE BEGINNING. Across 10 handcrafted levels , Another 2D Platformer keeps taking familiar platforming ideas and pushing them somewhere increasingly stupid. Rules change. Levels misbehave. Things that shouldn't be mechanics become mechanics. And the further you get, the less interested the game becomes in behaving like a normal 2D platformer. We could tell you what happens. But where's the fun in that? IT'S JUST ANOTHER 2D PLATFORMER. Right? FEATURES. APPARENTLY. 10 handcrafted levels. None of them can agree on what kind of game this is. Running and jumping!* *Terms and conditions apply. An exit. Somewhere. At least one level whose existence is currently disputed. A relaxing little detour. Nothing bad will happen. More of you than anyone reasonably asked for. Collectibles, secrets and increasingly questionable design decisions. Time Trials, because apparently simply surviving wasn't enough. Crates. So many crates.

title: Zombies Aren't Real
description: Zombies Aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you attempt to control a quick-spreading zombie infection in real-world cities by commanding military forces. You're given a bird's eye view of a city and shown where the infection will begin, but you have time to plan.  With limited resources, carefully choose how you will respond to the infection and establish a plan to save as many civilians as possible. Once you're ready the chaos begins. The zombies will fan out and begin to infect the population.  You are able to adapt your plan on the fly.  If the zombies break through your perimeter you can call in air support such as bombers or gatling gun helicopters to attempt to stop the spread before it gets out of control. If you're able to eliminate all the zombies you win and your score is determined by how many civilians you saved. Features Play in real-world cities Deploy specialized ground forces against the spreading horde, such as snipers, turrets, mortar squads and garrisons Call in air strikes when things get out of hand, but be careful to aim them well to minimize civilian casualties Place safe zones, gates, and more to protect the civilian population Steam Workshop support for custom maps "Zombies Aren't Real" is highly strategic and winning will push you to think cleverly and experiment with different combinations of units, buildings and upgrades.  It is not an incremental game.  Losing is fun! We encourage you to retry often, restarting a scenario once defeat is inevitable to adjust your strategy. The fun is in figuring out how to best defend the city! Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation, TomTom, Microsoft (Open Database License,  Esri Community Maps contributors, Google Open Buildings, work derived from BTN 2024 ign.es (CC BY 4.0,  postal codes: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

title: MMA Tactics - Martial Arts
description: From the Creator of Turn Based Boxing: Tactics, fight in playground scraps to packed stadiums in a gory, tactics-driven Mixed Martial Arts simulation. Use real MMA strategy, experience MMA history, discover and challenge fighters inspired by the living, the dead, and the legendary. Step into the violent world of underground Mixed Martial Arts. A realistic turn-based MMA simulation with (optional auto-battle) and perma-death. Recruit Fighters, Assign Perks, Train Stats, Build Synergies, Manage Injuries, Unlock strategies, Upgrade your Gym, Bribe the Commission and create a roster of MMA Champions. The Most Savage MMA Game: This is a hard game. Some fighters will die. Create Your Gym: Assemble a diverse team of fighters with unique skills and styles. Each fighter contributes to earning cash for the gym. Use cash to train your fighters and bribe the commission. Recruit and Customize Talent: Scour the globe for the most talented fighters to join your gym. From seasoned veterans to up and coming young studs, every fighter has unique strengths, weaknesses, and personalities. Over 125 Perks / Endless Fighter Builds: Perks are special abilities that enhance a fighter's performance in different aspects of the game. These can range from increased stamina and power to improved defensive maneuvers or tactical advantages in the cage. As the manager,  choose which perks to enable. Synergize perks with each fighter's talents, weaknesses, fighting style, and the gyms overall goals. Increasing Stats by Training (Level up after each win): Each stat contributes to a fighter's overall performance in the cage and can be improved. Some stats have stars, meaning the fighter is talented, granting a higher skill ceiling. Death: When a fighter sustains injuries during matches they risk death. Fighters age over time. At 60 years old one is vulnerable to death from injuries. At 100 they will die. Complete Quests and Unlock Strategies: Meet quest criteria to unlock strategies that any fighter in your gym can utilize. Strategies can be changed before each round of fighting. Climb the Ranking and win the Undisputed Championship: With perseverance, strategy, and a little bit of luck, you'll lead your gym to greatness and cement your legacy as one of the greatest MMA managers of all time. Join the community and share your fighters and compete in tournaments. Choose between classic pixel art or the new HD remastered textures. About the Developer: This game was made by an MMA fan. Supports 11 languages! (English, German, French, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi)

title: Sushi Gacha: Auto Battler
description: Pick from the gacha offer Each round starts with a gacha offer. Take one sushi, spend coins to reroll, hold one for the next spin, or walk away with the coins instead. The roll is random; the choice after it is yours. Build the four-slot line Your counter has four slots in one line, and the piece at the front takes the first normal hit. Once you press Fight, the round is out of your hands. Taunt draws attacks. Pierce skips the front. Splash catches the next slot. Echo repeats a neighbour's skill. A lineup can lose, swap two places, and win. Merge copies. Blend two pieces. Copies merge and gain stars. Two pieces can be blended once per round into sushi that never appears in the gacha. There are 21 blend-only creations and 53 kinds to find in all. Twelve rounds, twelve ranks Clear twelve rounds to finish a run, one fight per round. Rounds 4, 8 and 12 are Chef Fights: a set opponent waits, and beating it earns a free pick next round. On other rounds the shop changes: fairs, sales, market, prep, regulars. Your opponents are lineups that other players left behind in the same round (asynchronous, like Backpack Battles: nobody waits for anybody). Offline, or when nobody is there yet, you fight lineups recorded from 24 bot runs. Higher ranks change more than enemy numbers: coins, offer size, star limits, and series-bonus rules can all tighten. The daily run uses the date as its seed, so everyone gets the same shop. The whole game also works offline. The chef's lineup is shown a round early, so you can build for it. Your last 30 runs stay in the Records.

title: NinjaPVP
description: Create an opening. Complete your hand seals. Unleash your jutsu before your opponent closes in. Take the fight from village streets to rooftops in NinjaPVP, a free-to-play multiplayer ninja arena brawler. CAST JUTSU WITH HAND SEALS Your hand-seal sequence determines the technique you cast. Find space in the fight, complete your combination and unleash elemental jutsu. TAKE THE FIGHT TO THE ROOFTOPS Run along walls, leap between rooftops and glide over the village with your leaf canopy. Chase an opponent, escape an exchange or attack from another angle. KEEP YOUR OPPONENT UNDER PRESSURE Trade shuriken at range, close the distance and bring your jutsu into the fight. Use movement to find an opening for your next attack. BUILD YOUR NINJA Customize your ninja’s look and shape your loadout with weapons, blessings and trinkets to suit your playstyle. ENTER THE ARENA The initial mode is 4v4 Team Deathmatch. Work with your team to pressure opponents and take the fight across the village. Modes in development: Capture the Flag, Free-for-All and Battle Royale. These modes are not yet released. Release timing has not been announced. Add NinjaPVP to your wishlist.

title: HENTAI CAVEMAN
description: You control Kepeko, a caveman. Dinosaurs have destroyed the village and kidnapped the girls: Tonga, Tanga and Tunga. In a prehistoric world you collect items, explore a classic RPG map and rescue the cave girls. When you rescue one of the girls, she falls in love with you and moves in with you, unlocking a new hentai animation video: erotic, traditional 2D animation, explicit uncensored sex. The game uses an invented language, is packed with humor, easy to play, short and unpretentious — made for anyone who wants a retro RPG with 1990s anime aesthetics. Face the dinosaurs that took the girls. Simple, fun retro RPG combat and exploration. 90s anime look (not generic pixel art, not 3D). Sexual scenes in traditional hand-drawn 2D animation. Comedy, explicit sex, and made for fans of mangaka Yamamoto Doujin.

title: MMA Tactics - Martial Arts Demo
description: From the Creator of Turn Based Boxing: Tactics, fight in playground scraps to packed stadiums in a gory, tactics-driven Mixed Martial Arts simulation. title: Bullet Hell Zombies
description: THE ZOMBIES ARE COMING... Bullet Hell Zombies is a 1–4 player online co-op bullet hell roguelike that mash-ups round based horde survival with chaotic bullet hell dodging. Trapped inside a procedurally generated, haunted mansion, you and up to three friends must weave through bullet hell, rack up cash with every landed shot, and decide how to spend your fortune to make it out alive. EVERY BULLET LANDED IS MONEY IN THE BANK. Every shot that hits an enemy grows your pockets. Will you hoard your cash to buy devastating weapons and game-breaking items, or spend it to unlock doors, expand the procedurally generated mansion, and uncover hidden rooms? Work together to share loot and craft unstoppable builds. DANCE WITH DEADLY BOSSES. Survive long enough and you’ll face off against  bosses in music-synced battles . Enemies attack to the beats—listen to the rhythm, memorize the patterns, and move with the music to survive. Features: 1 - 4 Player Online Co-op: Play solo or squad up with up to three others online. Revive fallen teammates, share items, and combine builds. Over 300+ Weapons, Items & Enemies: Discover hundreds of unique guns, tools, and bizarre upgrades. Combine them to trigger wild synergies where no two runs ever play the same. Music synced boss fights: The music makes you move. The boss is dancing too... Gorgeous pixel art and animations: Hand-drawn pixel art, animated frame by frame. Procedurally generated maps: Every run feels fresh and unique! Satisfying and precise game feel: Tight controls and fair hitboxes, so every mistake is your own. Weapon and item synergies: Craft your build with your teammates and share items. Built-In Voice and Text Chat: Coordinate via built-in voice and text chat, revive fallen teammates, share cash, and combine builds. 50+ Characters and NPCs Music from various artists Much more...

title: Just Up: 2D Platformer Demo
description: Just Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top... GAMEPLAY Jump across platforms and use your dash to reach the next one as you make your way upward. Plan your movement, time your jumps, and use your dash whenever you need that extra bit of distance to keep climbing. CHANGING ENVIRONMENTS The higher you climb, the more the world begins to change around you. Watch the sky shift from bright blue days to dark, star-filled nights as familiar objects slowly give way to increasingly unusual sights. Continue upward and leave the atmosphere behind on your journey to the top. DEMO FEATURES Automatic Checkpoints with 3 Save Slots Built-in Speedrun Timer Around 10 Minutes of Gameplay Support for 32 Languages 4 Music Tracks 1 Achievement Steam Leaderboards Steam Cloud Saves

title: Cybernetic Strategy
description: DISCOVER ENDLESS COMBINATIONS. CREATE YOUR OWN CARRIES. Cybernetic Strategy is a multiplayer auto-battler with an emphasis on flamboyancy and ease of playability, where you build a squad of crazy robots, combine them with experimental items and augments, and send them into battle against your friends and enemies! The game has an emphasis on a special fantasy for EVERY unit, so you can make any non-tank unit the star of the game! Buy units from the shop, use guided positioning to arrange them on the board, activate powerful traits, equip spectacular items, and adapt your game plan as the match goes on, to truly be the best! EXPLORE A SOCIAL ASPECT IN AN AUTO BATTLER! With features such as the beginning racetrack race, the voting ballot system to choose what happens to other players, being fired out of a cannon carousel, and certain augments that allow you to truly feel the presence of other players and make your presence known in every game! VARIETY IN EVERY GAME! The constant variety in units, augments and even items makes every game play different! Be flexible and adaptable, and use what the game gives you to win all of those games! STRATEGY IS POWER Place your units carefully and think beyond simple front lines and back lines. Variety in assassins and unit targeting keeps you on your feet when it comes to positioning. Clever positioning is a big part, and it can single-handedly win you games! EXPERIENCE THE CRAZY TRAITS Experience spectacle traits such as GodCrafted, which rain meteors and meteor showers onto the board, or Clobbertron, which sends your units on a rampaging frenzy, or Gundam, which allows you to create a ginormous, giga-powerful carry! ITEMS THAT CHANGE THE FIGHT With 4 different tiers of items and so many units, each item is wildly different across multiple units, allowing for endless possible combinations for you to try! BIS is hard to come by here! AUGMENTS THAT DEFINE YOUR RUN Choose powerful augments that can either break the game's rules, manipulate your opponents (Mortdogged!) or make deals with the devil, try out all of them! FEATURES: 8-player multiplayer auto-battler, with many more modes coming in the future! A roster of 86 Base units, with a couple of secret units! Powerful trait breakpoints that can insta-win you games! Vote to determine the fate of your opponents! Equip units with a large variety of items! Choose from hundreds of augments! Get shot out of a cannon during carousel!

title: Lewd Gambit: Hentai Checkers
description: Beautiful rivals, dangerous combinations, and a trump card that can turn the match around. Lewd Gambit: Hentai Checkers combines Russian checkers, tactical cards , and an unlockable gallery of 18+ artwork . Plan your captures, push for promotion, and choose the perfect moment to reveal your strongest play. Build a hand around your tactics Before your first move, choose trump cards from your unlocked collection. Restore a lost piece, strip an enemy king of its crown, or change the tempo of the match. The right card can rescue a difficult position, but your resources are limited: up to three card uses per battle and one per turn . Timing matters just as much as the combination you play on the board. Every rival has her own approach Face 10 heroines with different priorities: forcing exchanges, controlling the center, preserving pieces, or racing to promotion. Their signature trump cards are announced in advance , giving you a chance to disrupt the effect with your next move. Adaptive difficulty responds to wins and losses while preserving each rival's character. The final encounter will put your planning to the test. Win your way to the next reward Unlock new looks for the heroines and expand your personal gallery. Earn experience, progress through 40 levels , increase your hand size, and strengthen your favorite cards with earned seals. Revisit unlocked illustrations as you work toward a complete collection. Features Russian checkers with mandatory captures, capture chains, and flying kings. 10 rivals with distinct tactical priorities and signature trump cards. 20 cards across bronze, silver, and gold rarities. Pre-battle card selection, upgrades, and a hand that grows to four slots . 40 progression levels with rewards. An unlockable gallery of 18+ artwork and 36 achievements . Neon visuals and adaptive difficulty .

title: MORTISCRIPT: Undead Auto Battler
description: MORTISCRIPT: Undead Auto Battler is a dark fantasy strategy RPG about programming an undead army and watching your plans play out on the battlefield. You are a Vampire Queen who has returned after being betrayed and left for dead. Your manor lies in ruins, your kingdom is in enemy hands, and rebuilding your power means putting the dead back to work. Write the Orders Before battle, give each formation a set of simple rules built around WHEN → ACTION → TARGET . Your units fight on their own, but the decisions they make come from the Orders you wrote. No programming knowledge is required. Watch Your Plan Play Out Once the battle starts, control gives way to observation. Build formations around each other, watch their Orders interact, and see exactly why a plan worked — or why it fell apart. Then change the rules and try again. Prepare for the Expedition Choose which forces to send, check the expected opposition and make sure their Orders are ready before leaving the manor. Expeditions contain multiple encounters and health carries between battles, so knowing when to push forward and when to retreat matters. Reclaim the Kingdom Return to your manor between expeditions to unlock new undead formations and expand what your army can do. Then push outward through hostile regions, dungeons and bosses as the Vampire Queen takes back the kingdom that betrayed her. Each region introduces new enemies and problems for your Orders to solve. Featuring Rule-based combat built around WHEN → ACTION → TARGET Auto-battles driven by the Orders you write Undead formations with distinct mechanics and synergies A combat view that explains why your units acted Multi-encounter expeditions with persistent health Manor progression and permanent formation upgrades Handcrafted regions, dungeons and bosses No programming knowledge required

title: Astro Fighters 3 Demo
description: ASTRO FIGHTERS 3 DEMO Twenty years ago humanity defeated the alien invasion. Now they have returned. The surviving alien forces have spent decades rebuilding their fleets and preparing for revenge. As colonies across the galaxy fall under attack, humanity launches the Astro Fighter III Program, deploying a new generation of elite pilots to stop the alien armada before it reaches the core worlds. Experience the first two levels of Astro Fighters 3 in full , with no changes to the gameplay found in the full release. The demo also brings forward a selection of unlockable content normally spread across the full 8-level game, giving you the opportunity to experience more of Astro Fighters 3's progression and replayability. A TASTE OF THE FULL ASTRO FIGHTERS 3 EXPERIENCE Take control of powerful starfighters and battle through relentless waves of enemies, massive bosses and bullet-filled battlefields. Master the art of grazing enemy fire, unleash devastating special weapons, slow time to escape impossible situations, and fight for high scores across the online leaderboards. The demo includes: • The first 2 levels of the full game , presented in their entirety • 6 unlockable player ships • All 70 unlockable Enhancement Cards from the full game's roguelite progression system • 2 unlockable Procedurally Generated Gauntlet Modes • 10-minute Survival Mode • 20-minute Survival Mode • 61 Steam Achievements • 3 Steam Leaderboards UNLOCK 70 POWERFUL ENHANCEMENT CARDS The complete collection of 70 Enhancement Cards is available to unlock in the demo. These cards allow you to shape future runs by modifying the rewards and bonuses you receive. Increase the chance of receiving your favourite special items, boost your score gains, increase your damage output, start levels with powerful bonuses, and discover combinations that suit your playstyle. The full Enhancement Card system is here, allowing you to experience the roguelite progression that forms a major part of Astro Fighters 3. UNLOCK MORE WAYS TO PLAY As you progress through the demo, you can unlock 6 different player ships , each giving you another way to approach the battle. You can also unlock two Procedurally Generated Gauntlet Modes , designed for survival and replayability. How long can you survive? 10 MINUTE GAUNTLET Fight through an ever-changing barrage of enemies and bullet patterns and survive for 10 minutes. 20 MINUTE GAUNTLET Push your skills even further and attempt to survive for 20 minutes against procedurally generated challenges. FAST-PACED ARCADE SHOOT 'EM UP ACTION • Relentless waves of enemies • Massive boss encounters • Bullet-filled battlefields • Risk-and-reward grazing system • Slow down time to survive overwhelming attacks • Devastating special weapons • 6 unlockable player ships • 70 unlockable Enhancement Cards • 2 Procedurally Generated Gauntlet Modes • 61 Steam Achievements • 3 Steam Leaderboards • Multiple difficulty levels • Local co-op multiplayer (2 x Joypads Required) THE WAR ISN'T OVER Astro Fighters 3 builds upon the classic arcade shoot 'em up formula while introducing a progression system that lets you shape future runs. Unlock ships. Discover Enhancement Cards. Experiment with different combinations. Master the art of grazing enemy fire and fight your way through increasingly dangerous bullet-filled battlefields. The demo gives you a chance to experience the first two levels of Astro Fighters 3 in full , while bringing forward unlockable content from across the complete game. Play the demo and experience Astro Fighters 3 for yourself. If you enjoy the fight, wishlist the full game on Steam and follow its development.

title: Goblin Apocalypse: Open World Survival
description: THE STORY With the death of the peaceful human king, the fragile peace on the island of Turtek comes to an end. Humans begin attacking goblin settlements, forcing many goblins to abandon their homes. You are one of the goblins who survived. Find surviving goblins and peaceful humans, build your own settlement, manage your growing colony, and survive in the open world of Turtek, alone or with friends in co-op. OPEN WORLD SURVIVAL Explore the open world of Turtek and gather the resources you need to survive. Discover abandoned areas, dangerous locations, hostile forces, and survivors scattered across the island. Choose where to explore, what to collect, and how to grow your settlement as you carve your own path through the world. PLAY SOLO OR CO-OP Survive the world of Turtek alone or team up with your friends in co-op multiplayer . Explore, gather resources, fight enemies, rescue survivors, and build your colony together. STAY UNSEEN A goblin does not have to win every fight. Crouch in tall grass and bushes, stay still, and let patrols walk right past you. Enemies can see you and hear you. Sprinting makes noise, standing in the open gets you spotted, and low cover hides you only while you stay low. Pick your fights instead of letting them pick you. STAMINA-BASED COMBAT Chain blade combos up close, or pick enemies off from range with a bow. Every attack, block, and action costs stamina. Spend it at the wrong moment and you are left open to the next hit. Being strong is not enough. Managing your stamina is what keeps you alive. CHARACTER PROGRESSION Level up and shape your survivor around the way you play. Improve core attributes such as HP , STR , and STAMINA to become stronger and more capable of facing the dangers of Turtek. LOOT AND EQUIPMENT Strip weapons and armor from the knights who burned your home. Fill your head, body, legs, feet, necklace, and shield slots with gear that grants different bonuses. Increase HP, Stamina, XP gain, and other useful attributes through different equipment combinations and build a goblin that suits your playstyle. BUILD YOUR SETTLEMENT Start with a small refuge and build your settlement from the ground up. Unlock new structures through the build tree, place them where you want, and gather the resources to raise them. Expand your base, strengthen its defenses, and turn a small shelter into a growing goblin colony that can stand against the humans. MANAGE YOUR SURVIVORS Your colony is more than just buildings. The goblins and peaceful humans you rescue become part of your growing community. Assign them tasks, organize your settlement, and let them keep working and growing even while you are away exploring Turtek. SURVIVE. BUILD. EXPLORE. GROW.

title: Arena Shooter
description: Hop in a tank. Call in a nuke. Flatten the fortress. Classic arena shooter action seen from above: chunky toy-soldier warfare with huge explosions and zero chill. Battle your friends and bots across 20 unique maps and modes, commandeer 60+ vehicle types, unleash 40+ perks and hold off zombie hordes and the classic Zombie Boss as day burns into night mid-firefight. Endless, Survival, Capture the Flag and more, all buttery-smooth and built for 120 FPS. EVERYTHING GOES: A FULLY DESTRUCTIBLE WORLD Watchtowers, barracks, hangars, windmills, castle keeps, bridges and a half-built skyscraper all come crashing down in fire and debris. Blow the bridge. Drop the oasis bridge out from under an enemy tank, and everyone on the deck goes down with it. Chain reactions. Shoot one explosive barrel and watch the blast chain into every barrel close by. Crush the clutter. Roll straight through fences, cacti, crates and barrels. Fire that sticks. Flames cling to soldiers, vehicles and buildings and keep burning after they fall, and napalm spreads the blaze across rooftops and rocks. 40+ PERKS Grab a perk mid-round and the match goes sideways. With 40+ perks, power-ups and upgrades to play with, no two fights end the same way. The best ones: Nuke: a launch siren, a falling bomb, a mushroom cloud and a rolling shockwave, then a radiation zone that hurts enemies caught on foot and raises radiation zombies. Airstrike: drag your aim line and a shark-nosed bomber carpets it with seven bombs. Napalm: seven fire bombs set a whole line of the battlefield ablaze. Minion Squad: three pocket-sized minions march into battle with you, and one of them brought grenades. Enfattener: zap rivals until they are twice as wide and 30% slower. Pure humiliation. Zombie Repellent + Summoner: the horde ignores you, and the zombies you raise hunt everyone else. Immobilizer: auto-zap nearby enemies and lock their feet in place for 15 seconds. Your own war machine: summon a personal Photon Shark, Rage Balloon, mech, helicopter or MLRS right next to you. Then there are power-ups: stack a Health Diamond and a Helmet for four times your health, or go Berserker for 60 seconds of pure rage. 60+ VEHICLE TYPES Walk up to any empty vehicle and it is yours, repainted in your colors. Tanks, mechs, helicopters, rocket trucks, balloons and more, and Shift boosts anything you drive. Tanks: from battle tanks to the 1,500 HP Heavy Tank and its alternating twin barrels. Electro: chain lightning that jumps through up to four enemies and stuns survivors for 15 seconds. Mechs: quad rocket volleys and a two-arm melee punch. Photon Shark: a laser mech with twin piercing beams that meet on your crosshair and a torso that spins a full circle. Helicopters: double rocket volleys from above, and rifle fire just bounces off. Rage Balloon: an armored balloon with double-strength grenades, two door gunners and a bazooka mode. MLRS rocket trucks: eight-rocket volleys that carpet a whole area. Buggies, jeeps, tractors and roadsters: fast raids and glorious roadkill. Catapults and field cannons: lob boulders and shells from a safe distance. ZOMBIES & BOSSES Zombie Boss: a classic boss showdown against a giant 3,120 HP brute whose ground smash sends out an energy wave that slams vehicles, minions and defenses. Giant sand worm: stand still in the open too long and it swallows you whole. Mega Mech: a triple-health raid boss packing twin rocket launchers and a laser. Zombie hordes: the undead crawl out of the caves and sprint at anyone in reach, and island nights unleash fast runners, heavies and hulking brutes. ALL MODES Twelve arenas, from open desert warzones to a zombie island, each with its own twist: Free-for-All: top score wins, across open desert warzones full of outposts to smash, towers to seize and sectors to capture. Urban Combat: a beachfront city of skyscrapers and villas. Run over one pedestrian too many and the cops come hunting. Capture & Hold: seize and hold nine control sectors across a giant open desert. Base Survival: team up and hold a walled citadel against raider waves from all four sides: infantry, tanks, helicopters, mechs and rocket trucks. Capture the Flag: everyone carries their own flag. Snatch rivals' flags through a sunny Italian seaside town and sprint home for 300 points each. Duel Arena: a tight gladiator ring built for close-quarters showdowns. Bomb Defusion: Red vs Blue at a nuclear facility. Plant the bomb and guard it through forty seconds on the fuse. Team Battle: Red vs Blue on a medieval battlefield. Grab a catapult, hurl boulders and flatten the enemy keep. Demolition Derby: every respawn drops you into a random ride, from tractors to tanks to rocket trucks. Ram everything. Island Survival: build up a beach camp by day and shelter stranded tourists, then hold it through the night against hordes of up to 240 zombies. Endless Mode: no timer and no final whistle. Take on your friends and the bots in any arena for as long as you like. Prefer to watch? Spectate a match and fly a free camera over the carnage. ARSENAL Many different weapon choices, even before you find a ride: Heavy rifle, bouncing grenades and a bazooka that locks onto helicopters. Shotgun and Flamethrower power-ups, plus the Laser Gun perk, for when you need a bigger argument. Energy melee that drops regular zombies in one punch and harvests crystals. Capture watchtowers for longer range and faster reloads, or crew a field cannon. WORLD Day and night cycle: golden daylight fades to sunset and a blue-hour night lit by headlights, searchlights and glowing crystals. Vaults and crystals: cliffside vault doors slide open, vault miners sneak out to dig crystals, and you can punch those crystal clusters for points. A roster of chunky heroes including Goldcap, Blast Rose, Frost Shark, Night Viper, Iron Belly and Fusehead. A satisfying soundtrack: punchy music and 100+ crunchy sound effects, from stomping mech footsteps to crackling chain lightning and a nuclear launch siren that clears the room. Buttery-smooth 120 FPS: built for high-refresh displays, with real-time shadows, glowing bloom and automatic resolution scaling. INSPIRED BY THE LEGENDS Arena Shooter is our love letter to the games that made us fall for bot matches, flag runs and vehicle brawls: Quake III Arena, Unreal Tournament 2004, Team Fortress 2, Halo: The Master Chief Collection, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Battlefield 6 and Ravenfield.
