title: Plague Inc: The Board Game
description: The ultimate strategic game of infection, evolution and extinction. Start by infecting a single country. Evolve symptoms to become more powerful. Contaminate the Olympics, trigger a nuclear strike and more. Each player is a deadly disease - compete with intelligent bots, friends or random people to be the first to wipe out humanity. Designed by the creator of the mega hit video game Plague Inc. - this is the digital version of the best selling physical board game. Question : Is this really a video game of a board game of a video game? Answer : Yes it is! :) I (James, the creator of Plague Inc.) originally made it to help test out new rules for the second edition of the print run - but had so much fun playing it digitally that I decided to infect everyone else with it too! Play full single-player games with intelligent bot players Full Legacy campaign with unique game modes, rules and rewards Global Daily Challenge - see how  your disease holds up Use the tutorial to learn the rules in a safe space Try and beat the infamous PlagueBot game mode from the physical game. Multiple online game modes let you share diseases with people all over the world. Online multiplayer - jump into games fast. Online Turn Based mode - take your time and play asynchronously Use Legacy mode to turn games into a living world that is shaped by your actions Have you always wanted to impress your friends with your  nosebleeds, pustules and diarrhea? Show off your skin lesions? Well this is your chance! As well as playing all the normal  multiplayer modes - you can take advantage of Same Device multiplayer to play on the big screen.

title: MOBA Manager 2026
description: MOBA Cybersport Management Simulator - MOBA MANAGER 2026. Pick your team in the middle of the 2026 season and compete to become the best team in the world. You decide who and how plays in your team and watch the outcome of your decisions during matches as tournaments and seasons progress. WHAT YOU DO You control - An Esports club, not individual heroes Your squad - Five positions, assembled from more than 300 players Live decision-making - Before and during the match, shaping how the game progresses THE DECISIONS Hero types - 15, three per position — separated by power curve timing Strategies - Choose between Farm/ Gank / Push & other strategies to define your playstyle Every player - 17 attributes & 5 personality profiles Training - Manage each player's condition and form through sharpness, morale and stress systems Staff - 5 unique roles, 3 tiers each Sponsors- 1 primary plus 3 earned slots, with monthly and major goals THE WORLD Clubs - 50+, across 6 regions — WEU, EEU, China, SEA, NA & SA Transfers - Buy players from another teams, sign free agents or scout for talent in the ladder Season - 60+ events, January to December Career start - 1st of July, so you jump straight into  action before most important tournaments Patches - 6 a year. The two major patches re-roll the game balance THE MATCH The map - 16 zones, one tick every 15 game-seconds, dynamic player movement Difficulty - 4 levels, Easy to Hardcore Languages - English and Russian

title: Backrooms Open World
description: Only few people ever ended up in the Backrooms. Even fewer made it out to tell the tale. Backrooms Open World is an attempt to recreate the Backrooms as realistically as possible. This includes atmospheric environments , the opportunity for social interactions , a physics-based melee combat system, a faction system and much more. This game contains an integrated asynchronous Massively Multiplayer mode (currently supporting up to 100 players on one server), but there is still an option to play in Single Player mode or in private Lobbies with friends. 7 Levels 5 Entities 2 Factions Singleplayer & Multiplayer Free Navigation between Levels PvPvE Asynchronous Multiplayer One official Server Proximity Voice Chat Wraparound World Progress Save between Sessions Physics-based melee combat VR Support Escape Option Customization Option Since this is an Open World game, there are no predefined goals, which means you can do whatever you want.  A few examples would be: Escaping the Backrooms Wandering around Fighting players from rival factions Talking with other Backroom fans :) Do whatever you want. No limitations. Motion Blur & VHS can be toggled off in Settings A VSync option is available There is a key binding for toggling VR mode that allows you to switch between VR and non-VR mid-game This project has been in development since January 2026

title: Hole Survivor : Isla Caliente - Female Protagonist
description: She knows every season and every rule. Now she has to survive the island herself. The Wahine DLC lets you play Hole Survivor as Nasrin "Naz" Ostovar. Join the women on the Wahine beach, get to know your campmates, and decide how to approach the people competing beside you. Jonah takes his place on the other beach. Listen, tease, confront, or hold something back. Your choices shape how you spend your time with the cast. Get close to your campmates, keep an eye on your rivals, and decide when to cross the sand to meet the men. Run the obstacle course, dive for supplies, and help your tribe through the island's challenges. The competition continues from Nasrin's perspective, with her place on the island at stake. Living with the women is only part of the game. At council, the men decide where their attention goes. The connections you make across the island can matter as much as your performance in a challenge. Requires the base game Hole Survivor.

title: Board Game Tycoon
description: Start your own board game publishing company! In Board Game Tycoon, your idea becomes a box with your company's name on it. Combine themes and mechanics, name your games and customize their covers. Simulated playtest groups try your prototypes. Work out the rough edges at the game table until your design is ready to publish. Game by game, you build your own catalogue. An approachable management sim for anyone who would love to tinker with board games. Family game night or a challenge for seasoned players? Will your game be easy to get to the table, or full of tricky decisions? Choose a theme, player count and audience, then combine the right mechanics. Your game, your cover Give your game a name and customize its cover. When your title joins the catalogue, you can see your own idea in it. Each release adds another box with your company's name on it. The playtest tells the story The game ends and everyone is talking about a rematch. Or the group spent more time leafing through the rulebook than playing. Watch their reactions and work through the findings. Another playtest group might see your design very differently. Revise what needs work and test your prototype again. Every change takes time and money. You decide when it is ready for print. Off to the printer Send your first print run to the printer and publish your game. Your prototype becomes a title in your catalogue. Now you find out how many boxes will sell and how much of your budget is left for the next idea. Give your game an audience Invite fictional content creators to a stream night with your prototype, or commission videos about games you have already published. Players rate and discuss your titles on BoardGameFreak, the fictional community site, while fictional magazines review them from their own perspectives. You put your game in the spotlight. Their videos, reviews and community reactions show you how it lands. Keep an eye on sales and stock too: unsold boxes tie up money on your shelves. As the last copies sell, it is time to arrange a reprint. The next playtest at the table, sales figures on the computer, another idea on the whiteboard: your isometric office brings it all together. Your catalogue tells the story of the games you have made. What's inside Game concepts for different audiences, shaped by themes and mechanics. Individual names and covers for your games. Simulated playtest groups, visible reactions and focused revisions. Publishing, sales, stock management and reprints. Fictional content creators, magazines and the BoardGameFreak community site. Conventions as another way to showcase your games. Single-player management in English and German. Planned for the full release Your games on other players' shelves. If you opt in, the games you publish can appear on the BoardGameFreak charts of other players in the same season, next to the simulated competition, complete with their names and covers. I review every name by hand before it shows up. This feature is not part of the demo. Privacy The game sends anonymous play statistics only with your consent, and the feature is off by default. The full notice is linked from this page.

title: Punk Dog Wars MOBA 2D
description: One stick. Your dog fights. You decide where. Punk Dog Wars is a three-way MOBA with nothing to press but where you go. Walk to dodge, stand still to shoot. Your dog casts its own skills, so every decision is about position: when to push, when to step out of a strike, when to turn back and save your Core. Every attack is drawn on the ground Every rival strike is marked on the floor before it lands. Walk out of it and it misses. Dodge an aimed shot and your dog banks NERVE for a harder hit of its own. Three teams, one surviving Core Fight 1v1v1, 2v2v2 or 5v5 across the streets of Véspera, a São Paulo-inspired city in 2187. Capture relays for stronger drone waves, take the turbo tracks to reach a fight first, and survive the bosses that come for everyone: the Warden Hound and the Tall Good Boy. Build a different dog every match 20 dogs, each with its own kit. Pickles and Brutus are ready from the start; win matches to unlock the rest, one dog per match. Tap one of three upgrade cards as you level, evolve a skill at level 4 and again at level 9. Gear is bought for you. Your items fire on their own. Play your way Keyboard (WASD or arrow keys) or a controller. A guided first match teaches the game in a few minutes. Solo matches any time, online matches against other players, or a private room with friends. Free to play. Start as a guest, no account required. English and Portuguese (Brazil), with a voiced announcer in both.

title: Realistic Football Career
description: BUILD A FOOTBALL CAREER THAT IS ACTUALLY YOURS Realistic Football Career is a text-based football career simulation where you experience the journey of a footballer from the very beginning. Choose your position, discover your starting abilities, join your first club and begin building your career. But there is no script that says you have to become a superstar. How far you go depends on the player you become. CHOOSE YOUR PATH Your position shapes the footballer you will become. Start with your own strengths and weaknesses, then develop your player over time through training and match experience. A promising beginning can become a great career. Or it can become something completely different. TRAIN. IMPROVE. COMPETE. A career is built between matches. Train your player, improve important attributes and work on the weaknesses holding you back. Your development affects what you can do on the pitch — and what opportunities may come next. MAKE THE DECISION You don't just watch matches happen. When important moments arrive, you decide what your player does. Shoot. Pass. Take a risk. Keep possession. Choose the option you believe is right and live with the result. Your abilities matter. Your decisions matter. And not every decision will work. EARN YOUR NEXT MOVE Perform well and new opportunities can appear. Develop your player, prove yourself on the pitch and work your way toward new clubs and higher levels of football. A transfer can change the direction of your entire career. But simply wanting the next move doesn't mean you'll get it. You have to earn it. SUCCESS IS NEVER GUARANTEED This is where Realistic Football Career is different. You might become one of the best players in the world. You might build a long and respected career without ever reaching the biggest clubs. You might struggle to reach your potential. You might get the opportunity you've been waiting for — and fail to take it. There is no invisible system pushing every career toward the same perfect ending. Football doesn't guarantee success. Neither does this game. NO TWO CAREERS NEED TO BE THE SAME Your position, attributes, training, performances, decisions and transfers combine to shape your journey. One career might take you rapidly toward the top. Another might become a fight for every opportunity. That's the point. You're not playing through the story of a predetermined football superstar. You're finding out what kind of career your player can actually build. YOUR CAREER ISN'T WRITTEN YET. Choose your position. Build your player. Make the decisions. Earn your opportunities. See how far you can go.

title: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up
description: Welcome to The Cozy Board Game Shop, a warm, sunlit store packed with board games... and every single box is on the floor. A Shop Full of Stories Arthur ran this shop for thirty years. Now it's yours. Last night his grandson Theo wanted to play with every game, just once, while Arthur fell asleep in the armchair. Theo didn't. Put every game back where it belongs and the shop is ready to open its doors again. Tidy, Shelve, Relax Pick up copies, carry them in a wobbly stack and find their home on the right shelf. Fill a section with all twelve copies of a game and watch it light up in a cascade of little boxes. Bit by bit, the chaos turns into a perfectly organised shop. Helpful Skills Every game you shelve earns XP, and XP earns skill points. Spend them on skills that make tidying even more satisfying: Copy Sense reveals every loose copy of the game in your hands, Magnet Hands pulls nearby copies straight to you, Quick Stack fills a shelf in one go and Smart Stack sorts your stack as you look at the shelves. Features 3,816 boxes to tidy : 318 board games, twelve copies each, every one with its own parody cover. Can you spot the games you know? 15 categories on two floors , from Kids and Party & Words to Fantasy & Dungeons, Sci-Fi & Space and Mystery & Spies. A shop full of nooks : a sunny greenhouse, a candle-lit horror room, a detective's office and a reading loft. Carry a whole stack at once , cycle through it with the mouse wheel, or toss a box across the room. 7 skills to unlock , 4 active and 3 passive, from faster running to carrying more games at once. Lost? Check the shop map on the lectern by the stairs. A relaxing soundtrack and soft, satisfying sounds. Fully localized in 12 languages , including a voiced welcome letter in every language. No timers, no pressure. Tidy at your own pace and save whenever you like. Streamers & creators Streaming, Let's Plays and monetized videos are welcome, no permission needed. The soundtrack is not registered with Content ID, so it is safe to stream.

title: Metal Naval Combat: Saturation Strike
description: 2071. The oceans have risen eleven meters. The coastal cities are gone, and the Starfall Isles are the last high ground left - until Ironveil Heavy Industries seized them, one island at a time. One island still stands. You are Tidewatch: one robot, one core, and whatever you can build before the tide comes. Metal Naval Combat: Saturation Strike is a real-time strategy game of factory building and naval missile defense. Mine, smelt and automate a whole war economy, fortify your island against wave after wave of incoming fire, then carry the war back across the sea. Start from nothing. Drive your tracked engineering robot and build every mine, smelter, refinery, electrolyzer and arsenal yourself. Automate everything. Three-layer conveyor belts, vacuum tubes, sorters, lifts, pipes and tanks - plus logistics drones that fly cargo between stations, and supply ships that bring materials from the islands behind the front. Your factory is your army. Iron, copper, coal, crystal and crude oil become interceptors, cruise missiles, ballistic missiles and mech drop pods - delivered by belt straight to the launchers. Saturation strikes. Cruise missiles, quadcopter swarms, kamikaze drones, anti-radiation missiles and ballistic warheads - often all at once, from every direction. Layer your defenses. Radar stations, missile-defense sites, CIWS guns and anti-drone lasers. Every interceptor is a real projectile on a real trajectory - and saturation really can break through. Take the gun yourself. Man the core turrets in first person - twin rapid-fire cannons, a high-energy laser or lock-on interceptor missiles - or raise your mech's energy shield over the base. Overwhelm them back. Open the strategic map, pick your targets and launch single shots or full salvos to saturate enemy air defenses. Boots on their beach. Airdrop mechs onto enemy shores, send recon drones ahead and learn to spot inflatable decoys. A real enemy economy. Ironveil's islands mine, refine and manufacture too. Destroy their arsenals and power plants, and their guns fall silent. An eleven-island campaign. Every island you take becomes your next base - and your next battlefield. Eleven directors, eleven ways to fight. Missile saturation, drone swarms, camouflage, fortress engineering, electronic warfare, heavy artillery and more. Each director has their own mechanics - and taunts you over intercepted radio. The Iron Throne. The final fortress hides inside a volcanic crater and fires the "Judgment" ballistic barrage every four minutes. Endless Defense unlocks after the campaign: hold any island you have conquered against ever-growing waves, boss offensives and Judgment barrages. Weekly Challenge with the same island and modifiers for everyone, ten optional modifiers with score multipliers, and local leaderboards with shareable score codes. [*]Interactive tutorials and an in-game strategy guide. [*]35 achievements and fully rebindable controls. [*]Voiced story, briefings and battlefield radio in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese.

title: Codys Collectathon
description: Everything collected. Oxygen running low. One jump left. The portal is your way out. First, you have to open it. Cody's Collectathon is a retro, single-screen platformer about finding a route, timing your jumps and knowing when to move. Collect every required item, activate the switches and reach the exit before Cody runs out of oxygen. 21 caverns. Plenty of ways to get into trouble. Explore frozen chambers, forest paths, an abandoned reactor and an ore mine. Watch patrolling enemies, cross crumbling floors and work your way around conveyors, ladders, webs and lasers. Normal mode starts you with five lives. Choose your kind of retro. Switch between 8-Bit Retro and 16-Bit Modern graphics. Keep the picture crisp, add CRT scanlines, choose smoothing or try the 8-bit monochrome display option. Play the main campaign for free. The free base game includes all 21 official caverns in Normal mode and both graphics styles. Optional paid DLC adds more ways to play: Pack 1: unlimited Arcade Continues, level skipping in supported non-Speedrun modes and official Speedrun mode. Pack 2: the Level Editor, local custom-level play, official Mirror Normal mode and community-made level-pack features. Pack 3: all features from Packs 1 and 2, including the combined Speedrun and Mirror modes. Create your own challenge. With Pack 2 or Pack 3, build collections of up to 50 caverns, customise 8-bit textures, sprites and portals, choose 16-bit visuals, backgrounds and weather, and test each room as you create it. Download compatible packs from the in-game catalogue or import a compatible ZIP. Community-made packs are freely distributed; Gazman Software does not charge for the packs themselves. DLC unlocks the editor and pack-management features. Game-pack export requires an internet connection, confirmation that you are 18 or older, and successful Test & Save completion of every level. Exports are limited to one game pack per 24 hours.

title: Realistic Battle Simulator
description: Pick a fighter or six for each side, call the winner, and watch. Spearmen hold against riders, archers cut down the unarmoured, a cannonball skips through a whole line. Every unit has its own armour, reach, speed and the foes it was made to beat - so every fight is a question with an answer. A war in twelve battles. Choose your hero and your banner, pull the lever to raise your host, and march down a painted road of fields, camps, shrines and sell-swords. Win spoils in the claw machine, buy and merge companies in camp, place them on the real field before every battle, and break the warlord in his own castle. Lose a field and you lose a banner; lose three and the war is over. Up to twenty thousand a side. Horns sound, bowmen loose on the volley, the lines meet in a cloud of dust, and the camera finds the moments that matter. When an army's nerve breaks, it runs. Paint armies with a brush. Drop a meteor, call down lightning, raise giants, and let the fallen rise as skeletons. Take hold of a single soldier and fight it out yourself. A new battle every day with a score to beat, a ranked ladder, tournaments and drafts, a table of who beats whom, a codex of every unit, and 51 medals to earn. Forge a unit - its look, its weapon, its numbers - and a battlefield tile by tile: rivers and bridges, walls and gates, hills and woods. Mod packs add units and fields of their own. 67 units in seven ages: knights and samurai, hoplites and ballistas, pirates and their cannon, farmers with pitchforks, orcs, trolls and skeletons, cavemen and sabre-tooths, riflemen and machine gunners 24 battlefields, from open meadows to river crossings, castles and night sieges, under any weather and at any hour From a duel of two to battles tens of thousands strong A roguelite campaign with five heroes, boons, relics, three warlords and three difficulties Replays with a timeline to scrub, battles to save and come back to, a photo mode Full controller support, made for the Steam Deck A no-blood setting, a colour-blind palette and a calm-screen setting Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud and Steam Leaderboards In English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Polish and Turkish The battles are done; the world is growing. Early Access brings more ages and units, more battlefields and more of the Warpath, shaped by what you tell us.

title: Visual Novel
description: New Capybara, June 1933. Prohibition, the mob, a funeral home doubling as a private investigator’s office—and a job that promises big money while almost certainly guaranteeing big trouble. You play as Sam Malone, the city’s most confident detective (according to his own statistics), and his assistant, Tommy—a man who genuinely tries to help, yet regularly ends up causing problems. Your decisions determine what you choose to trust and what you’re willing to sacrifice to get results. The plot branches out, with every choice shaping the course of your investigation. FEATURES A branching narrative with ten pivotal choices and multiple endings Dark humor born from the contrast between gritty noir and Tommy’s naivety A distinctive, vivid storytelling style and lively dialogue Atmospheric music that captures the spirit of 1930s American noir CONTENT WARNING The game contains scenes that some may find shocking. Not all of these appear in every playthrough. Murders involving firearms, including the shooting of characters Attacks with bladed weapons (a cleaver) and blows struck with the butt of a weapon Deaths of characters, often depicted in a humorous or grotesque manner Removal of gold teeth from the bodies of the deceased Human remains and bodies displayed in a sideshow attraction called the "Gallery of Mummies" Textual descriptions of animal carcasses and suspended bodies in a meatpacking plant’s cold storage unit Blood, a severed limb, and the mechanical processing of bodies at a meatpacking plant Deaths of animals and descriptions of their processing Abduction of a body, threats, and coercion, including scenes featuring armed individuals Human bodies drowned in a lake, and references to the concealment of bodies Insults and derogatory jokes directed at characters

title: Wild Crawlers: Auto Battler
description: Wild Crawlers is a roguelike autobattler about assembling a team of heroes and battling through monster-filled dungeons. Recruit new heroes, discover powerful loot, combine classes, and build unique synergies. Prepare your team, take on challenging encounters, and fight your way to the final bosses. No two runs are ever the same. Build Your Team Recruit heroes from the shop and create a team that fits your strategy. Each hero has a starting class, but you can unlock new class paths and take them in different directions. Experiment with class combinations, discover powerful synergies, and create unique team compositions with every run. Level Up Your Heroes Level up your heroes and unlock new upgrades at every step. Push them beyond their starting classes with unique talents and passive abilities. Make critical hits poison or burn enemies, gain stealth on kills, steal life, or restore mana. Each upgrade opens new possibilities, changes how your heroes fight, and creates new ways to build your team. Explore the Dungeons Explore dungeons packed with monsters, secrets, and loot. Discover treasure chests, collect hundreds of items and powerful relics, uncover hidden rewards, and take on optional challenges. Every room offers new discoveries and opportunities to shape your run. Master the Auto Battler Cast powerful spells to deal damage, heal your heroes, and turn the tide of battle. Choose the right moment to unleash your magic and overcome challenging enemies and bosses.
